Using it as a bludgeoning tool, Azyrran pounds at the reinforced barrels with determined fury, her shield protecting her from the worst of the spraying goop and flying splinters that're the result of her wrought destruction. She's certainly getting into it, isn't she? Azyrran tsks. "I was personally hoping to be able to fight something in all this, but I guess you made the right call, [pc.name]." If she'd wanted to fight, she should've said something; you would've sent her off with Gweyr to distract the cultists. "Oh yes, I should've said something. But then I think that old woman's just a little too abrasive for my tastes, and besides, if I went with her, I wouldn't get to be with you, hm?" How flattering. Come on, there's still a lot of the lower layer to take out before the entire pile can be toppled — and you'd appreciate it if she watched out for the goop. Just being close to the gray goop as it oozes from the broken barrels, sputtering and hissing on the snow as it evaporates into noxious fumes — it's making you light-headed and more than a little nauseous. "Aww. I'll cuddle you later and make it all better, won't I?" |Seeing you start on the stockpile, Berwyn pitches in as well — he doesn't say anything, but instead instructs his stone elemental to wade into the thick of things, pounding and smashing away at the barrels of goop with its heavy hammer hands. The dogboy summoner himself pitches in with a fire bolt here and there, softening up the reinforced containers for his elemental to finish off, keeping his attention focused on the bottom layer and letting barrels topple off the stack and smash onto the snowy ground. And truth be told, it's far more efficient than most other options you could come up with. Given that the golem is a literal stone, it's wading through the mess and smashing things up, completely impervious to the gray goop splattered all over its body and the splinters flying all over the place. Just being close to the gray goop as it oozes from the broken barrels, sputtering and hissing on the snow as it evaporates into noxious fumes — it's making you light-headed and more than a little nauseous. Berwyn's stone elemental, though, has no such problems, cutting an efficient swathe of destruction through the cultists' stockpile with its massive hands. Berwyn himself knows it too, and gives you a nod and self-satisfied smirk that's worth a thousand words. Maybe he's enjoying this a little too much, but then again, he's earned it. Best to get this over with before the cultists notice what the two of you are up to. |Seeing you start on the stockpile, Kiyoko starts on it from the other side — she doesn't get close to the goop barrels, but instead picks out several weak points in the pyramid stack which are supporting more weight than others, and starts incinerating them posthaste. The smell of burning wood and headed metal rises into the air along with plumes of white smoke as streams of ghostly blue foxfire roil outwards from her outstretched hands and engulf entire sides of the stockpile. She directs the flames in a broad sweeping motion, moving their point of impact across her target, spreading out the intense heat in the most expedient manner. It completely and utterly stinks — the goop vaporizes easily as it leaks from the scorched barrels, producing noxious fumes that rise along with the wood smoke in a blatantly visible plume. Just being close to the mess makes you light-headed and more than a little nauseous and you worry for your fox-wife and her constitution despite her keeping a healthy distance from the whole affair[kiyoko.pregStage 1 |, especially since she's carrying a kit in her womb ]. Still, the ball's already started rolling — the best thing for everyone would be to finish this as soon as possible to get away from it all. That, and be able to beat it before the cultists are able to pull themselves away from Gweyr's attack and deal with you. ] ] "

rows.original:
Just when you're getting into the swing of things, a shout breaks the rift's chill air — and this time it's not directed westwards, but right at you. Some of the demon cultists who've been hanging back throughout Gweyr's attack have finally noticed the state of their precious reserves and are attempting to peel away from the fray in order to deal with you. Gweyr hounds them all the while, jabbing and swinging with her bone spear while trying to herd them away from you in a last-ditch effort to buy you more time, but there're simply too many of them and now that the game's up there's no way to stop them. Giving the broken mess you've created one last smack for good measure and equally good luck, you turn and hightail it out of the cultist outpost before Tollus's goons can catch up with you[party.hasCompanions
        |, [party.compNames] hot on your heels
    ]. You run like you've never run in a long time, several of the demons spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, but the chase is half-hearted and you're able to throw them off your trail well before reaching the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon. Gasping and panting, [party.combatNames] take a moment to recover from your recent exertions, and it isn't long before Gweyr herself returns. 
    
    There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a nod and snorting.
    
    "Well, at least you're safe."
    
    You grin weakly. Well, best to leave the dangerous stuff to the most capable; she's got years of experience on you, right? Is she fine?
    
    Gweyr waves off your concern. "Couple of bruises. I've lived through worse in my stint down in the Heartlands. The bastards were all about using their new demonic powers that they forgot a good kick to the knee followed by another one to the goolies damn well does the same thing, and much faster.
rows.translation:
就在你渐渐进入状态的时候，一声呼喊打破了这片寒冷空气中的寂静——而这一次，呼喊并不是朝西边发出的，而是直接针对你的。那些在整个格温尔的进攻中一直躲在后面的恶魔教徒们，终于注意到了他们那些珍贵的储备物资的状况，于是他们试图脱离战斗，来对付你。 格温尔不断地追击他们，用她的骨制长矛刺击、挥舞，试图将他们从你身边驱散，为你们争取更多时间，但他们的数量实在太多，而且现在游戏已经结束了，再也无法阻止他们了。 为了彻底解决你造成的这一团糟，你又给了它最后一击，然后赶紧离开了那个邪教徒的前哨基地，以免Tollus的手下追上你。祝你好运！[party.hasCompanions
        |, [party.compNames] 紧追不舍
    ]你跑得仿佛已经很久没有运动过了。有几个恶魔展开了翅膀，开始在空中追捕你，但它们的追击显得并不认真，因此你在到达约定好的集合地点之前，就成功地摆脱了它们的追击。你喘着粗气，气喘吁吁地继续前进。 [party.combatNames] 请稍作休息，恢复一下刚才消耗的体力，不久之后，格温尔本人就会回来。

她的衣服和长矛上都沾满了血迹，她的部分毛发也已经被撕碎或剪短了，但至少那些血迹似乎并不是她的。 那头灰白的母狼盯着你看了一会儿，然后点了点头，发出一声哼声。

“好吧，至少你现在是安全的。”

你勉强笑了笑。嗯，把危险的事情交给最有能力的人来做才是最好的选择吧？她毕竟比你有多年的经验，对吧？ 她没事吧？

格温尔摆了摆手，表示你不必担心：“只是有些淤青而已。在我曾在心脏地带生活的那些日子里，我经历过更糟糕的事情。那些混蛋总是喜欢使用他们新获得的恶魔力量，但他们忘了——狠狠踢一下膝盖，然后再踢一下裆部，效果其实是一样的，而且速度更快得多。

        |, [party.compNames] hot on your heels
    ]. You run like you've never run in a long time, several of the demons spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, but the chase is half-hearted and you're able to throw them off your trail well before reaching the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon. Gasping and panting, [party.combatNames] take a moment to recover from your recent exertions, and it isn't long before Gweyr herself returns. 
    
    There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a nod and snorting.
    
    "Well, at least you're safe."
    
    You grin weakly. Well, best to leave the dangerous stuff to the most capable; she's got years of experience on you, right? Is she fine?
    
    Gweyr waves off your concern. "Couple of bruises. I've lived through worse in my stint down in the Heartlands. The bastards were all about using their new demonic powers that they forgot a good kick to the knee followed by another one to the goolies damn well does the same thing, and much faster.
    "

rows.original: [var0 |"Great work back there, [pc.name] — couldn't have done a better job myself. Maybe in my prime, but I'm not getting any younger these days; Garth was right to endorse you. With that kind of chaos, the bastards will be bemoaning allowing themselves to be drawn away from their outpost for days after this." Hah. It's nice to be recognised, especially from someone like her. Trying to hide her smile, Gweyr half-shrugs. "It wasn't bad working with you — together, we got something done. It should be enough to spur the cult into action for them to requisition more of those goop barrels from the source, but we'll see. Oh, and speaking of which..." The wolfess points behind her, and you realize she's got a couple of wax-wrapped packages stashed around the snowdrift. You look up at her with an eyebrow raised in question, and she grins. "While they were going after you, I snuck around and raided what I could from their stashes. I got a bunch of useful stuff, but this was snuck in with their food, and fuel. Wonder why it was there... doesn't matter, though. I've got no use for it as I am these days, but you're the adventuring type; you'll be able to find a creative way to put this to good use. Consider it your cut for a job well done." You receive 18x ovilixer. |"Decent work back there, not bad, not bad. That was about what I'd hoped for — they'll be bemoaning allowing themselves to be drawn away from their outpost for a little while yet. Were I younger, I might've been able to do better, but that was an age ago." Maybe you could've prepared better, but there's always overthinking it and not getting anything done in the end. Seriously, though... just decent work? Gweyr shrugs. "Never been in the habit of mincing my words. I've seen better... and I've seen worse, so that makes it decent. And coming from me, decent's pretty high praise, so I guess you can take it that way. It wasn't bad working with you — together, we got something done. It should be enough to spur the cult into action for them to requisition more of those goop barrels from the source, but we'll see. Oh, and speaking of which..." The wolfess points behind her, and you realize she's got a couple of wax-wrapped packages stashed around the snowdrift. You look up at her with an eyebrow raised in question, and she grins. "While they were going after you, I snuck around and raided what I could from their stashes. I was on campaign in the Heartlands once. Use captured supplies from enemies and all that, basic strategy for even the greenhorn leader that I was back then. I wasn't able to get very much, but still, every bit matters out here in the rift. Well, here's your cut for the job." You receive 3x bacon and 1x pupper pale ale. |"That being said, I do wish you'd been able to do more. You got some of them, all right, but it wasn't as much as I'd hoped." Maybe you could've prepared better, but there's always overthinking it and not getting anything done in the end. Gweyr scowls. "Well, I guess I overestimated you a bit, even if you do have Garth's endorsement. Back in the Crossed Swords I was the one who vetted new hires, not him... guess he hasn't gotten any better at it after all this time, which is why I had him keeping the books. Well, at least with your help I was able to put something done, which is better than nothing. It should be enough to spur the cult into action for them to requisition more of those goop barrels from the source, but I've got an uneasy feeling that it might be a toss-up. We'll see." ]
rows.translation: [var0 |干得真棒， [pc.name] 我自己也做不到比这更好的了。或许在我最鼎盛的时候还能做到，但现在我年纪也不小了；加斯推荐你确实做得对。面对那样的混乱局面，那些家伙以后肯定会后悔自己让队伍离开前哨站好几天。” 哈，能得到这样的认可真是太好了，尤其是来自像她这样的人。 格温尔努力掩饰着自己的笑容，半耸了耸肩说道：“和你一起工作确实不错——我们齐心协力，终于完成了一些事情。 应该 这一消息足以促使那些狂热者采取行动，从源头获取更多的那些黏稠液体容器，但我们还是拭目以待吧。哦，对了……” 狼女指了指身后的方向，你这才注意到她在雪堆里藏了几包用蜡纸包裹好的东西。 你挑起眉毛，带着疑问地看着她，而她则露出了微笑。 “当他们都在追你的时候，我偷偷溜过去，从他们的藏匿处拿了一些东西。我得到了一些很有用的东西，而这个则是和他们带来的食物、燃料一起偷偷带进来的。 不知道它为什么会出现在那里……不过也没关系。以我现在的状况，这个东西对我来说毫无用处，但你可是喜欢冒险的人，肯定能想出一些有创意的方法来利用它。就当这是对你出色表现的奖励吧。" 你将获得18个卵石提取器。 |干得不错，相当不错。正是我期望看到的结果——他们现在肯定会后悔自己暂时离开了自己的前哨站吧。如果我还年轻一些，或许能做得更好，但那已经是很久以前的事了。也许你本可以准备得更充分一些，但总是想得太多，结果什么都没做成。说真的……至少做到像样一点不就行了吗？ 格温尔耸了耸肩：“我从来就不习惯拐弯抹角。 我见过比这更好的，也见过比这更差的，所以这么说已经算是相当不错了。而对我来说，“相当不错”已经算是很高的评价了，所以你可以这么理解吧。和你们一起工作并没有什么不好的地方——我们共同努力，最终完成了一些事情。 应该 这一消息足以促使那些狂热者采取行动，从源头获取更多的那些黏稠液体容器，但我们还是拭目以待吧。哦，对了……” 狼女指了指身后的方向，你这才注意到她在雪堆里藏了几包用蜡纸包裹好的东西。 你挑起眉毛，带着疑问地看着她，而她则露出了微笑。 “当他们都在追捕你的时候，我就偷偷溜过去，把他们藏起来的东西尽可能多地偷了出来。我曾经在心脏地带参加过一次行动。 利用从敌人那里缴获的物资，这些就是即便是像我当时这样的新手领导者也能掌握的基本策略。我当时没能获得很多物资，但在这里，每一份资源都至关重要。好了，这就是你完成这项任务应得的报酬。" 你将获得3份培根和1杯小狗淡色艾尔啤酒。 |话虽如此，我确实希望你能做得更多一些。你确实完成了一些任务，但数量还是没有达到我的期望。” 也许你本可以准备得更充分一些，但有时候过度思考反而会导致最终什么事情都做不成。 格温尔皱起了眉头。“好吧，看来我确实高估你了……尽管你确实得到了加斯的推荐。在‘十字剑组织’的时候，负责审核新成员的人是我，而不是他……看来这些年来他的能力并没有有什么提高，所以才让他负责记账工作。 嗯，至少在你的帮助下，我终于完成了一些事情，这总比什么都不做好吧。 应该 这足以促使那些狂热爱好者采取行动，从源头获取更多的那种粘稠液体容器，但我有一种不安的感觉，结果可能会很难预料。让我们拭目以待吧。 ]

rows.original: "All right, if you're feeling up to it. [party.som |I'd say I'm better at the frontal approach myself, but if you think you can do a better job there I'm not going to stop you |I guess two hands will make more noise than one, and conversely, it'll be easier for me to get into their stockpile by my lonesome |I guess three hands will make a lot more noise than one, and conversely, it'll be easier for me to get into their stockpile by my lonesome ]. Garth taught me a couple of his tricks when we were younger, and even though my joints creak and ache more every year, I'm still up to the task of fooling a bunch of kids." So, what do you have to do? "You attack them as we planned; I'll wait for you to get them good before moving in myself. Once you begin the assault, start to disengage slowly — slowly is the keyword; draw them away as far as you can from their outpost and keep their attention so that they don't realize that they're being taken for a ride. The more of the cult creeps you're able to handle, the slower they'll be to shake off the ruse." All right. Long story short, beat the stuffing out of as many of them as you can before you're forced to retreat. "Buy me as much time as you can. One good thing about the jotuns — " she lifts up a flap of her thick coat to reveal several large cured bladders — "is that they make really good whale oil. I've tried, but never in all these years have I managed to render blubber like they do." Ah, you see. "There'll be a lot of smoke once the fire catches, so I'm going to be counting on you to keep their attention. Remember, you won't be able to defeat them all, not with more than a hundred out there, so disengage when you feel like you're reaching your limit and don't overstretch yourself. " Clapping you on the shoulder and giving it a squeeze, Gweyr nods. "Well, good luck. You'll need it." And with that, she's off. She doesn't sprint or run across the snow, but her stride is solid, her stance implacable. Just the sight of her moving is inspiring, and you can definitely see how she ended up leading a mercenary company — and how someone like Garth would get a stiffy for a big girl like her... Well, nothing for it. You gaze out over the snow and ice to the cultist outpost in the distance, [party.hasCompanions |give [party.compNames] a nod |steel yourself ], and start the approach from the west. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona etheryn berwyn kiyoko atugia einin azyrran quintillus |Cait doesn't say anything, but the fact that her usual cheery and carefree demeanour has evaporated in favor of thinned lips and a steely-eyed gaze tells you everything you need to know. She still hasn't given up on getting Calla back... that, or is bent on making those who did that to her sister pay. Actually, why not both? She can really be scary when she puts her mind to it, and the way she's brandishing her [cait.weapon] leaves little doubt that she means business. This is going to be cathartic for your pink kitten... |"Think we can take them?" Brint says, shielding his eyes as you march resolutely towards battle. "I figure we have a chance." Flattering, but Gweyr did say to start a fighting retreat the moment you engage with the cultists. You're not here to eradicate them or take the outpost; you're here to buy her time to sabotage the stockpile. He's got to keep that in mind and not get too into the spirit of things. "It just feels... awkward, you know? Fighting to deliberately lose? Every citizen of Khor'minos is raised on tales of the legionnaires' exploits on the field; the fact that they're more than a hundred to just us wouldn't have mattered any, according to the stories. Of course, we know they're just there to drum up support for the legion, but even so...!" You weren't born in Khor'minos or its surroundings, but you can try to imagine what Brint's getting at. "If any of the royal legions did what we're about to do, they'd have been decimated for cowardice — that means killing every tenth man in the surviving numbers. I just..." he rubs his temples. "I guess it just feels odd, that's all, like it's not something I should ever consider, or would have come up with on my own." |"Think we can take them?" Brienne says, shielding her eyes as you march resolutely towards battle. "I figure we have a chance." Flattering, but Gweyr did say to start a fighting retreat the moment you engage with the cultists. You're not here to eradicate them or take the outpost; you're here to buy her time to sabotage the stockpile. She's got to keep that in mind and not get too into the spirit of things. "It just feels... awkward, you know? Fighting to deliberately lose? Every citizen of Khor'minos is raised on tales of the legionnaires' exploits on the field; the fact that they're more than a hundred to just us wouldn't have mattered any, according to the stories. Of course, we know they're just there to drum up support for the legion, but even so...!" You weren't born in Khor'minos or its surroundings, but you can try to imagine what Brienne's getting at. "If any of the royal legions did what we're about to do, they'd have been decimated for cowardice — that means killing every tenth man in the surviving numbers. I just..." she rubs her temples. "I guess it just feels odd, that's all, like it's not something I should ever consider, or would have come up with on my own. Maybe if I'd been born a woman I might've a different perspective on it all — they do have different roles and all — but turning into one hasn't changed that in the least." |Arona shields her eyes, gazing out over the snow and ice as you march resolutely towards battle. There's a spring in her step that matches the tusky grin on her face, and the anticipation is oozing off her as she tightens her grip on her [arona.weapon], eager to get down to business already. "Shit, that's a lot of them out there," your orcish companions says gleefully. "The old dog wasn't kidding when she said the outpost must've at least a hundred of these fucker about. Shit, I'm already getting hard thinking about it." Ah, good old Arona. Well, she'll be able to scratch that itch of hers soon enough. Just... well, you know she's eager to get into the spirit of things, but you also want to draw the cultists away from the camp so Gweyr can get in and do her thing. So long as she doesn't lose herself too much in her battle-fury, things should be fine. "That's the good thing about being out here with you — never a boring moment, one way or the other. Hopefully there'll be some time to put one or two of these cumrags to their proper use afterward, but even if not... hoo, this is gonna be great." |Ryn shields her eyes, gazing out over the snow and ice as you march resolutely towards battle. Harrick wheels ominously overhead, the hawk silent for once as you approach the cultist outpost. "How are there this many of them and we simply didn't notice? Was Alissa that negligent?" Could be. Kas probably already had her tenterhooks into her sister, which would have made the problem all the more pronounced. Ryn looks away and swallows hard at that, but squares her shoulders and nods. "Okay. I'll Have Harrick pick out targets and harry them from a distance. He won't be able to do much actual damage, but I think he'll prove a fine distraction." You think back to every one of Harrick's shenanigans you've witnessed to date, and find yourself reaching the same conclusion as Ryn — one way or the other, this is going to be great. |Berwyn looks apprehensive as you march resolutely towards battle, the cultist outpost drawing closer with each step. With his stone elemental looming over the both of you as it pushes its way through the snow, you can't help but notice the usually confident and petulant dogboy looks subdued and pensive. Something on his mind? "The more I look at them, the more I get reminded of Mathia." Ah. That's all he needs to say — well then, he can take out his melancholy on them all he wants, and maybe get in a bit of practice. Practice for what... that's up to him to decide. Berwyn nods thoughtfully, and trudges on through the snow. |As the two of you trudge towards the cultist camp hand in hand, Kiyoko gives your fingers a reassuring squeeze. "Tense, beloved?" Of course you are — who wouldn't be when faced with such overwhelming odds? But the fact that she's here at your side makes it much easier to bear, which is what makes all the difference in the world. "Ah, you flatterer." Your fox-wife raises a finger to her lips in a coy smile, then [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |lowers the hand to run it across the gentle curve of her pregnant belly |lowers the hand to run it across the full curve of her hugely pregnant belly |boops you on the nose in a sudden fit of playfulness ]. "Come now. We struggle today to create a future for our children; what more meaningful endeavour could there be for us to pass through bitter cold, on the way to face insurmountable odds? A world for our children that is worth living in, is that not worth such an immense struggle? She's always got babies on the brain... "Alas, it is my nature, is it not?[pc.ra kitsune | As it is yours, too... ]" Kiyoko leans in against you, wrapping one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] about your calf, and the warm, sinuous sensation of her body sends shivers down your spine far more powerfully than the cold could ever manage. "Let us do our best, then." |"You ready back there?" There's a definite shift in Atugia's gait as you draw close to the cultist outpost, her footsteps landing heavier, her march more resolute. The snow gets pretty thick for her in places, especially given that she's a little short for the Marcher average, but your dullahan companion ploughs through the mess anyways, undeterred. Yeah, you're as ready as they get. You take it she'll be taking front and center? She sounds a bit tired there, so... A nod. Atugia briefly raises her eyes to the sky, then traces a rune in the air which glimmers faintly before dissipating. "Wouldn't have it any other way. Come on, [pc.name] — let's give them what-for." |You glance at Einin as the both of you slowly but surely make your way towards the cultist outpost, doing your best not to lose the advantage of surprise and retain the initiative here. Despite her short stature, your mecian companion has little problem with making her was across the snow, her light feet keeping her from sinking into the mounds and flurries. You've been around Einin long enough to be able to tell that she's looking a bit nervous. This isn't her kind of thing, is it? A frontal assault? She shakes her head, but quickly adds, "it's not that bad. I can flank them from the sides while you meet them head-on." If it were anyone else, you'd worry about splitting up against already overwhelming odds and potentially getting surrounded, but she's Einin. What's on her mind? A sigh. "I know that these aren't good people, [pc.name]. They threatened — no, still threaten Shayspa, they threaten Dad. And yet... given how many of them there are, I can't help but wonder how many of them were centaurs and homesteaders from out of Harvest Valley who were press-ganged into the cult's service. How many of them were people I may not have been really familiar with, but I at least knew in passing. It's been something that's been sticking with me a while now." Given the changes you've seen in people who were corrupted by Kasyrra, they almost certainly aren't the people she knew before. The peoples of Harvest Valley were simply... replaced with others who are perhaps similar, but not the same. You get that it's hard, but — " Einin hangs her head, but doesn't say anything until she finally squares her shoulders and takes a deep breath. "Come on, let's just get this over with. The world will be a better place for us having done this." |Azyrran is certainly in high spirits as you approach the cultist outpost, the hive knight taking front and center as she saunters confidently forward. Given that her colors make her stand out starkly against the whites and grays of the rift, she's clearly figured that if she's going to be drawing attention, she might as well do it in style. And hey, you have to agree — that's one eye-catching display she's got going over there. "Done admiring me?" Azyrran graces you with a small, sly smile. "Maybe if they stare at me as idiotically as you're doing, we can buy Gweyr all the time she needs without having to so much as land a blow." You have to chuckle at that. Ah, if only it were that easy. So long as she remembers that the main goal here is to create a diversion and not actually barrel headfirst into the fray... "Ah, I remember full well. You don't have to tell me what to do." Shielding her eyes, Azyrran gazes out over the last little bit of distance to the cultist outpost. "Regardless of our actual goal here, I'll be sure to make Mother proud of me." |So, your bunny-boy friend's going up for a match against his old organisation. Any deep thoughts he wants to share with you about it? His face plainly tells you he's got them, so there's no point denying it, but it's perfectly fine if he wants to keep them to himself. Quin laughs, even if there's no mirth in it. "What is this, some kind of pep talk?" Yes. It looks like he might be troubled. "I'm not troubled. I'm just... this wasn't the cult I joined back then. Everything's changed." Implying that things were better before? You're not sure that's right, given how given Gweyr's story Tollus was always a nasty piece of work even twenty years ago. "A group's more than just its leader, you know. Back then we were all under the impression it was all for fun and games, and then it wasn't." He swallows hard. "You know what? Never mind, you're right. I'm just making excuses for myself; I should've known better, kept myself in check instead of letting myself be lured in and staying in from sheer inertia. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's go in and wreck some shit." ] They [party.has einin etheryn |don't see you coming until it's almost too late, your companion[party.manyCompanions |s ] quickly and quietly getting into position for the initial assault. A sudden outcry rings out over the outpost as one of the lupine demons spots you — be it from sight, sound or scent, you have no idea — and howls, raising the alarm |see you coming from a reasonable distance and raise the alarm, but don't come out to meet you. No, no, that would be too easy — maybe they're wary of being drawn away from their posts, or maybe they're just afraid of you and your exploits to come forth and confront you. While the latter would be nice, it's probably too much to hope for, and [party.combatNames] break into a sprint, making a beeline for the outpost and trying to be as conspicuous as possible. Arrows fly out at you as a howl of alarm rises through the camp, echoing in the frigid air ]. Too late, too late — [party.combatNames] are already upon the outermost guards, weapons drawn and ready, minds steeled for the beatdown that's inevitably going to happen one way or the other. Only question at this point, really, is who's going to be receiving the pummelling... Nothing for it, then. Time to make Gweyr proud of the job you're doing here and defeat as many cultists as you can to buy her all the time you can before you inevitably have to draw back from your wounds, or disengage. It's a fight!

“想办法给我争取更多时间。关于那些巨兽，有一点好处是……”她掀起厚外套的一角，露出几个巨大的腌制膀胱，“它们能产出非常优质的鲸油。我试过自己制作，但这些年来，我从来没能像它们那样成功提取鲸脂。 啊，你懂的。 “等火势真正蔓延起来，现场会充满烟雾，所以我得靠你来吸引他们的注意力。记住，你不可能打败他们所有人——毕竟有上百个敌人，所以当你感到自己已经力不从心时，就立刻撤退，不要勉强自己。”格温尔拍了拍你的肩膀，然后点了点头。“好吧，祝你好运。你确实需要运气。 就这样，她出发了。她并没有在雪地上冲刺或奔跑，但她的步伐沉稳有力，姿态坚如磐石。仅仅看着她移动的样子，就让人感到振奋不已。你完全能够想象，她是如何最终领导起一支雇佣兵队伍的——也完全可以想象，像加斯这样的男人，为什么会为一个像她这样的大姑娘而心动…… 嗯，没什么别的办法了。你凝视着眼前的冰雪，望向远处那个邪教徒的前哨基地。 [party.hasCompanions |给予 你回想起迄今为止所目睹的哈里克的所有那些恶作剧，最终得出了与瑞恩相同的结论——不管怎样，这次行动肯定会有所成效。 很棒. |当你毅然走向战场时，贝尔温显得十分忧心忡忡。随着你每迈出一步，那个邪教徒的前哨基地就离你们更近了。那头拥有石元素力量的巨兽在雪地中艰难前行，它的身影笼罩在你们两人之上，你不禁注意到，这个平时总是自信又任性的狗男孩此刻显得格外沮丧和沉思。 他在想些什么吗？ 收获谷的居民们， einfach……被其他一些人取代了，这些新来的人或许与他们有些相似，但其实并不完全一样。你明白这有多难吧，但是——” 艾宁低下了头，没有说任何话，直到最终她挺直肩膀，深吸了一口气。 快点吧，把这件事赶紧解决掉。只要我们做了这件事，这个世界会变得更好。 |当你接近那些邪教徒的前哨基地时，阿兹兰显然心情非常愉悦。那位蜂群骑士走在最前面，自信地大步前行。由于她的服装颜色与裂隙中的白色和灰色形成了鲜明的对比，她显然也明白：如果自己想要吸引别人的注意，那么最好以一种引人注目的方式来做到这一点。 嘿，你得承认——她那身装扮确实非常抢眼。 rows.raw: " "All right, if you're feeling up to it. [party.som |I'd say I'm better at the frontal approach myself, but if you think you can do a better job there I'm not going to stop you |I guess two hands will make more noise than one, and conversely, it'll be easier for me to get into their stockpile by my lonesome |I guess three hands will make a lot more noise than one, and conversely, it'll be easier for me to get into their stockpile by my lonesome ]. Garth taught me a couple of his tricks when we were younger, and even though my joints creak and ache more every year, I'm still up to the task of fooling a bunch of kids." So, what do you have to do? "You attack them as we planned; I'll wait for you to get them good before moving in myself. Once you begin the assault, start to disengage slowly — slowly is the keyword; draw them away as far as you can from their outpost and keep their attention so that they don't realize that they're being taken for a ride. The more of the cult creeps you're able to handle, the slower they'll be to shake off the ruse." All right. Long story short, beat the stuffing out of as many of them as you can before you're forced to retreat. "Buy me as much time as you can. One good thing about the jotuns — " she lifts up a flap of her thick coat to reveal several large cured bladders — "is that they make really good whale oil. I've tried, but never in all these years have I managed to render blubber like they do." Ah, you see. "There'll be a lot of smoke once the fire catches, so I'm going to be counting on you to keep their attention. Remember, you won't be able to defeat them all, not with more than a hundred out there, so disengage when you feel like you're reaching your limit and don't overstretch yourself. " Clapping you on the shoulder and giving it a squeeze, Gweyr nods. "Well, good luck. You'll need it." And with that, she's off. She doesn't sprint or run across the snow, but her stride is solid, her stance implacable. Just the sight of her moving is inspiring, and you can definitely see how she ended up leading a mercenary company — and how someone like Garth would get a stiffy for a big girl like her... Well, nothing for it. You gaze out over the snow and ice to the cultist outpost in the distance, [party.hasCompanions |give [party.compNames] a nod |steel yourself ], and start the approach from the west. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona etheryn berwyn kiyoko atugia einin azyrran quintillus |Cait doesn't say anything, but the fact that her usual cheery and carefree demeanour has evaporated in favor of thinned lips and a steely-eyed gaze tells you everything you need to know. She still hasn't given up on getting Calla back... that, or is bent on making those who did that to her sister pay. Actually, why not both? She can really be scary when she puts her mind to it, and the way she's brandishing her [cait.weapon] leaves little doubt that she means business. This is going to be cathartic for your pink kitten... |"Think we can take them?" Brint says, shielding his eyes as you march resolutely towards battle. "I figure we have a chance." Flattering, but Gweyr did say to start a fighting retreat the moment you engage with the cultists. You're not here to eradicate them or take the outpost; you're here to buy her time to sabotage the stockpile. He's got to keep that in mind and not get too into the spirit of things. "It just feels... awkward, you know? Fighting to deliberately lose? Every citizen of Khor'minos is raised on tales of the legionnaires' exploits on the field; the fact that they're more than a hundred to just us wouldn't have mattered any, according to the stories. Of course, we know they're just there to drum up support for the legion, but even so...!" You weren't born in Khor'minos or its surroundings, but you can try to imagine what Brint's getting at. "If any of the royal legions did what we're about to do, they'd have been decimated for cowardice — that means killing every tenth man in the surviving numbers. I just..." he rubs his temples. "I guess it just feels odd, that's all, like it's not something I should ever consider, or would have come up with on my own." |"Think we can take them?" Brienne says, shielding her eyes as you march resolutely towards battle. "I figure we have a chance." Flattering, but Gweyr did say to start a fighting retreat the moment you engage with the cultists. You're not here to eradicate them or take the outpost; you're here to buy her time to sabotage the stockpile. She's got to keep that in mind and not get too into the spirit of things. "It just feels... awkward, you know? Fighting to deliberately lose? Every citizen of Khor'minos is raised on tales of the legionnaires' exploits on the field; the fact that they're more than a hundred to just us wouldn't have mattered any, according to the stories. Of course, we know they're just there to drum up support for the legion, but even so...!" You weren't born in Khor'minos or its surroundings, but you can try to imagine what Brienne's getting at. "If any of the royal legions did what we're about to do, they'd have been decimated for cowardice — that means killing every tenth man in the surviving numbers. I just..." she rubs her temples. "I guess it just feels odd, that's all, like it's not something I should ever consider, or would have come up with on my own. Maybe if I'd been born a woman I might've a different perspective on it all — they do have different roles and all — but turning into one hasn't changed that in the least." |Arona shields her eyes, gazing out over the snow and ice as you march resolutely towards battle. There's a spring in her step that matches the tusky grin on her face, and the anticipation is oozing off her as she tightens her grip on her [arona.weapon], eager to get down to business already. "Shit, that's a lot of them out there," your orcish companions says gleefully. "The old dog wasn't kidding when she said the outpost must've at least a hundred of these fucker about. Shit, I'm already getting hard thinking about it." Ah, good old Arona. Well, she'll be able to scratch that itch of hers soon enough. Just... well, you know she's eager to get into the spirit of things, but you also want to draw the cultists away from the camp so Gweyr can get in and do her thing. So long as she doesn't lose herself too much in her battle-fury, things should be fine. "That's the good thing about being out here with you — never a boring moment, one way or the other. Hopefully there'll be some time to put one or two of these cumrags to their proper use afterward, but even if not... hoo, this is gonna be great." |Ryn shields her eyes, gazing out over the snow and ice as you march resolutely towards battle. Harrick wheels ominously overhead, the hawk silent for once as you approach the cultist outpost. "How are there this many of them and we simply didn't notice? Was Alissa that negligent?" Could be. Kas probably already had her tenterhooks into her sister, which would have made the problem all the more pronounced. Ryn looks away and swallows hard at that, but squares her shoulders and nods. "Okay. I'll Have Harrick pick out targets and harry them from a distance. He won't be able to do much actual damage, but I think he'll prove a fine distraction." You think back to every one of Harrick's shenanigans you've witnessed to date, and find yourself reaching the same conclusion as Ryn — one way or the other, this is going to be great. |Berwyn looks apprehensive as you march resolutely towards battle, the cultist outpost drawing closer with each step. With his stone elemental looming over the both of you as it pushes its way through the snow, you can't help but notice the usually confident and petulant dogboy looks subdued and pensive. Something on his mind? "The more I look at them, the more I get reminded of Mathia." Ah. That's all he needs to say — well then, he can take out his melancholy on them all he wants, and maybe get in a bit of practice. Practice for what... that's up to him to decide. Berwyn nods thoughtfully, and trudges on through the snow. |As the two of you trudge towards the cultist camp hand in hand, Kiyoko gives your fingers a reassuring squeeze. "Tense, beloved?" Of course you are — who wouldn't be when faced with such overwhelming odds? But the fact that she's here at your side makes it much easier to bear, which is what makes all the difference in the world. "Ah, you flatterer." Your fox-wife raises a finger to her lips in a coy smile, then [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |lowers the hand to run it across the gentle curve of her pregnant belly |lowers the hand to run it across the full curve of her hugely pregnant belly |boops you on the nose in a sudden fit of playfulness ]. "Come now. We struggle today to create a future for our children; what more meaningful endeavour could there be for us to pass through bitter cold, on the way to face insurmountable odds? A world for our children that is worth living in, is that not worth such an immense struggle? She's always got babies on the brain... "Alas, it is my nature, is it not?[pc.ra kitsune | As it is yours, too... ]" Kiyoko leans in against you, wrapping one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] about your calf, and the warm, sinuous sensation of her body sends shivers down your spine far more powerfully than the cold could ever manage. "Let us do our best, then." |"You ready back there?" There's a definite shift in Atugia's gait as you draw close to the cultist outpost, her footsteps landing heavier, her march more resolute. The snow gets pretty thick for her in places, especially given that she's a little short for the Marcher average, but your dullahan companion ploughs through the mess anyways, undeterred. Yeah, you're as ready as they get. You take it she'll be taking front and center? She sounds a bit tired there, so... A nod. Atugia briefly raises her eyes to the sky, then traces a rune in the air which glimmers faintly before dissipating. "Wouldn't have it any other way. Come on, [pc.name] — let's give them what-for." |You glance at Einin as the both of you slowly but surely make your way towards the cultist outpost, doing your best not to lose the advantage of surprise and retain the initiative here. Despite her short stature, your mecian companion has little problem with making her was across the snow, her light feet keeping her from sinking into the mounds and flurries. You've been around Einin long enough to be able to tell that she's looking a bit nervous. This isn't her kind of thing, is it? A frontal assault? She shakes her head, but quickly adds, "it's not that bad. I can flank them from the sides while you meet them head-on." If it were anyone else, you'd worry about splitting up against already overwhelming odds and potentially getting surrounded, but she's Einin. What's on her mind? A sigh. "I know that these aren't good people, [pc.name]. They threatened — no, still threaten Shayspa, they threaten Dad. And yet... given how many of them there are, I can't help but wonder how many of them were centaurs and homesteaders from out of Harvest Valley who were press-ganged into the cult's service. How many of them were people I may not have been really familiar with, but I at least knew in passing. It's been something that's been sticking with me a while now." Given the changes you've seen in people who were corrupted by Kasyrra, they almost certainly aren't the people she knew before. The peoples of Harvest Valley were simply... replaced with others who are perhaps similar, but not the same. You get that it's hard, but — " Einin hangs her head, but doesn't say anything until she finally squares her shoulders and takes a deep breath. "Come on, let's just get this over with. The world will be a better place for us having done this." |Azyrran is certainly in high spirits as you approach the cultist outpost, the hive knight taking front and center as she saunters confidently forward. Given that her colors make her stand out starkly against the whites and grays of the rift, she's clearly figured that if she's going to be drawing attention, she might as well do it in style. And hey, you have to agree — that's one eye-catching display she's got going over there. "Done admiring me?" Azyrran graces you with a small, sly smile. "Maybe if they stare at me as idiotically as you're doing, we can buy Gweyr all the time she needs without having to so much as land a blow." You have to chuckle at that. Ah, if only it were that easy. So long as she remembers that the main goal here is to create a diversion and not actually barrel headfirst into the fray... "Ah, I remember full well. You don't have to tell me what to do." Shielding her eyes, Azyrran gazes out over the last little bit of distance to the cultist outpost. "Regardless of our actual goal here, I'll be sure to make Mother proud of me." |So, your bunny-boy friend's going up for a match against his old organisation. Any deep thoughts he wants to share with you about it? His face plainly tells you he's got them, so there's no point denying it, but it's perfectly fine if he wants to keep them to himself. Quin laughs, even if there's no mirth in it. "What is this, some kind of pep talk?" Yes. It looks like he might be troubled. "I'm not troubled. I'm just... this wasn't the cult I joined back then. Everything's changed." Implying that things were better before? You're not sure that's right, given how given Gweyr's story Tollus was always a nasty piece of work even twenty years ago. "A group's more than just its leader, you know. Back then we were all under the impression it was all for fun and games, and then it wasn't." He swallows hard. "You know what? Never mind, you're right. I'm just making excuses for myself; I should've known better, kept myself in check instead of letting myself be lured in and staying in from sheer inertia. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's go in and wreck some shit." ] They [party.has einin etheryn |don't see you coming until it's almost too late, your companion[party.manyCompanions |s ] quickly and quietly getting into position for the initial assault. A sudden outcry rings out over the outpost as one of the lupine demons spots you — be it from sight, sound or scent, you have no idea — and howls, raising the alarm |see you coming from a reasonable distance and raise the alarm, but don't come out to meet you. No, no, that would be too easy — maybe they're wary of being drawn away from their posts, or maybe they're just afraid of you and your exploits to come forth and confront you. While the latter would be nice, it's probably too much to hope for, and [party.combatNames] break into a sprint, making a beeline for the outpost and trying to be as conspicuous as possible. Arrows fly out at you as a howl of alarm rises through the camp, echoing in the frigid air ]. Too late, too late — [party.combatNames] are already upon the outermost guards, weapons drawn and ready, minds steeled for the beatdown that's inevitably going to happen one way or the other. Only question at this point, really, is who's going to be receiving the pummelling... Nothing for it, then. Time to make Gweyr proud of the job you're doing here and defeat as many cultists as you can to buy her all the time you can before you inevitably have to draw back from your wounds, or disengage. It's a fight! "

rows.original: [var0 |Ouch, this is going badly, really badly — while you'd expected overwhelming opposition, you hadn't expected them to come at you this forcefully. Sure, you've created a huge ruckus and done a little damage to the exterior of the cultists' outpost, but haven't actually managed to draw them very far away from their stations. [party.hasCompanions |With a brief nod to [party.compNames] |Seeing that you've done all you can with what strength you have ], you quickly make to fall back — it's not so much a fighting retreat as much as it's a rout consisting of [party.som |your lonesome |two people |three people ]. While you don't actually turn tail on the cultists to run — that would be a really bad idea — it's close. That stinging sensation you're feeling right now? Oh, it's shame. Sensing their victory, a dozen or two of the cultists emerge from the gates in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you're forced to empty the contents of your coinpurse in the hopes that greed will win out over lust. Who knows how these low-level demons think, anyway? It works, though; enough of Tollus's goons drop what they're doing, succumbing to the baser of their natures and grubbing over the scattered multitude of coins in the snow; their fellows scream and curse at them to keep up the pursuit, but their words fall on deaf ears. [pc.isDK |Sure, you can't help but feel it yourself when all that money leaves your person |Running like this with the last of your strength can't be good for you ], but better that than letting them catch up to you in your retreat, right? You run like you've never run in a long time, several of the demons spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, but thanks to the additional distraction of your hard-fought money you're barely able to throw them off your trail before reaching the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon. Gasping and panting, [party.combatNames] take a moment to recover from your recent exertions, and it isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking worse for the wear herself. There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a scowl and snorting. "Well, at least you're safe. What the fuck was that all about, were you even trying?" Seeing your current state, the wolfess' expression softens a little. "Well, I guess I overestimated you a bit, even if you do have Garth's endorsement. Back in the Crossed Swords I was the one who vetted new hires, not him... guess he hasn't gotten any better at it after all this time, which is why I had him keeping the books." You grin weakly. Is she fine? Gweyr's scowl returns, and she waves off your concern. "Couple of bruises; once you split and ran, I had to fight off a few of them on my own to get out as well. I've lived through worse in my stint down in the Heartlands — the bastards were all about using their new demonic powers that they forgot a good kick to the knee followed by another one to the goolies damn well does the same thing, and much faster. "Well, at least with your help I was able to put something done, which is better than nothing. Given that the fire was spreading merrily when I left, the dozen or so goop barrels I managed to light up should be enough to spur the cult into requisitioning more from the source, but I've got an uneasy feeling that it might be a toss-up. We'll see." Look, you're sorry that you didn't perform as well as — "Talk's cheap. Do better next time." |It looks like you've created enough of a ruckus — with a handful of Tollus's demon cultists sprawled out on the snow and the rest of them starting to devote their efforts to containing you in earnest, it's time to beat a fighting retreat before they manage to flank and surround you. [party.hasCompanions |Signaling to [party.compNames] |Getting into position ] to fall back, you disengage from the fray, leading the cultists on for as long as you can. Seeing you retreat from the battle and thinking they've won, several of their number emerge from the gates in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you do your best to draw them as far from their posts as you can before they realize what you're really up to. It's not as clean a disengagement as you'd have preferred, but you do the job well enough; having several of their number out cold on the snow gives the smarter of the demonic cultists pause as to whether pursuing you all the way into the open is a good idea. The bulk of them, though, don't give a shit and flow outwards, spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, succumbing to the baser of their natures. Demons in general really don't have very good impulse control, as you've noticed... a few close the distance in their sheer eagerness to get at you, but the sprint's tired them out and you're able to dispatch them relatively easily[party.hasCompanions |, working with [party.compNames] at your side ]. And then, from the southern end of the cultist outpost, a roar of flame accompanied by a plume of light gray smoke — Gweyr must have done her thing, which means you need to buy her time to escape. That gets the attention of the cultists still in camp; they scream and curse at their fellows to drop the pursuit and deal with the situation back at base, but their words fall on deaf ears. However, that's the final impetus you need to be able to throw off your pursuers and disappear into the icy wastes, zigzagging in a couple of detours. Eventually, though, you reach the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon, and [party.som | |the both of |all of ]you take a moment to recover from your recent exertions. It isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking worse for the wear herself. There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a nod. "You're fine?" You are. How did it go on her end of things? "Decently. You did a good enough job that I was able to get in close and lob some of the whale oil into the stockpile; didn't have enough time to spread it out as well as I'd have liked to, but it'll have to do. That was about what I'd hoped for — they'll be bemoaning allowing themselves to be drawn away from their stations for a little while yet. Were I younger, I might've been able to do better, but that was an age ago." You chuckle dryly and shake your head. Decently, huh? It sure didn't feel like just a decent attempt back there, but she's the old dog here Gweyr shrugs. "Never been in the habit of mincing my words. I've seen better... and I've seen worse, so that makes it decent. And coming from me, decent's pretty high praise, so I guess you can give yourself a pat on the back if you really need your ego stroked. It wasn't bad working with you — together, we got something done. It should be enough to spur the cult into action for them to requisition more of those goop barrels from the source, but we'll see." |Looking around at the cultists sprawled out cold on the snow and ice, with more starting to flood at you from the gates, you think it's about time you beat a fighting retreat. Enough of Tollus's goons have been taken out for the remainder to focus their ire on you — which is exactly the kind of opening Gweyr needs to get her job done, and done well. [party.hasCompanions |Signaling to [party.compNames] |Getting into position ]to fall back, you disengage from the fray, leading the cultists on for as long as you can, drawing them out so they don't get the chance to flank and surround you. Seeing you retreat from the battle and thinking they've finally won despite their losses, several of their number emerge from the gates in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you do your best to bait them as far from their posts as you can before they realize what you're really up to. It's a pretty clean disengagement as far as you're concerned, not exactly textbook but still more than sufficient; having several of their number out cold on the snow gives the smarter of the demonic cultists pause as to whether pursuing you all the way into the open is a good idea. The bulk of them, though, don't give a shit and flow outwards, spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, succumbing to the baser of their natures. Demons in general really don't have very good impulse control, as you've noticed... a few close the distance in their sheer eagerness to get at you, but the sprint's tired them out and you're able to dispatch them relatively easily[party.hasCompanions |, working with [party.compNames] at your side ]. And then, from the southern end of the cultist outpost, a roar of flame accompanied by a plume of light gray smoke — Gweyr must have done her thing, which means you need to buy her time to escape. That gets the attention of the cultists still in camp; they scream and curse at their fellows to drop the pursuit and deal with the situation back at base, but their words fall on deaf ears. However, that's the final impetus you need to be able to throw off your pursuers and disappear into the icy wastes, zigzagging in a couple of detours. Eventually, though, you reach the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon, and [party.som | |the both of |all of ]you take a moment to recover from your recent exertions. It isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking worse for the wear herself. There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a nod and smile. "You're fine?" You are. How did it go on her end of things? "Not bad, not bad. You did a good enough job that I was able to get in close and get a good even coating of whale oil on the stockpile; they had a nice little bonfire going on in the middle of their camp when I left. That was about what I'd hoped for — they'll be bemoaning allowing themselves to be drawn away from their stations for a little while yet. Were I younger, I might've been able to do better, but that was an age ago." You chuckle dryly and shake your head. She can't be as old as she says she is if she's still able to pull this off. Gweyr's smile widens. "It wasn't bad working with you — together, we got something done. It should be enough to spur the cult into action for them to requisition more of those goop barrels from the source, given the destruction I was able to cause. Oh, and speaking of which..." The wolfess points behind her, and you realize she's got a couple of wax-wrapped packages stashed around the snowdrift. You look up at her with an eyebrow raised in question, and she grins. "While they were going after you, I snuck around and raided what I could from their stashes. I was on campaign in the Heartlands once — use captured supplies from enemies and all that, basic strategy for even the greenhorn leader that I was back then. I wasn't able to get very much, but still, every bit matters out here in the rift. Well, here's your cut for the job." You receive 3x winterstem and 9x ovilixer. |Looking around at the cultists sprawled out cold on the snow and ice, you can only shake your head at the sheer chaos you've wrought in so short a time. However, the remaining cultists are starting to regroup and flood at you from the gates, completely devoid of fear or even self-preservation — your victory here has only drawn ever more ire towards you, and you think it's about time you beat a fighting retreat. Their attention is completely and utterly focused upon [party.combatNames], which is exactly the kind of opening Gweyr needs to get her job done, and done well. [party.hasCompanions |Signaling to [party.compNames] |Getting into position ]to fall back, you disengage from the fray, leading the cultists on for as long as you can, drawing them out so they don't get the chance to flank and surround you. Seeing you retreat from the battle and thinking they've finally won despite their losses, several of their number lope across the ice or take to the air in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you do your best to bait them as far from their posts as you can before they realize what you're really up to. It's a pretty clean disengagement as far as you're concerned, as textbook as they come; [party.hasCompanions |you stand shoulder to shoulder with [party.compNames] |you keep a steady stance and pace ] as you back away over the snow and ice. Demons in general really don't have very good impulse control, as you've noticed... a few close the distance in their sheer eagerness to get at you, but the sprint's tired them out and you're able to dispatch them relatively easily[party.hasCompanions |, working with [party.compNames] at your side ]. And then, from the southern end of the cultist outpost, an immense roar of flame accompanied by a plume of light gray smoke that towers to the sky — Gweyr must have done her thing, which means you need to buy her time to escape. That gets the attention of every single cultist; they drop their pursuit of you in order to deal with the situation back at base, and that lets you harry them a final time as they turn tail. It isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking exhilarated but none the worse for the wear. rows.translation: [var0 |哎哟，事情发展得不太妙啊…… 真的 糟糕——虽然你预料到会遇到强烈的反对，但没想到他们会以如此激烈的方式攻击你。当然，你确实制造了一些骚动，也对那些邪教徒的前哨基地造成了一些破坏，但实际上并没有让他们远离他们的据点。 [party.hasCompanions |简单地点了点头表示认可。 [party.compNames] |看到你已经尽了自己所能去做了。 ]你迅速撤退了——这与其说是一次战斗中的退却，不如说是一场溃败。 [party.som |你的孤独 |两个人 |三个人 ]虽然你并没有真的转身逃跑——那样做确实是个糟糕的主意——但你的反应已经很接近逃跑了。 现在你感受到的那种刺痛感？哦，那其实是羞耻感在作祟。 那些邪教徒察觉到自己已经获胜，于是有十几个人从大门里冲了出来追你，他们的目的无疑是要把你变成他们的玩物，甚至做出更恶劣的事情；你不得不把钱袋里的钱全部交出来，只希望贪婪能够战胜他们的欲望。 谁知道这些低等恶魔到底是怎么想的呢？不过，这个办法确实有效——足够多的托卢斯的打手们会抛下手头的事情，屈服于他们最原始的本能，开始在雪地里翻找那些散落的硬币；他们的同伴们则大声呼喊、咒骂他们，让他们继续追击，但这些话对他们来说根本毫无意义。 [pc.isDK |当然，当那些钱从你手中离开时，你也会不由得有这种感觉。 |这样拼命奔跑，耗尽最后的体力，肯定对身体健康没有好处。 ]不过，总比让他们在你在隐蔽处休息时追上你要好，对吧？你跑得飞快，仿佛已经很久没有跑步过了。有几个恶魔展开了翅膀开始追捕你，但多亏了你辛苦赚来的那些钱所带来的干扰，你才勉强成功地摆脱了它们的追击，最终到达了你们约定好的会合地点——那堆雪堆旁。你气喘吁吁，大口喘着粗气…… [party.combatNames] 请稍作休息，恢复一下刚才消耗的体力。不久之后，格温尔本人也回来了，她的样子同样显得疲惫不堪。她的衣服和长矛上都沾满了血迹，部分毛发也被撕碎或剪短了，不过至少那些血迹似乎并不是她的。这只灰白的母狼盯着你看了一会儿，然后皱起了眉头，发出一声哼声。 rows.raw: " [var0 |Ouch, this is going badly, really badly — while you'd expected overwhelming opposition, you hadn't expected them to come at you this forcefully. Sure, you've created a huge ruckus and done a little damage to the exterior of the cultists' outpost, but haven't actually managed to draw them very far away from their stations. [party.hasCompanions |With a brief nod to [party.compNames] |Seeing that you've done all you can with what strength you have ], you quickly make to fall back — it's not so much a fighting retreat as much as it's a rout consisting of [party.som |your lonesome |two people |three people ]. While you don't actually turn tail on the cultists to run — that would be a really bad idea — it's close. That stinging sensation you're feeling right now? Oh, it's shame. Sensing their victory, a dozen or two of the cultists emerge from the gates in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you're forced to empty the contents of your coinpurse in the hopes that greed will win out over lust. Who knows how these low-level demons think, anyway? It works, though; enough of Tollus's goons drop what they're doing, succumbing to the baser of their natures and grubbing over the scattered multitude of coins in the snow; their fellows scream and curse at them to keep up the pursuit, but their words fall on deaf ears. [pc.isDK |Sure, you can't help but feel it yourself when all that money leaves your person |Running like this with the last of your strength can't be good for you ], but better that than letting them catch up to you in your retreat, right? You run like you've never run in a long time, several of the demons spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, but thanks to the additional distraction of your hard-fought money you're barely able to throw them off your trail before reaching the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon. Gasping and panting, [party.combatNames] take a moment to recover from your recent exertions, and it isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking worse for the wear herself. There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a scowl and snorting. "Well, at least you're safe. What the fuck was that all about, were you even trying?" Seeing your current state, the wolfess' expression softens a little. "Well, I guess I overestimated you a bit, even if you do have Garth's endorsement. Back in the Crossed Swords I was the one who vetted new hires, not him... guess he hasn't gotten any better at it after all this time, which is why I had him keeping the books." You grin weakly. Is she fine? Gweyr's scowl returns, and she waves off your concern. "Couple of bruises; once you split and ran, I had to fight off a few of them on my own to get out as well. I've lived through worse in my stint down in the Heartlands — the bastards were all about using their new demonic powers that they forgot a good kick to the knee followed by another one to the goolies damn well does the same thing, and much faster. "Well, at least with your help I was able to put something done, which is better than nothing. Given that the fire was spreading merrily when I left, the dozen or so goop barrels I managed to light up should be enough to spur the cult into requisitioning more from the source, but I've got an uneasy feeling that it might be a toss-up. We'll see." Look, you're sorry that you didn't perform as well as — "Talk's cheap. Do better next time." |It looks like you've created enough of a ruckus — with a handful of Tollus's demon cultists sprawled out on the snow and the rest of them starting to devote their efforts to containing you in earnest, it's time to beat a fighting retreat before they manage to flank and surround you. [party.hasCompanions |Signaling to [party.compNames] |Getting into position ] to fall back, you disengage from the fray, leading the cultists on for as long as you can. Seeing you retreat from the battle and thinking they've won, several of their number emerge from the gates in pursuit, no doubt intent on making you their fucktoy or worse; you do your best to draw them as far from their posts as you can before they realize what you're really up to. It's not as clean a disengagement as you'd have preferred, but you do the job well enough; having several of their number out cold on the snow gives the smarter of the demonic cultists pause as to whether pursuing you all the way into the open is a good idea. The bulk of them, though, don't give a shit and flow outwards, spreading their wings and taking to the air as they pursue you, succumbing to the baser of their natures. Demons in general really don't have very good impulse control, as you've noticed... a few close the distance in their sheer eagerness to get at you, but the sprint's tired them out and you're able to dispatch them relatively easily[party.hasCompanions |, working with [party.compNames] at your side ]. And then, from the southern end of the cultist outpost, a roar of flame accompanied by a plume of light gray smoke — Gweyr must have done her thing, which means you need to buy her time to escape. That gets the attention of the cultists still in camp; they scream and curse at their fellows to drop the pursuit and deal with the situation back at base, but their words fall on deaf ears. However, that's the final impetus you need to be able to throw off your pursuers and disappear into the icy wastes, zigzagging in a couple of detours. Eventually, though, you reach the snowdrift that you agreed to reconvene upon, and [party.som | |the both of |all of ]you take a moment to recover from your recent exertions. It isn't long before Gweyr herself returns, looking worse for the wear herself. There's blood on her clothes and spear and some of her fur is ragged and cut short, but at least the bloodstains don't appear to be hers. The grizzled wolfess eyes you before giving you a nod. "You're fine?" You are. How did it go on her end of things? "Decently. You did a good enough job that I was able to get in close and lob some of the whale oil into the stockpile; didn't have enough time to spread it out as well as I'd have liked to, but it'll have to do. That was about what I'd hoped for — they'll be bemoaning allowing themselves to be drawn away from their stations for a little while yet. Were I younger, I might've been able to do better, but that was an age ago." You chuckle dryly and shake your head. Decently, huh? It sure didn't feel like just a decent attempt back there, but she's the old dog here Gweyr shrugs. "Never been in the habit of mincing my words. I've seen better... and I've seen worse, so that makes it decent. And coming from me, decent's pretty high praise, so I guess you can give yourself a pat on the back if you really need your ego stroked. It wasn't bad working with you — together, we got something done. rows.original:
So... what now?
    
    She jerks a thumb over her shoulder. "After this, I think we're all going to need a little breather, so if you don't mind I'm going to crawl back to my cave and lick my wounds; I'd invite you to come with, but I don't have much in the way of comforts. Come and find me when you're rested up and ready for the next step of the plan."
    
    With that, Gweyr turns tail and leaves, barely leaving tracks in the snow despite her weight and size. You watch her go, disappearing into the endless white and gray without a trace, then get ready to leave yourself. Going to catch your death of cold if you sit still for too long...
rows.translation:
那么……现在该怎么办呢？

她甩了甩肩膀，说道：“经历了这一切之后，我想我们都需要好好休息一下。所以，如果你们不介意的话，我就回我的‘洞穴’里养伤吧。虽然很想邀请你们一起，但我那里实在没有什么舒适的东西可以提供。 等你休息好了，准备好迎接计划中的下一步时，再来找我吧。”

说完，格温尔便转身离开了。尽管她体型庞大，但在雪地上却几乎没有留下任何痕迹。你目送着她消失在无边无际的白色与灰色之中，然后也准备动身离开了。 如果你坐得太久不动，肯定会感冒的……

rows.original: All right. Now that you've had a breather after that raid on the cultist camp, you're ready to hear the next stage of Gweyr's plan. What did she have in mind? "Tollus may have gotten beefier underlings compared to the kids he had twenty years ago, but they aren't any smarter this time around, either, nor do they show any more initiative. While you headed off and got some rest, I stuck around the place for a handful more hours, watched them to see what they'd do. Unsurprisingly, the first thing they did once the mess was cleaned up was send someone to get instructions from whoever it is up their chain of command who makes these decisions." That quickly? "That kind of cult... I've seen a number in my time, especially during my days down in the heartlands, but they're always the same. You can get fanatical loyalty out of your true believers, but at the same time they're not made to think for themselves." Gweyr shakes her head. "Either way, I did some tracking and learned that there'll be a ship coming pretty soon to pick up some more barrels of that gray goop to replace those that were lost. That's an opportunity to learn where they're coming from." Wait, wait. A ship — you can understand that Tollus might have a ship, his resources have expanded quite significantly since Kasyrra's arrival. But it's coming here to pick them up and not deliver them? "Strange, isn't it? That's what I thought too. But thinking on it more, it would make sense for the source to be close by and for them to just be using a ship to collect the haul and bring the barrels back to shore. Given the size of the stockpile we saw, it would fit about the size of a hold or so. "To be perfectly honest, I'm glad that's the case. While I would've stowed away on a ship going to who knows where to trace the source of that stuff, I'd rather not have to; I'm getting a little too old to be walking across the continent like I did with my father's mercenary company when I was younger." Reminiscing is nice, but what's her plan? "I still need a little time to figure out the best approach to this and call in some favors, but it doesn't look like we've got that long to plan out our move. Meet me by the eastern edge of the sea ice when you've made your preparations." You're still a little doubtful of the rather indeterminate yet urgent timeline that she's given you, but she's been right so far about these things. All right, she can go make her preparations, while you go make yours. A nod. "I'm not sure what we'll actually come across, but unlike last time, my goal here isn't to scuttle their ship or anything — that'd just spook them and send Tollus's goons into hiding, destroying our lead to the head of the snake. What I'm looking for is information on where this stuff is coming from, first and foremost. Other than that... who's paying for all this, who exactly is in his chain of command, how the logistics are being handled, anything that might give us an edge in what's coming up; I used to have Garth do the books for me, but I could do them myself if I damn well wanted to. You get me?" Right. Stealth and reconnoitering, not assault. "There'll be time enough to hack and smash once we get face to face with Tollus, and that isn't happening if we spook him away; his type are cowards, and he won't get into a fight he's not confident he can win. Sure, he's an asshole with an inflated ego, but that only goes so far." All right. So once again, meet her at the eastern edge of the sea ice, where the ice meets the headland? "If we're going to be tailing them out to sea, I'll need to borrow a raft from the jotuns. Obviously, once we push off, there'll be no turning back, so think long and hard about the things and people you want to bring with you. Now then, no sense standing around — time's a-wasting. We've both got things to do here."
rows.translation: 好吧。在刚刚袭击了那个邪教营地之后，你们已经休息好了，现在可以听听格温尔接下来的计划了。她究竟有什么打算呢？ “虽然与二十年前相比，Tollus现在拥有了一些更强大的手下，但这次他们并没有变得更聪明，也没有表现出更多的主动性。 当你离开去休息的时候，我在那里又待了几个小时，观察他们的行动。不出所料，一旦把现场清理干净，他们做的第一件事就是派人去向他们上级体系中那些负责做出这些决策的人请教指示。这么快就办成了？” “这种狂热组织……这些年来我见过不少，尤其是在我身处内陆地区的那些日子里。它们的本质总是相同的。你确实可以从那些真正的信徒那里获得狂热的忠诚，但与此同时，这些信徒也被剥夺了独立思考的能力。格温尔摇了摇头：“不管怎样，我进行了一些调查，发现很快就会有一艘船来取走那些被丢失的灰色粘稠物，以便替换它们。这是一个了解它们来源的好机会。等等，等等。一艘船……你也可以理解，Tollus应该会拥有一艘船，自从卡希拉到来之后，他的资源确实得到了相当大的扩充。但这艘船是专门来这里的…… 把它们捡起来。 而不是 交付 他们？ “奇怪，不是吗？我当初也是这么想的。但仔细想想，如果货物储藏地就在附近，他们用船来运输货物、把那些桶运回岸上，这也完全合情合理。考虑到我们看到的那些储藏量，那些货物大概能填满一艘船的货舱吧。 说实话，我挺高兴事情是这样的。虽然我本来也会偷偷搭上一艘船，去不知道哪里寻找那种东西的来源，但现在我宁愿不用这么做了；年纪大了，再像年轻时跟着父亲的佣兵队那样横跨整个大陆，已经有些吃力了。 回忆过去固然美好，但她到底有什么计划呢？ “我还需要一些时间来想出最好的解决办法，并找一些人帮忙，但看起来我们并没有太多时间来仔细规划下一步行动了。等你准备好之后，到海冰的东缘来找我吧。 你对她给出的那个既不明确又紧迫的时间安排还是有些怀疑，但到目前为止，她在这些事情上的判断都是正确的。好吧，她可以去准备她的东西了，而你也可以去准备你的。 点了点头。“我不确定我们会遇到什么，但与上次不同，这次我的目的并不是破坏他们的船只或采取类似的行动——那样只会把他们吓跑，让托卢斯的那些打手躲起来，从而让我们失去抓住首领的机会。 我首先需要的是关于这些物资的来源信息。除此之外……这些费用是由谁来支付的？他的指挥体系中到底有哪些人？物流工作是如何安排的？任何可能让我们在未来的行动中占据优势的信息都很有帮助。以前都是让加斯帮我处理这些账务，但如果我愿意的话，自己完全也可以做这些事情。 你明白我的意思吗？ 没错。现在应该采取隐秘行动和侦察，而不是直接进攻。 “等到我们与托卢斯正面交锋的时候，有的是时间大打出手的。但如果我们把他的注意力吓跑了，那就根本不可能达到这个目的了——他这种人就是胆小鬼，绝对不会去参加一场自己没有胜算的战斗。当然，他是个自负至极的混蛋，但这种自负也是有限度的。 好的。那么，还是在那片海冰的东缘与她会面吧，就在冰层与岬角相接的地方。 “如果我们真的要跟着他们一起出海的话，我就得向那些巨魔借一条筏子。显然，一旦我们出发，就再也无法回头了，所以请仔细考虑一下你想带上哪些东西和人一起走。好了，别浪费时间了——我们俩都有事情要做呢。
