rows.original: This... looks like the spot that Gweyr told you to meet her at — while the gray and white expanse of the rift is as it usually is, you're starting to get a feel for the place at this point. Like before, if she told you to meet her here, she'll show up at the right time — no sooner, no later. And no sooner have you arrived that you spot the old, grizzled wolfess waving you over from an icy cove not to far from the shore. There's a natural channel not too far from where you're standing that leads out through the sea ice, and Gweyr's got a large ice raft bobbing in the water nearby. It looks fairly precarious, but it is jotun-sized, and given the whalebone spikes and sled runners driven into the edges you probably won't fall off into the freezing waters. Probably. "Hurry, [pc.name], and get down by me. I heard some commotion coming from their outpost not to long ago; I gather we don't have much time to spare." A heavy fog's risen up over the ocean, bitingly icy even through your [pc.armor]. [dayNight |Even given the light of day, it's cut visibility over the water considerably |Under the veil of night, visibly over the water is even worse than it would be ], at just the perfect height to shroud the raft from vision. You give Gweyr a look, and she nods. "I called in a couple favors from the selkies, pulled a few strings. The mist won't bother us any, but it'll give us the cover we need to approach and tail them for any length of time. Hush now, the fun's starting!" Gweyr points, and in the distance you see a stream of demonic cultists leaving the camp, perhaps a dozen and a half of them in a massed rabble headed by two demontaurs. They head out onto the ice, and as you watch, one of the demontaurs pulls out a large horn from a satchel and gives it a blow, resulting in a loud note that echoes over the water. "Our cue to get into position," Gweyr mutters, grabbing a whalebone paddle and handing [party.som |you one of your own. |[party.combatNames] each one of your own |[party.combatNames] each one of your own ]. "I know it's cold, but look alive!" [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus |"Ugh, I'm really not made for this," Cait says as she takes up position and starts paddling, but doesn't give further complaint. Your pink kitten's eyes have gone all steely, as they usually do these days when the cult is involved. Presumably the thought of her sister and getting back at Tollus still fuels her, despite how cheerful she usually is... |Wordlessly, Brint settles in on the opposite side of the raft from you and starts paddling down the channel. He doesn't look like one used to such activity — large bodies of water are presumably in short supply down in Khor'minos — but at least his muscles help make up what he lacks in technique with raw strength. Under Gweyr's instruction, he quickly picks it up, though, and you make good time towards the open ocean. |Wordlessly, Brienne settles in on the opposite side of the raft from you and starts paddling down the channel. She doesn't look like one used to such activity — large bodies of water are presumably in short supply down in Khor'minos — but at least her muscles help make up what she lacks in technique with raw strength. Under Gweyr's instruction, she quickly picks it up, though, and you make good time towards the open ocean. |"Usually we have slaves to do this kind of thing," Arona mumbles, looking every bit the petulant teenager as she starts rowing. "This is crap." "Well, we don't have any slaves here, girl," Gweyr snaps. "And I can tell you're from one of the Sailgraves tribes, so I know you've been able to paddle even before you could walk. Pipe down and get to it already, we're making enough noise as it is." |Azyrran looks uncertainly at the paddle in her hands. "Not quite my style, given that I'm used to flying over water when I have to cross it. Still, I'm willing to give it a try." "You'd be spotted in no time in you flew. Now, rowing — you've got the muscles for it, girl, and technique can be learned," Gweyr replies. "Now, get to paddling like [pc.name] and me here. I didn't know a thing about rowing and poling back when I was young, but the barges on the heartland rivers taught me really quickly." |Quin settles in on the barge on the other side of you, hefting the paddle with a vengeance. You didn't think someone like him could put in that much muscle effort when sufficiently motivated, but the bunny-boy's been full of surprises these days. "Whoa, slow down there and keep in time with us, kid," Gweyr growls. "I know you want to get to the action, but you're going to make us go in circles if you paddle that hard. Breathe easy and take it slow." |You settle into a steady rhythm with Gweyr on one side and you the other, alternating your strokes to keep the raft going in a straight line down the channel towards open ocean. [pc.toughnessRange 60 |While your endurance isn't unsuited to constant manual labor, the ever-present nip of cold makes the sting of exertion all the more pronounced |While you give it your all, your endurance isn't really suited for this kind of constant manual labor and the ever-present nip of cold makes a bad situation even worse ]; while the cold fog does cover your approach extremely well, the fact that you're constantly having to breathe it in chills your insides. Even with how smoothly the ice raft moves through the water, one just worries that it isn't going to be paddling all the way on this little trip. ] Hidden from where you are, you spy a shape emerging from the mist over the horizon, large yet sleek; the unmistakable silhouette of a ship. But this one isn't like any ship you've ever seen — bearing neither sails nor oars, it cuts through the icy water against the waves nevertheless, smashing through floating ice and debris with a reinforced hull to reach the cultists. "Shit," Gweyr mutters. "How does that thing manage to move?" [party.oneComp kiyoko arona |"It's a Belharan warship. A destroyer, to be exact." You turn your gaze to Kiyoko mid-paddle. "These ships were part of the Belharan fleet that accosted my homeland. They were made to escort the heavier vessels... I also boarded one for this land to serve my task. I believe there are a couple specimens on display in museums in the capital... either way, Gweyr is right in that they do not move by oar or sail, but rather a curious device within the center of the ship that propels it through the water." Gweyr mutters something under her breath and curses. "Of course he would get one; more and more questions present themselves. So many things we've lost in these last couple centuries." "Maybe it is better that they were lost." Gweyr narrows her eyes. "How's that?" "There are things that should not be known, either for us before we have the wisdom to handle them, or those that should not be known outright. Many of the relics salvaged that were found not to be in the interests of the Cherry Blossom Throne were given to the servants of Orochigami-sama and made to disappear." "O-what?" "You call her Nareva in this part of the world." "Oh." Gweyr snorts. "That one was never my kind of goddess. Always a Tiran myself." "It suits you." |"That's not natural," Arona agrees with a nod, her muscles flexing and straining as she paddles. "We Sailgraves orcs have been building the best damn ships in the world, and that thing's smashing through ice without sails or oars. That's something that even we can't do; it's a reason why we can't raid certain places in winter. An ice-locked ship is as good as lost." "Wizard fuckery?" Gweyr mutters. "Of course it's wizard fuckery, old woman. Has to be in order to outpace even one of our longships. You wouldn't expect a skinny fuck like that Tollus man to be able to command the respect of an actual crew or slaves, would you?" "We don't know if he's personally captaining the ship, or even if he's here at all." "Same difference." |Beats you. It's not any kind of ship you've seen before, [pc.bg scholar noblescion arcanist acolyte |and you'd like to think you were fairly well-read before all this started |and you're not exactly one to be well-versed with the ways of the sea. ]. "Well, I'm as stumped as you are. The only actual boats I've ever had any kind of experience with are river barges." ] Closer and closer you paddle to the ship's stern, half-expecting any of the cultists that're boarding the ship to look down and see your little party far below in the water. But either they don't, or the icy mist holds — either way, while the ship is still in the water, the lot of you paddle close enough to be within reach of the reinforced hull. What now? "This." Producing a couple of spiked hooks and mallets from her bag, Gweyr directs you to find a spot on the hull to hammer them into. "We'll let them tow us all the way there and back. Unless you feel like rowing hard enough to keep pace with them, that is..." You test the bone hook in your hand. Is she sure they're sturdy? "These are what the jotuns use to tow whale carcasses back to shore, so." Right. While Gweyr secures the spikes into the ship's hull, you lash them to those already embedded in your raft with the cord she's provided. There's not a lot — just enough slack to make sure it doesn't snap if suddenly jerked, but also tight enough to keep you close in the ship's wake. No sooner have you finished securing your raft out of sight under the ship that it starts to move once more — there's a heart-pounding moment as the cords you've attached pull taut, and then to your great relief, your raft starts to move along with the ship. "No need to look so nervous, [pc.mf|boy|girl]," Gweyr says, clapping you on the shoulder. "Everything up here's much tougher than it looks. Now, our work's still not done." You didn't expect it to be. "Looks like they left one of the rear gunports open, sloppy creatures that they are. Why don't we see if there's something more that can be gained from all this, hmm? I'd have been happy with just finding out where the barrels were coming from, but this is an opportunity that I'm not about to pass up." The tone in Gweyr's voice makes it clear that she's already made up her mind, and indeed, she's already got a grappling hook in hand. Despite it being a small target — and from such an angle, too — the hook lands true and holds; Gweyr pulls the attached cord taut and tests it a couple times before lashing it to one of the raft's spikes. The raft... "It's secure enough that it won't float away, don't you worry about that. Now then, why don't we have ourselves a little adventure?" Rappelling across to the open gunport through the mist is harrowing — you may not be able to see the icy seas beneath you clearly, but you can damn well hear them churning. Gweyr takes the lead, slipping into the ship first, then sticking her head back out and gesturing for [party.combatNames] to follow. [pc.heightRange 60 78 |The gunport is pretty large — one can only wonder at the size of the arbalests that must have been stationed here for such size to be warranted — and you haul yourself on through, the thought of falling into the icy waters giving you strength. The old wolfess grabs you by the arms and heaves, and you squeeze on through the gunport, landing on a rope pile with a muffled thump |It's a bit of a tight fit given your size, but if Gweyr can get in, so can you. The old wolfess grabs you by the arms and heaves, and you squeeze on through the gunport, landing on a rope pile with a muffled thump |You're a bit small, so it's easy for you to squeeze on through the hatch even with your [pc.armor] on — Gweyr grabs you by the arms and hoists you in with ease ].[party.som| | [party.compNames] soon follows after you, carefully clambering in through the gunport, dropping in with a sigh of relief. | [party.compNames] soon follow after you, carefully clambering in through the gunport, the both of them dropping in with a sigh of relief. ] There isn't anyone belowdecks at the moment, although you can hear the massed footsteps of demons right above you; they must not expect to stay on the ship long for that. So... what are you looking for here? "Like I said earlier, anything. My goal here isn't to scuttle their ship or anything — that'd just spook them and send Tollus's goons into hiding, destroying our lead to the head of the snake. What I'm looking for is information on where this stuff is coming from, first and foremost. Other than that... who's paying for all this, who exactly is in his chain of command, how the logistics are being handled, anything that might give us an edge in what's coming up. "We may be alone for now, but try not to make too much noise while we're down here, we don't want them getting suspicious and coming down to take a look-see. While I'm sure we'll be able to beat a retreat quickly enough to avoid being discovered, I also don't want to fuck up our chances of actually getting our hands on any useful information." All right. "Now then, let's see what we can get our itchy fingers up to..." You only have so much time to explore the belowdecks of the cultist ship before the demons on deck smell a rat and come down to investigate. Having some resources and companions may help you save time; conversely, lacking resources and attempting to interact with the situations you find within the ship will likely take more time. You will likely not have long enough to go through every single interactable and come out ahead, so decide wisely as to where you should go and what you should do in order to find as many clues and discover as many resources as you can that will aid you in the inevitable confrontation to come.

] 目前船舱里没有人，不过你可以听到头顶上恶魔密集的脚步声——他们应该不指望能在这艘船上待太久吧。那么……你在这里寻找什么呢？ “就像我之前说的，什么都可以。 我的目的并不是要破坏他们的计划或什么的——那样只会把他们吓跑，让托卢斯的那些打手部躲起来，从而让我们失去抓住罪魁祸首的机会。我首先想要的是关于这些东西的来源信息。 除此之外……这些开销都是由谁来承担的？他的指挥体系中到底有哪些人？物流工作又是如何运作的？任何可能让我们在即将发生的事情中占据优势的信息都对我们来说非常重要。 “目前我们可能还是孤军奋战，但是…… 我们在这里的时候，尽量别发出太大的声音，我们可不想引起他们的怀疑，让他们下来查看一番。虽然我相信我们能够迅速撤退以避免被发现，但我也不想因此破坏我们获取有用信息的机会。” 好吧。 “那么，让我们看看能做些什么吧…… 在你探索那艘邪教徒船只的底层区域之前，你只有有限的时间——因为船上的恶魔很快就会察觉到异常并下来调查。如果你拥有一些资源和同伴，或许能帮助你节省时间；相反，如果缺乏资源，而试图应对船上遇到的各种情况，那么很可能会耗费更多的时间。 你很可能没有足够的时间去探索每一个可以互动的对象，从而取得胜利。因此，你必须明智地决定该前往何处、该做些什么，以便收集尽可能多的线索，找到尽可能多的资源，这些都将帮助你应对即将到来的不可避免的挑战。
rows.raw: " This... looks like the spot that Gweyr told you to meet her at — while the gray and white expanse of the rift is as it usually is, you're starting to get a feel for the place at this point. Like before, if she told you to meet her here, she'll show up at the right time — no sooner, no later. And no sooner have you arrived that you spot the old, grizzled wolfess waving you over from an icy cove not to far from the shore. There's a natural channel not too far from where you're standing that leads out through the sea ice, and Gweyr's got a large ice raft bobbing in the water nearby. It looks fairly precarious, but it is jotun-sized, and given the whalebone spikes and sled runners driven into the edges you probably won't fall off into the freezing waters. Probably. "Hurry, [pc.name], and get down by me. I heard some commotion coming from their outpost not to long ago; I gather we don't have much time to spare." A heavy fog's risen up over the ocean, bitingly icy even through your [pc.armor]. [dayNight |Even given the light of day, it's cut visibility over the water considerably |Under the veil of night, visibly over the water is even worse than it would be ], at just the perfect height to shroud the raft from vision. You give Gweyr a look, and she nods. "I called in a couple favors from the selkies, pulled a few strings. The mist won't bother us any, but it'll give us the cover we need to approach and tail them for any length of time. Hush now, the fun's starting!" Gweyr points, and in the distance you see a stream of demonic cultists leaving the camp, perhaps a dozen and a half of them in a massed rabble headed by two demontaurs. They head out onto the ice, and as you watch, one of the demontaurs pulls out a large horn from a satchel and gives it a blow, resulting in a loud note that echoes over the water. "Our cue to get into position," Gweyr mutters, grabbing a whalebone paddle and handing [party.som |you one of your own. |[party.combatNames] each one of your own |[party.combatNames] each one of your own ]. "I know it's cold, but look alive!" [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus |"Ugh, I'm really not made for this," Cait says as she takes up position and starts paddling, but doesn't give further complaint. Your pink kitten's eyes have gone all steely, as they usually do these days when the cult is involved. Presumably the thought of her sister and getting back at Tollus still fuels her, despite how cheerful she usually is... |Wordlessly, Brint settles in on the opposite side of the raft from you and starts paddling down the channel. He doesn't look like one used to such activity — large bodies of water are presumably in short supply down in Khor'minos — but at least his muscles help make up what he lacks in technique with raw strength. Under Gweyr's instruction, he quickly picks it up, though, and you make good time towards the open ocean. |Wordlessly, Brienne settles in on the opposite side of the raft from you and starts paddling down the channel. She doesn't look like one used to such activity — large bodies of water are presumably in short supply down in Khor'minos — but at least her muscles help make up what she lacks in technique with raw strength. Under Gweyr's instruction, she quickly picks it up, though, and you make good time towards the open ocean. |"Usually we have slaves to do this kind of thing," Arona mumbles, looking every bit the petulant teenager as she starts rowing. "This is crap." "Well, we don't have any slaves here, girl," Gweyr snaps. "And I can tell you're from one of the Sailgraves tribes, so I know you've been able to paddle even before you could walk. Pipe down and get to it already, we're making enough noise as it is." |Azyrran looks uncertainly at the paddle in her hands. "Not quite my style, given that I'm used to flying over water when I have to cross it. Still, I'm willing to give it a try." "You'd be spotted in no time in you flew. Now, rowing — you've got the muscles for it, girl, and technique can be learned," Gweyr replies. "Now, get to paddling like [pc.name] and me here. I didn't know a thing about rowing and poling back when I was young, but the barges on the heartland rivers taught me really quickly." |Quin settles in on the barge on the other side of you, hefting the paddle with a vengeance. You didn't think someone like him could put in that much muscle effort when sufficiently motivated, but the bunny-boy's been full of surprises these days. "Whoa, slow down there and keep in time with us, kid," Gweyr growls. "I know you want to get to the action, but you're going to make us go in circles if you paddle that hard. Breathe easy and take it slow." |You settle into a steady rhythm with Gweyr on one side and you the other, alternating your strokes to keep the raft going in a straight line down the channel towards open ocean. [pc.toughnessRange 60 |While your endurance isn't unsuited to constant manual labor, the ever-present nip of cold makes the sting of exertion all the more pronounced |While you give it your all, your endurance isn't really suited for this kind of constant manual labor and the ever-present nip of cold makes a bad situation even worse ]; while the cold fog does cover your approach extremely well, the fact that you're constantly having to breathe it in chills your insides. Even with how smoothly the ice raft moves through the water, one just worries that it isn't going to be paddling all the way on this little trip. ] Hidden from where you are, you spy a shape emerging from the mist over the horizon, large yet sleek; the unmistakable silhouette of a ship. But this one isn't like any ship you've ever seen — bearing neither sails nor oars, it cuts through the icy water against the waves nevertheless, smashing through floating ice and debris with a reinforced hull to reach the cultists. "Shit," Gweyr mutters. "How does that thing manage to move?" [party.oneComp kiyoko arona |"It's a Belharan warship. A destroyer, to be exact." You turn your gaze to Kiyoko mid-paddle. "These ships were part of the Belharan fleet that accosted my homeland. They were made to escort the heavier vessels... I also boarded one for this land to serve my task. I believe there are a couple specimens on display in museums in the capital... either way, Gweyr is right in that they do not move by oar or sail, but rather a curious device within the center of the ship that propels it through the water." Gweyr mutters something under her breath and curses. "Of course he would get one; more and more questions present themselves. So many things we've lost in these last couple centuries." "Maybe it is better that they were lost." Gweyr narrows her eyes. "How's that?" "There are things that should not be known, either for us before we have the wisdom to handle them, or those that should not be known outright. Many of the relics salvaged that were found not to be in the interests of the Cherry Blossom Throne were given to the servants of Orochigami-sama and made to disappear." "O-what?" "You call her Nareva in this part of the world." "Oh." Gweyr snorts. "That one was never my kind of goddess. Always a Tiran myself." "It suits you." |"That's not natural," Arona agrees with a nod, her muscles flexing and straining as she paddles. "We Sailgraves orcs have been building the best damn ships in the world, and that thing's smashing through ice without sails or oars. That's something that even we can't do; it's a reason why we can't raid certain places in winter. An ice-locked ship is as good as lost." "Wizard fuckery?" Gweyr mutters. "Of course it's wizard fuckery, old woman. Has to be in order to outpace even one of our longships. You wouldn't expect a skinny fuck like that Tollus man to be able to command the respect of an actual crew or slaves, would you?" "We don't know if he's personally captaining the ship, or even if he's here at all." "Same difference." |Beats you. It's not any kind of ship you've seen before, [pc.bg scholar noblescion arcanist acolyte |and you'd like to think you were fairly well-read before all this started |and you're not exactly one to be well-versed with the ways of the sea. ]. "Well, I'm as stumped as you are. The only actual boats I've ever had any kind of experience with are river barges." ] Closer and closer you paddle to the ship's stern, half-expecting any of the cultists that're boarding the ship to look down and see your little party far below in the water. But either they don't, or the icy mist holds — either way, while the ship is still in the water, the lot of you paddle close enough to be within reach of the reinforced hull. What now? "This." Producing a couple of spiked hooks and mallets from her bag, Gweyr directs you to find a spot on the hull to hammer them into. "We'll let them tow us all the way there and back. Unless you feel like rowing hard enough to keep pace with them, that is..." You test the bone hook in your hand. Is she sure they're sturdy? "These are what the jotuns use to tow whale carcasses back to shore, so." Right. While Gweyr secures the spikes into the ship's hull, you lash them to those already embedded in your raft with the cord she's provided. There's not a lot — just enough slack to make sure it doesn't snap if suddenly jerked, but also tight enough to keep you close in the ship's wake. No sooner have you finished securing your raft out of sight under the ship that it starts to move once more — there's a heart-pounding moment as the cords you've attached pull taut, and then to your great relief, your raft starts to move along with the ship. "No need to look so nervous, [pc.mf|boy|girl]," Gweyr says, clapping you on the shoulder. "Everything up here's much tougher than it looks. Now, our work's still not done." You didn't expect it to be. "Looks like they left one of the rear gunports open, sloppy creatures that they are. Why don't we see if there's something more that can be gained from all this, hmm? I'd have been happy with just finding out where the barrels were coming from, but this is an opportunity that I'm not about to pass up." The tone in Gweyr's voice makes it clear that she's already made up her mind, and indeed, she's already got a grappling hook in hand. Despite it being a small target — and from such an angle, too — the hook lands true and holds; Gweyr pulls the attached cord taut and tests it a couple times before lashing it to one of the raft's spikes. The raft... "It's secure enough that it won't float away, don't you worry about that. Now then, why don't we have ourselves a little adventure?" Rappelling across to the open gunport through the mist is harrowing — you may not be able to see the icy seas beneath you clearly, but you can damn well hear them churning. Gweyr takes the lead, slipping into the ship first, then sticking her head back out and gesturing for [party.combatNames] to follow. [pc.heightRange 60 78 |The gunport is pretty large — one can only wonder at the size of the arbalests that must have been stationed here for such size to be warranted — and you haul yourself on through, the thought of falling into the icy waters giving you strength. The old wolfess grabs you by the arms and heaves, and you squeeze on through the gunport, landing on a rope pile with a muffled thump |It's a bit of a tight fit given your size, but if Gweyr can get in, so can you. The old wolfess grabs you by the arms and heaves, and you squeeze on through the gunport, landing on a rope pile with a muffled thump |You're a bit small, so it's easy for you to squeeze on through the hatch even with your [pc.armor] on — Gweyr grabs you by the arms and hoists you in with ease ].[party.som| | [party.compNames] soon follows after you, carefully clambering in through the gunport, dropping in with a sigh of relief. | [party.compNames] soon follow after you, carefully clambering in through the gunport, the both of them dropping in with a sigh of relief. ] There isn't anyone belowdecks at the moment, although you can hear the massed footsteps of demons right above you; they must not expect to stay on the ship long for that. So... what are you looking for here? "Like I said earlier, anything. My goal here isn't to scuttle their ship or anything — that'd just spook them and send Tollus's goons into hiding, destroying our lead to the head of the snake. What I'm looking for is information on where this stuff is coming from, first and foremost. Other than that... who's paying for all this, who exactly is in his chain of command, how the logistics are being handled, anything that might give us an edge in what's coming up. "We may be alone for now, but try not to make too much noise while we're down here, we don't want them getting suspicious and coming down to take a look-see. While I'm sure we'll be able to beat a retreat quickly enough to avoid being discovered, I also don't want to fuck up our chances of actually getting our hands on any useful information." All right. "Now then, let's see what we can get our itchy fingers up to..." You only have so much time to explore the belowdecks of the cultist ship before the demons on deck smell a rat and come down to investigate. Having some resources and companions may help you save time; conversely, lacking resources and attempting to interact with the situations you find within the ship will likely take more time. You will likely not have long enough to go through every single interactable and come out ahead, so decide wisely as to where you should go and what you should do in order to find as many clues and discover as many resources as you can that will aid you in the inevitable confrontation to come. "

rows.original: Gweyr eyes you and nods slowly. "How goes it? Have you secured Imora's help yet?" Yes. she's agreed to provide you, her, and anyone else who follows along for the ride with tattoos to shield you from the deep, cold waters. And her? "Seastone and her alphas have got the place cordoned off. Won't be any demons getting past them... or things coming up from beneath, for that matter." They're worried about that, huh? "She assures me a pissed-off giant squid or leviathan is no laughing matter, and remember, whatever Tollus and his freaks are doing down there, it's scaring up all the deep creatures to the surface. Either way, they're ready whenever we are. "Make your final preparations, [pc.name], and come back to me when you're ready for an underwater adventure. At long last, I think I can finally finish this hunt of mine and put Tollus right were he belongs... I don't expect it to be easy, so consider everything that we've learned about Tollus and his operation up to this point, and prepare accordingly. Since you just told me that Imora's tattoos will fade once we resurface, there's going to be no turning back once we set off."
rows.translation: 格温尔注视着你，缓缓点了点头。“进展如何？你已经得到伊莫拉的帮助了吗？” “是的，她同意为你、她自己，以及任何愿意跟随你们的人纹上纹身，以此保护你们免受那些深邃而冰冷的水域的伤害。 那她呢？ “海石和她的团队已经把那个地方封锁起来了。不会有任何恶魔从他们那里逃过去……当然，也不会有东西从地下钻出来。” 他们是在担心这个，对吧？ “她告诉我，一只愤怒的巨型乌贼或利维坦可不是好惹的。而且要记住，无论Tollus和他的那些怪物在下面正在做什么，他们肯定把所有深海的生物都吓到了水面上来。 无论如何，只要我们准备好了，他们也会立刻行动。 “做好最后的准备工作吧， [pc.name]等你们准备好开始水下冒险的时候，再来找我吧。终于，我觉得我能够完成这次搜寻任务，把托卢斯送回他该去的地方……不过，我并不指望这会是一段轻松的旅程…… 考虑到我们迄今为止所了解的关于Tollus及其运作方式的所有信息，据此做好相应的准备吧。既然你刚刚告诉我，当我们重新浮出水面后，伊莫拉身上的纹身就会消失，那么一旦我们出发，就再也无法回头了。

rows.original: Gweyr gives you a long, hard look and nods slowly. "All the pieces are in place; the only thing that's left is taking the fight to the depths. Are you ready, [pc.name]?" This is the final leg of this quest; once you dive into the abyssal depths, you will not be able to backtrack. Consider everything you've learned on the previous leg of your quest, and prepare accordingly. If nothing else, Tollus and his minions will be down there, as well as the source of the goop which they've been spreading around the entire rift; on the other hand, you will have Gweyr accompanying you as a guest on this task. Knowing all this, do you still wish to proceed?
rows.translation: 格温尔凝视了你片刻，然后缓缓点了点头。“所有准备都已经就绪；现在唯一要做的，就是将战斗带到更深的地方。你准备好了吗？ [pc.name]?" 这是这次任务的最后阶段；一旦你深入那些深邃的深渊，就无法再回头了。请回想一下在之前任务中所学到的一切，并据此做好准备。至少，Tollus和他的手下会在那里，还有他们一直在整个裂隙中散布的那种黏稠物质；而另一方面，格温尔也会以客人的身份陪伴你完成这项任务。 了解了这些情况，你仍然愿意继续前进吗？

rows.original: You've made all your preparations, and are as ready as can be. Gweyr gives you a glance, then rises to her feet. "All right, let's go see Imora." Your feet are leaden as Gweyr leads [party.combatNames] across the permafrost to the sea ice, where Imora's usual basking spot is. As [party.som |the both |all |all ] of you approach the ice shelf, a splash from the water draws your attention. The old wolfess is first to snap to attention, about ready to throw down before you put a hand on her arm; it's impossible not to recognize the field of stars or colorful cape heralding Imora's approach. "[pc.name], Gweyr." Imora nods to you in turn, before pulling her bag out from the water and laying it out. "I saw you approach, and I have your goods ready." Although her hackles are still up, the wolfess puts her weapons away and looks around. "And you're sure we won't be perishing before we're twenty under?" A musical trill from the shaman proves to be the equivalent of a derisive snort, and she waves Gweyr down. "Just take a seat, you'll be fine. [pc.name] has done right by me, and I will do right by [pc.mf |him |her ] in response. Say hi to Seastone for me, okay?" [var0 |Imora opens up her bag and pulls out a little pot of electrum; a stack of random, mismatched coins have been hammered flat into a vaguely cauldron-like shape, and the contents rattle when she gives it a shake. "These here are a siorc speciality; you can hardly alchemize in the open water, so we make the cauldrons out of electrum, fill them with ingredients, and apply a little magic and pressure until they combine." "Don't the contents go everywhere when you make potions?" The shaman shakes her head and smirks, opening the pot and counting pearls. "Nope, usually the contents funnel themselves into lava-blown glass — I'm not about to go explaining how pressure works — and then you can quaff them. Anyway, we're doing ink right now, one of the few things we have to do in the air chambers or on the surface. I'm just going to let this pour out into a bowl." Oh, that makes sense... |Imora begins rummaging in her bag of tricks, pulling out a siorc electrum-cauldron, and a bottle of glowing red juice. "This shouldn't take long." ] Gweyr sits down cross-legged beside you as the siorc carefully measures out a number of pearls and drops them into the cauldron. "These here are some of our finer, more potent pearls." She holds one up and allows it to catch the [dayNight |sun |star ]light, before adding it to its friends. She begins to hum musically, channeling the arcane through her fingertips as she pulls out a crude glass vial of glowing red juice and pours it all over the pearls. Already you can hear a soft fizzing noise from the pearls, before it's smothered by a lid being tightly pressed into place. The sounds of effervescent redouble and combine with a heavy liquid sloshing as the shaman shakes the entire cauldron viciously in her hands until it's drowning out her musical humming. You and Gweyr both lean back uncomfortably when it begins to look very much like the star-kissed shaman is vigorously shaking a bomb at you [party.som| |both |all ]. Despite yourself you wince and jolt on the spot, especially when there's a distressing crunch from the electrum cauldron and it caves in on itself. It's only been a minute of humming and shaking, but the spell reaches its conclusion; Imora holds her hands over a bowl and opens them, grinning proudly as a thick red ink pours into it. "And there we have it; magical ink." "...That's it? What in the gods' names was that?" Gweyr growls, staring at the glowing, inky bowl. "This isn't some elaborate trick, is it?" "Did you miss the part where my cauldron crushed itself into a tiny ball and turned itself, and its very solid contents into a liquid? That was no trick. Now would you kindly present yourselves for tattooing?" Her mismatched eyes glitter, "plus, if I wanted to go through all of this trouble just to get you wet, I could think of plenty of other ways to—" "Just get on with it," the old wolf sighs. "No timer?" you ask. "No timer," Imora confirms. "Once you go below sea-level, the tattoo will remain active until you return to the surface." With a shrug, you bare your respective stomachs and wait for Imora to get to work. She pulls out a sharp-looking pearl needle and dips it in the ink, [pc.hasFur |parting your fur carefully to prick at the [pc.skinColor] flesh beneath. |pricking gently at your [pc.skinColor] flesh. ] The sting is only momentary, but heat continues to prickle at you even when she wipes away the blood of each soft stab. [pc.hasWombTattoo |You were worried it would look a little mismatched with your already-present womb tattoo, but the siorcanna does an appreciable job of incorporating glowing red ink into the design. Not bad at all— it's almost a shame that it's temporary. |It's not a large or laborious tattoo, and it's shaped like a little glowing red heart beneath your belly button. ] [party.som | |Your companion gets much the same treatment, eyeing the glowing red heart [companion1.heShe]'s been given curiously. |Your companions get a similar treatment, looking over each others' glowing-heart 'womb tattoo' with a smirk and a grin. ] "All good? All good." Imora wipes her hands off on a stretchy cloth and cleans off her needle by punching it into an acrid-smelling sponge. When it comes time to tattoo Gweyr, she puts up considerably more of a fuss. Her brow furrows in consternation at the abjectly cute-looking design, and it becomes an apparent struggle to sit still. "Never thought I'd be getting marked up like some slutty brat half my age. Did you have to make it a heart?" "Of course not!" Imora giggles, cleaning her needle once more and wiping down Gweyr's stomach. "Cheer up, you're about to dive head-first into a fight against monsters you've never faced before to prevent terrible atrocities. If you weren't so boring, you'd be knee-deep in horny siorcs wanting you to take them for their alpha." Her words do little to improve the dour grimace on Gweyr's face, but you do notice a little wag from her tail when Imora isn't looking. "I do look forward to the fight, at least." All done, Imora thumbs over her shoulder at the sea. "Well then. Seastone and her alphas are waiting for you by the trench; why don't you give your tattoos a test?"
rows.translation: 你已经做好了所有准备，已经做好了出发前的一切准备。 格温尔看了你一眼，然后站了起来。“好了，我们走吧，去见伊莫拉。” 在格温尔的带领下，你的足部步仿佛变得重型起来。 [party.combatNames] 穿过永久冻土，来到海冰上——那里正是伊莫拉平时喜欢晒太阳的地方。 [party.som |两者 |所有 |所有 ] 当你靠近冰架时，水花声引起了你的注意。那只老母狼最先反应过来，几乎要在你触碰到它的手部臂之前发起攻击；那些闪烁的星星图案以及那件色彩斑斓的斗篷，无疑是在宣告伊莫拉的到来。[pc.name]格韦尔。”伊莫拉也向你点了点头，然后从水中取出她的包，将其摊开。“我看到你过来了，你的货物已经准备好了。” 尽管她仍然有些戒备，但这位女狼还是把武器收了起来，环顾四周问道：“你确定我们在二十岁之前不会死掉吧？” 萨满发出一阵悦耳的颤音，那声音听起来就像是在嘲笑她，然后她示意格韦尔坐下：“坐下来吧，不会有事的。 [pc.name] 他们对我一直很好，因此我也会以同样的方式回报他们。 [pc.mf |他 |她 ] 作为回应，请代我向Seastone问好，好吗？ [var0 |伊莫拉打开她的包，拿出一小罐电银；那堆形状各异、大小不一的硬币被敲平后，形成了一个类似大锅的形状，轻轻摇晃时，里面的硬币会发出叮当声。“这些都是西奥克族的特产——在开阔的水域里很难进行炼金术，所以我们就用电银制作这些‘大锅’，在里面放入所需的材料，然后施加一点魔法和压力，让这些材料发生反应。制作药水的时候，里面的成分不会散得到处都是吗？” 女萨满摇了摇头，露出狡黠的笑容，然后打开罐子，数起那些珍珠般的颗粒来。“不会的，通常这些成分会自动聚集到那些被熔岩熔化的玻璃容器里——我可没打算在这里解释压力原理啊——之后你就可以把它们喝下去了。 无论如何，我们现在正在着手处理与“墨水”相关的工作，这是我们正在进行的为数不多的几项任务之一。 拥有 这些可以放在空气室里，也可以放在表面。我就把这些东西倒进一个碗里吧。” 哦，这样想起来确实挺合理的…… |伊莫拉开始从她的“法宝袋”里翻找起来，掏出了一个银色的大锅，还有一瓶散发着红光的液体。“这个应该不会花太长时间。 ] 格温尔盘腿坐在你身旁，而那位女巫则仔细地称取了几颗珍珠，将它们放入大锅中。“这些是我们最珍贵、效力最强的珍珠。”她拿出一颗，让轻型线在它上面闪烁。 [dayNight |太阳 |星星 ]她轻轻地将这些珍珠拿起来，然后在将它们与其它物品放在一起之前，先让轻型线照射在它们上面。 接着，她开始轻轻哼唱着曲子，通过指尖引导那些神秘的能量。她取出一支粗糙的玻璃小瓶，里面装着散发着红轻型的液体，然后将这些液体均匀地倒在珍珠上。 珍珠们开始发出轻微的嘶嘶声，但很快，盖子被紧紧地盖上去，这些声音就被压制住了。当女巫猛烈地摇晃着整个大锅时，那些嘶嘶声与重型液体的晃动声交织在一起，甚至盖过了她哼唱的音乐声。 当那个仿佛被星辰亲吻过的萨满开始猛烈地向你挥动炸弹时，你和格温尔都不由得感到一阵不适。 [party.som| |两者都 |所有 ]尽管你试图控制自己，但还是不由自主地在一瞬间缩了缩脖子，身体也微微一震，尤其是当听到那些令人痛苦的声音时。 处理大量数据或进行复杂计算 从那口镀银的大锅中，液体开始不断涌出，最终在碗中汇聚成一股。虽然只过了短短一分钟，这个咒语就已经完成了。伊莫拉将双手部放在碗上方，然后缓缓张开，脸上露出自豪的笑容——只见一股浓稠的红色墨水缓缓流入碗中。 就这样，神奇的墨水出现了。” “……就这些吗？这到底是什么东西？”格韦尔咆哮着，盯着那个发轻型的墨水碗，“这不是什么复杂的把戏吧？” “你难道没看到我的大锅是如何自己缩小成一个小球，然后把自己和里面那些原本固态的物质都变成了液体的吗？ 那可不是什么花招。现在，请你们乖乖站过来接受纹身吧？”她那双眼睛一闪一闪的，“再说，如果我只是想让你们湿身而已，其实还有很多其他办法可以做到…… 赶紧开始吧，”老狼叹道。 “没有计时器吗？”你问道。 “没有计时器，”伊莫拉确认道，“一旦你潜到海平面以下，这个纹身就会保持激活状态，直到你重新回到水面。 你们耸了耸肩，露出了各自的腹部，等待着伊莫拉开始行动。 她拿出一根看起来很锋利的珍珠针，将其浸入墨水中。 [pc.hasFur |小心翼翼地将毛发拨开，然后去刺那个…… [pc.skinColor] 血肉之躯。 |轻轻触碰你的…… [pc.skinColor] 肉体。 ] 那种刺痛感只是短暂的，但即使她擦去了每一次轻柔刺击留下的血迹，那种灼热感依然会持续困扰着你。 [pc.hasWombTattoo |你原本担心这个新的纹身会与你已经有的腹部纹身不太协调，但这位纹身师确实将发光的红色墨水巧妙地融入到了设计中。效果相当不错——实在可惜这只是个暂时的纹身。 |这个纹身并不大，也不需要花费太多时间来纹制，它的形状就像一个闪烁着红光的小爱心，位于你的肚脐下方。 ] [party.som | |你的同伴也遭到了同样的对待，他同样注视着那颗闪烁着红光的爱心。 [companion1.heShe]这个名称的由来实在有些奇怪。 |你的同伴也得到了同样的待遇，他们互相打量着彼此身上那些发轻型的心形“胎记”，脸上洋溢着 smirk和笑容。 ] 都好了吗？都好了。”伊莫拉用一块有弹性的布擦了擦手部，然后把针插进一块散发着刺鼻气味的海绵里进行清洁。 当到了给格韦尔纹身的时候，她却显得格外忙碌和小心翼翼。 看到这个看起来极其可爱的设计，她的眉头不由得皱了起来，坐得也显得很不自在。“真没想到自己会像某个年纪只有自己一半大的、行为放荡的小丫头一样被这样标记……非得弄成心脏的形状吗？当然不会！”伊莫拉轻笑着，再次清理她的针具，然后擦拭格韦尔的腹部。“振作起来，你即将投入到一场与从未面对过的怪物的战斗中，去阻止那些可怕的暴行。 要是你不是这么无趣的话，那些渴望成为你‘阿尔法’的雄性生物早就围着你转了。” 她的话丝毫没有改善格韦尔脸上那阴沉的表情，但是…… 做 当伊莫拉没有注意的时候，我注意到她的尾巴微微动了一下。“我…… 做 至少，我很期待这场战斗。” 一切准备就绪后，伊莫拉回头望了望大海，说道：“那么，海石和她的同伴正在沟壑边等着你；不如现在就测试一下你的纹身吧？
rows.raw: ' You've made all your preparations, and are as ready as can be. Gweyr gives you a glance, then rises to her feet. "All right, let's go see Imora." Your feet are leaden as Gweyr leads [party.combatNames] across the permafrost to the sea ice, where Imora's usual basking spot is. As [party.som |the both |all |all ] of you approach the ice shelf, a splash from the water draws your attention. The old wolfess is first to snap to attention, about ready to throw down before you put a hand on her arm; it's impossible not to recognize the field of stars or colorful cape heralding Imora's approach. "[pc.name], Gweyr." Imora nods to you in turn, before pulling her bag out from the water and laying it out. "I saw you approach, and I have your goods ready." Although her hackles are still up, the wolfess puts her weapons away and looks around. "And you're sure we won't be perishing before we're twenty under?" A musical trill from the shaman proves to be the equivalent of a derisive snort, and she waves Gweyr down. "Just take a seat, you'll be fine. [pc.name] has done right by me, and I will do right by [pc.mf |him |her ] in response. Say hi to Seastone for me, okay?" [var0 |Imora opens up her bag and pulls out a little pot of electrum; a stack of random, mismatched coins have been hammered flat into a vaguely cauldron-like shape, and the contents rattle when she gives it a shake. "These here are a siorc speciality; you can hardly alchemize in the open water, so we make the cauldrons out of electrum, fill them with ingredients, and apply a little magic and pressure until they combine." "Don't the contents go everywhere when you make potions?" The shaman shakes her head and smirks, opening the pot and counting pearls. "Nope, usually the contents funnel themselves into lava-blown glass — I'm not about to go explaining how pressure works — and then you can quaff them. Anyway, we're doing ink right now, one of the few things we have to do in the air chambers or on the surface. I'm just going to let this pour out into a bowl." Oh, that makes sense... |Imora begins rummaging in her bag of tricks, pulling out a siorc electrum-cauldron, and a bottle of glowing red juice. "This shouldn't take long." ] Gweyr sits down cross-legged beside you as the siorc carefully measures out a number of pearls and drops them into the cauldron. "These here are some of our finer, more potent pearls." She holds one up and allows it to catch the [dayNight |sun |star ]light, before adding it to its friends. She begins to hum musically, channeling the arcane through her fingertips as she pulls out a crude glass vial of glowing red juice and pours it all over the pearls. Already you can hear a soft fizzing noise from the pearls, before it's smothered by a lid being tightly pressed into place. The sounds of effervescent redouble and combine with a heavy liquid sloshing as the shaman shakes the entire cauldron viciously in her hands until it's drowning out her musical humming. You and Gweyr both lean back uncomfortably when it begins to look very much like the star-kissed shaman is vigorously shaking a bomb at you [party.som| |both |all ]. Despite yourself you wince and jolt on the spot, especially when there's a distressing crunch from the electrum cauldron and it caves in on itself. It's only been a minute of humming and shaking, but the spell reaches its conclusion; Imora holds her hands over a bowl and opens them, grinning proudly as a thick red ink pours into it. "And there we have it; magical ink." "...That's it? What in the gods' names was that?" Gweyr growls, staring at the glowing, inky bowl. "This isn't some elaborate trick, is it?" "Did you miss the part where my cauldron crushed itself into a tiny ball and turned itself, and its very solid contents into a liquid? That was no trick. Now would you kindly present yourselves for tattooing?" Her mismatched eyes glitter, "plus, if I wanted to go through all of this trouble just to get you wet, I could think of plenty of other ways to—" "Just get on with it," the old wolf sighs. "No timer?" you ask. "No timer," Imora confirms. "Once you go below sea-level, the tattoo will remain active until you return to the surface." With a shrug, you bare your respective stomachs and wait for Imora to get to work. She pulls out a sharp-looking pearl needle and dips it in the ink, [pc.hasFur |parting your fur carefully to prick at the [pc.skinColor] flesh beneath. |pricking gently at your [pc.skinColor] flesh. ] The sting is only momentary, but heat continues to prickle at you even when she wipes away the blood of each soft stab. [pc.hasWombTattoo |You were worried it would look a little mismatched with your already-present womb tattoo, but the siorcanna does an appreciable job of incorporating glowing red ink into the design. Not bad at all— it's almost a shame that it's temporary. |It's not a large or laborious tattoo, and it's shaped like a little glowing red heart beneath your belly button. ] [party.som | |Your companion gets much the same treatment, eyeing the glowing red heart [companion1.heShe]'s been given curiously. |Your companions get a similar treatment, looking over each others' glowing-heart 'womb tattoo' with a smirk and a grin. ] "All good? All good." Imora wipes her hands off on a stretchy cloth and cleans off her needle by punching it into an acrid-smelling sponge. When it comes time to tattoo Gweyr, she puts up considerably more of a fuss. Her brow furrows in consternation at the abjectly cute-looking design, and it becomes an apparent struggle to sit still. "Never thought I'd be getting marked up like some slutty brat half my age. Did you have to make it a heart?" "Of course not!" Imora giggles, cleaning her needle once more and wiping down Gweyr's stomach. "Cheer up, you're about to dive head-first into a fight against monsters you've never faced before to prevent terrible atrocities. If you weren't so boring, you'd be knee-deep in horny siorcs wanting you to take them for their alpha." Her words do little to improve the dour grimace on Gweyr's face, but you do notice a little wag from her tail when Imora isn't looking. "I do look forward to the fight, at least." All done, Imora thumbs over her shoulder at the sea. "Well then. Seastone and her alphas are waiting for you by the trench; why don't you give your tattoos a test?" '

rows.original: It works, it really does. Climbing from the ice shelf to sea level, Gweyr's the first to toe the waters, then gives you a wave. "Come on down. Imora's a tease, but she's good where it counts." It takes some courage to get around your instincts and step into the choppy, blue waters, but the old wolfess is right. Behind you, Imora gives a little encouraging wave, and the ocean is pleasantly balmy as you sink first one foot beneath the surface, then another, then finally fall forward and take the plunge. It's terrifying, that moment of your first breath where you feel the air leaving your lungs and water rushing in — followed by a spike of relief when you fail to drown. Down on your [pc.belly], Imora's magical ink glows faintly, working its magic and keeping you alive despite the icy sea pressing in all about you. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia einin etheryn |Beside you, Cait shivers a little, and you know it's not from the cold. Given that she's from the deserts of Jassira, she's about as much out of her element as she can get, and though you can see the seafloor here the same can't be said for the murky darkness that the ocean fades into in the distance. It's certainly a different world, to say the least. Cait's hair, fur and clothes are floating all over the place, but the reassuring pat you give her on the head still seems to work. She nods, mouths a few words, then realizes that she can't speak underwater and giggles a bit. That there's something of the bubbly Cait you know. |As you swim on, Brint looks a little unsteady on his feet, flailing around and trying to get used to his new weight in the water, or lack thereof anyway. To be fair, seeing a giant like him trying to right himself is a little funny, and you give him a little pat on the shoulder and try to heave him right-side up. Brint gives you a look, tries to say something, then realizes that while Imora's tattoo may keep you from drowning, it does nothing for speaking underwater. After a few tries, he eventually gives up, shrugs, and grins sheepishly. He'd better get used to it... that, or hopefully you won't have to fight Tollus while swimming. |As you swim on, Brienne looks a little unsteady on her feet, flailing around and trying to get used to her new weight in the water, or lack thereof anyway. To be fair, seeing a giant like your [silly |moo ]cow companion trying to right herself is a little funny, [silly | what with tits being natural floatation devices and all, ]and you give her a little pat on the shoulder and try to heave her right-side up. Brienne gives you a look, tries to say something, then realizes that while Imora's tattoo may keep you from drowning, it does nothing for speaking underwater. After a few tries, she eventually gives up, shrugs, and grins sheepishly. She'd better get used to it... that, or hopefully you won't have to fight Tollus while swimming. |Arona swims on beside you, clearly practiced at this — not surprising, for a seafaring people from the Sailgraves. For someone as thick and muscular as she is, your orcish companion is surprisingly aquadynamic — her movements unimpeded by her [arona.armor], she darts ahead, peers into the murky distance and then points. Guess she wants you to hurry up... Yeah, she's getting impatient, isn't she? Drawing her [arona.weapon], Arona gives it a few test swings through the water, then looks thoughtful — a rarity, indeed — before shaking her head. She's not too enthused about the drag her weapon's creating... you just hope that you don't have to fight while swimming. |Azyrran swims on beside you — or at least, tries to. Her vesparan instincts are telling her she's in the air and should be flying, but at the same time her insectile wings can't handle how thick the water is compared to air. The end result is more than a little comical, until she finally gives up trying to use her wings and instead paddles on awkwardly with her hands and feet. It's clear that Azzy isn't used to swimming, and you give your honeyed companion a reassuring pat before pressing on. |Quin swims on silently beside you; he's pulled and tied back his clothes close to his body and paddles on with an air of grim determination about him, having gone so far as to tie his ears down against his head so they don't drag in the water. You lay a hand on his shoulder and tilt your head. Is he sure he's going to be all right? Quin moves as if to brush you off, then rolls his shoulders and nods before pointing to the seafloor. Yeah, you understand he's getting at. Some things are just long overdue. |Your fox-wife paddles along beside you, hair and clothes billowing out behind her like some kind of pretty fish; it's a small miracle she can still move through the water as easily as she does with all the drag she must be creating. Oh, she smell of wet fur is going to be pretty bad later... but that just means more excuses for brushing and grooming later on, doesn't it? |Atugia swims easily through the cold waters, keeping ahead of you as a vanguard. She's clearly had some experience with water, although where and how she got it is anyone's guess. Does Teiglache have a lot of lakes and rivers? |Einin darts ahead of you, slipping agilely through the water as she scouts ahead, alert for trouble. You'd have imagined those mouse ears of hers would make her stand out more, but she's clearly experienced when it comes to swimming, even with all her clothes on. Pressed against the seafloor, she's barely visible, a dark shape flitting about and making sure you keep out of danger. |Ryn wouldn't have been bothered by the cold anyway, but water isn't something she appears to be used to. Still, she puts on a brave front, paddling forward as best as she's able to despite her clothes weighing her down. The poor thing couldn't have had much experience with swimming in the palace or the Winter City in general... well, there's always a time to learn, and that time is now. You swim on, Gweyr taking the lead with her spear in hand. While the wolfess is still wrapped up in her furs — plus having a fur coat all of her own — she's still quick through the water, this clearly being nothing new to her. Looking back at you, she waves you on, then points down at the seabed. ] It isn't long before [party.hasCompanions |all of |the both of ] you end up near the spot where the cultist ship anchored — now that you're on the other side of the waves, the buoy Gweyr left is eminently visible, bobbing in place with its red underside. Below it stretches the yawning mouth of a deep, dark chasm, the gaping maw of some abyssal beast, and about its lips swim a dozen or so siorc alphas brandishing spears. One of them — Seastone — darts over to Gweyr through the water, giving the both of you a wide-toothed smile by way of greeting. "Finally, you showed up. Feeling your age a little, aren't you?" Gweyr mouths something that's unintelligible underwater, but the scowl says all you need to know. Seastone guffaws and thumps the old wolfess on the chest, then turns her attention to you. "And you. Stay safe down there, okay? You're brave enough to head where even we fear to swim — or maybe you just don't know the dangers of the deep. Ha! "Either way, Gweyr tells me you've some history with these assholes, so even if you did, you're the best choice to go down and kick their asses. My girls and I will be staying up top to take care of any big ones you might stir up from the bottom of that pit, make sure they don't do too much damage trying to flee." You nod, and Seastone hands you each a glowing shard of coral. "Here, to light your way... and for good luck. I get the feeling you'll need it. If you don't come back in a day or two, my girls and I will consider the both of you dead... so come back, okay? I'd miss the both of you." Gweyr snorts, then takes you by the hand. Together, the both of you float over to the lip of the chasm, peering down into the upswell of icy water that rises from the unyielding blackness within. Gweyr looks at you, you look [party.hasCompanions |back at [party.som||[comp1.name]|[comp1.name] and [comp2.name]] |back at her ]. Swallowing hard, you take [party.som |Gweyr in hand, feeling her thick, gnarled fingers close in about yours |[comp1.name] and Gweyr in hand, feeling their fingers close in about yours |[comp1.name] and [comp2.name] in hand, feeling their fingers close in about yours ], then make the leap of faith. Blackness rushes in.
rows.translation: 这确实有效。从冰架爬到海平面，格温尔是第一个踏入海水的人，然后他还向你挥了挥手部：“下来吧。伊莫拉虽然爱逗人，但在关键时刻，她还是很可靠的。” 要克服自己的本能，踏入那波涛汹涌的蓝色海水，确实需要一些勇气，但这位老狼女说得对。 在你身后，伊莫拉轻轻地向你挥了挥手部，鼓励你。当你逐渐沉入水中，先是足部掌触到水面，接着整个身体没入水中，那一刻，海水温暖而舒适。然而，当你第一次尝试呼吸时，会感到空气从肺部被挤走，水迅速涌入肺部，这一刻确实令人感到恐惧；但当你发现自己并没有淹死时，那种如释重负的感觉也会立刻袭来。 趴在地上 [pc.belly]伊莫拉的魔法墨水发出微弱的轻型芒，发挥着它的魔力，在冰冷的海水包围你的情况下，依然让你保持生存。 [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia einin etheryn |在你身旁，凯特微微颤抖着，而你知道，这并非因为寒冷。考虑到她来自贾西拉的沙漠地区，对她来说，这里无疑是完全陌生的环境。虽然在这里你能看到海底，但远处的海洋却沉浸在一片昏暗的黑暗之中，这种情况就另当别论了。 至少可以说，这确实是一个完全不同的世界。 凯特的头发、毛发和衣服都飘得到了处都是，但你轻轻拍她的头，似乎还是起到了安抚她的效果。她点了点头，说了几句话，然后突然意识到自己在水下是无法说话的，于是忍不住笑了起来。 就是那种活泼开朗的凯特，你知道的。 |当你继续游动时，布林特显得有些站不稳，他不停地挥动四肢，试图适应自己在水中的新状态——或者说，试图适应自己实际上并没有增加重量的情况。说实话，看到这样一个巨大的生物努力保持平衡的样子，还挺有趣的。于是你轻轻拍了拍他的肩膀，试图帮他重新站稳。 rows.raw: " It works, it really does. Climbing from the ice shelf to sea level, Gweyr's the first to toe the waters, then gives you a wave. "Come on down. Imora's a tease, but she's good where it counts." It takes some courage to get around your instincts and step into the choppy, blue waters, but the old wolfess is right. Behind you, Imora gives a little encouraging wave, and the ocean is pleasantly balmy as you sink first one foot beneath the surface, then another, then finally fall forward and take the plunge. It's terrifying, that moment of your first breath where you feel the air leaving your lungs and water rushing in — followed by a spike of relief when you fail to drown. Down on your [pc.belly], Imora's magical ink glows faintly, working its magic and keeping you alive despite the icy sea pressing in all about you. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia einin etheryn |Beside you, Cait shivers a little, and you know it's not from the cold. Given that she's from the deserts of Jassira, she's about as much out of her element as she can get, and though you can see the seafloor here the same can't be said for the murky darkness that the ocean fades into in the distance. It's certainly a different world, to say the least. Cait's hair, fur and clothes are floating all over the place, but the reassuring pat you give her on the head still seems to work. She nods, mouths a few words, then realizes that she can't speak underwater and giggles a bit. That there's something of the bubbly Cait you know. |As you swim on, Brint looks a little unsteady on his feet, flailing around and trying to get used to his new weight in the water, or lack thereof anyway. To be fair, seeing a giant like him trying to right himself is a little funny, and you give him a little pat on the shoulder and try to heave him right-side up. Brint gives you a look, tries to say something, then realizes that while Imora's tattoo may keep you from drowning, it does nothing for speaking underwater. After a few tries, he eventually gives up, shrugs, and grins sheepishly. He'd better get used to it... that, or hopefully you won't have to fight Tollus while swimming. |As you swim on, Brienne looks a little unsteady on her feet, flailing around and trying to get used to her new weight in the water, or lack thereof anyway. To be fair, seeing a giant like your [silly |moo ]cow companion trying to right herself is a little funny, [silly | what with tits being natural floatation devices and all, ]and you give her a little pat on the shoulder and try to heave her right-side up. Brienne gives you a look, tries to say something, then realizes that while Imora's tattoo may keep you from drowning, it does nothing for speaking underwater. After a few tries, she eventually gives up, shrugs, and grins sheepishly. She'd better get used to it... that, or hopefully you won't have to fight Tollus while swimming. |Arona swims on beside you, clearly practiced at this — not surprising, for a seafaring people from the Sailgraves. For someone as thick and muscular as she is, your orcish companion is surprisingly aquadynamic — her movements unimpeded by her [arona.armor], she darts ahead, peers into the murky distance and then points. Guess she wants you to hurry up... Yeah, she's getting impatient, isn't she? Drawing her [arona.weapon], Arona gives it a few test swings through the water, then looks thoughtful — a rarity, indeed — before shaking her head. She's not too enthused about the drag her weapon's creating... you just hope that you don't have to fight while swimming. |Azyrran swims on beside you — or at least, tries to. Her vesparan instincts are telling her she's in the air and should be flying, but at the same time her insectile wings can't handle how thick the water is compared to air. The end result is more than a little comical, until she finally gives up trying to use her wings and instead paddles on awkwardly with her hands and feet. It's clear that Azzy isn't used to swimming, and you give your honeyed companion a reassuring pat before pressing on. |Quin swims on silently beside you; he's pulled and tied back his clothes close to his body and paddles on with an air of grim determination about him, having gone so far as to tie his ears down against his head so they don't drag in the water. You lay a hand on his shoulder and tilt your head. Is he sure he's going to be all right? Quin moves as if to brush you off, then rolls his shoulders and nods before pointing to the seafloor. Yeah, you understand he's getting at. Some things are just long overdue. |Your fox-wife paddles along beside you, hair and clothes billowing out behind her like some kind of pretty fish; it's a small miracle she can still move through the water as easily as she does with all the drag she must be creating. Oh, she smell of wet fur is going to be pretty bad later... but that just means more excuses for brushing and grooming later on, doesn't it? |Atugia swims easily through the cold waters, keeping ahead of you as a vanguard. She's clearly had some experience with water, although where and how she got it is anyone's guess. Does Teiglache have a lot of lakes and rivers? |Einin darts ahead of you, slipping agilely through the water as she scouts ahead, alert for trouble. You'd have imagined those mouse ears of hers would make her stand out more, but she's clearly experienced when it comes to swimming, even with all her clothes on. Pressed against the seafloor, she's barely visible, a dark shape flitting about and making sure you keep out of danger. |Ryn wouldn't have been bothered by the cold anyway, but water isn't something she appears to be used to. Still, she puts on a brave front, paddling forward as best as she's able to despite her clothes weighing her down. The poor thing couldn't have had much experience with swimming in the palace or the Winter City in general... well, there's always a time to learn, and that time is now. You swim on, Gweyr taking the lead with her spear in hand. While the wolfess is still wrapped up in her furs — plus having a fur coat all of her own — she's still quick through the water, this clearly being nothing new to her. Looking back at you, she waves you on, then points down at the seabed. ] It isn't long before [party.hasCompanions |all of |the both of ] you end up near the spot where the cultist ship anchored — now that you're on the other side of the waves, the buoy Gweyr left is eminently visible, bobbing in place with its red underside. Below it stretches the yawning mouth of a deep, dark chasm, the gaping maw of some abyssal beast, and about its lips swim a dozen or so siorc alphas brandishing spears. One of them — Seastone — darts over to Gweyr through the water, giving the both of you a wide-toothed smile by way of greeting. "Finally, you showed up. Feeling your age a little, aren't you?" Gweyr mouths something that's unintelligible underwater, but the scowl says all you need to know. Seastone guffaws and thumps the old wolfess on the chest, then turns her attention to you. "And you. Stay safe down there, okay? You're brave enough to head where even we fear to swim — or maybe you just don't know the dangers of the deep. Ha! "Either way, Gweyr tells me you've some history with these assholes, so even if you did, you're the best choice to go down and kick their asses. My girls and I will be staying up top to take care of any big ones you might stir up from the bottom of that pit, make sure they don't do too much damage trying to flee." You nod, and Seastone hands you each a glowing shard of coral. "Here, to light your way... and for good luck. I get the feeling you'll need it. If you don't come back in a day or two, my girls and I will consider the both of you dead... so come back, okay? I'd miss the both of you." Gweyr snorts, then takes you by the hand. Together, the both of you float over to the lip of the chasm, peering down into the upswell of icy water that rises from the unyielding blackness within. Gweyr looks at you, you look [party.hasCompanions |back at [party.som||[comp1.name]|[comp1.name] and [comp2.name]] |back at her ]. Swallowing hard, you take [party.som |Gweyr in hand, feeling her thick, gnarled fingers close in about yours |[comp1.name] and Gweyr in hand, feeling their fingers close in about yours |[comp1.name] and [comp2.name] in hand, feeling their fingers close in about yours ], then make the leap of faith. Blackness rushes in. "

rows.original: First, it's the trench's rocky walls that lose color as the light fades, then the glimmer of light from the waves above shrinks to a seam before disappearing completely. Further and further you sink into the darkness, forcing yourself to descend ever deeper even though your body shies at the sensation of falling with no solid ground underfoot; soon enough, the only thing keeping you from scraping against the trench's walls is the small shard of coral Seastone handed you, keeping the darkness at bay with a faint circle of light. Deeper and deeper... The current of cold water welling up from below strengthens, slowing your descent; something is driving it up to the surface with insidious force. It not for it, telling which direction is up would be hard; more and more water presses in upon your frail, fleshy body, an intense crushing force that threatens to squeeze the life out of your lungs and heart, but Imora's magical tattoo keeps you alive and breathing to the bitter end. An eternity passes by in what feels like the blink of an eye, the only tell that this isn't some kind of dream the presence of [party.som |Gweyr's hand |[party.compNames] and Gweyr's hands |[party.compNames]' hands ] in your own. But at last, your feet touch solid ground, kicking up a cloud of ancient silt and sand as you land. Wondering if you've just hit a snag, you shine the coral light around, but soon confirm that you've reached the bottom of the trench, by all appearances. This place isn't without life of its own — the pitch-black darkness is populated with pinpricks and flashes of light that flicker briefly in the water before winking out, and you swear you feel things moving against your feet as you step forward. And then as Gweyr points, her outstretched hand but a dim silhouette, you see it too. The castle's buried in trench wall, half of it jutting out like some kind of rock formation. The shattered remains of statues lie all about the ground: the remains of colossal heads and limbs lying strewn on the seabed, their features undeniably that of ice giants — jotuns. The closer you draw to the ruins, the more obvious it becomes that the castle is made for giants and not the smaller races of Savarra — everything is jotun-sized, and scaled to match. As for the cult, signs of their presence are evident — scattered bits of rope, old bottles, rotting wood and more litter the rocky sand of the depths, strewn around without care and feeding whatever creatures that lurk this deep beneath the surface of the ocean. They mustn't feel particularly inspired to hide their presence here, and rightly so — what sort of creature could, or would, pursue them all the way down into the deep dark? Still, that makes it easy to find the entrance. [pc.weapon] in hand, you follow the trail — tracks have been left in the silt and clay where heavy loads have been dragged across it, and without much to disturb them they've lingered for you to find. You arrive at a set of great double doors, but the actual entrance is a hole in the underside of the castle's floor, a break where the masonry's fallen away. Swimming upwards, you reach out and take a deep lungful of — — Air! It's cold and clammy, more than a little miserable, but it's air all right. You heave a couple of times, feeling water gush out of your nose and mouth, then haul yourself up onto cold stone and help Gweyr up onto solid ground. The old wolfess takes a second or two to wring the water out of her clothes and fur, then coughs the last of the sea out from her lungs. "Tira's tits," she mutters, heaving a sigh. "Wonder where we are. Even the jotuns themselves don't tell any stories about their glory days building this kind of thing; as far as I've ever known them it's been all about the tribal life." [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia einin etheryn |Cait hauls herself out of the water, first shoving her [cait.weapon] onto dry land before pushing herself up and over. With her being as top-heavy as she is, it takes both you and Gweyr helping her to get her front up up and out of the water, but once that's done and over with the rest is easy by comparison. Coughing and spluttering, Cait takes a moment to dry off, wringing her tail and squeezing her hair dry. "Ooohh. I'm going to have to dye my hair and fur again when we get back." "When we get back," Gweyr affirms with a small smile. "Keep up that morale, girl. We've got more things to worry about now, but when we make it back I'll dye your fur all you want, teach you a couple tricks I learned to look good on the march. Coming from him, that's a compliment, but it's to be expected, isn't it? This place was presumably built by giants, after all. Makes sense it'd be giant-sized. "Yeah, but..." Coming from a Sailgraves woman like her, that's got to be something. Damn, I think I saw my granddad in there somewhere while we were sinking. I saw him a couple times as a sprat, but his ship got scuttled on a raid and he never made it home." Really? That wasn't what you meant, but... all right. Flicking the worst of the salt water from her hands, Arona clenches her [arona.weapon], peering into the darkness. "Fuck.
