阿兹兰勉强笑了笑，但那笑容显得有些忧郁。“那个女孩，我能够理解她的感受。在我那些无法回到蜂巢的日子里，一想到自己可能永远失去了母亲和姐妹们，这种念头就一直压在我的心头。 想象一下，如果这件事持续了二十年……即使知道那并不是她的错，我也一定会受到极大的折磨。但是，如果我…… 做了 我曾经以为我的母亲抛弃了我，就像那个女孩一样……哦，如果真是那样的话，我该有多痛苦啊。 愤怒的正如她所说，那里确实有很多问题需要解决。她母亲的离世无疑对格温造成了伤害，而更糟糕的是，你并不完全确定她真正憎恨的是格韦尔，还是这些年来她在心中构建起来的母亲的形象。我想，后者的可能性更大吧，但是…… “我们等着看吧。这既不会容易，也不会很快结束，我现在就已经能预感到这一点了。 |嗯，这样应该就能解决那个问题了，”昆蒂勒斯笑着说，一边做着几个夸张的动作擦手。“那位老妇人为正义奋斗了这么久，确实应该得到休息。” 是啊，格韦尔还是会继续战斗的，只不过是另一种形式的战斗罢了。 我当然感兴趣。至少，在我不能和你一起外出活动的时候，这能让酒馆里的气氛变得更热闹一些。毕竟，有一个家庭陷入了困境……这也给我们上了一课，让我们明白自己的行为会如何影响周围的人。 正如你所说，那里确实有很多需要改进的地方。她母亲的离世无疑对格温造成了伤害，更糟糕的是，你并不完全确定她真正憎恨的是格韦尔，还是这些年来她在自己心中构建起来的母亲的形象。 后者的情况应该更为复杂吧，但你可能会想…… “我们等着瞧吧。这既不会容易，也不会很快，我现在就已经能预感到这一点了。” 那么他呢？他的家庭又该如何呢？ 想到这里，奎因不禁皱起了眉头。 嗯……我实在很难说这种情况比加斯的状况更糟糕还是稍微好一些。当然，两者的问题性质不同，如果你非要把这种状况也称为‘一团糟’的话……不过这个话题留到下次再讨论吧。 |好吧，这件事就这样解决了，”清子说道，你们俩看着格温尔把加思带走，加入到他们孩子们的行列中。“确实干得不错。” 格温尔追逐那个邪教组织的日子可能已经结束了，但她只不过是开始了一场不同类型的斗争而已。之前与桑德斯和格温之间有过几次冲突，但幸好最终没有人真的动起手来。这对未来的发展来说，确实树立了一个良好的榜样。 我真心希望那位老妇人能够和女儿重归于好，”你的狐狸妻子说道，“毕竟家庭才是最重要的。考虑到那个女儿甚至都不记得自己母亲的样貌，我非常认为她其实并没有真正怨恨自己的母亲，而是在她心中构建了一个关于母亲的扭曲形象。这反而会让事情变得更加复杂……她把自己所有的负面情绪都寄托在了对母亲的怨恨之中。 要想不再讨厌格韦尔，格温就必须审视自己，重新审视自己的本质——而这种自我反思的能力，以及拥有这样的心理承受力，其实是很多人所缺乏的。不过，在家人的帮助下，或许她终于能够接受母亲回到家中这一事实了。 幸好我们女儿的性格要好得多，不是吗？”清子轻笑着说道，“啊，抱歉，也许我的话有点刺痛你了。不过，你的朋友能够和家人团聚，真是太好了……我相信，这样才是最好的结果。 |看到加斯和他的家人终于团聚了，真是太好了，”瑞恩说道，同时注视着格韦尔正把她的丈夫拉到车后，与他们的孩子们在一起。“他一直包容着我，也包容了你……把他的妻子带回家，对他为我们所做的一切来说，这只是一个小小的回报罢了。呵呵，看现在的形势发展，似乎是他正在为此付出代价。 “嗯，他把事情拖了这么久……我能够理解他的恐惧，他希望明天能和今天一样，因为你知道自己已经度过了今天这个日子。 但如果我能克服恐惧，早点去寻求帮助，冬城或许就不会陷入如此糟糕的境地了。 如果她早点去寻求帮助，或许根本就不会遇到你。 你明白我的意思吧…… [pc.name]我也有过类似的经历，所以对于加思在不久的将来可能会遭遇的任何事情，我并不能说自己会感到完全同情，因为他的处境在某种程度上也是他自己造成的。对于我自己，我也不能否认这一点。 ]
rows.raw: " It takes a little longer than expected — not surprising in retrospect, but certainly melancholic. Gweyr pauses for a moment to inspect the hanging wolfshead sign over the entrance, to thumb the grain of the doorway's timbers. The old wolfess takes a deep breath, squares her shoulders, and then rubs her temples. She's afraid. "Mom..." "I remember when these were new; I put them in place myself," Gweyr mutters thoughtfully. "Never thought I'd have reason to see them again. And now that I'm here, I find myself wondering just how I'm going to face your sister." "...She's half the reason why you're here, Mom." "I know, kid. Just give me a second or two to gather myself. Funny, isn't it? A woman who survived the dark places under the Heartlands as a mercenary, who lived her life in the cold — she's afraid of facing her own daughter. It shouldn't make sense, and yet it does." But at last, Gweyr gathers herself; Garret and you push open the door for her, and she steps in. [dayNight |There aren't that many patrons in the common room given that the evening crowd hasn't gathered yet, but that just means the old wolfess is more able to gather notice as a hush falls over the taproom. What spoils the mood even more, though, |The common room is in a reasonable state of carousel as is expected for the Frost Hound, and doesn't pause in the least as the old wolfess makes her entrance. No, what spoils the mood ] is the fact that instead of Garth behind the bar with his mugs, Gwyn's manning his post, a distinctive scowl on her face that leaves little doubt as to what she thinks of her mother's homecoming. [gwyn.isPregnant |As pregnant as she is, Gwyn's all too ready to sweep out from around the counter, waddling up to her mother and glaring daggers at her. It's sobering, the juxtaposition of all the anger packed into a pregnant woman, but in the end... it's not really surprising, is it? |Showing her teeth, Gwyn's all too ready to sweep out from around the counter, striding up to her mother and glaring daggers at her. It's sobering, seeing such naked hatred completely consume the usually docile Gwyn, but then... this outcome was never really in doubt, was it? ] "So that's what you look like. You dare to show your face here," Gwyn growls, trying her best to sound aggressive and not-so-surreptitiously choking back a sob in the process. "You dare! I was the one who stayed with Daddy all these years! I was the one who cooked his meals, darned his clothes, listened to him, while you — you — what have you done for him, anyway!" "I bought all of you time to have a future," Gweyr replies quietly. "I can't believe you're acting like some kind of martyr after throwing the three of us away like so much trash for years! I won't let you steal Da — " "Gwyneth, that's enough." Gwyn looks like she's going to scream, but her inner submissiveness, especially to her father, clashes with the rage roiling inside of her at the sound of Garth's voice. Moaning, the nursery matron raises her hands to her face and starts to weep. "And don't turn on the waterworks for me." Garth says as he closes the last of the steps down from the Hound's second floor. "Not in front of the customers, either. Go out back and we'll settle this later." Gwyn doesn't seem to hear her father, and after another bout of sniffling and sobbing Garret sighs and takes his sister out back, hooking his hands under her shoulders and gently but firmly leading her away from the scene. That leaves Garth, Gweyr and you — and everyone else in the common room, of course. "I leave our daughter to tend the bar while I clean the guest rooms, and this happens; you're still capable of making an entrance as ever. Welcome home, for what it's worth." "Our daughter..." "Like you, she was never one for lying." As Gweyr shakes her head and lets her shoulders slump, Garth turns to you. "Well then, [pc.name], you've brought my wife home, after all these years. I suppose I should thank you for that, even if I suspect I won't have peace under this roof for a little while." He can damn well put up with it, then. This isn't just about him, or Gweyr, or Sanders. You've been here in Hawkethorne for a while now, and heard the rumors going about town — as what passes for the village alderman, he shouldn't be surprised that tongues wag about him, and some of the things said are unkind. On the other hand, people saying that Gwyn's first litter of pups was fathered either by him or Garret — that's the kind of hearsay that truly gains legs when it's plausible to begin with. "Yes, I've heard that one, and many others. As much as it hurts, what's it got to do with bringing my wife back, [pc.name]?" What's it got to do is that the buck stops here. Yes, you've heard all sides of the tale as to what happened twenty years ago. No, you don't think anyone will ever truly be apportioned the blame, and it's one of those situations where frankly everyone had a hand in mucking it all up. But the consequences of their actions so long ago have bled not just into their lives from that day on, but the lives of those around them — Garret and Gwyn, for example — and maybe even Hawkethorne at large. Just like before, no one wants to admit the problem that's lying in plain sight, letting it fester, and fixing it starts with bringing Gweyr back so she can catch up on the twenty years she missed with her son and daughter. Is it going to be perfect and everything's going to be fine once she's back in the Hound? No, of course not. But at least everyone's going to have to confront the matter and start working on patching things up, for the sake of the next generation if nothing else. The sons shouldn't have to pay for the sins of the fathers, as the saying goes. "Nice speech there, [pc.name]. Now, Garth, what [pc.heShe] means is that we're going to go in the back with our children and do some catching up," Gweyr adds, catching her husband by the scruff of his neck. "And you've got some explaining to do, like [jaelyn.isMaid|why you've got a pale elf waitress here, and just why she's wearing my old maid outfit|the state you've let the sign fall into all these years when I wasn't around to bother you with it]." ...And that's it. With all of the family out back, the show's over, although you can hear raised voices coming from the backyard, muffled as they are. There's the temptation to do more, but you've already done plenty by convincing Gweyr to come home and Sanders to step aside. The rest is truly up to them to sort out, and judging by the ruckus caucus that's going on they're well on their way to doing just that. While you don't expect this family to sort out all its dysfunctions in a day or even a year, the important thing is that they've made a start on it. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona atugia azyrran quintillus kiyoko etheryn |"All's well that ends well, eh?" Cait gives you a weak grin and wipes her brow. "For a moment there — well, a couple of moments — I thought it was really touch and go. That bit with Sanders, and when Gwyn looked like she was fit to burst — I thought it was all going to break down there, and a fight would've been the least of it." Oh, it would've been the least of it all right, but sometimes you've got to rip off the scab to let the wound heal. "It just goes to remind me how thankful I should be to have had a mom and dad who cared for me with everything they had, even if the latter wasn't always around. He may have had to travel on business so often, but I never doubted that he'd be there for me and Mom if either of us ever needed him." |"All's well that ends well, eh?" Brint gives you a weak grin and wipes his brow with the back of his hand. "That could've gone a lot worse if Sanders or Gwyn had decided to press the issue and had gotten handsy." It was a risk you were willing to take not just for Gweyr, but her kids' sakes as well. Well worth it, otherwise you wouldn't have started this whole chain of events to begin with. "Yeah, I know it's got to be worth it, and yes, it did come close a couple of times. But..." he pauses and muses a moment, scratching his chin. "Y'know, I can't blame Gwyn, even if she took things a little further than I'd have done. If my dad just showed up at my doorstep one day, I'd have a handful of questions that'd need answering, too. Maybe not angry ones if he went away for a good reason, but still a stern-talking to given that he didn't tell anyone why." |"All's well that ends well, eh?" Brienne gives you a weak grin and wipes her brow with the back of her hand. "That could've gone a lot worse if Sanders or Gwyn had decided to press the issue and had gotten handsy." Maybe not angry ones if he went away for a good reason, but still a stern-talking to given that he didn't tell anyone why." |"Sheesh, sappy stuff," Arona mutters, crossing her arms. "It's like that kind of stuff that Rags always liked to read to Hretha." Well, it's not quite a happy ending, if that's what bothers her. There's still a lot this family needs to work through, and the baggage of twenty years isn't going to be cleared up in a single night. "Y'know what I think would've been more interesting? If a fight had broken out, either with that old priest or the daughter. What? Don't look at me like that — I'm not saying that it'd have been any better, I'm just saying it would've been more interesting, that's all. You can't deny that." Interesting for Arona, maybe. Does she ever think about her parents, wherever they may be? Arona shrugs. "Look, let's just say that I'd want my kids to remember me in my prime. Strong, young, beating in someone's head. Not old and weathered like that woman... she might've even been worthy of looking up to, once. Now, she's just beaten and going to be living out the rest of her years, waiting for a straw death." You shake your head at that, noting that Arona neatly evaded the question about her parents and making a note to press her on it sometime. Oh no, no. If anything, Gweyr's true battle has only just begun. |"Looks like it all ended just peachy, didn't it?" Atugia says, watching Gweyr drag Garth off. "I was a little worried there — Carmen always didn't like it when people fought, least of all those she considered her own." Does she think that even knowing everything that Gweyr did, that the baroness would consider the wolfess one of her own? Tui thinks this over for a bit. "I'd say so. Maybe she made a mistake or two, but she did it in the defense of the town; if Carmen was going to find fault with her for that, then she'd be a hypocrite." Just what were the details of this thing that the baroness did anyway that were so bad to even surpass Gweyr's mass slaughter? "That's her story to tell, not mine. Sorry, but I don't have that right." Well, if she says so... |"What a happy family," Azyrran says with a sigh as she watches Gweyr drag Garth off out back. "There's a lot of mending that needs to be done there." She speaks the truth, yeah. Still, you think that all this was for the best, and that it went surprisingly well given that neither Sanders nor Gwyn actually came to blows with her. There's hope yet. Azyrran chuckles, a forced laugh, then looks a bit melancholic. "The girl, I can empathize with her. In the days that I couldn't return home to the hive, the thought that I might've lost my mother and sisters forever was always a weight on my heart. To imagine that it would've stretched on for twenty years... even knowing that it wasn't her fault, I'd have been sorely tested. But if I did believe that my mother had abandoned me, like the girl does... oh, I would've been furious." Like she said, there's a lot of mending that needs to be done there. The absence of her mother has undoubtedly damaged Gwyn, and to make things worse you're not entirely sure if it's Gweyr she actually hates, or more an image of her mother that she's built up over the years. More the latter, you'd imagine, but... "We'll see. We'll see. It'll be neither easy nor quick, I can already tell as much." |"Well, that should put paid to that," Quintillus says with a grin, dusting off his hands with several exaggerated motions. "Old woman deserves a break after fighting the good fight for so long." Yeah, Gweyr's still going to be fighting, just battles of a different sort. "Can't say I'm not interested. The absence of her mother has undoubtedly damaged Gwyn, and to make things worse you're not entirely sure if it's Gweyr she actually hates, or more an image of her mother that she's built up over the years. That could make things harder... she has invested so much of her identity in resenting her mother." But with her family helping her, maybe she can finally come around to her mother being home. "It is a good thing our daughter is much better in the way of temperament, is it not?" Kiyoko chuckles. "He's put up with me, he's put up with you... bringing his wife back home is a small price to pay for everything he's done for us." Heh. I'm not going to deny the same of myself, either." ] "

rows.original:
As you approach the entrance to Gweyr's little hideaway, you can't help but notice something's... different. It puts your hackles up, and has you reaching for your weapon. 

    Nothing jumps out at you, though. But neither do you find any trace of the old wolf, either. A few minutes looking through her hideout shows no sign that she's been here since the last time you saw her. What little food she had has been stolen away by animals already, and her possessions have been blown into disarray by the wind. 
    
    Shit, maybe the cult got to her? Or she had to go into hiding because of them. In either case, there's no sign of her; this place has been abandoned.
rows.translation:
当你接近格温尔的小隐居处入口时，你不禁会发现有些地方……不一样了。这种异常让你感到警觉，不由得伸手去拿武器。

不过，并没有什么东西突然跳出来攻击你。同时，你也找不到那只老狼的任何踪迹。 花了几分钟时间检查她的藏身处，却发现没有任何迹象表明她自你上次见到她之后还来过这里。她剩下的那点食物早就被动物们抢走了，而她的物品也被风吹得乱七八糟。 
    
    该死，也许那个邪教组织控制了她？又或者是因为他们的缘故，她不得不躲起来。不管是哪种情况，现在都找不到她的踪迹了——这个地方已经被彻底废弃了。

A siorc figure is laid out on the ice star-gazing and unbothered by the cold, their own flesh a stunning mirror of the celestial scape above. ] There's a rug beneath her, and a bag that you can see... but no obvious weapons. [var0 |You peer a little more closely, and figure this has to be Imora — the siorc fits the description Gweyr gave you, and the wolfess did say that she liked to sunbathe. [party.som |Checking over your gear, you walk towards the siorcanna |[companion1.name] nods at you and checks [companion1.hisHer] gear, joining you as you step closer |Your companions check themselves and nod, ready to dish out a beating if the worst occurs ]. While you don't think you've got the wrong person, it doesn't hurt to be prepared just in case. The siorc sits up as you draw closer, tail slapping on the ice; Her voice is sing-songy, tickling your ears and taking the edge off of any tension you'd had building up. "Hello there, traveler[party.hasCompanions |s ]! Kindly don't shoot or stab, I'm unarmed." You sigh and return your [pc.weapon], spreading your own hands in peace. [pc.isDK |Plus you can probably throttle her with bare hands if it comes to it. ]She's Imora, is that right? That puts the siorc on guard, which answers your question neatly. "Who's asking?" A friend of Gweyr's. The two of you are hunting together, for lack of a better way to put it, and the wolfess sent you to ask for the help only a shaman like her could provide. The Siorc smiles — a pointy-toothed affair — and greets you with eyes nearly completely closed, only barely hinting at the bright pools of color beneath. "Well, if that isn't quite flattering, coming from that [silly |stinky ]old grump. Well then, I'm Imora, Shaman of Starhome, beta of High Shaman Seastone. And you?" [pc.dcb |"[pc.name]..." You trail off and take a better look at her, trying to get the proper measure of this sparkly tart's power. So far? No tells. |"I'm [pc.name]. [party.som |A pleasure!" |This is [companion1.name]." [companion1.name] grins and waves. |These two are [companion2.name], and [companion1.name]." The other two give her little nods of the affirmative. ] |"Heh, I'm [pc.name]! A super-duper pleasure to meet you, cutie." ] Imora gives a little curtsey — a motion that draws her suit tightly against her slit to show at the tender flesh beneath — before waving her hands gently. "And with that... what exactly does that old wolfess want with me?" You briefly explain the situation with the rift, the goop, and how you need to delve into the depths of the ocean to pursue Tollus, Leold and their goons. You understand that she can grant you and your companions magical tattoos that'll keep you alive so far underwater? Imora hesitates. "This is rather out of the blue, but yes, it's something I can do. That being said, give me a moment; we can discuss it in a minute or two when I've got my thoughts straightened out — you caught me while I was out relaxing, and I'm not quite in a business frame of mind... or at least, not serious business." Yeah, that's fine. You'll ask about it once she's gotten her bearings. |It could still be a trap though, and the Siorc hasn't taken note of you. ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.IMORA_MET | |[dayNight |虽然天气很冷，但看起来确实有某个希奥克生物躺在冰面上晒太阳呢。 |在夜幕降临之际…… 寒冷的 夜色宁静而寒冷，但天空仿佛被星光照成了一片美丽的地毯。有一位萨奥克人坐在冰面上凝视着星空，丝毫不受寒冷的影响，他们的肌肤仿佛成为了映照天上景色的镜子，美丽得令人惊叹。 ] 她的身下铺着一块地毯，还有一个你可以看到的包……不过并没有明显的武器。 [var0 |你仔细观察了一下，终于确定这一定是伊莫拉——这位女巫符合格韦尔给你的描述，而且那头母狼也确实说过她喜欢晒太阳。 [party.som |检查好自己的装备后，你朝着那个神秘的地方走去。 |[companion1.name] 向你点头，然后进行检查。 [companion1.hisHer] 齿轮，会在你靠近的那一刻与你一同启动。 |你的同伴检查了自己的状态，然后点了点头，准备在最坏的情况发生时给予反击。 ]虽然你认为自己找对人了，但以防万一，做好准备总没有坏处。当你靠近时，那位女巫坐了起来，尾巴在冰面上拍打着；她的声音带着轻快的节奏，听起来十分悦耳，让你原本可能积累起来的紧张情绪都烟消云散了。 “你好啊，旅行者。[party.hasCompanions |s ]请不要开枪或刺我，我手部无寸铁。” 你叹了口气，然后把武器收了回去。 [pc.weapon]伸出自己的双手部，追求和平。 [pc.isDK |而且，如果真的有必要的话，你甚至可以徒手制伏她。 ]她是伊莫拉，对吧？ 这个回答让那位女巫提高了警惕，这也很好地回答了你的问题——“谁在问？” 是格韦尔的一个朋友。用另一种说法，你们俩正在一起狩猎，而这位女狼人正是派你来寻求只有她这样的萨满才能提供的帮助的。 那位女巫露出了笑容——那是一张长满尖牙的脸——她几乎闭着眼睛与你打招呼，只有那双眼睛中闪烁的明亮光芒微微透露出她的内心。“嗯，这样的赞美，出自她之口，真是再贴切不过了…… [silly |难闻的 ]老脾气嘛……那么，我是伊莫拉，星之家园的萨满，也是“高等萨满·海石”模式的测试者。你呢？ [pc.dcb |"[pc.name]……”你的话渐渐停了下来，仔细打量着她，试图判断出这个闪闪发光的“小辣妹”到底有多厉害。不过目前来看？还完全不清楚。 |我…… [pc.name]. [party.som |非常荣幸！ |这就是 [companion1.name]." [companion1.name] 微笑着挥手部致意。 |这两个就是 [companion2.name]，以及 [companion1.name]另外两个人也轻轻点了点头，表示同意。 ] |呵呵，我嘛…… [pc.name]真高兴见到你，可爱的人。 ] 伊莫拉微微鞠了一躬——这个动作使得她的套装更加紧贴身躯，从而露出了下方那柔软的肌肤——然后轻轻挥了挥手部。“那么……那个老狼女到底想从我这里得到什么呢？你简要地说明了与那道裂隙、那种黏稠物质有关的状况，以及为什么你必须深入海洋深处去追捕Tollus、莱奥德以及他们的手部下。你知道，她可以为你和你的同伴施加魔法纹身，这些纹身能让你在水中存活下去，对吧？ 伊莫拉犹豫了一下。“这个要求有点突然，不过确实是我能够做的。不过，请给我一点时间，等我想清楚后再讨论吧——你抓到我正在休息的时候，我现在还没进入工作状态呢。……或者至少，这不算什么严肃的事情。” “嗯，那样也好。等她熟悉环境后，你会再问她的。 |不过，这也可能是个陷阱，而且那个希奥克根本没有注意到你。 ] ]

rows.original:
As you swim down towards this 'Temple of Challenge,' you're struck by the scale of it, pausing for a brief moment in the journey down. Imora grins and indicates the structure with a grandiose sweep of her arm. "Not bad, huh?"

            Huge schools of silver-and-blue icefish move around like turbulent stormclouds, the depths of which swap between obscuring and framing the building. When you catch sight of the foundations you could swear they've been gouged clear out of the earth by a pair of immense claws, and gods only know how long ago such an event occurred judging by the tremendous growth of coral and weed clinging to it like sylphic architecture of its own.
            
            And then you 'touch down' on the ground, where Imora leads you to an enclosure near the temple building. All at once the pressure in your ears pops, and a shiver rocks its way down your spine. 

            "Okay, this is the air-cave... if you want to rest, I'll get you prepped and make sure you're safe to stay underwater for a little while and get into a scuffle. Alright?" Imora shakes out her lengthy locks, dripping dry surprisingly quickly. 
            
            The shaman settles down and double-checks her work, ensuring that the next time you're submerged you'll still be able to breathe water. It's a deeply unsettling feeling to swap from breathing air, to breathing water... and back again. [party.Yall] spend a few moments heaving — much to Imora's amusement — before you're able to relax once more.
rows.translation:
当你朝着这座“挑战之神殿”游去时，它的规模令你惊叹不已，你在下行的过程中不由得停下了脚步。伊莫拉咧嘴一笑，然后用她那豪迈的手势指了指那座建筑：“不错吧？那些庞大的银蓝色冰鱼群像翻腾的暴风云一般游动，它们的身影时而遮挡住建筑物，时而又将其映得清晰可见。当你终于看到那些建筑物的地基时，你会忍不住怀疑，是不是有某对巨大的爪子将它们直接从地底挖了出来。而那些附着在地基上的珊瑚和藻类，已经生长得如此茂盛，仿佛它们本身就是一种奇妙的自然建筑，由此可见，这种事件究竟发生在多久之前了。
            
            然后你降落在地面上，伊莫拉带你来到了寺庙附近的一个围栏处。突然间，你耳朵里的压力消失了，一阵寒意从脊梁骨一直传到全身。

“好了，这就是空气洞穴……如果你想休息的话，我会为你做好准备，确保你可以安全地在水下待一段时间，进行那些活动。好吗？”伊莫拉甩了甩她那长长的头发，那些水竟然出奇地快就干掉了。 
            
            女萨满仔细检查了自己的工作，确保下次当你潜入水中时，仍然能够呼吸水中的空气。从呼吸空气转变为呼吸水中的空气，然后再变回来，这种感觉实在令人感到非常不安。 [party.Yall] 你得花上几分钟的时间来喘息，这让伊莫拉觉得非常有趣，直到最后你才能再次放松下来。

rows.original: "Hey, I was hoping to see you again." Imora, the sparkly shark-shaman smiles and shakes out her hair. [pc.dcb |"What now?" Imora snorts, planting her hands on her hips. "You don't have to say it like I'm trying to sell you something; I wanted to let you know it's possible to undertake The Temple of Challenge." |"How come?" Imora grins toothily, planting her hands on her hips. "I wanted to let you know; The Temple of Challenge is open to outsiders again." |"D'awwh, I bet you were, cutie!" Imora clears her throat and glances away, slowly planting her hands on her hips. "We've opened up The Temple of Challenge now." ] The siorc's stance relaxes a little once she has your attention, settling into an easy smile. "Basically, one of our hunters happened to spot you and Gweyr putting a stop to that stinky barrel nonsense, and we've been able to rake a bunch of the remainders away, and keep a few extra guards nearby... Seastone told me to let you know; you get first crack at it, if you'd like." "What does that mean?" "Mmn! Well, if you pass the Temple of Challenge, you can visit our home, Starhome. And you'd get to meet Seastone herself, and challenge her to an Alpha position. Plus there tends to be lots of treats and surprises left in the temple itself by other people who've tried and given up." The siorc-shammy is definitely skipping a lot of extra information, and after spending a few moments thinking, you start again. "What exactly is the temple? Where is it, how do I get there, can I bring friends?" "Ah, sorry. So the temple-slash-cave of challenge is an old building full of monsters and some ghosts that gradually reform. Yes, you can bring friends; occasionally someone will enter with their Betas, I'm sure Seastone won't mind if you bring some help." "Really?" "Yeah. Have you seen our culture? Someone's Betas are a representation of a siorc's own strength, confidence, and upbringing. Sure, your companions may not be actual 'Betas'" Imora pauses to air-quote. "But they're still a reflection of you, and are treated as such." "What's inside the temple, then?" "Not telling about that, but as for getting there? The same old deal; I get you underwater — there's an air-cave right outside the entrance that you can rest in and prepare — and then you go in! Door locked behind you. If you give up, just knock and a guard will get you."
rows.translation: 嘿，我本来还希望能再见到你呢。”闪烁着光芒的鲨鱼萨满伊莫拉微笑着，甩了甩自己的头发。 [pc.dcb |现在该怎么办？” 伊莫拉哼了一声，双手叉腰说道：“你没必要说得好像我在向你推销什么一样；我只是想告诉你，完成‘挑战神殿’的任务确实是可行的。 |怎么会这样？” 伊莫拉咧嘴一笑，双手叉腰说道：“我想告诉你，挑战神殿又向外界开放了。 |哎呀，我敢打赌你肯定也是吧，小可爱！” 伊莫拉清了清嗓子，把目光移开，然后慢慢将双手叉在腰上。“我们现在已经开放了‘挑战神殿’了。 ] 一旦吸引了你的注意，那位女巫的姿态便放松了下来，露出一个轻松的微笑。“基本上，是我们的一名猎人偶然发现了你和格韦尔正在处理那些讨厌的桶状物，之后我们便把剩下的那些东西清理掉了，还在附近安排了一些守卫。……海石让我告诉你：如果你愿意的话，你有权优先尝试。” “这是什么意思？” “嗯……如果你能够通过‘挑战神殿’，就可以来我们的家园——星之家。而且你还有机会见到海石本人，并向她挑战，争夺Alpha的位置。 而且，那些曾经尝试过但最终放弃的人，往往还会在神庙里留下许多小礼物和惊喜。” 这位巫师肯定遗漏了很多重要的信息，经过一番思考后，你决定重新开始尝试。 到底是什么？ 是 那座寺庙？它在哪儿？怎么去那里？我可以带朋友一起去吗？” “啊，抱歉。其实那座所谓的‘挑战之穴’只是一座布满怪物和一些正在慢慢变性的鬼魂的古老建筑罢了。当然，你可以带朋友一起去；偶尔也会有人带着他们的测试版角色一起来，我相信海石也不会介意你们多带些帮手部吧。真的吗？” “是的。你见过我们的文化吗？对于我们来说，某人的‘测试版’就代表着这个人自身的实力、自信以及成长背景。当然，你的同伴可能并不是真正的‘测试版’……”伊莫拉停顿了一下，然后模仿着别人的语气说道。 但它们仍然反映了你的真实面貌，人们也是这样看待它们的。” “那么，神庙里到底有什么呢？” “这个我就不说了。不过要进入那里的话，方法还是一样：我会把你带到水下，在入口外面有一个空气洞穴，你可以在那里休息、做准备，然后再进入神庙！ 门在你身后锁上了。如果你放弃了，只需敲门，就会有守卫来帮你。

        |You check your gear and walk towards the siorcanna.
        |[companion1.name] nods at you and checks [companion1.hisHer] gear, joining you as you stalk closer.

    ] 
    
    Once you're a couple of meters away the Siorc sits up, tail slapping on the ice. Her voice is sing-songy, tickling your ears and taking the edge off of any tension you'd had building up. "Hello there traveler[party.som
        |

        |s

        |Plus you can probably throttle her with bare hands if it comes to it. 
    ]"Who are you, then?"
    
    The Siorc smiles — a pointy-tooth'd affair — and greets you with eyes nearly completely closed, only barely hinting at the bright pools of color beneath. "Imora, Shaman of Starhome, beta of High Shaman Seastone. And you?"
    
    [pc.dcb

rows.original: [seastone.home |Imora snorts and sits up on one of her pillows, big sharky tail swishing as she tosses her hair back. |Imora grins a sharky grin and tosses back her lengthy locks, slapping at the ice with her similarly-sharky tail. ] "[seastone.isABN |Please, I would hope our Alpha has you intimately educated on siorcanna physiology. |Aren't you already intimately familiar with siorcanna physiology? You big dumb [silly |stinky ]alpha... |Hah, well I would be happy to teach you all about our physiology, even if you're [silly |a big dumb stinky |an ] outsider. ]" "I meant more about the people than their insides; tell me about your home and the people." "You make your first mistake already there then; we are our insides." Imora spreads her hands as though this answered your entire question. "More correctly, we love to love, and make love. Alphas have betas, who are wonderfully cared for as a point of respect. We're all bright, and colorful, and different and special, so that we might attract the attention of betas or alphas respectively... and then there's the might-makes-right measure of proving you're strong and capable." "So are the strongest in charge?" "Mostly," Imora scratches her head. "High Shaman Seastone for instance is actually a big dumb nerd like me, she just also happens to have abs, act mature, and is capable of beating down any challengers." Perhaps you might not be speaking to the most unbiased observer. "Her mother, on the other hand, was waaay bigger, but... softer; a shaman through-and-through. But she was still the alpha of a huge family. One of her betas happened to be similarly big — but definitely more ab-tacular — as a warrior, and that's basically why Seastone is as she is... Sometimes it takes a stronger beta who's been won over by a smart sexy alpha, to ensure the best for the people." Imora smiles, waving a hand nebulously around herself. "As for our home? Starhome, so named because of the fact that if you looked up from the depths, you could see the frozen sky still shimmering with a field of its own stars... the water here used to be so clear you could see for miles. Hopefully one day it will be again." The shark continues to smile and twiddles her fingers together, tail slapping on the floor. "Alphas and betas, all the way down. We fight and we fuck, and that means more to us, on a more personal and deep level than any outsider can understand."
rows.translation: [seastone.home |伊莫拉哼了一声，坐到了其中一个枕头上，她那条像大鲨鱼尾巴一样的长发在甩动时发出哗啦声。 |伊莫拉露出一副鲨鱼般的笑容，将她那长长的头发甩到身后，同时用她那同样像鲨鱼尾巴一样的尾巴拍打着冰面。 ] "[seastone.isABN |拜托了，我希望我们的Alpha版本能吸引到你。 亲密地 掌握了关于西奥卡纳生理结构的知识。 |你难道不是已经……了吗？ 亲密地 熟悉西奥卡纳的生理结构吗？你这个大笨蛋 [silly |难闻的 ]阿尔法…… |哈，其实我很乐意为大家讲解我们的生理结构，即使你们…… [silly |又大又蠢又臭的东西 |一个 ] 局外人。 ]我指的是那些人本身，而不仅仅是他们的内在特质；请告诉我关于你的家乡以及那里的人们的事情。” “那么你就已经犯了一个错误了——对我们来说，内在特质才是我们真正的本质。”伊莫拉摊开双手部，仿佛这个回答已经完全解答了你的问题。 更准确地说，我们热爱去爱，也热爱亲密相处。阿尔法成员会拥有贝塔成员，而这些贝塔成员会得到无微不至的关怀，因为这种关怀本身就是一种尊重。我们每个人都充满活力、个性鲜明，而且各具特色，这样才能够分别吸引贝塔成员或阿尔法成员的注意。而另一种方法，就是通过实际行动来证明自己的强大与能力。 那么，最强的人都会负责这些事情吗？” “差不多吧，”伊莫拉挠了挠头，“比如高阶萨满希斯通，其实她也是个像我一样笨笨的家伙，只不过她有腹肌，表现得比较成熟，而且有能力击败任何挑战者罢了。”也许你并不是在和最公正的观察者交谈。 而她的母亲，体型要大得多，不过……性格更为温和；她彻头彻尾就是一位萨满。但她依然是那个庞大家庭的领袖。她的某个兄弟同样体型高大——但作为一名战士，他的能力无疑更为出众，而这也正是海石成为如今这样的一个人的原因……有时候，需要有一个更强大的兄弟，被一位聪明而性感的领袖所吸引，才能为整个家族带来最好的结果。 伊莫拉微笑着，漫无目的地挥了挥手部。“至于我们的家园……星之家园，这个名字的由来是，如果你从深海中向上望去，就能看到那片被冰封的天空，上面仍然闪烁着自己特有的星辰……这里的水曾经清澈得令人能够看到数英里之外的景象。希望有朝一日，它能再次变得如此清澈。 鲨鱼依然微笑着，手部指不停地交叉捻动，尾巴在地板上拍打着。“阿尔法们和贝塔们，从一开始就是如此。我们彼此争斗，也彼此亲密接触，而这些对我们来说，意味着比任何外人都能理解的东西都要重要得多——在更个人化、更深刻的层面上来说。

rows.original: "You wanna know about me? Hmm, well, Seastone calls me her little stardrop... gets me all gooey inside and slick just thinking about it." Imora tilts her head back and shakes out her lengthy locks, thinking for a moment. "I'm a shaman, as I've made it clear, and my speciality is in transformation. How much do you know about alchemy?" You're familiar enough; one ingredient for transformative, one ingredient for location, electrum, and done. The Siorc nods slowly and smiles, waving at her fancy colorful cape. "Yep. We pressure-cook ours in little sealed cauldrons with electrum lining, what with the being-under-water thing, but it's the same otherwise... except for the special stuff." "Special stuff?" "Yeah, I can do more than alchemy transformatives. I can really transform the heck out of something... It's more than just ingredients; it's willpower and proper magic woven together around systems of concept. Also tattoos, considering there isn't much to write on that isn't a clay tablet, we can weave beautiful magic in tattoos too." Imora grins her sharky grin. "Perhaps you'd be interested in some of those?"

rows.original: Imora's expression sours before becoming something a lot more... mixed. "Uuugh, they're so dumb. [silly |Dumb and stinky. ]So they have this whole caste of people — mostly elves — who are professionally loyal, muscular, smoking hot, magically powerful, and secretly all totally super down to fuck— they aren't in charge. It makes no sense!" [pc.dcb |"Elaborate." |"What do you mean?" |"Awww, what? They sound like the super bestest though." ] The shaman snorts and leans back on her hands, idly playing with a pillow. "There are like, nobles and stuff... and they can be whatever. Then there are valkyries, and those girls are all super hot. Our whole alpha-beta thing applies to outsiders too, and Valkyries make for great partners! And for the few that succumb to our mightiest warriors when they cross paths? The sweetest, happiest betas, I've had to tattoo a couple in my day so they could live underwater comfortably." "Okay, sometimes they're really grumpy, until we make it clear they can still flap up there and do their worship thing; Alphas gotta keep their betas happy." She waves off-handedly, shrugging while she puts her thoughts in order. "Still... our ways aren't their ways, but it's disappointing when we get in a scuffle with the elves, and a valkyrie wins, and they don't even take a beta! So many girls and guys come back totally dejected, losing and getting nothing for it. It hurts on an emotional level that goes way beyond a couple broken bones. It's built into us!" Perhaps you could nudge a few towering, muscular elven women in the right direction next time they get in a fight with the siorcanna. Now there's a thought to warm your loins at night. rows.original: The shaman smiles, tail slapping idly at the ice. "You need a temporary means to go underwater then? Presumably with all the not-dying?" "It's a simple enough process; grind up pearls, the fruit of a sea-lantern — glowing, underwater plants we use for light in Starhome — and melt some electrum. Of course, going to incredible depths are a matter of increased risk; it takes a little extra work, [var0|as you well know|but I don't think you need to worry about the crushing depth]." Her hand pats a bag that makes a little clanking noise. "I've got plenty of plain pearls and lantern juice, so if [party.som|you|you and your friend|you and your friends] would like the tattoo, I'll just need the electrum."
rows.translation: 萨满微笑着，尾巴闲散地拍打着冰面。“那么，你需要一种暂时性的方法来潜入水中吧？毕竟那些‘不会死亡’的东西都在那里……” “这个过程其实很简单：把珍珠磨碎——那些海灯果，也就是我们在星之家园里用来照明的发轻型水下植物——然后再熔化一些电银。当然，要去做这些的话…… 难以置信 深入探索意味着面临更大的风险；这需要付出更多的努力。 [var0|如你所知|但我觉得你不必担心那种深不可测的难度。]她的手轻拍着一个袋子，袋子发出轻微的叮当声。“我这里有很多普通的珍珠和灯笼汁，所以如果…… [party.som|你|你和你的朋友|你和你的朋友们] 我想纹这个纹身，只需要用到电银就可以了。

rows.original: [flags.IMORA_TEMP_TAT |Imora begins rummaging in her bag of tricks, pulling out a siorc electrum-cauldron, and a bottle of glowing red juice. "This shouldn't take long." |Imora opens up her bag and pulls out a little pot of electrum; it looks like a stack of random, mismatched coins have been hammered flat into a vaguely cauldron-like shape, and the contents rattle when she gives it a shake. "These here are a siorc speciality; you can hardly alchemize in the open water, so we make the cauldrons out of electrum, fill them with ingredients, and apply a little magic and pressure until they combine." "Don't the contents go everywhere when you make potions?" The shaman shakes her head and smirks, opening the pot and counting pearls. "Nope, usually the contents funnel themselves into lava-blown glass — I'm not about to go explaining how pressure works — and then you can quaff them. Anyway, we're doing ink right now, one of the few things we have to do in the air chambers or on the surface. I'm just going to let this pour out into a bowl." Oh, that makes sense... ] [party.som |You |You and [companion1.name] |You and your companions ] watch as the siorc takes a measured number of pearls out of the cauldron and drops them into another. "Waste not, want not," before she begins to hum musically. She pours glowing red juice from a crude glass vial into the makeshift electrum cauldron, seals the lid, and shakes the contents until they're sloshing and rattling in time to her humming. As she does so, the sound of hissing and fizzing begin to drown her out, until it looks very much like the star-kissed shaman is vigorously shaking a bomb instead of performing alchemy. Despite yourself you wince and lean back, especially when there's a distressing crunch from the electrum cauldron and it looks to cave in on itself. It's only been a minute of humming and shaking, but the spell appears to reach its conclusion; Imora holds her hands over a bowl and opens them, grinning proudly as a thick red ink pours into it. "And there we have it; magical ink. Now. Present your [party.som |lovely tummy |tummies |tummies ] to me, and remember; the moment you drop below sea-level, these tattoos will become active. If you go back up again, the magic ends." "No timer?" [party.som |you ask |[companion1.name] asks |[companion2.name] asks ]. "No timer." With a shrug, you bare your stomach[party.hasCompanions |s ] and wait for Imora to get to work. She pulls out a sharp-looking pearl needle and dips it in the ink, [pc.hasFur |parting your fur carefully to prick at the [pc.skinColor] flesh beneath. |pricking gently at your [pc.skinColor] flesh. ] The sting is only momentary, but heat continues to prickle at you even when she wipes away the blood of each soft stab. [pc.hasWombTattoo |You were worried it would look a little mismatched with your already-present womb tattoo, but the siorcanna does an appreciable job of incorporating glowing red ink into the design. Not bad at all— it's almost a shame that it's temporary. |It's not a large or laborious tattoo, and it's shaped like a little glowing red heart beneath your belly button. ] [party.som | |Your companion gets much the same treatment, eyeing the glowing red heart [companion1.heShe]'s been given curiously. |Your companions get a similar treatment, looking over one-another's glowing-heart 'womb tattoo' with a smirk and a grin. ] "All good? rows.translation: [flags.IMORA_TEMP_TAT |伊莫拉开始从她的“法宝袋”里翻找起来，取出了一个银色的大锅，以及一瓶散发着红光的液体。“这个应该不会花太长时间。 |伊莫拉打开她的包，拿出一小罐电金；那看起来就像是一堆形状各异、大小不一的硬币被敲平后拼凑成了一个类似大锅的形状，当她摇晃罐子时，里面的东西会发出叮当声。 这些是赛奥克族的特制工具；在开阔的水域中很难进行炼金术操作，因此我们用电银制成这些大锅，将所需的材料放入其中，再施加一些魔法和压力，让这些材料充分融合在一起。 制作药水的时候，里面的成分不会到处散开吗？” 女萨满摇了摇头，露出微笑，然后打开罐子，数起了那些珍珠般的颗粒。“不会的，通常这些成分会自动聚集到那些被熔岩熔化的玻璃容器里——我可没打算在这里解释压力原理啊——之后你就可以把它们喝下去了。 无论如何，我们现在正在忙于处理与墨水相关的工作，这是我们正在进行的为数不多的几项任务之一。 拥有 这些可以放在空气室里，也可以放在表面。我就把这些东西倒进一个碗里吧。” 哦，这样想起来确实挺合理的…… ] [party.som |你 |你和 [companion1.name] |你和你的同伴 ] 看着那位女巫从大锅里取出一定数量的珍珠，然后将它们放入另一个锅里。“不浪费，就不会缺少，”她边说着，边开始轻声哼唱起来。 接着，她从一个粗糙的玻璃小瓶中取出鲜红色的液体，倒入这个临时制作的电银大锅里，盖上盖子，然后摇晃容器，让里面的液体随着她的哼唱节奏来回晃动、发出声响。 就在她这么做的时候，嘶嘶声和泡泡声开始盖过她的声音，以至于看起来那个被星星眷顾的萨满其实是在猛烈地摇晃一颗炸弹，而不是在进行炼金术。 不管你愿不愿意，你都会不由自主地皱起眉头，然后向后仰去，尤其是当那些声音听起来特别令人不安的时候。 处理大量数据或进行复杂计算 从那口镀银的大锅中，某种物质似乎正在不断聚集，最终整个容器仿佛都要被压塌了。虽然这只持续了一分钟的嗡嗡声和震动，但这个魔法仪式似乎已经完成了。伊莫拉将双手部放在一个碗上，然后张开双手部，脸上露出自豪的笑容——顿时，浓稠的红色墨水倾泻进了碗里。“就这样，魔法墨水准备好了。现在，你们可以…… [party.som |可爱的小肚子 |肚子 |肚子 ] 对我来说，记住这一点：一旦你降到海平面以下，这些纹身就会开始发挥作用。而一旦你重新回到海平面上，这种魔法效果就会消失。” “没有时间限制吗？ [party.som |你问吧。 |[companion1.name] 询问 |[companion2.name] 询问 ]没有计时器。” 你耸了耸肩，然后露出了肚子。[party.hasCompanions |s ] 然后等待伊莫拉开始工作。 她取出一根看起来很锋利的珍珠针，将其浸入墨水中， [pc.hasFur |小心翼翼地将毛发拨开，然后去刺那个…… [pc.skinColor] 血肉之躯。 |轻轻触碰你的…… [pc.skinColor] 肉体。 ] 那种刺痛感只是短暂的，但即使她擦去了每一次轻柔刺击留下的血迹，那种灼热感依然会持续困扰着你。 [pc.hasWombTattoo |你原本担心这个新的纹身会与你已经有的腹部纹身不太协调，但这位纹身师确实将发光的红色墨水巧妙地融入到了设计中。效果相当不错——实在可惜这只是个暂时的纹身。 |这个纹身并不大，也不需要花费太多时间来纹制，它的形状就像一个闪烁着红光的小爱心，位于你的肚脐下方。 ] [party.som | |你的同伴也遭到了同样的对待，他同样注视着那颗闪烁着红光的爱心。 [companion1.heShe]这个名称的由来实在有些奇怪。 |你的同伴也得到了同样的待遇，他们互相打量着彼此身上那些发光的心形“纹身”，脸上洋溢着笑容。 ] 都好了吗？都好了。”伊莫拉用一块有弹性的布擦了擦手部，然后将针插入一块散发着刺鼻气味的海绵中，把针清洗干净。

rows.original:
You sigh and sit still, waiting for the shaman to mix up a dish of thick ink. Her hands work with surprising deftness, delicately filing bone-needle tips while an electrum cauldron sizzles. Once the sizzling stops, she cracks open the sealed cauldron and reveals the pearlescent ink, now far thinner. "One of my finest mixtures yet."
        
        [seastone.home
            |Imora gets up from her couch and nudges you into her spot. With a little humming she carefully props you up against a stack of pillows, making sure you're completely comfortable at rest. "No fidgeting, okay?"
            |Imora vacates her spot on her comfy outdoor rug, resting your hands in your lap and carefully propping you upright with some pillows at your lower-back. "Don't go fidgeting, alright?"
        ] The siorc shaman smiles and sidles in next to you, readying her needles. Up close they look to be very slightly hollow, and she warms up the tip with a little fire magic.
        
        Just before the bone can burn, she dips it into the ink, which is drawn up the heated needle. "Definitely one of my finest. Alright, this is going to sting for a little while."
        
        Imora sets to the task of puncturing you with plenty of swiftness, and an easy smile. She isn't lying about causing a sting when she goes to work on you, and you find yourself uncomfortably twitching as you're gently stabbed at. The shaman herself appears pleased, at least; she's humming a musical tune the entire time, and you're incapable of telling if it's spellcraft or she just enjoys watching you squirm.
        
        There's no small amount of fear when she's tattooing you right above your artery, but she keeps a firm grip on the side of your head with her free hand to make certain that there isn't even a millimeter of risky fidgeting. "Well, how is it?" You finally ask.
        
        "You have an incredibly impressive body, [pc.isSoulbound
            |even if it seems to be highly resistant to transformation or alteration.
            |I've never known someone so transmutable.
        ] I don't even think you'll need a touch-up." 
        
        Your muscle tingles and burns with equal measure, and you have to fight the impulse to scratch and rub for several long minutes before Imora applies a salve that cools you almost immediately. "Touch-up?"
        
        "Mhm, there's usually a little degree of loss when it comes to alchemy on people. This can be caused by impurities in the materials, or just their natural resistance. But as I've said before; you have a great body. And not just for tongue-fucking." Imora climbs off of you and rinses her hands clean, before fetching a cloth and gently rubbing your neck down. "[pc.isSoulbound
            |I used a little extra to make up for your resistance, but it's all taken with perfect purity. I doubt you'll need the edges cleaned up ever.
            |You basically have no resistance to this stuff, and your body took to the ink as though it had the perfect purity. It's unlikely you'll ever even need these edges cleaned up.
        ]"
        
        When she's finally finished, the sparkle-shark [seastone.home
            |fetches a silver mirror from one of her drawers
            |guides you to the water's edge
        ]. In your reflection you can see you have a trio of dense pearlescant-black lines on each side of your neck! [pc.isBimbo
            |It's like, super-duper cute the way the light catches it.
        ] "How does it work?"
        
        Imora shrugs and grins. "You just go underwater. Make sure to breathe out completely when you do, or you'll have a coughing fit and that's no fun."
        
        "And the cold?"
        
        "The tattoo doesn't do anything above-ground, but you'll be fine if you're submerged; it takes about five-to-ten seconds to kick in." 
        
        It all sounds a little too good to be true. "And the cost?"
        
        "I'll accept a smooch! You know, you're a citizen now! Or near enough to, after completing the temple of challenge and [seastone.isABN
            |you've climbed under Seastone's dick.
            |you've topped Seastone.
            |proven you're unwilling to bow to anyone.
        ]"

[pc.dcb
        |"Tell me about this 'Siorc-Fang Necklace'."
        |"So... how is this 'Siorc-Fang Necklace' meant to work?"
        |"So, like, what's the deal with the siorcy necklace?"
    ]
    
    Imora [seastone.home
        |gets up from her sofa and reaches into a shelf food of colorful reagents
        |rolls onto her stomach on the rug and rummages around in her bag
    ], before returning to a sitting position. In her hands is a tight coil of string, and a large shark-tooth. "It's fishing line and a shark's tooth... and with plenty of magic, effort, electrum, and paint? A powerful transformative, capable of slowly turning any race into a superior member of the siorcanna."
    
    "Slowly? But how?"
    
    The shaman tosses at her hair and smiles, indicating the tooth. "I have to assume just saying 'magic' isn't going to cut it for you... or do you mean the process? Together we paint the tooth in ways that represent your ideal appearance — afterall, siorcs come in all manner of colors, sizes, and gender compared to the boring races — then put it on, and then you fuck like animals and let the magic happen."
    
    It doesn't sound exactly convincing; arts and crafts, fuck, suddenly a siorc? Imora seems to sense your disbelief before rolling her eyes, waving the tooth around. "This thing is worth four times its weight in pearls, and the paint is about forty-sixty electrum to dye, and stored in oil. And I am a very capable shaman. At least twenty of the siorcs of Starhome were made this way by Seastone's mother, and I've made ten myself as a favor to a few of Seastone's friends."
    
    Looks like Imora really can turn you into a wildly-colored siorc.

"Uuuh, let's see here. Technically any, but there aren't that many pigments available underwater. Red, Blue, Purple, Pink, White, Yellow, Orange... uuuh, and black. Similarly you can be striped or not, no star-fields for you, it's a bit too complicated... plus I like being unique." Imora slaps at your leg with her tail, grinning.
        
        "We can do hair color, but that stuff's basic... I'm sure you can find a dye for that. The eyes are more difficult, sorry. Now, it is understood that our biology is pretty variable, unfortunately the siorc-tooth changes race... not gender, not body type." She waves off-handedly, eyeing your own 'body type' up and down. "Luckily there are measures for changing that in other places in other ways. Similarly, there'll be no transformation for tauric individuals; it's been tried in the past, and it... let's just say it doesn't work." While she's busy suppressing a shiver, you do your best to avoid thinking about that too.

嗯，让我想想……从技术上来说，任何颜色都可以，但是水下可用的颜料并不多。红色、蓝色、紫色、粉色、白色、黄色、橙色……嗯，还有黑色。同样地，你的图案可以是条纹状的，也可以不是；不过星星图案就有点不太适合了，因为那样会太复杂了。而且，我就喜欢与众不同。”伊莫拉用尾巴轻拍着你的腿，咧嘴笑道。

“我们可以改变头发的颜色，但那些都属于基础操作……我相信你能找到适合的染发剂。不过眼睛的颜色就比较难改变了，实在抱歉。不过，我们的生物特性其实有很大的变异性，不幸的是，‘希奥克之牙’这个特征会决定你的种族归属。不是性别，也不是体型。”她漫不经心地说道，同时上下打量着你的体型。“幸运的是，在其他地方有其他方法可以改变这些。同样地，对于属于‘金牛座’类型的人来说，也是没有办法通过改变体型来改变自己的特性的；过去曾经有人尝试过，但并没有成功。……就当我们说，那个方法行不通吧。”当她努力抑制着自己的颤抖时，你也尽力不去想这件事。

Instead she [seastone.home |drags over a huge wooden barrel sloshing with crystal-clear water. She holds back her hair and thrusts her head in, 'inhaling' through her unseen gills before sauntering back over. "Breathe out..." |heads to the ice's edge, scoops her long locks back, and dunks her head beneath the surface. After a few moments she 'inhales' through her unseen gills before sauntering back over to you, hips swaying. "Breathe out..." ] Her voice has a hypnotic, underwater quality to it — a little deeper — with her secondary lungs filled with water. It proves to be soothing, pushing down through your building panic and the ever-present need to fuck like animal. When you exhale, it's a fight to keep yourself from sucking in a fresh gasp of air, but she hauls you up and drives your head into the water. "Mfgl!" You keep your mouth closed, lungs empty, before Imora thrusts her hands into the water and clamps them over your nose and mouth with a soothing hum. "Iiiiin..." you can hear her order even with your head under, and abruptly everything makes sense. When you draw in, the cool water at last feels like it's washing away the heat burning you up. Clarity rushes over you, before you're abruptly pulled back out. "Congratulations siorc-[pc.mf |boy |girl ]... I didn't even need to give you gill-to-gill." There are still spots and sparks fluttering in your vision, before you take a look at yourself. A real look at yourself, while the fires inside you dim and your breathing becomes something normal. Water flows from your brand new gills, and once empty you can breathe the open air too. Your skin has changed color, a large shark tail capable of whipping and tripping flexes and wags behind you, your elfin ears twitch, your sharky teeth and powerful jaw clench tightly, and your core feels naturally warmer than before... You've become a siorcanna! And now it's possible to go deep underwater without worrying about drowning or freezing... although your companions will need tattoos to survive. Imora looks you up and down, exhaling water of her own and beaming with pride. "I am unbelievably pleased with how you turned out... great fuck too, [seastone.isABN |fellow beta. |my wonderful alpha. |considering you've deigned to avoid becoming alpha or beta of our little family. ]" [pc.dcb |"Not bad, at all..." You finally manage to groan out, too dazed for much more. |"Thanks, Imora..." You finally gasp, too dazed and strung out for more than simple gratitude. |"That was, like... so... something." You attempt to string a metaphor together, only to find that you're all strung-out. "Thanks!" ] "I'll leave you to recover, [pc.name]. If you ever find yourself un-siorc'd, then all you have to do is pay again!" The shaman's mismatched eyes twinkle brightly enough to match the field of stars, and she [seastone.home |nudges you gently back outside of her room. |gestures you away from her rug before lying down to enjoy the afterglow at last. ] Hey, at least your sticky, cum-covered body isn't freezing when you re-dress... just cold. Brr. Your body must not actually heat up all the way unless you go actually submerging yourself. "

rows.original: [flags.IMORA_TALK_GWEYRQUEST |There's something you need to bring up with her. "Oh? So serious all of a sudden? Do you know your expression really changes when you go from fun mode to business mode?" Imora's smile lingers for a moment or two, then vanishes when she realizes you're not joking. "All right, spit it out. What's eating at you, [pc.name]?" You briefly explain the situation with the rift, the goop, and how you need to delve into the depths of the ocean to pursue Tollus, Leold and their goons. You understand that she can grant you and your companions magical tattoos that'll keep you alive so far underwater? Imora hesitates. "You know Gweyr, huh?" Call it predestiny or something. You knew her husband, and one thing led to another. So, here you are. "This is rather out of the blue, but yes, it's something I can do." Right, [pc.isDK |she can spit it out, then. |if she doesn't mind telling you what exactly she has in mind? ] |Right. So, has she gotten her thoughts in order now? Time is of the essence here. "Right, right, you don't need to tell me. Seastone has her warriors all over the entrance to the trench; the only reason I'm not there this moment is that my brains are worth more than my brawn." Good. Now then, can she [pc.isDK |just spit it out already |tell you what she's got in mind ]? "My usual tattoos won't hold up under those conditions — at that kind of depth, the weight of the water would crush even the strongest of alphas. Most smaller creatures native to the bottoms of ocean trenches can't survive when brought to the surface; without the pressure to keep them in shape, they swell, deform, and die. Pretty strong magic would be needed for surface-dwellers like you and Gweyr to survive." The demons, of course, aren't bothered one bit. How convenient. Imora shrugs. "I think the expectation of power comes with the territory of being a demon and all. But back to the point — I'll need to give you all some special tattoos for the task. And special tattoos, alas, require special reagents for the ink." The shaman counts off on her fingers with a smile. "Ground up pearls, electrum, and the sliced fruit of a sea-lantern — glowing red plants that we use for light in Starhome — are all you need for the normal, temporary tattoo... but for those depths? It takes a little extra work." You're seeing where this is going... "Seastone and her alphas are gearing up for conflict, both against these demons and the elves; and I'm supposed to be reserving the more precious of my spell components for what's to come. If you're going to be taking from me, I'd like something in return. You scratch my back and I'll scratch yours, hmm?" Gweyr told you to expect something like this, so you're not surprised. All right, what's her price? "Some of the more useful things to my practice are harpy eggs — and for obvious reasons, they're hard to get around here. I used to be able to get a few every now and then from the avanai, but now that they're as concerned with this grand alliance business as Seastone is, the supply's dried up and there's precious little left to me, even if I keep the eggs frozen. So yes, this is my price: get me a few purple harpy eggs by any means necessary, and I'll get Gweyr, you, and everyone else who comes along deep-sea tattoos for heading down into the trench. Does that sound fine?" And are there any alternatives? "We-ll." Imora's mismatched eyes glitter brightly enough to match the field of stars covering her body, and she bites her lip. "I might be persuaded to help out if you prove yourself enough of an alpha that I could claim I didn't know what I was doing, and that you were simply too strong for me..." rows.translation: [flags.IMORA_TALK_GWEYRQUEST |有件事你需要和她谈谈。 “哦？突然这么严肃了？你有没有注意到，当你从轻松模式切换到工作模式时，你的表情确实会发生变化啊？”伊莫拉的笑容持续了一两秒，但当她意识到你并不是在开玩笑时，那笑容立刻消失了。“好吧，快说吧。到底什么事让你这么烦恼？ [pc.name]你简要说明了关于裂缝、那种黏稠物质的情况，以及为什么你必须深入海洋去追捕Tollus、莱奥德和他们的手下。你知道她可以为你和你的同伴施加魔法纹身，让你们在水中存活下去，对吧？ 伊莫拉犹豫了一下。“你认识格韦尔，对吧？” 或许这就是命运的安排吧。你认识她的丈夫，然后一系列事情就发生了，最终你就来到了这里。 “这件事确实有点突然，但没错，这是我能够做到的。对， [pc.isDK |那她就可以直接说出来了。 |如果她不介意告诉你她到底有什么打算的话…… ] |好吧。那么，她现在把思路理清楚了吗？时间非常紧迫。 “好了好了，你不用告诉我了。Seastone在沟渠的入口处部署了她的战士们；我此刻没有去那里，只是因为我的智慧比体力更重要。” 很好。那么，现在她能…… [pc.isDK |快说吧！ |让我告诉你她到底在想什么吧。 ]我平时纹的纹身在那种环境下是撑不住的——在那么深的水中，水的压力甚至会压碎最结实的纹身。大多数生活在海洋沟壑底部的小生物，如果被带到水面，是无法存活的；没有了那种压力来维持它们的身体结构，它们就会肿胀、变形，最终死亡。 像你和格韦尔这样的地面生物，要想生存下来，就需要相当强大的魔法力量。 当然，那些恶魔根本不在乎这些。真是太方便了…… 伊莫拉耸了耸肩：“我想，作为恶魔，拥有强大的力量本来就是理所当然的事情吧。 但回到正题——我需要向大家说明一些事情。 特别的 完成这项任务需要特定的纹身。而那些特殊的纹身，唉，确实需要特殊的颜料。”萨满微笑着用手指一一数着。“磨碎的珍珠、电银，还有海灯笼切下的果肉——那些在星之家园里被用来照明的红色植物——这些就是制作普通临时纹身所需要的材料……但如果是那些深处的生物所要求的纹身，那就需要额外的工序了。 你应该已经猜到接下来会发生什么了…… “西斯通和她的那些高手们正在准备与这些恶魔以及精灵们交战；而我呢，本应该把那些更珍贵的法术材料留到将来需要的时候使用。如果你们打算从我这里拿走些什么，我希望也能得到一些回报。你们帮我一把，我也会帮你们一把，嗯？ 格韦尔早就提醒过你会遇到这种事情，所以你现在并不感到惊讶。那么，她想要什么作为交换呢？ “对我来说，一些非常实用的物品就是鹰身女妖的蛋——显然，这种东西在这里很难获得。 过去我偶尔还能从阿瓦奈那里得到一些，但现在他们和海石一样热衷于这个大联盟的事情，供应量已经枯竭了，即使我把那些蛋都冻起来保存，我也几乎再也得不到什么了。 所以，我的条件就是：无论用什么方法，只要能弄到几颗紫色的哈比蛋，我就把格温尔、你，以及所有愿意一起前往深海的人，都纹上适合深海探险的纹身。这样安排，你们觉得怎么样？ 还有其他替代方案吗？ “我们……”伊莫拉那双不匹配的眼睛闪烁着轻型芒，那轻型芒几乎可以与覆盖在她身上的星辰之海相媲美。她咬了咬嘴唇，继续说道：“如果你能证明自己确实是个足够强大的领袖，让我可以声称自己根本不知道自己在做什么，而你只是比我强大太多……那么，我或许会愿意帮忙的。 看来你现在正处于一个十字路口，那么你打算在这里做些什么呢？ ]

rows.original:
Here, the eggs she wanted. Three of the things all the way from where you found them, as fresh as they can be.

    Imora gives you a thin smile, then leans in and raps her knuckles against the pointy end of the shell, listening intently at the sound the egg makes. She repeats this for all three of them, then at long last gives you a nod. "They're not stale, at the very least. Pass them over — I'll have them frozen at the earliest opportunity."
    
    Maybe it's you, but it seemed like she was disappointed you didn't choose a proverbial romp in the hay over this... 
    
    She gives you a toothy grin. "Maybe? Maybe. But we can always do that later, if you're having second thoughts about it. For now, though, the eggs."

这里有她想要的鸡蛋。其中三颗是从你最初找到它们的地方直接拿来的，新鲜度丝毫未减。

也许只有你有这种感觉，但她看起来似乎对你没有选择这种‘在干草堆里尽情嬉戏’的方式而感到有些失望。她朝你露出了灿烂的笑容：“也许吧？也许吧。不过如果你后来改变了主意，我们随时都可以再做那件事。不过现在，还是先来做这些鸡蛋吧。

rows.original:
[var0
        |After half an hour for the both of you to recover, Imora heaves a huge sigh of satiation and rolls over on her side, the exertions of sex still showing their toll on her. Eyeing you, the siorc beta gives you a wink, then raises a finger to her lips.
    
        "Wow, that was something. My knees have gone all weak..."
        
        Hey, if you're going to entrust your life to her magic, you're going to give her every incentive to do the best job that she can. It'd be an awful shame if something awful happened to such a great lay like you, wouldn't it?
        
        Imora chuckles and slaps you on the [pc.ass] with a weak swipe of her tail. "You tease."
        
        All right, all right...
    ]
    
    Now that you've given Imora her payment, about the tattoos... 

    "Yes! The both of you should come to me once you're done with your preparations, and then I'll slap on the tattoos, like you asked. The magic will fade once you return to the surface, but so long as you're below sea level it should last as long as you need it to."
    
    As long as you need it to... convenient, that.
    
    "Hey, after the first couple land-dwellers drowned and froze after not coming up before their time ran out, I had to look for better solutions. These deep-sea tattoos draw power from the ocean itself to stay working, but once you're up on land..."
    
    Does that count, say, if you enter an underwater cave with air in it?
    
    Imora shakes her head. "You should still be fine. Just don't rise above sea level, and the tattoo's powers won't fade on you. Got it?"
    
    All right, got it.
    
    "Good! Now then, go back to that old dog and tell her that I'm all ready for sending the both of you down below. I've seen her hanging around with Seastone of late, but never really had the chance to say hi, so why don't you send her my regards?"
    
    You'll do just that. Very well, you'll be back before too long. Now, to head back to Gweyr and tell her the good news.

        哇，太厉害了……我的膝盖都软了……”

好吧，好吧……
    ]
    
    既然你已经把钱付给了伊莫拉，那么关于那些纹身的事情…… 

    “好的！等你们准备好一切后，就来找我吧，我会按照你们的要求把纹身纹上去。一旦你们回到水面，这些纹身的效果就会消失，但只要你们还在海平面以下，这些纹身就会持续发挥作用，直到你们需要的时候为止。只要它能让你觉得方便……那就没问题。”

“嘿，在最初的那些陆地生物在规定的时间之前没有浮上来，结果淹死或冻死之后，我就不得不寻找更好的解决办法。这些深海纹身能够从海洋中获取能量来保持正常运作，但一旦你到了陆地上，这些纹身就无法继续发挥作用了。那么，比如说，如果你进入一个有空气的水下洞穴，这种情况也算数吗？”

伊莫拉摇了摇头：“你应该不会有问题。只要不上升到海平面以上，那个纹身的力量就不会消失。明白了吗？好的，明白了。

“太好了！现在你去告诉那个老女人，我已经准备好了把你们俩送到下面去。最近我看到她经常和海石在一起，但一直没有机会跟她打招呼，所以你能不能代我向她问好呢？你就会去做这件事的。很好，你很快就会回来。现在，去格温尔那里，把这个好消息告诉她吧。
rows.raw:
"
    [var0
        |After half an hour for the both of you to recover, Imora heaves a huge sigh of satiation and rolls over on her side, the exertions of sex still showing their toll on her. Eyeing you, the siorc beta gives you a wink, then raises a finger to her lips.
    
        "Wow, that was something. My knees have gone all weak..."
        
        Hey, if you're going to entrust your life to her magic, you're going to give her every incentive to do the best job that she can. It'd be an awful shame if something awful happened to such a great lay like you, wouldn't it?
        
        Imora chuckles and slaps you on the [pc.ass] with a weak swipe of her tail. "You tease."
        
        All right, all right...
    ]
    
    Now that you've given Imora her payment, about the tattoos... 

    "Yes! The both of you should come to me once you're done with your preparations, and then I'll slap on the tattoos, like you asked. The magic will fade once you return to the surface, but so long as you're below sea level it should last as long as you need it to."
    
    As long as you need it to... convenient, that.
    
    "Hey, after the first couple land-dwellers drowned and froze after not coming up before their time ran out, I had to look for better solutions. These deep-sea tattoos draw power from the ocean itself to stay working, but once you're up on land..."
    
    Does that count, say, if you enter an underwater cave with air in it?
    
    Imora shakes her head. "You should still be fine. Just don't rise above sea level, and the tattoo's powers won't fade on you. Got it?"
    
    All right, got it.
    
    "Good! Now then, go back to that old dog and tell her that I'm all ready for sending the both of you down below. I've seen her hanging around with Seastone of late, but never really had the chance to say hi, so why don't you send her my regards?"
    
    You'll do just that. Very well, you'll be back before too long. Now, to head back to Gweyr and tell her the good news.
    
    "

rows.original: Crossing the ice shelf, [party.hasCompanions |you're brought to a pause as [comp1.name] raises [comp1.hisHer] hand, the other pointing off to the side. "Hey, [pc.name]! Do you see that?" Indeed, now that [comp1.name] is pointing it out, you saw it. How can you not? A |you're brought to pause by [pc.hasEmoteEars |your ears twitching |a tingling on the back of your neck ], and you look around, trying to find the source of your discomfiture. It doesn't take you long to find it — a ] tightly-grouped procession of humanoid figures, eight of them, are crossing the ice in your direction. There aren't any convenient snowdrifts or stray ice chunks to hide behind, and they've clearly noticed you at this point, deep voices carrying over the air; it's all you can do to steady your hand on your [pc.weapon] and hope that this group isn't outright hostile. As the people draw closer, the first thing that you notice about is that they're... well, giant. Anywhere between four and a half to five and a half yards tall, the group of eight quickly draws into view even at a distance, men and women alike; their prodigious stature announcing their presence to all around, so it's little wonder they don't bother with stealth. Patchwork tribalwear of sealskins and bear hides adorns their bodies, the pelt of one single animal clearly not enough to clothe any of them alone; their cobalt blue skins, wine-red eyes and shaggy hair colored from black to light gray and every shade between. Given how much skin they're showing, they must not mind the cold very much. [flags.SIGRUNE_DEFEATED |You recognise them, of course — you'd encountered one of their number way back in the Old Forest. These are Sigrune's people, the jotuns, ice giants of the north; you must be on their home turf |You've heard stories of giants before, monstrous people living out in remote, inhospitable wildernesses, but to see them in the flesh is another thing altogether ]. They're dragging behind them on two massive ice sleds their catch of the day — a whale carcass, half of it already butchered into meat, blubber and bone. As they draw closer, two of them detach from the group, a man and woman, and approach you while the remainder stay back with the sleds. [pc.ra elf |"You! Long-ears! Get out of our lands! You have no place here!" Whoa, whoa, hold up a moment. The way they're brandishing those ice clubs of theirs is positively menacing — isn't there any reason you can't talk this through? You have business here in the glacial rift, after all. Perhaps you could — "We've tried talking with your kind, long-ears," the woman says, pointing her club down at you. "See where it's brought us! No, there's no more goodwill to be had — your kind has wasted it all. Once more, get out and back to your city where you belong! There is no room for you here under the ancient accords!" Look, perhaps — "If you won't leave, we'll make you leave, tiny creature!" As one, both giants close the remaining distance to you, brandishing their clubs menacingly while the remaining jotuns stay with the sleds. "We've suffered you and your kind long enough!" Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with — and for some reason, your being an elf of one stripe or the other has only provoked an irrational hatred in these icy giants. You've only moments to ready yourself before the duo of jotuns are upon [party.combatNames]. |"You! [pc.race]! What are you doing here in these lands — our lands? Turn back, small creature; you are badly lost to be here. Turn back before you freeze and become food for the fishes." Unfortunately, no. You have business here — this land is under the threat of corruption by agents from the south, and you're here to deal with it. You've been pursuing them for some time now, and hopefully you can end their shenanigans here. [party.has etheryn |Paradoxically, the jotuns look even angrier at that, eyes narrowing and features creasing. Rumbling, the man raises his club to point at not you, but Etheryn at your side. "Corruption from the south, you say. Here to fight it, you say. Yet you bring it right here with you!" "W-what?" Ryn looks genuinely shocked at the jotun's accusation. "I'm not corrupted! I'm just — " "— An elf," the woman finishes for her. "You foul the rift with your presence, tiny creature, you and all of your kind. There is no space for elves of any kind between the glaciers, and your reek fills the air!" Look, maybe you can talk this through! The corruption you're speaking of isn't Ryn or any other elf, but — well, have they seen any people dressed in dark, hooded robes? Perhaps toting barrels of gray goop around? A snort. "Why should we tell you anything, elf-friend? Your allegiances are clear. We have endured the elves for centuries, and enough is enough. We will send a message to your queen by returning you to her — the first of many to come!" "Alissa is — " Ryn begins, but is cut short by the jotuns' clubs smashing into the snow where she was standing a moment ago, throwing up a spray of stinging powder. Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with. For some reason, just having Ryn with you has made things all the worse; it's probably for the best that you didn't mention she's named you Champion of Winter. You've only moments to ready yourself before the duo of jotuns are upon [party.combatNames], swinging and crashing, seeking to flatten [party.som | |both of |all of ]you like the insects they must see you as. |"Corruption from the south." The woman jotun lowers her club a little and looks at the man before turning back to you. "So you're here to fight the elves?" What? "If you are here to fight corruption, then certainly you must mean the elves," the man rumbles. "They are not meant to be here and foul the rift with their presence." Wait, no, you didn't mean elves! Have they seen any people dressed in dark, hooded robes? Perhaps toting barrels of gray goop around? A snort from the woman, and then she sniffs the air. "No one would be as foolish as to dress like that out here. But you — you smell of the elves, and their stink is all over you. Like whale innards, the stench never fades. You are a friend of the elves?" Well, you spent some time in the Winter City — Damn, you must've said something wrong, for both jotuns' faces crease in anger and they step forward, brandishing their ice clubs menacingly. "So you admit it! You are a spy for the elves! No friend to an elf is a friend to us — we'll give you a message to bring back to your mistresses!" Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with. For some reason, the merest hint of any kind of relations with elves has provoked an irrational hatred in these icy giants; it's probably for the best that you didn't mention Ryn named you Champion of Winter. You've only moments to ready yourself before the duo of jotuns are upon [party.combatNames], swinging and crashing, seeking to flatten [party.som | |both of |all of ]you like the insects they must see you as. ] [flags.SIGRUNE_DEFEATED |This makes no sense! Sigrune didn't react like this to elves — but then, you don't remember if you brought it up or not, and she was away from her people even before the start of the Godswar. Whatever the case, these jotuns are just about as implacable and willing to talk as she was... ] ] [silly |"What sick elf queen sends babies to fight us?" the jotun man roars as he raises his club. "You are so small, it is funny to us!" ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 穿越冰架， [party.hasCompanions |你暂时停下了动作，因为…… [comp1.name] 提高 [comp1.hisHer] 一只手伸出来，另一只手则指向旁边。 “嘿， [pc.name]看到了吗？” 的确，现在看来…… [comp1.name] 就是指出了这一点，你看到了吧。怎么可能没看到呢？ |您当前所处的状态是由……导致的。 [pc.hasEmoteEars |你的耳朵在抽动。 |后颈处有一阵刺痛感 ]你环顾四周，试图找出让自己感到不适的原因。没过多久，你就找到了——那就是…… ] 一队由八个人类形态的生物组成的队伍正紧密地排列着，正朝你的方向穿过冰面。周围既没有可以躲藏的雪堆，也没有零散的冰块可供掩护，而且他们显然已经注意到了你——那些低沉的声音在空气中传来，你只能尽力稳住手中的…… [pc.weapon] 并且希望这个群体并不会怀有敌意。 当人们逐渐靠近时，你首先会注意到的是，他们……嗯， 巨人这群人身高在四点五码到五点五码之间，即使从远处看，也能很快辨认出来——其中既有男性也有女性。他们惊人的身高使得自己的存在立刻被周围的人注意到，因此他们根本不需要刻意隐藏自己。 他们的身上穿着由海豹皮和熊皮拼接而成的部落服饰，显然，单凭一种动物的皮毛是远远不够为每个人制作衣物的；他们那钴蓝色的皮肤、酒红色的眼睛，以及从黑色到浅灰色、再到各种中间色调的蓬松毛发，构成了他们独特的外貌特征。 鉴于他们露出了这么多皮肤，看来他们应该不太怕冷吧。 [flags.SIGRUNE_DEFEATED |你当然认识他们——早在古老的森林里，你就曾与他们中的某位相遇过。这些就是西格鲁娜的族人，北方的冰巨人们；你现在肯定是在他们的地盘上。 |你之前肯定听说过关于巨人的故事——那些生活在偏远而恶劣的自然环境中的庞大生物，但亲眼见到它们，却是另一回事了。 ]他们拖着两辆巨大的冰橇，上面装着当天捕获的猎物——一具鲸鱼尸体，其中一半已经被分割成肉、鲸脂和骨头。当他们逐渐靠近时，有两个人从队伍中分离出来，一男一女，朝着你走来，而其余的人则继续留在那里拖着冰橇。 [pc.ra elf |你！长耳朵的家伙！快离开我们的土地！你们在这里没有立足之地！” 哇，等等，先别急。他们挥舞着那些冰棍一样的东西，看起来真的很吓人啊——难道就不能通过谈判来解决这个问题吗？ 毕竟，你在冰川裂隙这里也有自己的事务要处理。或许你可以…… “我们早就尝试过与你们这些长耳朵的生物进行对话了，”女人说着，用她的棍子指着你，“看看这带来了什么结果！不，现在已经没有任何善意可言了——你们把这些都浪费掉了。 再一次，离开吧，回到属于你的城市去！根据那些古老的协议，这里没有你的容身之地！ “看吧，也许……” “如果你不肯离开，我们就强迫你离开，小小的生物！这两头巨兽同时向你冲来，挥舞着它们那凶猛的棍棒，而其他的巨魔则继续守在雪橇旁。‘我们受够你们这类生物了！’” 该死，他们根本不愿意听任何道理——而且不知为何，无论你属于哪一类精灵，都只会激起这些冰原巨兽的非理性仇恨。 在那些巨魔即将降临之前，你只有短短的几分钟时间来做好准备。 [party.combatNames]. |你！ [pc.race]你究竟为什么会来到这片属于我们的土地上？快回去吧，小小的生物——你在这里简直是迷路了。在冻死变成鱼的食物之前，赶紧离开吧。” 可惜，事实并非如此。你来到这里是有重要使命的——这片土地正面临着来自南方的势力的侵蚀和破坏，而你的任务就是阻止这一切。你已经追查他们有一段时间了，希望你能在这里彻底终结他们的恶行。 [party.has etheryn |具有讽刺意味的是，那些巨人看起来因此变得更加愤怒了，他们的双眼眯成了一条线，面部肌肉也出现了扭曲。那个男人低吼着，举起他的棍棒，指着的不是你，而是站在你身旁的伊瑟琳。“你说这是来自南方的腐败势力，说你们是来对抗它的，可实际上，你们就是把这些腐败势力带到了这里！ 什、什么？”瑞恩听到这个巨人的指控，显得十分震惊。“我没有被腐蚀！我只是——” “——一个精灵，”那个女人替他完成了这句话。“你们的存在玷污了这片裂隙，这些渺小的生物，你们整个种族都是如此。在冰川之间，没有任何地方适合任何形式的精灵存在，你们的气味充斥着整个空气！ 听着，也许你们可以坐下来好好谈谈！你所说的那些腐败行为并不是瑞恩或其他任何精灵造成的，而是——嗯，他们有没有看到过那些穿着黑色斗篷、背着灰色粘稠液体的家伙？ “哼，我们为什么要告诉你这些，精灵朋友？你的立场已经很明显了。几个世纪以来，我们一直忍受着精灵们的存在，现在真的受够了。我们会把你送回你的女王那里，以此向她传递一个消息——而这只是开始而已！ 艾莉莎是……”瑞恩刚开口，就被那些侏儒们挥动的棍棒打在了她刚才站立的地方的雪地上，那些棍棒在雪地上敲击，溅起了阵阵刺鼻的粉末。 该死，他们根本不愿意听任何道理。不知为什么，只要有瑞恩在身边，情况就会变得更糟；你没有提到她是被任命为“冬季冠军”的这件事，或许反而是件好事。在那些侏儒们冲上来之前，你只有短短的几秒钟时间来准备应对了。 [party.combatNames]摆动着，撞击着，试图将一切压平…… [party.som | |两者都 |所有 ]如果你喜欢昆虫，它们肯定也会把你当成同类来看待的。 |南方的腐败势力。”那个女巨人的棍子微微下垂，她看了看那个男人，然后又转向你：“所以你是来对抗精灵们的？” 什么？ “如果你是来对抗腐败的，那么你指的肯定就是精灵们，”那个男人低沉地说道，“他们本就不该出现在这里，他们的存在只会让这个裂隙变得更加混乱。 等等，不，你说的不是精灵吧！他们有没有看到过有人穿着深色的兜帽长袍？或许还拖着装满灰色黏液的桶到处走？” 女人哼了一声，然后闻了闻空气。“没人会蠢到在这种地方穿成那样。但是你——你身上有精灵的味道，他们的臭味全都沾在你身上了。就像鲸鱼的内脏一样，那种味道永远也消不掉。你是精灵的朋友吗？ 嗯，你在冬城待了段时间—— 该死，你肯定说错了什么，因为那两个巨人的脸上都浮现出愤怒的神情，他们大步走上前，挥舞着冰棍，显得十分凶狠。 “所以你承认了！你是精灵们的间谍！凡是与精灵为友的人，也就与我们为友——我们会让你带个消息回去，告诉你那些女主人！ 该死，他们根本不愿意听任何道理。不知为何，只要稍微提到与精灵有任何形式的联系，这些冰冷的巨人就会表现出非理性的仇恨；你没有提到瑞恩称你为“冬季勇士”，或许反而是件好事。在那些巨魔到来之前，你只有短短的几分钟时间来做好准备。 [party.combatNames]摆动着，撞击着，试图将一切压平…… [party.som | |两者都 |所有 ]如果你喜欢昆虫，它们肯定也会把你当成同类来看待的。 ] [flags.SIGRUNE_DEFEATED |这根本说不通！西格鲁娜对精灵们从来不会有这样的反应——不过，你也不记得自己是否提过这件事了，对吧？ 是 在神战开始之前，她就已经远离了自己的族人。无论原因是什么…… 这些 那些巨魔们，和她一样，同样冷酷无情，也一样不愿意与人交谈…… ] ] [silly |到底是哪位病态的精灵女王派来的…… 婴儿们 想与我们战斗吗？”那个巨人男子咆哮着，举起了他的棍棒。“你们太渺小了，对我们来说简直就是笑柄！ ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

Well, you spent some time in the Winter City — Damn, you must've said something wrong, for both jotuns' faces crease in anger and they step forward, brandishing their ice clubs menacingly. "So you admit it! You are a spy for the elves! No friend to an elf is a friend to us — we'll give you a message to bring back to your mistresses!" Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with. For some reason, the merest hint of any kind of relations with elves has provoked an irrational hatred in these icy giants; it's probably for the best that you didn't mention Ryn named you Champion of Winter. You've only moments to ready yourself before the duo of jotuns are upon [party.combatNames], swinging and crashing, seeking to flatten [party.som | |both of |all of ]you like the insects they must see you as. ] [flags.SIGRUNE_DEFEATED |This makes no sense! Sigrune didn't react like this to elves — but then, you don't remember if you brought it up or not, and she was away from her people even before the start of the Godswar. Whatever the case, these jotuns are just about as implacable and willing to talk as she was... ] ] [silly |"What sick elf queen sends babies to fight us?" the jotun man roars as he raises his club. "You are so small, it is funny to us!" ] It's a fight!"

rows.original:
Making your way across the sea ice, you raise your head and spy too late a pair of jotuns upon the ice, [rand
        |clustered around a fishing hole they've cut
        |each hefting the carcass of a freshly-killed seal
        |dragging an ice raft back to wherever they store these things
        |out spearfishing with giant harpoons of whalebone
    ]. While the ice shelf is mostly flat and open, [dayNight
        |the constant white is blinding and having to screw up your eyes against the never-ending glare
        |the dakrness of night
    ] seriously cuts your field of vision to a fraction of what it should be.

    The jotuns, alas, suffer no such handicap. Shock first registers on their faces, then anger as the duo drop what they're doing and grab clubs of ice, rushing over to you with their intent clear.
    
    "It's [pc.himHer]! The elf[pc.ra elf
        |
        |-friend
    ]! By order of the chieftain, you are to be cast from the ice, interloper!"
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |"Not this again," Ryn sighs as she readies herself for battle at your side. "My family certainly had a knack for making enemies of all stripes, didn't they?
    
    ]

rows.original: [var0 |With a mighty crash, the jotun man topples like a felled tree to the ice, while the woman has sunk to her knees, panting heavily. [lastStanding.resDefeated |They're clearly too turned on to fight any longer — or at least, don't have the will to keep on going, at any rate. For how formidable their bodies are, everything has a weakness |Despite their formidable bodies, all wiry muscle under the pelts and hides, even the mighty frost giants have their limit. You cast an eye over the other six jotun with the sled, wondering if they'll just charge you at this point seeing their fellow tribespeople fall, but they appear cowed or shocked enough by a relative midget like you bringing down two of their number that they don't approach. [party.has arona |"Well, if that wasn't a workout," Arona says, taking a hand off her [arona.weapon] to slick back her hair before the sweat in it freezes. "Can't say it wasn't satisfying to actually beat the shit out of someone twice your height — damn, now you've made me all hard. Go on, then. For their own sake, they really oughtn't try anything stupid. Please. ] The remaining six jotun look at you, then each other, then back at you. As one, they leave the sled and advance, prompting you to tighten your hold on your [pc.weapon] — but they don't go for you, instead bundling their defeated tribeskin onto the sleds with the carcass and blubber before beating a hasty retreat. Good, at least they know they've bitten off more than they could chew. "This doesn't end here, elf[pc.ra elf | |-friend ]!" one of them roars back at you as they disappear into the distance — despite their size, they sure can move fast when properly motivated. Watching the retreating jotuns, Arona guffaws and plants the business end of ther [arona.weapon] by her feet. "Damn, I was hoping they'd actually have the guts to attack after that. After making sure that everything's okay and the jotuns have really left and aren't circling around for an ambush, she comes around to you and holds her head in her hands. "Oh no, oh no, oh no..." It would appear that she's got another diplomatic situation on her hands, one that's devolved into outright hostility. It may not be outright war with the jotuns, but it seems like it's coming pretty close. "Alissa never told me any of this was going on!" Well, assuming that her sister even knew in the first place, why would she? Ryn was Duchess of the Rim, after all — Alissa saw to it that she was never intended to be anything more than a royal cuntlicker. Matters of state would be beyond Ryn. Not to mention the fact that given the way Ryn described her sister as being more interested in having fun, Alissa wouldn't have cared anyway. You wouldn't be surprised if at some point, her ministers and advisors stopped bringing her their problems to begin with. Ryn closes her eyes and heaves a deep sigh, balling her fists. "Why can't my family ever do anything right?" Well, look at it this way: she now gets to be the good var Ridell and fix all of their mistakes. The pale elves need her more than ever — even if Elthara's doing the day-to-day handling of matters back in the Winter City, this is a no less important part of rulership. "We..." the words choke in the jotun man's throat, clearly loathe to say them. He looks at the woman, who nods, and then bites his lip. "We yield. No more." They were the ones who attacked you first, [pc.isDK |so they've got some nerve throwing themselves on your mercy. But as long as they grovel a bit more, you might be inclined to let them off easy |but fine, you're willing to let them off — from their point of view, they're doing the right thing ]. Still, you might have a lesson or two in mind to reinforce the message to not mess with you, if you were so inclined... ]
