rows.original: Care to explain just what's going on here? The first time you ran into jotuns, you got the clear impression that they didn't like elves — the pale elves, to be precise. Just why all the animosity? [party.has etheryn |The jotun woman coughs and glowers at you disbelievingly. "You stand with one of them as your friend, and you don't know anything about it? Ask her!" You look at Ryn, who looks back at you and shrugs helplessly. She's just as clueless as you are, and you tell the pair of jotuns just as much. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds. "Please," Ryn says, swallowing hard as she steps forward. "Until not so long ago, I'd rarely left the palace proper and never ventured beyond the walls of the Winter City. Tell me what grievances you have against my... against the pale elves so that I may set them right." |[pc.ra elf |"You are an elf!" the jotun woman roars, then breaks into a coughing fit, her chest heaving. She pauses to catch her breath, then continues. "How could you not know?' Well, [pc.ora wyldelf |you're a wyld elf, not a pale elf. If she hasn't noticed how bitterly cold you are, not to mention how much you're shivering at the moment, perhaps she should do so and realize you're not from around these parts |to begin with, you weren't born an elf and aren't really one in the ways that really count; you just look like one through alchemical and magical means. If she hasn't noticed that you're really feeling the cold in the rift when a pale elf wouldn't, perhaps she should be a bit more aware of her foes ]. So no, you have no reason to be in the know with regards to what shenanigans the pale elves have been up to here in the rift. Just because you look like one doesn't mean you are one, and even if you were a pale elf that wouldn't have meant anything, either. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds. Most pale elves never even leave the Winter City to begin with. |"You are an elf-friend, a spy for their kind! Even if we didn't know what you looked like from the description the whaling party brought back to the tribe, the stink of elf spoor is all over you! How could you not know of their doings?" The jotun woman finishes her words, then breaks into a coughing fit. "Impossible." You're trying to be reasonable here. Sure, you might have had contact with a number of pale elves and know them on a personal level, but you haven't heard this story from them. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds up in the rift. Most pale elves never even leave the Winter City to begin with. So yes, you'd like them to explain it from their point of view. This is more than what they imagined a spy for the elves would have afforded them, right? ] ] The two jotuns look at you, then at each other again. Slowly, the jotun man nods to his companion and sets down with a sigh, pushing his ice club a little distance away from him before sitting cross legged on the ice. Even having lowered themselves thus, the duo are as tall as you are, all the better to see eye to eye as you speak. "Fine. We shall talk. Others may not, but we shall talk. If you know what is good for you, elf[pc.ra elf | |-friend ], you will leave this place." You'll decide after you've heard them out. Now, if they don't mind, perhaps they should begin.
rows.translation: 能解释一下这里到底发生了什么吗？当你第一次遇到那些巨魔时，你就明显感觉到他们并不喜欢精灵——更确切地说，是他们不喜欢那些苍白精灵。那么，为什么他们会如此敌视精灵呢？ [party.has etheryn |那个巨人族女子咳嗽着，难以置信地瞪着你：“你和他们中的一个人是朋友，却对此一无所知？去问她吧！” 你看向瑞恩，她也抬头看着你，无奈地耸了耸肩。 她和你一样一无所知，而你也把这一点原原本本地告诉了那对巨魔。那些苍白精灵并不是什么由不到一百人组成的群体或部落；他们实际上是一个完整的国家、一个城邦，甚至更多。 仅仅因为他们当中有些人按照 jotuns 的标准来看是在干些坏事，这并不意味着…… 所有 其中一些人知道他们那些卑鄙的行径。 “求您了，”瑞恩艰难地咽了口唾沫，向前走去。“直到不久前，我几乎从未离开过宫殿，也从未踏出过冬城的城墙。请告诉我，您对我……对苍白精灵们有什么不满，这样我才能为您们解决问题。 |[pc.ra elf |你是个精灵！”那个巨人女性吼道，随即开始剧烈咳嗽，胸部剧烈起伏。她停下来喘口气，然后继续说道：“你怎么会不知道呢？ 嗯， [pc.ora wyldelf |你真是个…… 荒野 精灵，才不是呢。 苍白 精灵啊，如果她还没有注意到你有多么寒冷，更没有看到你此刻正在瑟瑟发抖，或许她应该留意一下，才会意识到你并不是这个地方的人。 |首先，你并非天生就是精灵，从真正重要的意义上来说，你也不属于精灵一族；只是通过一些炼金术和魔法手段，你看起来才像精灵而已。如果她还没有注意到，在那些普通的精灵不会感到寒冷的地方，你却确实会感到寒冷，那么她或许应该更加警惕自己的敌人了。 ]所以，其实你并没有理由去了解那些苍白精灵在裂隙地带究竟策划了什么阴谋诡计。仅仅因为你是…… 看 like one doesn’t mean you”这句话的意思是“表面上看似如此，但实际上并非如此”。在游戏文本中，这句话可以用来描述某种情况或行为，虽然表面上看起来符合某种规则或预期，但实际上却隐藏着其他含义或后果。例如，在游戏中某个角色表现出某种行为，但这种行为背后的动机或目的可能与其他玩家或游戏规则相悖，从而产生“like one doesn’t mean you”的效果。 是 首先，即使你…… 是 一个苍白的精灵，其实也无关紧要。这些苍白的精灵并不是什么由不到一百人组成的群体或部落；他们是一个完整的国家，一个城邦，甚至更多。仅仅因为在他们中间有些人按照 约顿巨人 的标准来看是在干些坏事，这并不意味着…… 所有 他们中有些人知道自己的这些卑鄙行径。大多数苍白精灵从一开始就从未离开过冬城。 |你是个与精灵为友的人，是他们一族的间谍！即使我们根据捕鲸队带回部落的描述无法认出你的样子，但你身上散发着的那种精灵特有的气息，已经暴露了一切！你怎么可能不知道他们的所作所为呢？那位巨灵女子说完后，突然开始剧烈咳嗽起来。“不可能。” 你试图保持理性。当然，你可能确实与一些苍白精灵有过接触，甚至与他们建立了私人关系，但这个故事并不是他们告诉你的。 这些苍白精灵并非什么由不足百人组成的群体或部落；他们实际上是一个完整的国家、一个城邦，甚至更多。仅仅因为在他们中间有些人按照 约顿巨人 的标准来看是在干些坏事，这并不意味着…… 所有 他们中的有些人知道他们在裂隙中犯下的那些卑鄙行径。大多数苍白精灵从一开始就从未离开过冬城。 所以，你确实希望他们能从自己的角度来解释这些事情。这可比他们想象中精灵派来的间谍能提供的信息要多得多，对吧？ ] ] 那两个巨人先看着你，然后又互相看了看。慢慢地，那个男巨人向他的同伴点了点头，叹了口气坐了下来，把他的冰棍稍微推开一些，然后盘腿坐在冰面上。即便这样坐着，他们两个还是和你一样高，这样你们交谈时就能平视对方了。 “好吧。我们谈谈吧。其他人可能不愿意，但我们会谈谈的。如果你知道什么对自己有好处的话，精灵……[pc.ra elf | |-friend ]你会离开这个地方的。” 等你听完他们的话后，再做决定吧。现在，如果他们不介意的话，或许应该开始讲了。
rows.raw: " Care to explain just what's going on here? The first time you ran into jotuns, you got the clear impression that they didn't like elves — the pale elves, to be precise. Just why all the animosity? [party.has etheryn |The jotun woman coughs and glowers at you disbelievingly. "You stand with one of them as your friend, and you don't know anything about it? Ask her!" You look at Ryn, who looks back at you and shrugs helplessly. She's just as clueless as you are, and you tell the pair of jotuns just as much. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds. "Please," Ryn says, swallowing hard as she steps forward. "Until not so long ago, I'd rarely left the palace proper and never ventured beyond the walls of the Winter City. Tell me what grievances you have against my... against the pale elves so that I may set them right." |[pc.ra elf |"You are an elf!" the jotun woman roars, then breaks into a coughing fit, her chest heaving. She pauses to catch her breath, then continues. "How could you not know?' Well, [pc.ora wyldelf |you're a wyld elf, not a pale elf. If she hasn't noticed how bitterly cold you are, not to mention how much you're shivering at the moment, perhaps she should do so and realize you're not from around these parts |to begin with, you weren't born an elf and aren't really one in the ways that really count; you just look like one through alchemical and magical means. If she hasn't noticed that you're really feeling the cold in the rift when a pale elf wouldn't, perhaps she should be a bit more aware of her foes ]. So no, you have no reason to be in the know with regards to what shenanigans the pale elves have been up to here in the rift. Just because you look like one doesn't mean you are one, and even if you were a pale elf that wouldn't have meant anything, either. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds. Most pale elves never even leave the Winter City to begin with. |"You are an elf-friend, a spy for their kind! Even if we didn't know what you looked like from the description the whaling party brought back to the tribe, the stink of elf spoor is all over you! How could you not know of their doings?" The jotun woman finishes her words, then breaks into a coughing fit. "Impossible." You're trying to be reasonable here. Sure, you might have had contact with a number of pale elves and know them on a personal level, but you haven't heard this story from them. The pale elves aren't any kind of hivemind or tribe consisting of less than a hundred people; they're an entire nation, a city-state and more. Just because some of their number are up to no good by the jotuns' reckoning doesn't mean that all of them are in the know about their dastardly deeds up in the rift. Most pale elves never even leave the Winter City to begin with. So yes, you'd like them to explain it from their point of view. This is more than what they imagined a spy for the elves would have afforded them, right? ] ] The two jotuns look at you, then at each other again. Slowly, the jotun man nods to his companion and sets down with a sigh, pushing his ice club a little distance away from him before sitting cross legged on the ice. Even having lowered themselves thus, the duo are as tall as you are, all the better to see eye to eye as you speak. "Fine. We shall talk. Others may not, but we shall talk. If you know what is good for you, elf[pc.ra elf | |-friend ], you will leave this place." You'll decide after you've heard them out. Now, if they don't mind, perhaps they should begin."

rows.original: It is the woman who speaks, her voice settling into a monotonous drone as she recounts a tale etched into her memory from many retellings. "Since time immemorial, the rift has been divided between the four peoples birthed of this land: the jotuns to the east, the selkies to the west, the siorcanna beneath the ice and the avanai in the skies. It is a good land for those who are born of the ice; we belong here, each in our own ways, and intrude little upon each other's domain. The only outsiders were those shaggy minotaurs from across the ocean when the ice grows thick, and they are always only passing through, never staying." You nod. All right, you're following her so far. [party.has etheryn |Ryn beside you, y |Y ]ou make yourself as comfortable as you can on the snow and ice and listen to the rest of the tale. "Two and a half centuries ago, elves came from the south, a dark-skinned goddess at their head along with a strong warrior-queen. They told us there was a great darkness coming from the lands there, and offered us their... protection. We could join their host if that was our desire, and some of us did. And as it turned out, there was a great darkness from the southlands that reached even this far, the goddess and her elves did protect us, and a few from the four peoples did even join the host — the valkyries, as they were, and still are, called. "But that is long over, and they've outstayed their welcome by far. They serve no purpose in the rift any more; the darkness they were here to fight is long gone! Instead, more and more elves come into the rift every year — there are no more new valkyries from the four peoples, they are all elves! Elves gather by the dragon's fissure in the southwest to sift the waters for metals without care for us, their foundries dump slag upon the ice; the heat escapes from their works and crafts and — no more!" That's probably for the best; both jotuns are growing visibly more agitated as the woman recounts the tale, and you get the main gist of their complaints. [party.has etheryn |You turn to Etheryn and give her a nod, seeing if your elven companion has anything to say about the jotuns' tale so far. "They are... not wrong, as far as I know. I've never heard anything about dumping slag upon the ice, but it's true that my grandmother began the practice of sluicing the glacial streams for copper and tin within the mountains instead of mining it from under the Frostwood. The druids were occupying it while in schism with the Winter City, and besides, mining was a terribly dangerous job, only given to convicted criminals. Sluicing was far safer and more humane..." "For you," the jotun man spits. "Unlike selkies and siorcanna, neither us nor the avanai can drink seawater. Every decade you claim more and more of the streams, and we are forced to go higher and higher to seek water that isn't fouled with mining waste. We invited you elves as guests in good faith, and this is how you repay us." Ryn opens her mouth to speak again, but you hold up a hand to silence her. This is a deep-rooted problem that isn't going to be solved by platitudes and promises — there's far more going on here than meets the eye. You need to understand what's going on in the rift, how Tollus and his cult tie into all of this, and what's going on with the local elves before doing anything. She may want to prove herself, but she needs to properly assess the entirety of the situation in her capacity before making any kind of decision. While you can understand Ryn's desire to make this right, it's only when she's got all of the facts and proven herself to these people with some show of goodwill that she'll be in a position to broker peace with them. Ryn hesitates, then gives you a slow nod and settles back down. |The only question remains, then, as to what's to be done. "That is simple," the jotun man spits. "We unite and drive the goddess and her elves from the rift. They came offering protection and having set down roots here, now demand protection. As one, the peoples of the ice declare that this will not stand any longer." But there's a new ruler in the Winter City now. Yes, they've said that this situation has been going on for two centuries or more now, but given the changed situation surely some sort of peaceful solution can be — "The queen of the pale elves takes her orders from the goddess. The goddess is not moving. Hence, even if you speak the truth, elf[pc.ra elf | |-friend ], there is nothing that can be done." Or is there? ] "There is no stopping the Grand Alliance. Alone, you may best us as you just have. United, we peoples of the glacial rift will send the goddess and her elves the clear message that they have overstayed their welcome. The land and ice groan under the burden of their fouling; their pain has grown to the point where even we jotuns are having dreams and visions of their suffering. No more." There's a note of finality in those last words that leaves no question that the conversation is over. Having recovered enough to stand, both frost giants pick up their clubs and other things before turning to leave, still unsteady on their feet as they return the way they came, thoroughly beaten. Even after all this, the jotuns' story raises more questions than it answers. What is the grand alliance that they spoke of? Does this tie into the demon cult's machinations, and if so, how? Could they really stand against the Lumian valkyries? There's no doubt that the jotuns are strong, and their allies too, but going against the direct devotees of a goddess still feels like a tall order. You shake your head. While you might be able to defeat Tollus and the demon cult, some problems are sticky enough to be impossible to solve just by swinging a sword around.[party.has etheryn | Turning to Ryn, you note that she looks even more upset than you are — absolutely despondent. Is she all right? "No, I'm not all right. Grandmother was the one who funded the methods and devices used in sluicing the rivers; she gave the artificers official royal patronage. It was supposed to be more humane, cleaner than mining under the Frostwood. More efficient. And now..." She sighs. "I don't want to say it, but I'm beginning to understand why Alissa hated me so. For her to go from a carefree life of drinking and partying to having to deal with this. I would hate myself." It's not her fault. Heavy is the head who wears the crown — only feckless fools imagine all kings and queens do is eat, drink and have orgies all day, because that's what they would do if they were royalty. Alissa should have known that and prepared herself accordingly in life. The failing is Alissa's, not Ryn's for existing. And as for her grandmother, sluicing the glacial rivers was probably all that and more, but the costs were shifted onto the peoples of the rift where there were none before. There's got to be a way this can be worked out, and you'll help her find it. Ryn doesn't look completely convinced, but nods and wipes the tears from her eyes, stands up a little straighter. "I — " We. "Right. We'll just have to see what has to be done, won't we? I've uncovered my sister's corruption and driven two demons from the Winter City. What's brokering peace with the jotuns on top of that?" Great, that's the spirit. All right, then, time to move on. Time's a-wasting. ]
rows.translation: 是这位女性在讲述这个故事，她的声音逐渐变得单调而乏味，因为她所讲述的这个故事，是通过多次重复的讲述而深深地刻在了她的记忆之中。“从远古时代起，这片土地上的居民就被分成了四类：东边的约顿人，西边的海豹精，冰层之下的西奥卡纳人，以及天空中的阿瓦奈人。 对于那些生来就生活在冰原上的人来说，这里是一片理想的家园；我们每个人都以自己的方式生活在这里，几乎不会侵犯彼此的领地。唯一的外来者，就是那些当冰层变厚时从海洋对岸而来的毛茸茸的弥诺陶洛斯，但他们也只是一过而已，从不会在这里久留。你点了点头。好吧，到目前为止，你一直在跟随她。 [party.has etheryn |你身边的瑞恩，哟…… |Y ]在冰雪之上，尽你所能地让自己舒适一些，然后继续听这个故事吧。 “两个半世纪前，精灵们从南方来到了这里。他们的首领是一位皮肤黝黑的女神，还有一位强大的女战士女王。她们告诉我们，来自那些地方的暗影势力正在逼近，于是向我们提供了……保护。如果我们愿意，可以加入他们的行列，确实也有一些人这么做了。而后来事实证明，…… 是 来自南方大陆的浓重暗影甚至蔓延到了这里，但女神和她的精灵们保护了我们，而且四个种族中也有一些人加入了我们的队伍——他们就是现在仍然被称为“女武神”的那些人。 但那已经是很久以前的事了，而且他们在这里停留的时间已经远远超出了被欢迎的限度。他们在裂隙中已经没有任何作用了；他们当初来这里所要对抗的暗影早已消失无踪！相反，每年都有越来越多的精灵来到这个裂隙——来自那四个民族的新的女武神已经不再出现了，现在来这里的都是精灵！ 精灵们聚集在西南方向的巨龙裂缝旁，毫不顾及我们，从水中筛选金属；他们的铸造厂将熔渣倾倒在冰面上，热量从他们的作坊和工艺品中散发出来——就这样罢了！ 或许这样反而是好事；当这位女子讲述这个故事时，那两个巨魔显得愈发焦躁不安，你也能大致理解他们所抱怨的内容了。 [party.has etheryn |你转向伊瑟琳，微微点了点头，想看看这位精灵同伴对于那些巨人的故事有什么要说的。 “据我所知，他们说的并没有错。我以前从未听说过有人会把熔渣倒到冰面上，但确实是我的祖母开始采用这种方法——从山中的冰川溪流中提取铜和锡，而不是在霜木地带进行采矿。 在与冬城决裂期间，德鲁伊们占据着那里。而且，采矿是一项极其危险的工作，只有被定罪的罪犯才会被派去从事这项工作。而挖掘矿脉则要安全得多，也更加人道…… 这是给你的，”那个巨人说道，“与人鱼和西奥卡娜不同，我们阿瓦奈人也无法饮用海水。每隔十年，你们就会侵占越来越多的溪流，我们不得不越往高处寻找没有被采矿废料污染的水源。我们是出于善意邀请你们精灵们前来做客的，而你们却这样回报我们。 瑞恩刚要开口说话，你却抬手示意她安静。这是一个根深蒂固的问题，仅靠一些空洞的承诺是无法解决的——这里面隐藏的真相远比表面看起来要复杂得多。在采取任何行动之前，你必须弄清楚裂隙中究竟发生了什么，托卢斯和他的邪教组织是如何卷入这一切的，还有当地精灵们目前处境如何。 她或许想要证明自己的能力，但在做出任何决定之前，她需要先全面了解整个情况。虽然我们可以理解Ryn想要把这件事处理好的心情，但只有当她掌握了所有事实，并且通过一些积极的行动向这些人证明自己的诚意时，她才有可能与他们达成和解。 瑞恩犹豫了一下，然后缓缓点了点头，又重新坐了下来。 |那么，唯一剩下的问题就是该采取什么行动了。 “这很简单，”那个巨人说道，“我们联合起来，把那位女神和她的精灵们从裂缝中赶出去。他们当初来到这里寻求保护，现在却反过来要求我们给予他们保护。 冰之民族们一致宣称，这种状况再也不能继续下去了。 但是，现在冬城有一位新的统治者。虽然他们说过，这种局面已经持续了两个世纪甚至更久，但考虑到如今形势的变化，肯定能够找到某种和平的解决办法吧…… 这些苍白精灵的女王听从女神的命令。而女神本身并未采取任何行动。因此，即使你说出了真相，也无济于事……[pc.ra elf | |-friend ]没有什么办法可以解决了。” 或者，真的没有办法吗？ ] 没有任何力量能够阻止大联盟。单凭你们自己，或许还能像现在这样战胜我们；但当我们联合起来，冰川裂谷的各族人民将会向那位女神和她的精灵们传达一个明确的信息：他们的停留已经超过了被欢迎的限度。这片土地和冰原正在承受他们带来的污染之重；他们的所作所为所造成的痛苦，甚至已经让像我们这样的巨人们也开始做关于他们苦难的梦和看到相关的幻象。 不再有了。” 那最后的话语中带着一种决绝的意味，让人毫不怀疑这场对话已经结束。两位霜巨人恢复了足够的体力，站了起来，捡起他们的棍棒和其他物品，然后转身离开。尽管足部步还有些不稳，但他们还是沿着来时的路走了回去——显然，他们已经败得一败涂地。 即便经历了这一切，这些巨人的故事仍然引发了更多的疑问，而非提供了答案。他们所提到的那个庞大联盟究竟是什么？这与恶魔教派的阴谋有什么关联？如果有的话，这种关联又是如何体现的？他们真的有能力对抗卢米安的英灵女武神吗？ 毫无疑问，那些巨魔以及他们的盟友确实非常强大，但要与一位女神的忠实信徒们抗衡，仍然显得困难重重。 你摇了摇头。虽然你或许能够击败托卢斯以及那个恶魔崇拜组织，但有些问题实在棘手，仅仅依靠挥舞剑刃是无法解决的。[party.has etheryn | 转向瑞恩，你会注意到她看起来比你还要沮丧——简直陷入了极度的绝望之中。 “她没事吧？” “不，她并没有没事。是祖母出资购买了用于治理河流的各种方法与设备，她还正式给予了那些工匠皇室的支持与认可。 这本应该是一种比在霜林下采矿更人道、更清洁的方式，也应该更高效。然而现在……”她叹了口气，“我不想这么说，但我开始明白为什么艾丽莎会那么恨我了。对她来说，从那种无忧无虑、整天喝酒玩乐的生活，突然转变为不得不面对这一切…… 这个我会恨自己的。” 这不是她的错。谁戴着王冠，谁就要承担这份责任——只有那些愚蠢的人才会以为所有的国王和王后整天都在吃喝玩乐，因为他们确实就是这么做的。 他们 rows.raw: " It is the woman who speaks, her voice settling into a monotonous drone as she recounts a tale etched into her memory from many retellings. "Since time immemorial, the rift has been divided between the four peoples birthed of this land: the jotuns to the east, the selkies to the west, the siorcanna beneath the ice and the avanai in the skies. It is a good land for those who are born of the ice; we belong here, each in our own ways, and intrude little upon each other's domain. The only outsiders were those shaggy minotaurs from across the ocean when the ice grows thick, and they are always only passing through, never staying." You nod. All right, you're following her so far. [party.has etheryn |Ryn beside you, y |Y ]ou make yourself as comfortable as you can on the snow and ice and listen to the rest of the tale. "Two and a half centuries ago, elves came from the south, a dark-skinned goddess at their head along with a strong warrior-queen. They told us there was a great darkness coming from the lands there, and offered us their... protection. We could join their host if that was our desire, and some of us did. And as it turned out, there was a great darkness from the southlands that reached even this far, the goddess and her elves did protect us, and a few from the four peoples did even join the host — the valkyries, as they were, and still are, called. "But that is long over, and they've outstayed their welcome by far. They serve no purpose in the rift any more; the darkness they were here to fight is long gone! Instead, more and more elves come into the rift every year — there are no more new valkyries from the four peoples, they are all elves! Elves gather by the dragon's fissure in the southwest to sift the waters for metals without care for us, their foundries dump slag upon the ice; the heat escapes from their works and crafts and — no more!" That's probably for the best; both jotuns are growing visibly more agitated as the woman recounts the tale, and you get the main gist of their complaints. [party.has etheryn |You turn to Etheryn and give her a nod, seeing if your elven companion has anything to say about the jotuns' tale so far. "They are... not wrong, as far as I know. I've never heard anything about dumping slag upon the ice, but it's true that my grandmother began the practice of sluicing the glacial streams for copper and tin within the mountains instead of mining it from under the Frostwood. The druids were occupying it while in schism with the Winter City, and besides, mining was a terribly dangerous job, only given to convicted criminals. Sluicing was far safer and more humane..." "For you," the jotun man spits. "Unlike selkies and siorcanna, neither us nor the avanai can drink seawater. Every decade you claim more and more of the streams, and we are forced to go higher and higher to seek water that isn't fouled with mining waste. We invited you elves as guests in good faith, and this is how you repay us." Ryn opens her mouth to speak again, but you hold up a hand to silence her. This is a deep-rooted problem that isn't going to be solved by platitudes and promises — there's far more going on here than meets the eye. You need to understand what's going on in the rift, how Tollus and his cult tie into all of this, and what's going on with the local elves before doing anything. She may want to prove herself, but she needs to properly assess the entirety of the situation in her capacity before making any kind of decision. While you can understand Ryn's desire to make this right, it's only when she's got all of the facts and proven herself to these people with some show of goodwill that she'll be in a position to broker peace with them. Ryn hesitates, then gives you a slow nod and settles back down. |The only question remains, then, as to what's to be done. "That is simple," the jotun man spits. "We unite and drive the goddess and her elves from the rift. They came offering protection and having set down roots here, now demand protection. As one, the peoples of the ice declare that this will not stand any longer." But there's a new ruler in the Winter City now. Yes, they've said that this situation has been going on for two centuries or more now, but given the changed situation surely some sort of peaceful solution can be — "The queen of the pale elves takes her orders from the goddess. The goddess is not moving. Hence, even if you speak the truth, elf[pc.ra elf | |-friend ], there is nothing that can be done." Or is there? ] "There is no stopping the Grand Alliance. Alone, you may best us as you just have. United, we peoples of the glacial rift will send the goddess and her elves the clear message that they have overstayed their welcome. The land and ice groan under the burden of their fouling; their pain has grown to the point where even we jotuns are having dreams and visions of their suffering. No more." There's a note of finality in those last words that leaves no question that the conversation is over. Having recovered enough to stand, both frost giants pick up their clubs and other things before turning to leave, still unsteady on their feet as they return the way they came, thoroughly beaten. Even after all this, the jotuns' story raises more questions than it answers. What is the grand alliance that they spoke of? Does this tie into the demon cult's machinations, and if so, how? Could they really stand against the Lumian valkyries? There's no doubt that the jotuns are strong, and their allies too, but going against the direct devotees of a goddess still feels like a tall order. You shake your head. While you might be able to defeat Tollus and the demon cult, some problems are sticky enough to be impossible to solve just by swinging a sword around.[party.has etheryn | Turning to Ryn, you note that she looks even more upset than you are — absolutely despondent. Is she all right? "No, I'm not all right. Grandmother was the one who funded the methods and devices used in sluicing the rivers; she gave the artificers official royal patronage. It was supposed to be more humane, cleaner than mining under the Frostwood. More efficient. And now..." She sighs. "I don't want to say it, but I'm beginning to understand why Alissa hated me so. For her to go from a carefree life of drinking and partying to having to deal with this. I would hate myself." It's not her fault. Heavy is the head who wears the crown — only feckless fools imagine all kings and queens do is eat, drink and have orgies all day, because that's what they would do if they were royalty. Alissa should have known that and prepared herself accordingly in life. The failing is Alissa's, not Ryn's for existing. And as for her grandmother, sluicing the glacial rivers was probably all that and more, but the costs were shifted onto the peoples of the rift where there were none before. There's got to be a way this can be worked out, and you'll help her find it. Ryn doesn't look completely convinced, but nods and wipes the tears from her eyes, stands up a little straighter. "I — " We. "Right. We'll just have to see what has to be done, won't we? I've uncovered my sister's corruption and driven two demons from the Winter City. What's brokering peace with the jotuns on top of that?" Great, that's the spirit. All right, then, time to move on. Time's a-wasting. ]"

        那你呢？”你终于把话题转向了凯娜；你凑近她那魁梧的身躯，放下了那个空杯子。

有那么几分钟，你们两人之间一片寂静。……或者，环境也可以安静得令人几乎听不到任何声音，只有背景中持续不断的雷暴声在回荡。当凯娜终于开口说话时，她只是叹了口气，耸了耸肩：“其实……没什么好说的。我的父亲是他那个时代最著名的炼金术士，名叫贾卡德。 我的母亲？她是一条美丽的蓝色巨龙，名字叫做“当雪花落在草地上，所有的心都会敞开”。我知道，这个名字很长……简而言之，就是在巨龙们与那些同类的战争中，我的母亲被一个巨兽杀害了。我的父亲非常担心我的安全，于是将我置于休眠状态，并承诺等战争结束就会回来接我。" 
        
        她的声音微微颤抖了一下，尽管茶杯早已空了，她还是继续小口喝着茶。“他再也没有回来；他活得不够久，没能看到战争的结束。直到有一只海妖来到了这里，我才真正重新醒了过来。”

“海妖？
        
        德拉科陶尔清了清嗓子，然后将目光移开。“还有……她不幸去世了。不过是因为年老去世的！这，你知道的，已经算是很幸运的了。”凯娜叹了口气，耸了耸肩，调整着自己的马尾辫。“但我还是很想念她。她像故事书里的公主一样，用一个吻试图把我唤醒，结果我不小心把她弄晕了，之后我们开始约会、结婚，虽然没能生育——但我们也尝试过——最后幸福地度过了余生。
        
        从那以后你就一直一个人生活吗？ [pc.dcb
            |那真是太可悲了……为什么不试着走出去呢？你的实力足以应付这里的大多数蠢货。
            |那听起来挺困难的……出去交几个朋友应该不会那么难吧？
            |为什么不出去做点事情呢？
        ]凯娜颤抖着，凝视着那扇石门。“害怕广阔的天空，实在不想谈论这个话题。总之，我很抱歉……或许我们可以换个话题吧？
rows.raw:
'
        Kaina proves to be a beyond-decent furnace; her smooth draconic form gives off a heat of its own, and the tea is rich on your tongue. While you're wrapped up in blankets, and pressed up against her bulk, the massive monster's feminine upper-body sips tea beside you. "So, this might sound strange but... would you tell me of yourself? Everything about you?"
        
        That's a tall ask, [pc.isBimbo
            |you have a hard time remembering, like, this morning! What did you have for breakfast? Oh! Oh wait, it was a muffin! It had sausage in it, and a bunch of li— oh, right. You do your best to gather up your scattered thoughts and begin your tale, starting with the adventures
            |you've been up to a lot... But you endeavor to do your best, beginning with the adventures
        ] that introduced you to Kasyrra. [kas.romantic
            |Including your tentative romance with the salacious dragon-succu-cow in question.
        ]
        
        "How... wonderful." Kaina spends the entire time enraptured, drinking in your stories as though she'd been dying of thirst. There are only intermittent interruptions in order to keep you well lubricated with tea, otherwise you're made quite comfortable wrapped up in blankets and surrounded by warm dragon-taur. Her tail coils up in your lap, writhing when you pet it like a cat.
        
        "What about yourself?" You finally turn the conversation in Kaina's direction; leaning into the bulk of her tauric body and putting down your empty cup.
        
        For a few moments, quiet reigns over the two of you... or as quiet as it can be, with the constant soft sounds of a thunderstorm in the background. When Kaina finally speaks up it's with a sigh and a shrug. "There... isn't much to say. My father was the most famous alchemist of his time; Jacquard. My mother? A beautiful blue dragon, named When The Snow Falls Upon Grass, All Hearts Become Open. I know, lengthy name. The short version is that mom was skewered by the jotun during the dragon's war with their kind. My father feared for my safety, put me in stasis, and promised to come back when the war was over." 
        
        Her voice wavers for a moment, and she sips from her own teacup despite the vessel being long empty. "He never came back; he didn't live long enough to see the war's end. It wasn't until a selkie found her way in, that I was actually awoken again."
        
        "A selkie?"
        
        The dracotaur clears her throat and glances away. "Also... passed away, unfortunately. Of old age though! Which is, you know, far more fortunate." Kaina sighs and shrugs, adjusting her ponytail. "But I still miss her. She tried to wake me up with a kiss like a storybook princess, I accidentally knocked her out, and then we dated, married, couldn't breed — but enjoyed trying — and lived out our years happily."
        
        "You've been alone since? [pc.dcb
            |That's pretty pathetic... why not try going out there? You're strong enough to take on most of the airheads around here.
            |That sounds rough... surely it's not that hard to go out and make a few friends?
            |Why not, like, go out and do stuff?
        ]"
        
        Kaina shivers and stares at her stone doors. "Scared of the open sky, don't wanna talk about it. Anyway, I apologize... perhaps we could change the topic?"
        '

rows.original:
"Oh... welcome." Kaina twiddles her fingers shyly and welcomes [party.yall] inside, adjusting her ponytail. "Please! Come in out of the cold, I didn't expect you back so soon. Then again... I suppose I can't tell time so well, anyway."
    
    Once more you enter the dracotaur's lair, letting warmth wash over you and granting you a chance to recover from the dry icy shelves behind. The soft thunderstorm in Kaina's scrying orb is just as inviting as the heat, and the curvaceous taur herself. "Please, grab a seat. I've blankets aplenty, and all the time in the world."
rows.translation:
哦……欢迎来到这里。”凯娜害羞地扭动着手指，热情地表示欢迎。 [party.yall] 她站在屋里，整理着自己的马尾辫。“求你了！进来吧，外面太冷了，我没想到你会这么快回来。不过……说实话，我其实不太会看时间。”

你再次走进这只龙牛的巢穴，温暖的气息立刻包围了你，让你有机会从之前在那些干燥冰冷的石壁上经历的寒冷中恢复过来。凯娜的占卜球中呈现出的那场柔和的雷暴，和这里的温暖一样令人感到舒适，而那只身材曲线的优美的龙牛本身，也同样吸引人。“请坐吧，我有足够的毯子，而且时间也充裕得很。

rows.translation: 凯娜轻轻拍手部，然后带你来到她那个温馨的小洞穴里——那里堆满了各式各样的毯子。 [party.som |多亏你是自己来的，这意味着你可以…… 所有 那些毯子。 |你只需要和别人共用一条毯子就行了。 [companion1.name]. |虽然你得和另外两位同伴共享同一条毯子，但你的份量仍然很充足！而且凯娜的毯子非常保暖。 ] [pc.dcb |太好了。 |相当不错。 |耶耶耶！ ] 那只龙兽又开始忙活起来，它小心翼翼地用爪子操作，生怕在那些已经被时间侵蚀得布满痕迹的石头上留下更多的划痕。它轻轻推了推自己的炉子，目光紧紧地盯着里面那些散发着橙色光芒的宝石。 它的注意力依然完全集中在泡茶上，只有当你取了几撮你准备的茶叶时，它才停下来，温柔地对你笑了笑。那笑容是如此的愉悦…… [silly |蒙斯-陶尔 |怪物牛头人 ] 他拿出一个看起来像是用银网制成的小笼子，把那些叶子困在里面，然后把整个笼子浸进一锅煮沸的水里。“牛奶和蜂蜜吗？ [var0|你瞥了一眼你那位乳汁丰沛的伴侣， [party.comp azyrran |还有那些带着甜蜜的黄蜂，也在向它们点头致意…… |点头 ] 朝着那高大的公牛走去。“啊，但我们已经穿得暖暖和和的了啊！”她撅着嘴，耳朵还不停地抽动。 [party.comp azyrran |他们最终还是放弃了，摆脱了自己选择的那些伪装，然后紧紧依偎在一起，各自倒出了一杯金黄色的液体和甜美的淡奶油。“哦，真是太美味了！你们两个真是太珍贵了，要是我能一直把你们留在身边，就能随时享受这些美味了……”凯娜叹了口气，微笑着轻轻揉了揉他们的头，分别换来了他们咧开的笑容和轻微的笑声。“那好吧，你们再舒服地躺下来吧，我去泡茶给大家喝。 |她最终还是放弃了，脱下了自己选择的那些“毯子般的装饰”，向前倾身，将双乳紧贴在一起，让那些甜美的淡色乳汁填满一个容器。“哦，这真是太美妙了！太珍贵了……现在我甚至更后悔自己之前发生了争执；要是我能永远拥有你，作为这些乳汁的来源该多好啊。 ]|[pc.isMilky |幸运的是，你手头有奶油，可以用来给那头龙兽补充能量。“哦，太好了。”凯娜微笑着，继续开始她的工作。 |可惜你没有多余的牛奶了，不过你应该还能应付过去；这茶的味道确实很浓。 ]] 这一次，当凯娜在房间里闲逛时，她的尾巴会帮你找到她——毕竟，四百磅重的肌肉无论走到哪里，都能轻轻触碰你的腿，或者把枕头扔到你的腿上。 [party.som |她最终在你旁边坐了下来，递给你一杯水，还分享了几条你的毯子。 |她负责相关工作。 [companion1.name] 喝了一杯酒之后，它就坐在你旁边，然后递给你一杯酒，再拿来一些毯子。 |她为你的同伴端上饮料，然后坐在你旁边，递给你一杯酒，同时拿了一些毯子过来。 ] 想……依偎在一起吗？

rows.original: You'd rather just relax and enjoy the ambience; drink and catch a nap to warm your bones. Cuddling up will likely only earn you a dicking. The dracotaur blinks and blushes, although she doesn't get too close... not that this stops her tail from wrapping around your waist. "I feel like some statement about my innocence as a respectable lady is being called into question." "[silly |You're thirsty on main, Kaina. |You do seem prone to... thirstiness. ]" Even the word thirst makes the taur squirm a little, and her cheeks flush deeply red. "...Point taken. Let's just enjoy the tea then." Instead of starting up a dialogue with Kaina, you simply close your eyes and... soak. Warm blankets cover your body with a reassuring weight, the soft orange glow of the stove just about keeps you from being completely wrapped in darkness with your eyes closed, and the storm-orb in the room's centre soothes you with the sound of far-off rain and muted thunder. Kaina herself appears the very picture of content herself when you open your eyes enough to check; her own are half lidded, looking over you[party.som | while she smiles softly. | and [companion1.name] with a soft smile. |, [companion1.name], and [companion2.name] with soft smiles for each of you. ] Nobody speaks, you only drink, and let your minds wander and doze. Some time in the near future, you're going to have to bring snacks. Your mind is shrouded in weight, and once your tea is finished you find that you've taken to petting Kaina's tail like a pet [silly |Cait |cat ].
rows.translation: 你还不如放松下来，享受这种氛围吧——喝点酒，小睡一会儿，让身体暖和起来。要是靠亲近她，很可能只会惹来麻烦。那只龙兽会眨眨眼、脸也会红起来，不过她并不会靠得太近……不过，这并不妨碍她的尾巴缠在你的腰上。“我觉得有人正在质疑我作为一个正派女士的清白身份啊。[silly |在主线上，你会感到口渴的，凯娜。 |你似乎确实很容易感到口渴…… ]就连…… 单词 口渴让那头金牛有些坐立不安，她的脸颊也变得通红。“……好吧，你说得有道理。那我们就专心享受这杯茶吧。” 你没有选择与凯娜开始对话，而是闭上了眼睛，尽情地沉浸在这片刻的宁静之中。 温暖的毯子将你的身体紧紧包裹起来，带来一种令人安心的触感；炉子散发出的柔和橙色光芒，几乎让你在闭上眼睛的时候也不会完全陷入黑暗之中；而房间中央的那个模拟风暴的装置，则通过模拟远处的雨声和轻柔的雷声，为你带来宁静与安抚。 当你仔细观察时，会发现凯娜本人简直就是满足与愉悦的化身——她的双眼半掩着，正若有所思地注视着你。[party.som | 而她却温柔地微笑着。 | 以及 [companion1.name] 带着温柔的微笑。 |, [companion1.name]，以及 [companion2.name] 带着温柔的微笑，面对你们每一个人。 ] 没有人说话，你只是静静地喝茶，让思绪随意飘荡，偶尔小憩一会儿。在不久的将来，你得自己准备零食了。你的思绪被沉重的情绪所笼罩，而当茶喝完之后，你会发现自己开始像抚摸宠物一样轻轻抚摸凯娜的尾巴。 [silly |凯特 |猫 ].

rows.original:
You barely register the moment you'd fallen asleep... but you're awoken by the sensation of someone [pc.hasHair
                |brushing your hair away
                |tapping you gently on the nose
            ]. Kaina grins when you peel your eyes open and yawn, before having to stifle one of her own. "Don't you set me off, we've gotten enough sleep by now."
            
            "How long?"
            
            Kaina shrugs helplessly. "I don't use a timekeeping device; you'll have to check when you go outside."
            
            Actually peeling yourself out of all of these blankets is more akin to agony; to leave behind such softness and warmth. At the very least, [party.yall] are given some damp clothes to wipe off with. After you've shocked yourself to wakefulness and cleaned off any sweat, you regather your belongings and prepare to face the outside world again. "I'll see you soon, yes?" Kaina smiles, stretching herself out slowly until there's an interesting combination of clicks from both her humanoid half and draconic form.
            
            How could she not? It's that or death by chill. You give her tail a squeeze, wait for her to push open the massive stone doors of her illusory cave-entrance, and then brace yourself for the ice once more.

她应该在一两年前就从那次小睡中醒来了，我敢肯定……好吧，让我从头开始讲。我的阿姨——那个被人们称为‘带来灰烬的人’、‘能重新点燃森林之火、也能惩罚敌人的人’；或者用一个听起来不那么拗口的名字来说，就是灰烬使者——在很久以前的战争中受了伤。为了治愈伤势，她进入了沉睡状态；由于那些伤势的原因，她现在经常处于睡眠状态…… 哪场战争？” 凯娜眨了眨眼，说道：“呃……对，发生过很多场战争。不过不是乔顿战争，那场战争中她差点被一个精灵杀死。真难以相信，这么一个小小的生物竟然能够击败一条真正的龙。不过她从未跟我讲过这个故事；也许她会愿意跟你分享的。总之，既然我手部头有些茶，就在想你是否愿意帮忙把茶送过去，顺便看看艾什阿姨怎么样？我已经挑出了她最可能会喜欢的茶叶，把它们包好了。 等等，你阿姨竟然是一条真正的龙？” “嗯！灰烬使者是一条金龙，它那闪闪发光的鳞片仿佛能吸收太阳的热量呢。”凯娜甜甜蜜蜜地说道，“我相信她肯定愿意为这杯茶献出几颗宝石的。又一次，凯娜将那个袋子放在你的左手部中，微笑着，而你还没来得及接受或拒绝……接着，她又把一颗手部指大小的翡翠放在你的右手部中。嗯，如果她打算付给你一笔巨额报酬，而你还有机会见到一条真正的巨龙的话，这样的机会当然不能错过啊。 很难拒绝。 好吧，你的阿姨藏在哪里呢？” 凯娜跺着脚走到房间的后面，打开一张长凳，里面露出一个装满各种小玩意儿的箱子。你看到里面有几本泛黄的书籍、一个音乐盒、一卷卷轴，还有一本皮封的书——她从书中抽出一页拿在手部里。回到你面前时，她得意地笑着举起那页纸：“虽然这些可能有点过时了，但她的确被困在山上那里。 一座山？你接过那张纸，皱起了眉头——这张地图显然很旧了，但如果你把它的轮廓与你所熟悉的地域对照起来看，其实还挺清晰的。 灰烬使者位于收获谷最西端的山脊上。 我想我知道这是在哪里了，幸好这些山脉本身并没有移动。不过这里大部分都是农田。哦，还有牛头人以及马人居住在这里。”当凯娜把炭笔递给你后，你在她的地图上画了几笔标注。 哦！原来食物就是从这里来的吗？”凯娜指着她炉子旁边一个直到现在才被注意到的箱子，箱子上贴着“帕珀里奇农场”的标签。“不管怎样，我真的想再次感谢你在这件事上给予我的帮助。 你想暂时退休一段时间吗？”凯娜将马尾辫拨到一边，然后弯腰行礼。
rows.raw: ' When you 'knock' on Kaina's cave entrance, you're immediately bowled over by the dracotaur's exuberant entrance. Warmth washes over [party.yall], banishing the chill of the ice shelves behind. "[pc.name]! The delivery came! How did you manage it? I thought you'd just be pulling a couple of small sacks!" Small sacks? Does she not realize how much money that huge ruby was worth? "I... asked a specialist if she could do the legwork?" You awkwardly step back under her earnest, delighted gaze. The massive monster clears her throat and waves you inside, tucking her hammer away. "I don't think you understand how much of a favor you've done for me; until now I've just been getting by on ice-fishing. I haven't had bread in a very, very long time. That caravan promised to stop by once a month, so I can order things. I can own new belongings, and I don't have to go outside!" Her tail wraps around your waist in some close approximation of a hug as she guides you inside. The soft sound of thunderstorms awaits, there's a faint perfume in the air, and a pot of fresh tea is already merrily brewing off to the side. "They offered coffee too but it makes me uncomfortably giddy." You notice the temperature of the room drop considerably, which is explained by Kaina taking deep, nervous breaths. "Something still bothering you?" You finally ask, unwilling to watch her fidget any longer. "...Sort of, I have everything I need, but now all I can do is worry about my auntie." Agni flaps idly on the spot, puffing herself up by the heat of the stove. |[arona.isDom |"She hot?" Arona teases. |"Is she hot?" Arona grins. ] |"Another dragon? Oh that's amazing..." Atugia sighs. |[azzy.kdb |"Oh no! Is she okay?" Azyrran frowns and threads her chitinous digits together. |"I can't possibly be a dragoon and be asking about this for the first time! You must have cheated." Azzy asserts. |"Oh no! Is your auntie alright?" Azzy gasps. ] |"An aunt? Like you?" Brienne blinks in surprise. |"I'll be damned; there're more of you?" Brint's brows slowly raise in surprise. |"An auntie? Oh dear, is there anything we can do?" Cait's ears tuck back. |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |"O-oh no... an auntie? Surely we can help." Ryn's ears droop. |"You've an auntie? Perhaps we can help?" Ryn tucks her hair back and frowns. "If that's alright with [pc.name]." |"You have an aunt? Obviously we have to help her too." Ryn frowns. ] |"This sounds like trouble..." Einin sighs. |"More of you? Interesting..." Kiyoko looks up from her inspection of a teapot "I'm sure it's within our capacity to help." |Quin looks up from an inspection of his tail, placing a hand over his heart. "Surely, for a damsel in distress such as yourself, we could lend your aunt a helping hand." |[viv.isDemon |"Oh no, another of you? In need of help, too... my curiosity abounds." Viv runs a hand down her cleavage and gives a grin laden with promise. |"Another of you? In distress? [pc.name] has proven [pc.mf |him |her ]self adept in handling problems. Perhaps we can be of assistance?" Viv looks up from inspecting the stove's rocks, smiling softly and giving you both a delightful view of her ample cleavage. ] ] ] Kaina blushes and adjusts her shaggy ponytail, resisting the urge to suck down another deep breath. "I'm sorry, you've already done so much for me... but I haven't heard from her in a decade or two." A decade or two?! That's quite a while... "She should've woken from her nap a year or two ago, I'm sure... okay, let me start at the beginning. My aunt — Bringer of Ash, The Fire That Renews The Forest and Scourges Foes — or as you'd probably find less cumbersome; Ashelander, was hurt a long time ago in the war. She went to sleep to try and heal from her injuries; she sleeps often, as a result of them..." "Which war?" Kaina blinks. "Uh... right, multiples wars've happened. Not the jotun war, I think she was near slain by an elf. Hard to believe someone so small could fell a true dragon. She never told me the tale though; perhaps she'd share it with you. Anyway, seeing as I have some tea, I was wondering if you'd be willing to deliver some and check up on auntie Ash? I picked out the tea I think she'd like the most and bagged it up." "Wait, your aunt is a fully-fledged dragon?" "Mhm! Ashelander's a gold dragon. With lustrous, beautiful scales that capture the warmth of the sun itself." Kaina sighs sweetly. "I'm sure she'd be willing to part with a couple of gems for the tea." Once more, Kaina places the bag in your left hand and smiles softly before you have a chance to accept or decline... and then places a finger-sized emerald in your other hand. Well if she's going to pay you an outrageous sum, and you get the opportunity to meet a full-sized dragon? It's hard to say no. "Alright, where is your aunt hidden?" Kaina stomps off to the back of her room, opening a sitting bench and revealing a chest of goodies within. You catch sight of a few yellowed tomes, a music box, a rolled parchment, and a leather-bound book from which she un-clips a page. As she returns, she holds up the page and smiles proudly. "It's probably more than a little outdated, but this is the mountain she's stuck inside." A mountain? You accept the paper and frown; it's clearly old, but if you were to superimpose the map over the areas you know, it's rather clear; Ashelander is in the western-most ridge of the Harvest Valley. "I think I know where this is, thankfully the mountains themselves haven't moved. This here though is mostly farmland. Oh, and there're taurs, and marefolk here." You update Kaina's map with a couple of scribbles once she hands you a charcoal pen. "Oh! Is that where the food came from?" Kaina points at a crate next to her stove — unnoticed until now — with a stamp reading 'Pupperidge Farms' on it. "A-anyway, I want to thank you again, honestly, for your help with this. Would you like to retire for a while?" Kaina sweeps her ponytail aside so that she can bow at the waist. '

rows.original: "You have news about Auntie Ashe?" Kaina sits up in her pillow pile, eyes wide. "Did she— how is she doing?" You wince, and draw forth the beautiful mace that houses the dragon's soul. "Do you recognize this?" The dracotaur clicks her lengthy tongue curiously and gets up, thumping her way over with the usual ponderously heavy steps of her form before accepting the weapon. "Hmn... it smells familiar, and I recognize the coloration; Auntie had clothing just like this, I think a pair one of her girlfriends or boyfriends bought for her. Does this belong to her then?" You're about to answer when she abruptly goes stock-still, but for her tail which lashes around so hard it sends pillows ceiling-ward. "Auntie?" Ah... of course; she's speaking directly to her. It feels tremendously awkward not being part of the conversation though, and apparently the 'taur notices this. "Oh, uhm... come here, please, [pc.name]." Kaina makes grabby hand motions toward you, and when you're close enough she plants your hand on the hilt as well. "Much better," Ashe's voice rings out softly. "I'm so sorry, Kaina... I wasn't there for our family." "N-no Auntie..." "It's true, I was distracted with my own personal pleasures. I had a lot of time lying there... awake, and that is a lot of time for thinking. I missed seeing a lot of you, and your parents. Such a shame." Clearly this is going to descend into a pity party, and you clear your throat. "That's clearly not your fault, there's no point bogging yourselves down with it." Ashe's presence in your mind quiets for a long moment, and likely in Kaina's too— the poor girl looks like she's about to cry. "I should explain what happened, shouldn't I? I suppose it's too late now for regrets," Ashe's voice is warm and reassuring now, and at the sound of it, Kaina's tail wraps around your hips. "I died, and honestly that was a long, long time ago... I've simply been going through the throes this entire time." Kaina listens quietly, sharing a moment of practically holding hands with you over the mace holding her auntie's soul. You stroke her tail occasionally, but the blue-scaled dracotaur does an admirable job of holding back her sniffles. Re-hearing the tale doesn't make it any less [pc.dcb |unpleasantly moist-eyed, or stupidly heart-string-pully |tear-jerking or depressing |super-duper-sad ]. Honestly you're just glad the poor girl didn't have to see Ashe as you had; she'll always get to remember her aunt as the radiant, golden dragon she always was. The direction of the conversation turns away from Ashe, eventually, and towards you. "Yes, [pc.mf |he |she ] saved me, essentially. I want to stay with [pc.mf |him |her ], and watch over [pc.mf |his |her ] descendents." Kaina takes a deep breath, dabbing the corner of her eyes and leaning into you hard enough to nearly topple you over. "You're always welcome back for tea, auntie." "I know dear. And get a little sun on you, goodness your father would give you such a pinch for getting this pale." The quadrupedal death machine fidgets and squirms. "It's scary out there." Ashe's laughter is silken smooth in your head, and you'd swear — just for a moment — that Kaina was your niece, and you nod along in overprotective sympathy. "It'll be fine, you're a big strong girl and I'm incredibly proud of you. I'll make sure we visit, and [pc.name]'s children and I will visit. Over and over, to check on sweet Kaina and be sure that she's taking care of herself." Kaina pouts, releasing the mace at last and letting a slow, shuddering breath whistle through her teeth. "I'll try, I'll try..." "Good girl," you and Ashe say in tandem... okay perhaps you shouldn't cross [silly |the streams |contaminate ] mental communication through this thing in the future.
rows.translation: 你有关于阿什阿姨的消息吗？”凯娜从枕头堆中坐起来，眼睛瞪得大大的。“她……她现在怎么样了？” 你微微一皱眉头，然后拿出了那把蕴含着龙之灵魂的精美战锤。“你认得这个吗？” 这只龙人好奇地吐了吐长舌头，然后站了起来，以它那特有的重型步伐走过来，接过了那把武器。 嗯……这个味道好像很熟悉，这种颜色我也见过；阿姨就有这样一套衣服，应该是她某个朋友送她的吧。那么，这件衣服应该是她的吧？” 你正准备回答，她突然停住了动作，只有她的尾巴剧烈地摆动着，把几个枕头都甩到了天花板上。 阿姨？” 啊……当然，她是在直接跟阿姨说话。不过，自己并没有参与到这个对话中，这种感觉实在很尴尬，显然阿姨也注意到了这一点。“哦，嗯……请过来一下。 [pc.name]凯娜朝你伸出了手部，当你靠近 enough时，她也将你的手部放在了剑柄上。” “好多了，”阿什轻声说道，“我真的很抱歉，凯娜……我没能为我们的家庭尽到责任。不…阿姨…” “是真的，我确实被自己的私事分散了注意力。有很长一段时间，我都是躺在那儿…醒着的，而这样的时间足够让人陷入很多思考。我很想念你们，也很想念你们的父母。 真是太遗憾了。” 显然，这场谈话很快就会变成一场自怨自艾的场合，于是你清了清嗓子说道：“这显然不是你的错，没必要为此而烦恼。” 阿什的形象在你脑海中消失了好一会儿，凯娜大概也是同样的感觉——那个可怜的女孩看起来快要哭出来了。 我应该解释一下发生了什么，对吧？我想现在后悔也已经太晚了，”阿什的声音温暖而令人安心，听到这些话，凯娜的尾巴便缠在了你的腰上。“我死了，说实话，那已经是很久很久以前的事了。……这段时间，我真的是一直在煎熬中度过。” 凯娜静静地听着，仿佛通过那根承载着她阿姨灵魂的权杖，与你紧紧相连。你偶尔会轻轻抚摸她的尾巴，而这只拥有蓝色鳞片的龙兽也做得非常出色——它成功地抑制住了自己的抽泣声。 再次听这个故事，并不会让它变得不那么有趣或感人。 [pc.dcb |眼睛里噙着泪水，显得既尴尬又令人难过 |令人动容或令人沮丧 |超级难过 ]说实话，你只是庆幸那个可怜的女孩没有像你一样看到艾什的真面目；她永远会记得她的阿姨是那只光彩照人、金光闪闪的龙。 最终，谈话的方向从艾什转向了你。“是的， [pc.mf |他 |她 ] 基本上，是你救了我。我想继续留在你身边。 [pc.mf |他 |她 ]并加以守护 [pc.mf |他的 |她 ] 后代们。” 凯娜深吸一口气，擦了擦眼角，然后紧紧地靠向你，差点把你撞倒。“阿姨，您随时都可以再来喝茶哦。” “我知道的，亲爱的。你也该多晒晒太阳，不然你爸爸看到你这么苍白，肯定会狠狠地责骂你的。” 那头四足的死亡机器不停地扭动、挣扎。“外面的环境太可怕了……” 阿什的笑声在你耳边回荡，那声音柔和而悦耳。有那么一瞬间，你甚至觉得凯娜…… 你的 你放心，你是个坚强勇敢的女孩，我为你感到无比骄傲。我会确保我们一定去探望他的。 [pc.name]我会带着孩子们再去看看她。一次又一次地去，看看可爱的凯娜，确保她一切都好。” 凯娜撅了撅嘴，终于放下了那根钉头锤，然后缓缓地、颤抖着吐出一口气：“我会努力的，真的会……” “好孩子。”你和阿什异口同声地说……不过，也许你们真的不应该这样劝她。 [silly |这些直播流 |污染 ] 未来，人们可以通过这个装置进行心灵交流。

rows.original:
Kaina looks almost embarrassed to see you in this state, twiddling her fingers while her massive hind claws stompy-stomp at the ground. "That's so not fair."

rows.original: The harsh, inhospitable environment of the glacial rift slows your progress in any direction — the lack of landmarks tends to veer one off course, while the constant white of snow and ice threatens snow blindness if ignored for too long. Navigation and orienteering are tenuous at best, but by sheer grit and a bit of luck you're able to explore enough to be confident in finding your way around this portion of the rift and its immediate surroundings. Well, confident is perhaps a little too brazen... but at least you won't get hopelessly lost.
rows.translation: 冰川裂谷中严酷且不适宜生存的环境会阻碍你向任何方向前进——缺乏地标很容易使你偏离路线，而持续不断的冰雪白色光线若长时间不加以注意，还会导致雪盲。 导航和定向能力充其量也只能说算一般，但凭借坚定的毅力和一点点运气，你还是能够探索足够的区域，从而有信心在这片裂隙地带及其周边找到前进的方向。不过，说“有信心”或许有点过于自信了。..但至少你不会迷失方向，陷入无望的境地。
rows.raw: "The harsh, inhospitable environment of the glacial rift slows your progress in any direction — the lack of landmarks tends to veer one off course, while the constant white of snow and ice threatens snow blindness if ignored for too long. Navigation and orienteering are tenuous at best, but by sheer grit and a bit of luck you're able to explore enough to be confident in finding your way around this portion of the rift and its immediate surroundings. Well, confident is perhaps a little too brazen... but at least you won't get hopelessly lost."

rows.original: Where there are no roads, people make them, as the saying goes. While there's no actual path leading you on through the rift, there're nevertheless routes more often used by the local denizens, and you see traces of their passing from time to time: bloodstains, the tracks of sled runners, even a few large footprints. The tracks must be relatively fresh for snow to not have erased them yet, and it's not just one person — or people — who use these invisible paths. Another saying comes to mind: when in Belhar, do as the Belharans do. Following the tracks does indeed yield fruit before they peter out and disappear as you find yourself in new surroundings. Sure, it's still ice and snow, but they're arranged in a different way from where you just were...
rows.translation: 俗话说，没有路，人们就会自己开辟出来。虽然这条裂隙中并没有真正的通道可供通行，但当地居民仍然会使用一些固定的路线，因此你偶尔会看到他们留下的痕迹：血迹、雪橇的足迹，甚至还有一些巨大的脚印。 这些足迹一定还比较新鲜，否则雪早就把它们覆盖掉了。而且，使用这些隐秘路径的并不只是一个人或几个人。 还有另一句俗语：到了贝尔哈尔，就要按照贝尔哈尔人的方式来行事。 沿着这些痕迹前行，确实会在它们逐渐消失之前带来成果，因为你会来到新的环境中。当然，那里依然是冰雪覆盖的地带，但这些冰雪的排列方式有所不同…… 不同 与你刚才所在的位置相比，已经相差甚远了……

The tracks must be relatively fresh for snow to not have erased them yet, and it's not just one person — or people — who use these invisible paths.\n\n Another saying comes to mind: when in Belhar, do as the Belharans do. Following the tracks does indeed yield fruit before they peter out and disappear as you find yourself in new surroundings. Sure, it's still ice and snow, but they're arranged in a different way from where you just were..."

rows.original: Trudging forward, you hit a bank of snowdrifts, each one chest-deep if not more. It takes you some time to find a way through all that with solid enough footing to carry you past, but when you do you come into new, unexplored territory. How you know it's new... you swallow hard when you don't know why you know you've made progress forward, you just do. Imagined or not, this place is doing things to your mind... even if it's helping you in some form or fashion, it's still deeply unsettling.
rows.translation: 你艰难地向前行进，遇到了一片积雪堆，每一堆都至少有你的胸那么高。你花了一些时间才找到一条能够穿过这些积雪的道路，确保自己的脚步足够稳固，能够继续前进。而当你终于穿过这些积雪后，你便来到了一个全新的、尚未被探索过的区域。 如何 你知道这是新东西……当你不知道该怎么做的时候，只会感到一阵紧张。 为什么 你知道自己已经在取得进步了，只要继续坚持下去就好。 无论你是否愿意承认，这个地方确实对你的心理产生了影响……即使它在某种程度上对你有所帮助，这种影响依然会让你感到非常不安。

It takes you some time to find a way through all that with solid enough footing to carry you past, but when you do you come into new, unexplored territory. How you know it's new... you swallow hard when you don't know why you know you've made progress forward, you just do.\n\n Imagined or not, this place is doing things to your mind... even if it's helping you in some form or fashion, it's still deeply unsettling."

rows.original: If you hadn't been looking closely, you'd have missed the entrance to this crevasse into the ice. The gash in the white and blue is angled such that it's all but invisible unless you're looking at it directly from the north — which is hard, given that one usually has one's eyes trained on the ocean this far out onto the sea ice. However, once you know it's there, it couldn't have been more obvious when you think about it. The crevasse itself has a narrow lip, but rapidly expands past the entrance into chambers that can only be described as quite roomy, if one doesn't mind the constant chill of ice. Steps have been cut into the descent and the surface of the ice roughened so as to dissuade one from slipping, clear evidence of intelligent artifice; several of the walls have been smoothed to make the place just marginally more accommodating. The signs of life are far more numerous and clearly not that of the locals — metal instead of bone, cloth and thread instead of hide and pelt. Several empty barrels lie against one of the ice walls, waiting to be filled with... well, you know by now. With how deep the crevasse goes, you get the feeling that it extends some way below sea level; any leak sprung in the walls would result in the entire place filling up fast with freezing ocean water. Still, it's secure enough for these people to use the crevasse as a refuge. [var0 |Now that you know what you're looking for, you see it: a barely visible seam in the ice by the crevasse's rear, illuminated by a faint blue glow. The secret entrance, then... if you're ready, you can force it open and make your way under the sea. |With the lureling and Tollus defeated and the cavity within the ice shelf collapsed, the tunnel that once led in is blocked by several huge ice chunks, a situation that no doubt goes on all the way inside of the once-hollow ice shelf. Tollus has moved on, even if some of his underlings still linger in the area — there's nothing left for you here. |Apart from a couple bedrolls and a hastily thrown-together stone firepit, though, there doesn't seem to be any further signs of habitation within the crevasse. You give the little encampment a thorough look-over, hoping to find some sort of lead on the cultists, but come up short. [party.has quintillus |"This can't be all," Quin says, a large scowl masking the taleer's face as he shuffles through some of the empty barrels and kicks at a bedroll. We know there's more going on here than a couple of bastards up to mischief." So what does he want to do about it? Stake out this place and get Tollus's goons when they return? Knock them around and get them to talk? Quin shakes his head. "No point in that — we'd be wasting time waiting here. I like to go out and find things, rather than wait for them to come to me. That way we get to set our own pace at taking down these bastards." ] If there's more to the cultists' scheming, this doesn't look like where they're doing their dastardly deeds. While you'll have to come back here later to clean up, you should start looking for them about their mischief elsewhere. ]
rows.translation: 如果你没有仔细观察，就会错过这条通向冰层裂缝的入口。这条横贯在白色与蓝色冰面上的裂口呈一定角度，因此除非从北方直接望去，否则几乎无法发现它的存在——而在这种情况下，由于人们通常会将视线投向更远处的海洋，所以也很难注意到它。 然而，一旦你意识到它的存在，仔细想想就会发现，它其实再明显不过了。 这条裂缝的入口处边缘很窄，但一旦进入内部，裂缝会迅速扩展，形成一些空间相当宽敞的洞室——当然，前提是你能忍受那里持续的冰冷气息。 在下坡的路上，人们特意设置了台阶，冰面也被处理得粗糙一些，这样就能有效防止人们滑倒——这些显然都是人为设计的结果；而一些墙壁也被打磨得平整一些，使得这个地方使用起来稍微方便一些。 这些生命迹象的数量要多得多，而且显然不属于当地生物——它们是由金属而非骨头构成的，使用的是布料和线绳而非皮革。有几只空桶靠在冰墙旁，等待被装上东西。嗯，你现在应该已经明白了。鉴于这条裂缝的深度，你会觉得它很可能延伸到海平面以下；如果裂缝的墙壁出现任何渗漏，整个区域很快就会被冰冷的海水淹没。 尽管如此，这个裂缝对于这些人来说仍然是一个足够安全的避难所。 [var0 |现在你知道自己在寻找什么了，你也看到了：在裂缝后方，冰面上有一道几乎看不见的缝隙，那里散发着微弱的蓝光。那就是秘密入口……如果你准备好了，就可以把它打开，然后进入海底世界。 |随着那些低等生物和托卢斯被消灭，冰架内部的空洞也坍塌了，原本通向内部的隧道现在被几块巨大的冰块堵住了。可以肯定，这种情况在整个曾经中空的冰架内部都存在。托卢斯已经离开了，尽管他的一些手下可能还滞留在这个地区——但这里已经没有什么东西可以留给你们了。 |不过，除了几张简易床铺和一个匆忙搭建的石制火坑外，这个裂缝里似乎没有任何其他居住的痕迹。你仔细检查了这个小营地，希望能找到关于那些邪教徒的任何线索，但最终一无所获。 [party.has quintillus |不可能只有这些吧，”奎因说道。他的脸上堆满了愁容，一边在那些空桶间穿行，一边踢着一条睡袋。我们 知道 这里发生的事情可不只是几个混蛋在搞鬼那么简单。” 那么，他打算怎么做呢？在这个地方埋伏，等托卢斯的打手们回来再对付他们？把他们揍一顿，逼他们开口吗？ 奎因摇了摇头：“那样做毫无意义——我们只是在这里浪费时间而已。我更喜欢主动去寻找线索，而不是坐等事情找上我们。这样，我们就可以按照自己的节奏来对付这些混蛋。 ] 如果这些邪教徒的阴谋还有其他隐情，那么这里显然不是他们实施邪恶计划的地方。虽然你之后还得回来清理残局，但你应该去其他地方寻找他们正在搞的鬼把戏。 ]

rows.original: As the walled exit from the Winter City's elevator shaft disappears over the horizon and the icy mountains loom ahead, the air grows colder and colder; it's not just your body that shrinks in on itself to conserve heat within your [pc.armor], but the chill is even managing to get to your mind, slowing your consciousness to a crawl. That's why you don't notice the trio of dark-robed figures standing by the pathway up the mountainside, even though their clothes make them stand out against the whites and grays that dominate the landscape. However, they're preoccupied with their own tasks as well, mugging a couple of barrels bound with cord up the mountain, and it's only when you're almost under them that they notice you and one of them lets out a shout of warning. "It's the meddler![party.has quintillus| And the traitor Quintillus, too!]" [party.has quintillus |"Why, so it is," Quin says, snapping to attention and trying not to let it show that his teeth are chattering. Suited to his taleer figure as his outfit may be, it doesn't do much against the cold. "So, what are you chucklefucks doing up there? You ought to be down here so I can beat the shit out of you." |You snap to attention and raise your head. That was close — if they'd chosen to surprise you instead of raising the alarm, you might've been easily accosted. Damn! You got careless... ] But now that you're alert, there's little doubt that these three are from Tollus's cult — the hooded robes might have a bit more fur and padding stitched into them along with a pelt lining, but they're no doubt the garish uniforms that the demon cult wears. More telling, though, is the fact that they're all sporting transformations of one sort or the other — a pair of large curved horns poking out from the front of one of the hoods, reptilian tails, demonic bat wings — these saps might have been any of the peoples who inhabited the Marches at some point, but Tollus and Kasyrra are turning them into something else altogether, something more suited to their purposes. And they don't appear to mind one bit. "What do we do? We can't fight [party.has quintillus|them|[pc.himHer]] head-on![flags.CQ_CLEAR| Even the Master couldn't beat the meddler!]" "I'm a lover, not a fighter!" You only have moments to react before the trio of cultists hurl the barrels they were carrying up the mountainside down at you and make a break for it; the flimsy wooden containers splinter upon impact on the jagged rocks below, sending a cascade of something gray and viscous down upon [party.combatNames]. Without their burden weighing them down, the trio of cultists leap off the mountainside, leathery wings bursting out of the back of their robes as they sail into the air. [party.has quintillus |"Get down!" Quin yells. The taleer springs into action, bowling into you [party.manyCompanions|and [comp2.name] ]with all of his might, tackling you into the snow. You land into a snowdrift with a soft thud as the gelatinous fluid splashes down onto the frozen gravel not too far from where you were standing, hissing and sizzling like acid as it hits the ground; wisps of mist or maybe smoke rise from the puddle as it slops, oozes, and finally either seeps into the ground or evaporates into a foul-smelling cloud. 但现在你已经注意到了，毫无疑问，这三个人属于托卢斯的邪教组织——那些带兜帽的长袍上可能缝有一些毛皮和衬垫，里面也衬着兽皮，但毫无疑问，这些就是那个恶魔邪教所穿的那些花哨制服。 更值得注意的是，这些生物都发生了某种形式的变异——有的头顶长出了巨大的弯曲角，有的长着爬行动物的尾巴，还有的拥有恶魔般的蝙蝠翅膀。这些生物原本可能是曾经居住在边境地区的各种族群，但托卢斯和卡希拉将它们改造成了完全不同的存在，使它们更符合自己的目的。 他们似乎一点也不在意。 “我们该怎么办？我们不可能打架…… [party.has quintillus|他们|[pc.himHer]] rows.original:
Passage through the glacial rift is hard. No amount of fire, magical or mundane, can stave off the sensation of empty numbness that bites at body and soul; no layer of warm clothing can insulate you from the oppressive presence of the mountains of ice that crushes you beneath their sheer cold grandeur. The entire land itself feels like it's alive, knowing you are not of its fold and bringing itself to bear upon you in the most indirect way possible until you either flee or perish.

    [var0
    |Even so, even though the glaciers and drifts are no match for your indomitable will. When they press in upon you, you push back twice as hard, keeping their imposing presence at bay. They are fine with this; they are immortal and everlasting, while you will eventually tire. Ice and rime move, but they move at their own pace.
    
    You have won for now. For now. They will return.
    |Each step you take bites into your flesh and soul; even though you know your fingers and toes are still working, they cry out that they are numb. The unending glare of [dayNight|sun|moon]light off snow and ice bores into your eyes and threatens to drive you insane. Mountains of madness to the east and west, an ocean of nightmares to the north; you feel your resolve slipping away even though your body claims to be working just fine.
    
    And the voice. [pc.resolveRange 20 60 
    |You feel like someone is always just out of sight, speaking to you — the voice changes but the message doesn't: you're supposed to hurt people, especially those elves with gaudy wings and shining armor. Why won't it go away?!
    |It's like a scratching at the back of your mind, an insidious whispering creeping upon your consciousness. You can only make out a few words, and you don't like them.
    |The voice is unbearably loud; it's hard to think straight with your heart pounding and palms sweating. In moments of delusion, you find yourself talking back to it, yelling at it — but it just keeps shouting, drowning you out with its roaring drone of anguish and hatred!
    ]
    ]
rows.translation:
穿越冰川裂谷是一件极其艰难的事。无论是火焰、魔法还是普通的手段，都无法抵御那种侵蚀身心、令人感到麻木与空虚的感觉；再厚的保暖衣物也无法阻挡那些冰山所带来的压迫感——它们以冰冷而庄严的力量将人压得喘不过气来。整个这片土地仿佛都有生命，它知道你不属于这里，于是会以各种隐晦的方式对你施加压力，直到你要么逃离，要么灭亡。

    [var0
    |即便如此，尽管那些冰川与积雪无法抵挡你那不屈不挠的意志。当它们向你压来时，你会以双倍的力量予以反击，将它们那令人畏惧的力量挡在身后。它们对此并无异议；它们是永恒不灭的，而你终会感到疲惫。冰与霜会移动，但它们总是按照自己的节奏前进。

目前来说，你赢了。但只是暂时而已。它们还会再次回来的。
    |你迈出的每一步都在侵蚀你的肉体与灵魂；尽管你知道自己的手指和脚趾仍在正常活动，它们却仍在哀嚎着表示已经失去了感觉。那无休止的强光…… [dayNight|太阳|月亮]刺眼的冰雪轻型芒直射你的双眼，仿佛要将你逼疯。东边是连绵不断的疯狂山脉，西边则是无边无际的噩梦海洋；尽管你的身体似乎仍在正常运转，但你却感觉到自己的决心正在逐渐消逝。

还有那声音…… [pc.resolveRange 20 60 
    |你总觉得有人就在你视线之外，一直在对你说话——声音变了，但信息却始终没变：你必须伤害别人，尤其是那些长着华丽翅膀、穿着闪亮盔甲的精灵。为什么这种感觉就是挥之不去呢？！
    |这就像有什么东西在你脑海中轻轻挠动，有一种阴险的低语声逐渐侵入你的意识。你只能听清其中寥寥几句话，而那些话让你感到非常不适。
    |这个声音大得让人无法忍受；当你的心脏剧烈跳动、手掌不断出汗时，根本无法保持清醒的头脑。在某些恍惚的时刻，你会发现自己开始回应这个声音，甚至对着它大喊大叫——但它却依然持续不断地咆哮着，用它那充满痛苦与仇恨的噪音彻底淹没你的一切！
    ]
    ]

rows.original: You're passing by a wall of ice when a faint light catches your eye. Part of the wall's face has caved in on itself, exposing a section of glowing ice within — a geode, only of bitter cold instead of stone. Numerous crystals line the interior, and several have broken off into small, easily palmable chunks; you gather a handful of these and are on your way. Oddly enough, while they feel cool, they aren't as cold as you would expect, and don't melt in your grasp, either...
rows.translation: 当你路过一堵冰墙时，一道微弱的轻型芒吸引了你的注意。冰墙的某部分已经坍塌，露出里面一块发轻型的冰——其实就是一个冰晶洞，只不过里面装的不是石头，而是刺骨的寒冰。无数冰晶在洞内排列着，其中还有一些已经断裂成小块，大小正好可以放在手掌中。你捡了几块，然后继续前行。奇怪的是，虽然这些冰块摸起来很凉，但并没有你想象中那么冷，而且放在手里也不会融化……

rows.original:
As you make your way through the rift, you stumble upon the most incongruous sight: a gray heap of dross or slag, still giving off a faint warmth despite the cold. Of course, it looks like it won't stay that way for long, but while it lasts it's a welcome change from the usual sting of bitter chill. Slag from the pale elves' foundries, perhaps — you remember Ryn mentioning somewhere that the Rift is where they get metal, by sluicing the glacial flows for copper and tin ore. While it's worrying that they would just dump their waste out here in the middle of nowhere, your body is still glad for the heat, however fleeting.

    [party.CombatNames] spend a little while warming yoursel[party.hasCompanions|ves|f] up, then prepare to leave when the dross pile finally cools. There're even a few bits of semi-usable copper in the mess — poor quality enough to be overlooked by the foundry workers, perhaps, but still worth something as salvage.
rows.translation:
当你穿过那道裂隙时，偶然看到了一个极其怪异的景象：一堆灰色的废渣或熔渣，尽管周围十分寒冷，却仍在散发着微弱的热量。当然，这种状态不会持续太久，但在这寒冷的环境中，这一幕确实为人们带来了一丝不一样的感受。 这些可能是苍白精灵铸造厂产生的废渣——你应该还记得瑞恩曾经提到过，裂谷地区是他们获取金属的地方，他们通过从冰川流中筛选出铜矿和锡矿来获取这些金属。虽然他们把废渣随意倾倒在这片偏远的地方，确实令人担忧，但至少这些废渣带来的热量还是让你的身体感到些许慰藉，尽管这种温暖只是短暂而已。

    [party.CombatNames] 花点时间让自己暖和起来吧。[party.hasCompanions||f] 等那些废料终于冷却后，就可以准备离开了。在那堆废料中甚至还能找到一些还算能用的铜块——虽然质量太差，可能会被铸造厂的工人忽略，但作为废料回收来说，还是值一些钱的。

rows.original: As you make your way across the sea ice, an ominous rumbling comes from under your feet. You already know what to expect, and have your [pc.weapon] readied by the time the ice explodes upwards in a shower of frigid spray and jagged chunks. Clambering out of holes bored through the ice, a trio of selkies advances upon you, shields and javelins at the ready as they whip their bodies over the ice using their seal halves.[party.hasCompanions | You have barely enough time to rally [party.compNames] to your side | you have barely enough time to fall back into a defensible position ] before they're upon you, stabbing and jabbing — perhaps not with the intent to kill, but clearly determined to drive you off. "Go away! Go away!" they chorus in their melodious voices, the sweet sound completely at odds with the intensity of the violence they're visiting upon you. "You're not welcome here[pc.ra elf |, elf ]!" [party.oneComp cait etheryn arona quintillus |"No! Please, stop!" Cait's pleas fall on deaf ears as the selkies poke and prod at her ample bodily cushioning — thankfully not hard enough to do any actual damage, but enough to be quite uncomfortable. "Why won't you listen?" |Ryn sighs at the sight. "When all this is over, we're going to have a big mess to clean up. And I thought the whole situation with the druids was bad... at least they're willing to listen and negotiate. This is terrible." |"Is that a challenge?" Arons snickers at the sight of the selkie trio wriggling over the ice. "Because damn, it sounds like one to me. Don't get to fuck something like you that often — winner takes all, okay?" |"Airheads," Quin mutters, readying himself as the selkies advance. "But then, you'd have to be a special kind of stupid to imagine the cult as they are now could ever be your friends. Shall we?" ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你踏着海冰前进时，足部下突然传来一阵令人不寒而栗的轰鸣声。你早已预料到会发生什么，因此已经做好了准备。 [pc.weapon] 就在冰层开始向上炸裂，迸发出冰冷的水花和锋利的冰块时，你已经做好了准备。三个海豹女从冰层中钻出的洞穴中爬了出来，她们手持盾牌和标枪，利用自己海豹的身体在冰面上灵活移动，向你袭来。[party.hasCompanions | 你几乎没有足够的时间来重新集结力量了。 [party.compNames] 站在你这一边 | 你几乎没有任何时间可以退回到一个能够自卫的位置。 ] 在他们冲上来之前，他们会用刀刺你、用棍棒打你——或许他们并没有杀人的意图，但显然他们是决心要把你赶走。 “走开！走开！”他们用那悦耳的声音齐声喊道，这种甜美的声音与他们对你施加的暴力的激烈程度形成了鲜明的对比。“你们不受欢迎在这里。[pc.ra elf |精灵 ]!" [party.oneComp cait etheryn arona quintillus |不！求你们了，停下来吧！”凯特的恳求被置若罔闻，那些海妖不断地戳弄她那丰满的身体——幸好他们的动作并没有造成实质性的伤害，但确实让人感到非常不适。“为什么你们就是不听呢？ |瑞恩看到这一幕，不禁叹了口气。“等这一切结束之后，我们将会面临一大堆需要清理的麻烦。我原本还以为德鲁伊们的情况已经够糟糕了……至少他们还愿意倾听我们的意见并进行协商。但这次的事情，实在太可怕了。 |这算是一种挑战吗？”看到那三个海妖在冰面上扭动的身影，阿隆斯冷笑道，“听起来确实像是一种挑战啊。像你们这样的家伙，可不容易有机会遇到这样的机会——胜者通吃，明白吗？ |白痴们，”奎因低声说道，同时做好了应对那些人鱼逼近的准备。“不过，要想认为现在这样的邪教组织会成为你们的朋友，那可真是需要一种特殊的愚蠢才行。我们开始吧？ ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: Crossing the ice shelf, you're suddenly set upon by a sensation of unease; you look around amidst the broken ice and snowdrifts, but don't spot any sign of danger. Was it just your nerves? Even out on the sea ice, the looming presence of the mountains presses in on your mind at all times, coupled with the abyssal depths you know lurk beneath the ice shelf. As you ponder this, though, tremors shake the ice under your feet, tremors that quickly grow as cracks grow in the ice with alarming rapidity. You [party.hasCompanions |shout for [party.compNames] |make ] to run, but it's already too late; the ice underfoot erupts upwards, raining frigid saltwater and chunks of ice all over as a trio of figures explode from the ocean beneath, boring through the ice as though it were nothing. As the spray settles, you're able to take a good look at them: while having human heads, arms and torsos, they have tails where legs would be on a humanoid frame, fat, blubbery seal tails that jiggle and wobble as they emerge from the hole and slink across the ice in your direction. Two of them have bone javelins — no, harpoons, and the sharp ends are decidedly pointed at you as the third speaks. [pc.ra elf |"Get out, elf," the seal-tailed woman says. "This is your first and only warning; we won't be so merciful next time." Are you trespassing on her territory or something? "No. But no longer are your kind wanted in the rift, elf. All of us have suffered your presence here long enough, and the lies you and your goddess have brought with you. Take that back to your kind in the shining city below the glacier, and don't return." You... you can't do that. The demon cult, it's here in the rift, and if you don't — The selkie looks at her sisters, and they share a smile — maybe they were just itching for an excuse to fight you, and you've served it up to them on a silver platter... "We don't know of any cult, but we do know of you and the damage you've done, long-ears. And if you won't leave, we'll just have to persuade you that it's in your interests." |"Turn back for your own safety, [pc.race]," the seal-tailed woman says. "Conflict is coming to this place, and we'd rather not have the uninvolved caught up in it. Whatever business you have so far from your home, it's not important enough that you risk yourself so." On the contrary, it is important enough for you to be up here. If Tollus's demon cult has its way unopposed, it's going to [pc.isDK |be quite the annoyance to you and your plans in the long run |make whatever conflict's brewing up here in the rift worse ] with their corruption. You've pursued them all the way up here to the land's end, and you're not about to stop right now. [party.has etheryn |"You're here to stop corruption, you say," one of the seal-women says with a sneer, swinging the point of her bone javelin over to level it right at Etheryn. "What's this you have with you, then?" Ryn's mouth falls open. "W-what? I-I'm perfectly fine, I — " "The reek of elven corruption clings to you, as it does all your kind, and it's brought us nothing but suffering. We've had enough of you — time for you to leave!" Look, maybe you can talk this through! The corruption you're speaking of isn't Ryn or any other elf, but — well, have they seen any people dressed in dark, hooded robes? Perhaps toting barrels of gray goop around? The trio of selkies soundly ignore you, advancing menacingly on Ryn even as you interpose yourself between them and your elven companion; the points of their bone javelins may appear primitive at a first glance, but they're no less deadly than the finest bronze. "Please — " Ryn begins, but the lead selkie cuts her off. "Enough." Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with. Just having Ryn with you has made things all the worse; it's probably for the best that you didn't mention she's named you Champion of Frost. |"Hey, what're you doing up here? Are you lost? You should be more careful, we almost mistook you for an elf! There's some pretty bad stuff that's about to happen in this place and the likes of you really shouldn't be wandering around unawares!" Actually, you're on an important errand of your own. Have any of them seen black-hooded people anywhere around the rift?" The trio of selkies huddle about each other, chattering in a tongue you don't understand, then the middle one turns back to you with a nod. "Yeah! They're all over the place! Kind of nice people, even if they don't bother us a lot. They look busy a whole bunch of the time. It's not hard to find them, the weird things they wear really make them stand out against the snow and ice. They have their own thing to do, but they've said that once they're finished they might be interested in helping us chase off the elves — guess they don't like the long-ears very much, either!" Look, they mustn't talk to Tollus's cultists any more. They're dangerous people and — "They're not dangerous, they're nice! Even offered to help get rid of the elves for us, like I said! What kind of meanie are you, telling us to not talk to our friends any more?" Look — Before you can say any more, another of the selkies leans over to her sister and whispers something in that tongue of theirs. In the blink of an eye, the trio's friendly demeanour evaporates, their brows creasing and faces growing pouty. "My sister says you smell of the elf city." That's true, but it isn't as she thinks it is — "So you admit it! You're a spy for those horrid creatures, and you don't want us getting any more friends to oppose you and your lot!" Now, that's a leap to — "You're a horrid liar, just like all those elves!" ] ] The seal-woman clears her throat, a short, sharp noise, and her sisters flanking her slither over the ice at you with surprising speed for having a blubbery tail instead of legs, bone javelins at the ready. You're not getting out of this without violence, alas. [party.has etheryn |"Just what have we done to you for your kind to hate us so?" Ryn cries out, but your elven companion's protests are only answered with several short jabs from the seal-womens' bone javelins. ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你穿过冰架时，突然感到一阵不安袭来；你环顾四周，只见碎冰和雪堆，却看不到任何危险的迹象。难道只是自己的神经在作祟吗？即便是在海冰上，那些耸立在远处的山脉也始终令你感到压力，更何况你深知冰架下方潜藏着无底的深渊。就在你思考这些的时候，足部下的冰层开始颤抖，这种震动迅速加剧，冰面上也出现了令人担忧的裂缝…… [party.hasCompanions |为……呐喊助威 [party.compNames] |制作 ] 想要逃跑，但已经为时太晚；足部下的冰层突然向上迸发，冰冷的海水和冰块四处飞溅，与此同时，三个身影从海中冲了出来，他们仿佛能轻易穿透冰层一般，从其中穿了出来。 当雾气散去后，你可以清楚地看到它们：虽然它们拥有人类的头部、手臂和躯干，但在人类身体的部位应该有腿的地方，却长着肥厚的海豹尾巴。这些尾巴在它们从洞穴中钻出来、沿着冰面朝你爬来时，会不停地摆动和颤动。 其中两个人手持骨制标枪——不，应该是鱼叉，而那些锋利的尖端显然都是指向你的。这时，第三个人开口说话了。 [pc.ra elf |滚开，精灵，”那个长着海豹尾巴的女人说道，“这是你第一次也是最后一次得到警告；下次我们可不会这么仁慈了。” 难道我是闯入了她的领地还是怎么回事？ “不，并非如此。但是，精灵，你们的同类已经不再被允许进入这个裂隙了。 我们所有人都已经受够了你的存在，以及你和你的女神带来的那些谎言。把那些东西带回冰川下方那座光芒闪耀的城市里去，永远不要再回来。你不能那么做。那个恶魔教派就藏在裂隙之中，如果你不……” 塞尔基看着她的姐妹们，她们互相笑了笑——也许她们早就想找借口与你战斗了，而你现在正是把这样的机会奉到了她们面前。我们不知道有任何邪教组织，但是…… 做 我早就听说过你，也知道你造成了多大的破坏，那些爱打小报告的家伙。如果你不肯离开，那我们就只能想办法让你明白，离开才是对你最有利的选择。 |为了您的安全，请立即返回。 [pc.race]封尾女子说道，‘冲突即将降临到这个地方，我们不希望那些与此事无关的人也卷入其中。无论你目前离家外出是出于什么原因，都不应该为了这件事而让自己陷入危险。’” 相反， 是 这件事的重要性足以让你亲自出面处理。如果托卢斯的恶魔崇拜团体能够毫无阻碍地为所欲为，那么后果将不堪设想。 [pc.isDK |从长远来看，这肯定会给你和你的计划带来很多麻烦。 |只会让裂隙中正在酝酿的这些冲突变得更加激烈。 ] 由于他们的腐败行为，你一路追查他们，直到这片土地的尽头，而现在你也绝不会停止追查。 [party.has etheryn |你们说是来打击腐败的，”其中一位女海豹猎人冷笑道，将骨制标枪的尖端对准了伊瑟琳，“那你们身上带着这些东西又是为了什么？” 瑞恩张大了嘴巴，一时不知该说什么好。 什、什么？我、我完全没事，我——” “你们身上散发着精灵堕落的恶臭，你们整个种族都是如此，这种气息给我们带来了只有痛苦。我们受够了你们——是时候让你们离开了！听着，也许你们可以好好谈谈这个问题！你所说的那些腐败行为并不是瑞恩或其他精灵们造成的，而是……嗯，他们有没有看到过那些穿着黑色斗篷、拖着装满灰色黏稠物质的桶的人呢？ 那三个人鱼完全无视了你，它们威胁地朝瑞恩冲去，而你则挡在了它们和你的精灵同伴之间。乍一看，它们手中的骨制标枪可能显得十分原始，但实际上，它们的杀伤力丝毫不亚于最精良的青铜武器。 求你……”瑞恩刚开口，那位为首的塞尔基人便打断了她。 “够了。” 该死，他们根本不愿意听任何劝说。有瑞恩在旁边，情况反而变得更糟了；或许你没有提到她任命你为“冰霜勇士”，反而是件好事。 |嘿，你在这里干什么呢？是不是迷路了？可得小心点，我们差点把你当成精灵了呢！这个地方马上就要发生一些非常糟糕的事情，像你这样的人真的不应该在这里随意走动啊！” 其实，你本身也在执行一项重要的任务。有人在裂隙附近看到过戴黑帽的人吗？ 那三个海妖挤在一起，用一种你听不懂的语言叽叽喳喳地交谈着，然后中间那个海妖点了点头，转向你说：“没错！它们到处都是！虽然它们不太会打扰我们，但还算挺不错的生物。 他们大部分时间看起来都很忙碌。找到他们并不难，因为他们穿的那些奇怪衣服在冰雪环境中确实非常显眼。他们各有自己的事情要做，但他们说过，等忙完之后，可能会愿意帮忙我们赶走那些精灵——看来他们也不太喜欢那些长耳朵的生物吧！" 看，他们再也不能和托卢斯的信徒们来往了。那些人很危险，而且—— “他们并不危险，他们人很好！就像我说的，他们甚至主动提出帮我们消灭那些精灵！你这种人真是太刻薄了，居然劝我们不要再和自己的朋友来往了？ 看—— 还没等你说出任何话，另一位人鱼就凑到她妹妹身边，用她们那种特有的语言低声说了些什么。转眼间，这三个人原本友好的表情消失了，她们的眉头紧锁，脸上也露出了不高兴的表情。 我姐姐说你身上有精灵之城的味道。” 确实是这样，但原因并不是她想象的那样…… “所以你承认了！你是那些可怕生物的间谍，你根本不想让我们再交到任何朋友来反对你和你的同伙！ 现在，这可真是…… “你是个糟糕的骗子，和那些精灵们一样！ ] ] 那位身披海豹皮的女性清了清嗓子，发出一声短而尖锐的声音，她身旁的姐妹们也迅速滑向你的方向。尽管她们有着肥厚的尾巴而非双腿，移动速度却出奇地快，手中还握着骨制标枪。唉，看来不发生冲突，你是无法摆脱这个局面的了。 [party.has etheryn |我们到底得到了什么…… 完成 为什么你们要如此憎恨我们？”瑞恩哭喊道，但你的精灵同伴的抗议只换来了封印女人们投掷出的几支骨制标枪。 ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！
