As the spray settles, you're able to take a good look at them: while having human heads, arms and torsos, they have tails where legs would be on a humanoid frame, fat, blubbery seal tails that jiggle and wobble as they emerge from the hole and slink across the ice in your direction. Two of them have bone javelins — no, harpoons, and the sharp ends are decidedly pointed at you as the third speaks. [pc.ra elf |"Get out, elf," the seal-tailed woman says. "This is your first and only warning; we won't be so merciful next time." Are you trespassing on her territory or something? "No. But no longer are your kind wanted in the rift, elf. All of us have suffered your presence here long enough, and the lies you and your goddess have brought with you. Take that back to your kind in the shining city below the glacier, and don't return." You... you can't do that. The demon cult, it's here in the rift, and if you don't — The selkie looks at her sisters, and they share a smile — maybe they were just itching for an excuse to fight you, and you've served it up to them on a silver platter... "We don't know of any cult, but we do know of you and the damage you've done, long-ears. And if you won't leave, we'll just have to persuade you that it's in your interests." |"Turn back for your own safety, [pc.race]," the seal-tailed woman says. "Conflict is coming to this place, and we'd rather not have the uninvolved caught up in it. Whatever business you have so far from your home, it's not important enough that you risk yourself so." On the contrary, it is important enough for you to be up here. If Tollus's demon cult has its way unopposed, it's going to [pc.isDK |be quite the annoyance to you and your plans in the long run |make whatever conflict's brewing up here in the rift worse ] with their corruption. You've pursued them all the way up here to the land's end, and you're not about to stop right now. [party.has etheryn |"You're here to stop corruption, you say," one of the seal-women says with a sneer, swinging the point of her bone javelin over to level it right at Etheryn. "What's this you have with you, then?" Ryn's mouth falls open. "W-what? I-I'm perfectly fine, I — " "The reek of elven corruption clings to you, as it does all your kind, and it's brought us nothing but suffering. We've had enough of you — time for you to leave!" Look, maybe you can talk this through! The corruption you're speaking of isn't Ryn or any other elf, but — well, have they seen any people dressed in dark, hooded robes? Perhaps toting barrels of gray goop around? The trio of selkies soundly ignore you, advancing menacingly on Ryn even as you interpose yourself between them and your elven companion; the points of their bone javelins may appear primitive at a first glance, but they're no less deadly than the finest bronze. "Please — " Ryn begins, but the lead selkie cuts her off. "Enough." Damn it, they're determined not to be reasoned with. Just having Ryn with you has made things all the worse; it's probably for the best that you didn't mention she's named you Champion of Frost. |"Hey, what're you doing up here? Are you lost? You should be more careful, we almost mistook you for an elf! There's some pretty bad stuff that's about to happen in this place and the likes of you really shouldn't be wandering around unawares!" Actually, you're on an important errand of your own. Have any of them seen black-hooded people anywhere around the rift?" The trio of selkies huddle about each other, chattering in a tongue you don't understand, then the middle one turns back to you with a nod. "Yeah! They're all over the place! Kind of nice people, even if they don't bother us a lot. They look busy a whole bunch of the time. It's not hard to find them, the weird things they wear really make them stand out against the snow and ice. They have their own thing to do, but they've said that once they're finished they might be interested in helping us chase off the elves — guess they don't like the long-ears very much, either!" Look, they mustn't talk to Tollus's cultists any more. They're dangerous people and — "They're not dangerous, they're nice! Even offered to help get rid of the elves for us, like I said! What kind of meanie are you, telling us to not talk to our friends any more?" Look — Before you can say any more, another of the selkies leans over to her sister and whispers something in that tongue of theirs. In the blink of an eye, the trio's friendly demeanour evaporates, their brows creasing and faces growing pouty. "My sister says you smell of the elf city." That's true, but it isn't as she thinks it is — "So you admit it! You're a spy for those horrid creatures, and you don't want us getting any more friends to oppose you and your lot!" Now, that's a leap to — "You're a horrid liar, just like all those elves!" ] ] The seal-woman clears her throat, a short, sharp noise, and her sisters flanking her slither over the ice at you with surprising speed for having a blubbery tail instead of legs, bone javelins at the ready. You're not getting out of this without violence, alas. [party.has etheryn |"Just what have we done to you for your kind to hate us so?" Ryn cries out, but your elven companion's protests are only answered with several short jabs from the seal-womens' bone javelins. ] It's a fight! "

rows.original:
"Owwwie!"
    
    The last of the selkies puts up a bit of a struggle, but you push the seal-tailed woman to the ice and kick her bonework shield and javelin out of her reach. Whirling around, you half-expect more to emerge from the holes in the ice, now slowly freezing over, but all is still — for now. Heaving and gasping, their faces flush, the selkies lie limply on the ice, the fight gone out of them. Maybe their hearts weren't in it to begin with, but that's immaterial now.
    
    What, if anything, do you do with them? The area is secure, as far as you can tell; you have a bit of a breather to do something before you have to move on.
    
    [party.has arona
        |"Wouldn't mind trying out one of these beauties," Arona says with a chuckle, reaching down to the curvaceous selkie songstress to grab the seal-tailed woman's tits with one hand and finger her genital slit with the other, eliciting a squeal and shiver. "Heard stories of how they'd wash ashore on the Sailgraves... but never managed to find one myself back home. Hanging out with you sure has its perks, huh?"
    ]
rows.translation:
哎哟！”

最后那名海豹女郎还试图抵抗，但你将她推到了冰面上，同时将她手中的骨制盾牌和标枪踢出了她的攻击范围。你迅速转身，原本还以为那些冰面上的洞穴中会再有东西冒出来，但现在那些洞穴正在慢慢结冰，暂时来看，一切都安静了下来。 他们喘着粗气，面颊通红，无力地躺在冰面上，所有的斗志都已经消失殆尽。也许从一开始，他们就没有真正投入这场战斗，但现在这一切都已经无关紧要了。

那么，你会对他们做些什么呢？ 从这个角度看，这个区域是安全的；在你继续前进之前，你有了一些时间可以稍作休息，做些事情。
    
    [party.has arona
        |我倒想试试这些美妙的东西呢，”阿罗娜笑着说道，她伸手去触碰那位身材曲线的海妖歌手——一只手抓住这位海豹尾女子的胸部，另一只手则轻轻触碰她的私处，这让女子发出了一声尖叫，同时浑身颤抖起来。“我听说过它们会冲上Sailgraves的海岸……但在自己的家乡却从未找到过。能和你在一起，果然有很多好处啊，对吧？
    ]

rows.original:
You give the closest of the selkies a prod with your foot; she lets out what could have been a moan or groan, it's hard to tell with these voluptuous seal-women. Either way, you're satisfied that they're too winded to get up and sneak up on you once you turn your back on them, so it's fine to just leave them lying here and let them reflect on what they've done for a bit.[pc.isDK
            | And if something should happen to them while they're unable to defend themselves... well, that's not your problem.
        ]
        
        Turning around, you set off at a brisk pace across the ice once more. For such a barren place, there certainly are dangers lurking in every direction... 
        [party.oneComp cait etheryn arona
            |
            
            "Their hearts weren't in it," Cait pipes up as she falls in line beside you.
            
            She could tell?
            
            "Yeah. I think they just wanted us gone — this kind of aggression isn't something they're used to. I know it."
            
            You give your pink kitten a long, hard look, and finally shake your head and shrug. Whether their heart was in it or not, whether they were used to casual violence or not, they were in your way and weren't willing to reason. Things could've gone much worse.
            
            "Yeah, I know. I'm just trying to see things from their point of view. C'mon, [pc.name], let's get this whole mess sorted out so that it can be peaceful here once again. Or at least, as peaceful as it'll ever get..." 
            |
            
            "I feel kind of bad having to beat them like this," Ryn says, looking over her shoulder at the beaten selkies. "They weren't really trying to hurt us, they just wanted us gone."
            
            Really? Because you're pretty sure they were trying to stick several sharp pointy ends into you back there. Maybe you just dreamed up the whole thing?
            
            "That's not what I meant, and you know it! I just — "
            
            Yeah, you know what Ryn meant. It's just that you have a job here, and if they're going to stand in your way like that they should be prepared to face the consequences. There're big things going on here, and it's going to take more than just words and a handful of spears to stop you.
            
            Ryn nods, but still looks unhappy about all this.
            |
            
            "Aw, shucks," Arona grumbles as you start away from the gasping selkies. "I was kinda hoping to be able to fuck them good. Then again, it's colder than death's pecker out here — if I let my cock out in this kind of air, it might freeze and fall off. That's how these things work, right?"
            
            Huh?
            
            "That's what Hretha used to tell me, anyways, just after I got it. Huh."
        ]
rows.translation:
你用脚轻轻踢了踢那些海豹女中的一个；她发出了一声可能是呻吟也可能是叹息的声音，这些身材丰满的海豹女实在很难分辨她们到底在表达什么。无论如何，你放心地认为，她们现在肯定气喘吁吁，根本不可能在你转身离开后偷偷接近你，所以你就让她们躺在这里，好好反思一下自己刚才做了什么吧。[pc.isDK
            | 如果他们在无法自卫的情况下遭遇了什么……嗯，那就不是你该关心的问题了。
        ]
        
        你转过身，再次以快速的步伐在冰面上前进。对于这样一个荒芜的地方来说，四周肯定隐藏着各种危险…… 
        [party.oneComp cait etheryn arona
            |
            
            他们根本不是真心的，”凯特边说边站在你旁边排队。

她能看出来吗？

“嗯，我觉得他们只是想让我们离开——这种攻击性行为他们根本不习惯。 我知道。”

你仔细地打量着那只粉红色的小猫，最终摇了摇头，耸了耸肩。无论它们是否真心愿意配合，无论它们是否已经习惯了这种随意的暴力行为，它们就是挡在了你的路上，而且根本不愿意听你的解释。 情况本可能变得更糟。

“是啊，我知道。我只是想试着从他们的角度来理解事情。拜托， [pc.name]让我们把这一切混乱的局面都解决掉，让这里再次恢复平静。至少，让它变得尽可能平静吧…… 
            |
            
            这样把他们打败，我总觉得有点过分，”莱恩边说边回头看了看那些被击败的海豹精。“他们其实并没有想要伤害我们，只是想把我们赶走而已。”

“真的吗？可你很清楚，他们当时可是想用那些尖锐的东西刺伤你的吧。 也许你只是把这一切想象出来的而已？

“我不是这个意思，你心里明白的！我只是——”

是啊，你肯定知道Ryn的意思。只是你在这里有工作，如果他们要这样阻挠你，那就应该准备好承担后果。 这里正在发生一些重大的事情，仅仅依靠言语和几支长矛是远远不够的，无法阻止这一切。

莱恩点了点头，但看起来仍然对这一切感到不满。
            |
            
            哎呀，真倒霉，”当你离开那些喘着气的海妖们时，阿罗娜抱怨道，“我本来还挺希望能和她们好好享受一番的……不过话说回来，这里冷得要命——如果我把老二露在这种空气中，估计会冻掉然后掉下来吧。事情就是这么个道理，对吧？”

“哈？”

“反正赫蕾莎在我得到它之后就是这么跟我说的。哈。
        ]

rows.original: Striding over, you reach for the selkie songstress from between her huntress sisters and grab her by under the arms, hauling her upright so that her gaze is level with yours. She puts up a token resistance, batting feebly at you with her seal half, but you bat her tail away with your knee and shake her roughly. While you don't expect these lackadaisical lasses to have the whole picture of what's going on in the rift, you're going to squeeze them for every scrap of information you can wring out of their blubbery bodies regardless of how reliable it might be; you'll put together the pieces later. "Wha... what do you want?" Well, you have pressing business here in the rift, and you'd be better served knowing just what's going on in the mountains and over the sea ice. "You want to know things? Sure, I know plenty of things, like — " You poke the selkie songstress in the cheek with a warning finger, and she shuts up. No, you want to know things pertinent to your business here, like why does everyone here suddenly have a grudge against the pale elves, and just what kind of offer did the people in robes and hoods make? Maybe she should start from there if she wants to be useful. "The elves... they've been here for two centuries and we've put up with them for as long, but they've gone too far this time! They're throwing horrible things in the water, like, it melts the ice and makes the fish go away! Plus, the warm water attracts all kinds of icky monsters out of the sea trenches... everyone's feeling it! The rift itself, it's finally waking up, the spirits of the ice and glaciers and ocean are waking up and telling us to go in..." Go in where? "Go into the keep the elves built! You can't have missed it, it's on the eastern edge of the mountains, where land meets the ice — it's the dreams, they speak to us then, telling us to go in and drive them out! It's not just us, it's the jotuns, the avanai, the siorcs, everyone has to do it together, because it's only then that we have any chance of finally getting rid of our guests who overstayed their welcome! I — " You tune out the selkie's ramblings and think on her words. A strange emanation intruding upon the dreams of the rift's inhabitants — it's certainly something Kasyrra's proven herself to be capable of, at least on an individual scale. Powerful enough to affect the whole of four entire peoples all at once, though? Something isn't matching up. Neither is Kasyrra personally here, even if her cultists are, and if they're possessed of that kind of power then you're in for a hard time. There's likely to be something more to the puzzle here, a piece or two you haven't found yet; more than one thread is coming together at the same time and it's creating confusion as to what goes where. " — And there I was saying — " You'd like to hear about the cult. "Huh?" The cult! The people who offered to help them fight the elves once they were done with... whatever it is they're doing. "Oh! Uh, I think we first met them when they were interested in a giant squid we'd brought up. Like I said, the elves are causing all kinds of things to rise up from the really deep trenches, and if we were going to fight tooth and limb to protect ourselves we might as well eat them in the bargain, right? So, uh, they came and were really interested in the squid and how big it was, and all the tentacles it had, and wanted to know where it'd come from. So we went and showed them — we didn't really expect land-dwellers to be able to swim that well, but they did and followed us no problems! They gave us a lot of nice stuff in return, food and pretty things and other bits and pieces we can't really get underwater and the avanai are loathe to spare, and said we'd been very helpful, and, uh — " The cultists followed them without issue. "Yeah, I know, right? Most land-dwellers drown or freeze, but they didn't! It was kind of weird and a little scary, really, but they were so nice in giving us all that stuff, so it was ok. And then they said that they'd stop the squids and other bad things from coming out of the trenches, and that once they were done they'd think about helping us drive off the elves, since we'd been so helpful, and — " Seeing as how the selkie's starting to ramble and babble again, you drop her back onto the snow and ice by her sisters, and start trudging away. Maybe you're wrong, but it looks like Tollus and his goons took advantage of the seal-womens' good-nature to hire them as scouts, after a fashion. They were interested in deep-sea creatures, monsters to be specific, and went down into the ocean trenches no problem, not minding the depth, water, or cold. Hmm... [party.has quintillus |"They couldn't do those kinds of things before, I'm sure," Quin says, arms folded. The taleer's been listening quietly behind you throughout all this, quietly taking notes while the selkie babbled on in circles. "Most of the cult's rank and file didn't know how to do any actual magic back then, at least not by themselves. Too busy doing drugs, having fun, and fucking all over the place." Think it might be Kasyrra's doing? "Maybe. Dunno. I doubt that they actually put any effort into learning how to swim or hold their breath, either. So that leaves either big red demon lady doing that to them, or Tollus, the creep. With how the latter appears to be masterminding the operation here, I'd wager it's him." Not that surviving cold seas was part of his magical repertoire before, either. Quin shakes his head again. "No, but he would be motivated enough to learn, borrow, or steal that kind of power if it meant he stood something to gain from it. Man's ambitious, and given what he's already done to pursue his aims this would be small fry in comparison. Come on, [pc.name]. Now more than ever, we've got to figure out what he's up to." ]
rows.translation: 你大步走过去，从那些擅长狩猎的姐妹们中间将那位会唱歌的海豹女子拉了出来，抓住她的手臂将她拉直，让她的视线能与你的对齐。她试图抗性，用她那半只海豹爪无力地朝你挥舞，但你用膝盖将她的尾巴拨开，粗暴地摇晃着她。 虽然你不会指望这些懒散的女孩们能完全了解裂隙中发生的一切，但无论如何你都会从她们那里榨取每一丝可能的信息，无论这些信息有多可靠；之后你再把这些零碎的信息拼凑起来，弄清楚整个事情的来龙去脉。 你……你到底想干什么？” 嗯，你在裂隙这里有紧急的事情要处理，而了解山脉那边以及海冰区域发生了什么，对你来说肯定更有帮助。 “你想知道这些事情？当然，我知道很多事情，比如—— 你用警告的手指戳了戳那位会唱歌的塞尔基女孩的脸颊，她这才闭上了嘴。其实你真正想知道的是一些与你的任务相关的事情，比如为什么这里的所有人突然都对那些苍白精灵怀有敌意，还有那些穿着长袍、戴着兜帽的人究竟提出了什么条件？如果她想真正帮上你的忙，或许应该从这些地方开始讲起。 It's not just us, it's the jotuns, the avanai, the siorcs, everyone has to do it together, because it's only then that we have any chance of finally getting rid of our guests who overstayed their welcome! I — " You tune out the selkie's ramblings and think on her words. rows.original: Join the hunt. You know there's always someone who sticks around afterwards.
rows.translation: 加入这场搜寻吧。你知道，总会有有人在事后留下来继续寻找。
rows.raw: "Join the hunt. You know there's always someone who sticks around afterwards."

rows.original: You aren't up for a hunt right now.
rows.translation: 你现在可没精力去狩猎啊。
rows.raw: "You aren't up for a hunt right now."

rows.original:
"I think I'll pass on hunting this time, but good luck, friends!" you say, declining the group as politely as you can.

    "Very well. Good luck in your own endeavors. If you ever wish to join in the future, we always have room for more," the squad leader replies, giving you a salute before she and her compatriots take flight through the trees toward their quarry.
rows.translation:
这次我就不参与狩猎了，祝各位好运吧！”你礼貌地拒绝了团队的邀请。

[var0
        |"Sure, I can help. What are we hunting?"
        
        [var1
            |"A frost troll," one of the valkyries says, indicating a patch of icy terrain that looks to have huge swaths of dirt and ice carved out of it. "We've cornered one in its temporary den, but that just makes it more dangerous. These things have been breeding like rats lately, and they terrorize the local populations."
            
            [party.randComp arona atugia
                |"Damn! They're like Benny's angry, horny cousins. Awesome! Let's go show them who's boss!" Arona says, hefting her hammer with an excited laugh. 
                |"I've read that it only takes them a month to reach maturity under the right conditions. I wonder if the cultists have been fosterin' those conditions," Atugia says, scrutinizing the distant den. "But regardless, we can't have them messin' with the locals."
                
                She readies her focus, preparing to set out.
            ]
            
            "We're prepared to fight it in the lair, but it'll most likely smell us coming and come out to meet us. We just have to be ready for it," the lead valkyrie explains. 
            
            She smiles, signaling for you and her fellow valkyries to follow. As you trudge closer to the den, you see [pc.bgMulti barbarian scholar
                |the tusk-grooves and other territorial markings typical of large beasts.
                |the tusk-grooves and other territorial markings frost trolls are known for.
                |extra gashes in the ice and dirt that must have come from giant tusks.
            ] 
            
            Sure enough, the monster leaps out of the den before you get close enough to clearly see inside. It's all matted fur and sharp tusk, and its eyes are full of rage. Bulging muscle ripples along every part of its body, and you steel yourself as it roars in anger.
            
            You were prepared, however, and its bellows do nothing to shake your resolve. 
            
            Time to fight!
            |"A great walrus," one of the valkyries answers. "[flags.VALK_WALRUS
                |We got word of another one getting territorial around a herd of selkie.
                |Exposure to natural leylines causes some of the bulls to grow to tremendous sizes. These bulls can often harm the cows, and cause trouble and injuries among the local villages. They also have enough meat and blubber to supplement a week's worth of meals in the palace.
            ]"
            
            [party.has arona
                |"A hunt with actual valkyries? Oh fuck yeah! Here we come, you swimming steaks!" Arona shouts, hefting her hammer and falling in line alongside you. "Wait, we won't be under water, will we?"
                
                Another valkyrie laughs at her question.
            ]
            
            "The big ones love to lounge on the thickest parts of the ice shelf. They spend more time there than the smaller walruses. The scouts confirmed this one in particular is still above the water. Just follow us," she says, indicating for you[party.som
                |
                | and [companion1.name]
                | and your allies
            ] to follow.
            
            As you navigate the ice flows, you see the giant walrus long before it takes notice of you. The thing is massive, and when it finally does notice you it issues a series of angry, baying barks that shake your bones. You and the valkyries ready your weapons, intent to finish this hunt before the beast can cause too much harm.
        ]
        |"Sure! [pc.dcb
            |I'm always up for a good hunt.
            |I'm always up to hunt with [pc.isValk
                |my sisters!
                |a couple valkyries!
            ]
            |I'm, like, ready to [silly
                |turn those walking foodstuffs into burgers!
                |help anytime!
            ]
        ]" you reply, falling in with the troupe as they set off.
        
        [party.has arona
            |"A hunt with actual valkyries? Oh fuck yeah! Here we come, you walking steaks!" Arona shouts, hefting her hammer and falling in line alongside you. She might need to work on the volume, but her enthusiasm is high.
        ]
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |"A hunt? I think I could help. I was too young when [ryn.lowConfidence
                |m-my dad died
                |father died
            ], and I still don't have much practice, but I've gotten really good with [var2
                |this spear
                |my bow
            ]," she says, drawing her weapon as she falls in line alongside you.
        ]
        
        The group walks through the brush and trees, trying to maintain a certain semblance of stealth, until one of the valkyries at the head stops you.
        
        "Listen," she whispers, and you take note of an immense crunching in the brush that's getting closer by the second. "Ready up, we can catch it here!"
        
        The group scatters into the trees, lying in wait as the sound of breaking brush gets closer. You don't have to wait long for the sound's origins to make itself known.
        
        [var3
            |An absolutely massive cave bear lumbers out from behind a particularly thick copse of trees. The thing eclipses the height of an average bear by three lengths at least. When it stands to sniff the air, its head reaches near to the treetops. Looking down, it takes immediate notice of your hunting party. With a menacing growl, it bares its fangs and claws.
            
            You and the hunters are ready when it [silly
                |bears down on you 😉 haha get it bears
                |descends on you
            ], and spring into action.
            |An absolutely massive elk. [flags.VALK_ELK
                |You've seen how big they can get
                |You'd [pc.bg scholar
                    |read accounts
                    |heard stories
                ] about how big they are
            ], but seeing it in person still shocks you. These things are large enough to eat entire branches off the large forest pines, and this one does just that as it plods out from around a particularly thick copse. The icy blue glow of its antlers bathes your entire hunting party in soft light.
            
            When it finally looks down and takes note of your readied hunting party, it snorts menacingly. With one stamp of its mighty hoof, it lowers its antlers and readies to charge.
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |当然，我可以帮忙。我们要猎什么动物呢？
        
        [var1
            |一只霜冻巨魔，”其中一位女武神说道，同时指向一片被冰雪覆盖的地形——那些冰层中似乎还有大片的泥土和冰块被侵蚀出来形成的痕迹。“我们把其中一只困在了它的临时巢穴里，但这反而让它变得更加危险了。最近这些怪物繁殖得像老鼠一样快，它们一直在恐吓当地的居民。
            
            [party.randComp arona atugia
                |该死！他们简直就像本尼那些愤怒又好色的表亲一样……太棒了！我们赶紧去让他们知道谁才是老大吧！”阿罗娜兴奋地笑着说，同时举起了手中的锤子。 
                |我读过资料，说在适当的条件下，它们只需要一个月就能成熟。我想知道那些邪教徒是否一直在创造这样的条件，”阿图吉娅一边说，一边仔细观察着远处的巢穴，“但无论如何，我们都不能让它们影响到当地的居民。”

她调整好自己的状态，准备出发了。
            ]
            
            我们准备在它的巢穴里与它战斗，但它很可能会察觉到我们的到来，然后出来与我们交战。我们只需要做好充分的准备就行了，”那位首席女武神解释道。

她微笑着，示意你和其他女武神跟随着她。当你逐渐靠近那个巢穴时，你看到了…… [pc.bgMulti barbarian scholar
                |那些典型的、用于标记领地的大型野兽的獠牙凹槽以及其他痕迹。
                |长牙凹槽以及其他用于标记领地的特征，正是霜冻巨魔所闻名的特点。
                |冰层和泥土上那些明显的裂痕，肯定是巨型獠牙造成的。
            ] 
            
            果然，在你靠近到足以看清洞穴内部之前，那只怪物就已经从洞穴中冲了出来。它的身体覆盖着浓密的毛发，长着锋利的獠牙，眼中充满了愤怒。它全身肌肉虬结，当你听到它愤怒的咆哮声时，你立刻做好了战斗的准备。

不过，你早已做好了应对的准备，它的咆哮丝毫没有动摇你的决心。

是时候战斗了！
            |一只很棒的海象，”其中一位女武神回答道。[flags.VALK_WALRUS
                |我们得到消息，又有一只动物开始在一群海豹周围争夺领地了。
                |接触天然的能量脉线会使一些公牛长得异常巨大。这些公牛常常会伤害母牛，给当地村庄带来麻烦和伤害。同时，它们的肉和脂肪也足以满足宫殿里一周的食用需求。
            ]"
            
            [party.has arona
                |和真正的女武神一起狩猎？哦，太棒了！我们来了，那些会在水中游动的‘美餐’！”阿罗娜喊道，她举起手中的锤子，然后跟在你身边排好了队。“等等，我们不会在水底下吧？”

另一位女武神听了她的提问，笑了起来。
            ]
            
            那些体型较大的海象喜欢躺在冰架最厚的地方休息。它们在那里待的时间比体型较小的海象要长。侦察员们确认，这只海象现在仍然位于水面上。跟着我们走就行，”她边说边向你指路。[party.som
                |
                | 以及 [companion1.name]
                | 以及你的盟友们
            ] 接下来，请继续阅读。

当你在冰面上移动时，你会远远地看到那只巨大的海象，而它却直到这时才注意到你的存在。那只生物体型庞大，当它终于注意到你时，会发出一连串愤怒的吠叫声，那些声音震得你的骨头都在发颤。你和那些女武神立刻拔出了武器，决心在这只野兽造成更多伤害之前结束这场猎杀。
        ]
        |当然可以！ [pc.dcb
            |我一直都很喜欢参加有趣的搜寻活动。
            |我总是很乐意和……一起出去打猎。 [pc.isValk
                |我的姐妹们！
                |几名女武神！
            ]
            |我已经准备好了。 [silly
                |把那些能走动的“食物”变成汉堡吧！
                |随时都可以寻求帮助！
            ]
        ]你回复道，然后便加入了这支队伍，和他们一起出发了。
        
        [party.has arona
            |能和真正的瓦尔基里一起狩猎？太他妈棒了！来吧，这些行走的‘烤肉’！”阿罗娜喊道，她举起手中的锤子，然后跟在你身后排好了队。她的声音可能有点太大，但她的热情确实十足。
        ]
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |一场狩猎？我想我可以帮忙。我当时还太年轻了…… [ryn.lowConfidence
                |我爸爸去世了。
                |父亲去世了
            ]虽然我还没有太多实践经验，但我已经做得相当不错了。 [var2
                |这支长矛
                |我的弓
            ]就这样，”她说着，拔出武器，然后与你并肩站好队列。
        ]
        
        小队穿过灌木丛和树木，努力保持隐蔽，直到走在最前面的那位女武神突然停下了你。

“听，”她低声说道，这时你注意到灌木丛中传来越来越近的巨大踩踏声。“准备好了，我们可以在这里抓住它！”

小队迅速分散到树林中，潜伏起来。不久之后，发出这些声音的生物终于出现了。
        
        [var3
            |一只体型巨大的洞穴熊从一片特别茂密的树林后面走了出来。它的体型至少是普通熊的三倍。当它站立起来嗅探空气时，它的头部几乎能够触到树梢。向下望去，它立刻注意到了你们的狩猎队。随着一声威胁性的低吼，它露出了獠牙和爪子。

你们和猎人们都已经做好了准备…… [silly
                |压力越来越大，让你喘不过气来呢；）哈哈，就是这种感觉吧。
                |突然降临到你身上
            ]然后立即采取行动。
            |一只体型巨大的麋鹿。 [flags.VALK_ELK
                |你已经看到它们能长到多大了吧。
                |你可能会 [pc.bg scholar
                    |查看账户信息
                    |听说过这些故事。
                ] 关于它们的大小
            ]但亲眼看到这一幕仍然会让你感到震惊。这些生物体型庞大，足以咬断大森林中松树的树枝，而这只家伙就在从一片特别茂密的灌木丛中走出来时，真的这么做了。它那冰蓝色的鹿角散发出的柔和轻型芒，照亮了你们整个狩猎队。

当它终于低下头，注意到你们已经做好了狩猎准备时，它发出了威胁性的哼声。然后，它用自己强有力的蹄子一踏地面，低下鹿角，准备发起冲锋。
        ]
    ]

rows.original: You're fighting an ice troll. It's matted fur and nasty breath make an already ugly monster even more of a hassle to fight.
rows.translation: 你正在与一只冰霜巨魔战斗。它那杂乱的毛发以及恶臭的呼吸，使得这个本就丑陋的怪物变得更加难以对付。
rows.raw: "\n        You're fighting an ice troll. It's matted fur and nasty breath make an already ugly monster even more of a hassle to fight."

rows.original: You're fighting a giant cave bear. It's golden brown fur and sharp claws make for an impressively fearsome beast.
rows.translation: 你正在与一只巨大的洞穴熊战斗。它那金棕色的毛皮和锋利的爪子，让它成为一只令人胆寒的野兽。
rows.raw: "\n        You're fighting a giant cave bear. It's golden brown fur and sharp claws make for an impressively fearsome beast."

rows.original: You're fighting [silly|an ultra|a vetraskorran] elk. Its mighty antlers glow with a soft blue light, and its fur blends easily with the trees around it.
rows.translation: 你正在战斗。 [silly|一款超棒的游戏|阿维拉斯科兰] 麋鹿。它那强有力的鹿角会散发柔和的蓝轻型，它的毛色也与周围的树木融为了一体。
rows.raw: "\n        You're fighting [silly|an ultra|a vetraskorran] elk. Its mighty antlers glow with a soft blue light, and its fur blends easily with the trees around it."

rows.original: You're fighting a giant bull walrus. Its tusks are sharpened to a point, and its eyes are full of territorial rage.

rows.raw: "\n        You're fighting a giant bull walrus. Its tusks are sharpened to a point, and its eyes are full of territorial rage."

rows.original:
It rapidly becomes difficult for you and [pc.isValk
        |your fellow valkyries
        |your valkyrie allies
    ] to keep up with the fight. Despite your combined efforts, the [var0
        |troll
        |beast
    ] bats you aside like nothing more than toys. When none of you can stand any longer, it bounds off into the wilderness in a mad effort to escape. There's no way you'll be able to catch up with it in your state, and those of you with lesser injuries are helping the others get back on their feet. A valkyrie cleric makes her way over to you, healing your bruises with magic and helping you to stand.
    
    "Sometimes the hunts go like this. There's nothing we can do but nurse our wounds and be more prepared for next time. Every loss is a valuable experience. This helps us learn their patterns, so that our next excursion has a better chance at success," she says with a smile.
    
    "We hope this won't dissuade you from joining in next time!" another shouts.
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |It's fine... Next time will be different!
        |Definitely not. We can't win them all, but that just means we'll have to try again.
        |I think I bruised my butt. We'll have to try extra hard next time!
    ]" you say. 
    
    "That's the spirit! Next time we'll get enough [var0
        |ivory to last the carvers a week!
        |meat for a lord's feast!
    ]"
    
    [party.has arona
        |"If I could just have gotten a good hit in, I could've crushed that thing's skull! I still can't believe it just ran away! If a beast in the Sailgraves has you outmatched, you're as good as dead," Arona mutters, rubbing her sore muscles.
    ]
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |"[ryn.lnhConfidence
            |T-that could have gone much worse! I'm g-glad we're all safe and sound. Next time w-we should prepare a bit more, I think,
            |That certainly wasn't the worst way that could have gone! Next time we'll just have to do a little more prep work,
            |Not the worst way it could have gone. I'm still gonna be feeling sore tomorrow, but that's better than being dead. Next time I'm sure we can get it!
        ]" Ryn says, stowing her [var1
            |spear
            |bow
        ].
    ]
    
    The lot of you finish dressing your wounds, and you part ways with your winged compatriots.

rows.original:
[var0
        |The massive troll chokes on one last roar, sweeping out with tusk and claw at opponents it can no longer see. Then, with a final gurgle, it crashes to the ground. When they're sure it's dead, a cheer goes up among the valkyrie squad. They clap you on the back, offering congratulations as they approach the corpse.
        
        "We don't eat troll, but the bones are sturdy and the tusks make excellent ivory," one of them explains as they begin to dress the body. "Animals in the rift, however, will make a feast of the meat before any rot sets in."
        
        You watch them for a while, and then one of the valkyries approaches you with a smile.

The giant huntress regards you with a raised eyebrow, stretching out on the ground like a cat before flipping back up to a crouch. "Perhaps. Maybe next time I teach you, proud thing," She grins, lifting her tail and giving you a parting sight of her femcum slicked thighs as she bounds off. The snowstorm from before picks up around her as she leaves, obscuring her from sight. Wait a second... She didn't return the favor! You sigh, going back to what you were doing a little hornier than you were before. "

rows.original: [flags.RIFT_CULTISTS_MET |It's impossible to miss the cultist band as you cross the frigid reaches of the rift — their dark robes billow constantly in the cold, landward winds that howl through the icy glaciers. In the same way, given how they're specifically hunting for you, it's also impossible for them to miss you, too. It's kind of cathartic in that sense — the knowledge that once your eyes meet, conflict is inevitable. Grabbing their weapons, the demonic cultists drop their pace and sprint across the snow and ice to get at you, lustful, maniac fervor in their gazes. "For Lady Kasyrra and the Master!" [party.oneComp quin cait |"Fanatics," Quintillus says with a sigh and snap of his fingers. "The most useful of the lot, in a sense... and the most disposable. Back in the day, half of that bunch couldn't even hold a normal campfire conversation without going crazy and shitting themselves. Makes sense that they'd be the first to turn themselves into demons. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's take out the trash and be on our way." |"You horrible creeps!" Cait yells back as she readies her [cait.weapon], knuckles whitening from how hard she's gripping it. "You're not getting away, not with everything you've done!" |Completely expendable, implacable and fanatical — the kind you'd send out to hunt someone like you, if you were a cult leader. In a way, the ability of the demon cult to attract such people is really quite impressive. Where is Tollus getting all of them from? ] It's a fight! |Traveling through the rift, you're stopped by the sound of voices coming to you, carried forward by the inland breeze. There's something discordant about them — human but not quite human, either too honeyed or too guttural, and that catches your attention. [party.hasCompanions |Holding up a hand, you signal for [party.compNames] to wait behind you while you scout ahead a little, see who's just around the next snowdrift |While retracing your steps and going around might allow you to avoid these people straight in your path, you'd lose a lot of time finding a way around. Maybe seeing if you can't sneak by them wouldn't be a better idea — assuming they're unfriendly to begin with, of course ]. Using the large mound of snow as cover, you crouch down on all fours and slink closer, try to get a better look at the scene... ...And find it a rather unpleasant one. Similar to the welcoming party you encountered just moments into the glacial rift, you're faced with a handful of demons, all wearing the outfits of Kasyrra's — or more correctly, Tollus's — little cult. Numbering perhaps five or six, they're escorting a wooden sled heaped high with ominous-looking barrels securely lashed to it, making good time for the rough terrain of snow, ice and rock. Given how sparsely they're dressed, barely anything besides the voluminous dark robes, hoods and cloaks so beloved by cults all over across time, it's easy to conclude that they aren't bothered in the last by the bitter cold of the rift. At their head are two large demontaurs, pulling the sled — they might have been centaurs once, but are now almost unrecognisable as such. Two large curled horns sprout from each of their brows, and their horse bodies have become coated with thick purple hide and scales, resembling dragons more than anything. Even though it's less drastic, their human bodies haven't escaped transformation either, some smaller scales pock-marking their skin, which perhaps shouldn't be that shade of purplish-red... So these are demon centaurs, then, or at least ones that've gotten used to their form. [flags.CQ_CLEAR |It looks like Tollus managed to send up a few of his recruits from Harvest Valley all the way here before you went and foiled his plans to subvert the centaurs and bring them under his control |There're supposed to be centaurs down in Harvest Valley... Tollus must be down there recruiting for his cult and sending them to other places around the Marches to do his bidding. While his underlings are present in the rift, he may not be here in person just yet ]. Not to mention the barrels they're carrying, no doubt filled to the brim with the caustic gray goop you encountered in your first run-in with the cultists. There's enough of them that if they were filled with drink, there might be enough to go around a couple busy nights in the Frost Hound, maybe three. This stuff... wherever it's coming from, they're carrying it to the four corners of the rift and... doing whatever it is they're doing with them. Dumping it out and fouling the place, if your first run-in with the cultists was any indication. [party.oneComp quin cait |"Oh, great. It's these assholes again." Quin says from beside you. Wait, you thought you told him to stay back! "I was. Then I realized that it was these bastards, and I'll be damned if I just let you go on up ahead by yourself. If you've forgotten, part of the reason why I'm here with you to begin with is to fight these guys... so don't ask me to hang back when the cult is involved. Wouldn't want to risk missing out on all the fun." |"It's those creeps again!" Cait says from beside you, pouting. Her big blue eyes dart from one demon to the other, her expression struggling between indignant determination and fear. "C'mon, we've got to do something!" Wait, you thought you told her to stay back![silly | She's so dummy thicc, the clapping of her tits and ass will surely give you away! ] "I was going to. Then I realized it was these creeps again... they keep on showing up everywhere there's trouble, [pc.name]. I still haven't given up hope of getting Calla back, so don't ask me to wait things out when the cult's involved. C'mon, let's go beat them up and make them talk!" |This isn't good. It might be possible to hide and let the group pass by, but that wouldn't sit right with you — [pc.isDK |it'd mean you'd passed up a chance to kick these creeps' asses and make them talk, rough them up a bit |just letting them go ahead and do what they're about without even trying to stop them would weigh on your conscience ]. Stealthily, you peek your head over the snowmound again, counting their number and wondering if you could take them on. ] That, alas, is answered by one of their number — a tall and lanky incubus — pulling back the hood of his cloak and concentrating briefly. You feel a pulse of... of something wash over you, and then the demon spreads his wings and points unerringly in your direction. Instantly, the group of demonic cultists drop their lazy, trudging pace and pull out various weapons, heading straight for the snow mound you're hiding behind. Both demontaurs hoof it away, double-timing it with the sled; it's clear they intend to make away while the remainder of the demon cultists stall you. [party.oneComp quin cait |"What the fuck!" Quin exclaims, reaching for his [quin.weapon] once it becomes clear stealth is no longer a recourse. "No one could pull that kind of shenanigans back when I was with them!" No one was a demon when he was with them. "Yeah, well. Guess I'll just have to learn some new tricks myself to keep up with their demon bullshit. Horns and hooves won't protect them from a good ass-kicking." |Cait clutches at her head briefly, rapidly blinking as if clearing her vision. "Eeek! That... [pc.name], are you all right?" Yeah, you're fine; that barely touched you. Looks like the cultists picked up some new tricks when they started growing wings, horns and hooves. If that's what Kasyrra can do for them, you're not surprised a bunch of people are signing up for Tollus's little goon squad. "Well, we'll just have to up our game, too. Like Dad used to say, there aren't any shortcuts to power. If you get given it and it can be taken away from you any moment, you don't really own it." She shakes her head and grips her [cait.weapon] all the tighter. "Here they come, [pc.name]!" |So much for that. The cult wasn't that powerful when you encountered them before... guess Kasyrra really did make good on her promises of power, didn't she? Well, for all the horns, hooves and wings, you'd have been surprised if they didn't learn a new trick or two — it just means you'll have to keep pace with them, that's all. ] "Meddler!" one of the cultists calls out. "We know you're there — Lady Kasyrra has left us very explicit instructions as to how to deal with you if you were to stick your nose in our business again!" Explicit instructions, eh? Would they mind sharing with you just what those instructions were? "Oh, you'll find out soon enough. Get [pc.himHer]!" With the demons thundering across the snow and ice for you, you [party.hasCompanions |call [party.compNames] to your side and ]ready your [pc.weapon]. It's a fight! ]
rows.translation: [flags.RIFT_CULTISTS_MET |当你穿越裂隙中冰冷的区域时，绝对不可能错过那些穿着黑色长袍的狂信者。在那些呼啸着穿过冰川的寒风中，他们的长袍不断飘动。同样地，既然他们是在专门寻找你，那么他们也不可能错过你。 从某种意义上来说，这种体验其实是一种宣泄情绪的方式——当你意识到一旦目光相遇，冲突就不可避免时，那种感觉确实会让人感到一种解脱。那些恶魔般的邪教徒抓起武器，放慢脚步，在冰雪上飞奔着向你扑来，他们的眼中充满了贪婪与疯狂。 为了卡希拉女士和大师！ [party.oneComp quin cait |狂热分子，”昆蒂勒斯叹了口气，打了个响指说道，“从某种意义上说，他们是这群人中最有用的……也是最容易被舍弃的。过去，那群人里有一半的人，甚至无法进行一场普通的篝火谈话，否则就会发疯甚至吓得屁滚尿流。所以他们才会成为第一个变成恶魔的人。 “来吧， [pc.name]我们把垃圾倒掉，然后就可以出发了。 |你们这些可怕的怪物！”凯特边喊边准备行动。 [cait.weapon]她的手指因用力过猛而指关节都发白了。“你不可能逃脱的，毕竟你做了那么多坏事！ |完全可牺牲、冷酷无情且狂热执着——这种人正是邪教领袖会派去追捕同类的对象。从某种意义上说，这个恶魔邪教能够吸引到这样的成员，确实令人印象深刻。Tollus是从哪里找到这些人的呢？ ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！ |当你穿越那道裂隙时，一阵由内陆微风带来的声音吸引了你的注意。这些声音听起来有些不对劲——它们是人类发出的，但又不太像人类的声音，有的过于甜腻，有的则过于粗哑，这种奇怪的感觉让你停下了脚步。 [party.hasCompanions |你举起一只手，示意着…… [party.compNames] 当你先去探路时，有人会留在你身后，看看下一个雪堆后面究竟有什么。 |虽然重新走原来的路线、绕道而行可以让你避开那些挡在你路上的人，但这样会浪费很多时间来寻找绕行路线。或许，试着悄悄从他们身边经过会是个更好的办法——当然，前提是他们本来就不怀好意。 ]利用那大堆积雪作为掩护，你四肢着地悄悄靠近，试图更清楚地观察现场的情况…… ……结果发现，眼前的景象相当令人不悦。就像你在冰川裂谷中刚进入不久时遇到的那个欢迎仪式一样，此刻你面对的也是几只恶魔，它们全都穿着卡希拉——或者更准确地说，是托卢斯——那个小教派的服饰。 他们大概有五六个，正护送着一辆装满那些看起来十分危险的桶子的木制雪橇。这些桶子都被牢牢地绑在雪橇上，因此他们在雪地、冰面和岩石铺就的崎岖路面上行进得相当顺利。从他们穿着的衣物来看——除了那些历代邪教们都非常钟爱的宽大黑袍、兜帽和斗篷之外，几乎没有什么其他衣物——可以很容易地推断出，他们根本不在意裂隙中刺骨的严寒。 走在最前面的是两只体型庞大的拆解兽，它们正在拉动雪橇——这些生物或许曾经是半人半马，但现在已经几乎无法被认出原来的样子了。它们每个人的眉毛上都长着两根巨大的卷曲角，马身的皮肤也覆盖着厚厚的紫色鳞片，看起来更像龙而不是马。虽然变化没有那么剧烈，但它们的人类身体也同样发生了变化，皮肤上分布着一些较小的鳞片，这些鳞片的颜色本不该是这种紫红色的…… 所以，这些应该就是恶魔半人马了，至少是那些已经习惯了这种形态的恶魔半人马。 [flags.CQ_CLEAR |看起来在你破坏了他颠覆半人马并使其屈服于自己的计划之前，托卢斯已经成功地将他从丰收谷招募来的一些新兵送到了这里。 |在丰收谷应该有半人马……托卢斯肯定在那里招募他的信徒，然后将他们派往边境地区的其他地方去执行他的命令。虽然他的手下们都在那个裂隙地带，但他本人可能还没有亲自出现在那里。 ]更不用说他们携带的那些桶了——毫无疑问，那些桶里都装满了你在第一次与那些邪教徒遭遇时见过的那种腐蚀性灰绿色的黏稠物。这些桶的数量非常多，如果里面装的是饮料的话，的话，足够在“霜犬酒馆”酒吧里热闹几个晚上，甚至可能三个晚上都够用。 这些东西……无论它们是从哪里来的，那些人都会把它们带到裂隙的各个角落，然后对它们进行一些未知的操作。如果你第一次与那些邪教徒的遭遇能够说明什么的话，那就是他们在把这些东西倾倒出来，从而污染了这个地方。 [party.oneComp quin cait |哦，太好了。又是这些混蛋。”奎因在你旁边说道。 等等，你刚才不是让他待在后面吗！ “我确实是这么说的。但后来我发现就是这些家伙，所以我绝对不可能让你一个人冲在前头。如果你忘了的话，我当初跟着你来的原因之一就是为了对付这些家伙……所以当涉及到那个邪教组织的时候，别让我留在后面。我可不想错过所有的精彩场面。 |又是那些讨厌的怪物！”凯特站在你旁边，撅着嘴说道。她那双蓝色的大眼睛在那些恶魔们之间来回转动，她的表情既充满了愤怒与决心，又带着恐惧。“快，我们必须想办法才行！” 等等，你明明告诉她要待在后面的啊！[silly | 她的身材实在太火爆了，她那胸部和臀部的晃动肯定会让别人发现你的存在！ ] 我本来是打算这么做的。然后我发现，又是这些讨厌的家伙……每当有麻烦发生的时候，他们总是会出现。 [pc.name]我仍然没有放弃让卡拉回到我身边的希望，所以当那些邪教组织牵涉其中的时候，别让我坐以待毙。来吧，我们一起去揍他们一顿，让他们说出实话！ |这样不行。虽然可以躲起来让那群人过去，但这样做你会觉得心里过不去的。 [pc.isDK |那意味着你错失了机会，没能把这些混蛋打得落花流水、让他们乖乖开口说话，也没能让他们尝到点苦头。 |甚至都不去干涉，让他们随心所欲地做自己想做的事情。 尝试中 阻止他们会让你感到内疚。 ]你悄悄地再次把头探出雪堆之外，数了数他们的数量，心里也在琢磨着自己是否有能力与他们对抗。 ] 唉，这个问题由他们中的一位回答了——一个高大瘦削的梦魔。他拉下了斗篷的兜帽，短暂地集中精神，然后你感受到了一股……某种能量。 某个东西 那种恐惧感突然涌上心头，紧接着那个恶魔展开了翅膀，准确地朝你的方向飞来。瞬间，那些恶魔教徒们放下了懒散的步伐，拔出了各种武器，直冲着你藏身的雪堆冲了过来。而那两只恶魔巨兽也加快了脚步，拖着雪橇一起飞奔，显然它们打算在其他的恶魔教徒牵制你的时候逃走。 [party.oneComp quin cait |搞什么鬼！”奎因惊叫道，同时伸手去拿…… [quin.weapon] 一旦发现隐秘行动已经不再可行时，就会明白这一点。“在我和他们在一起的时候，根本没人能耍那种把戏！” 在他和他们在一起的时候，根本没有人是恶魔。 “好吧，看来我只能自己学习一些新招数，才能跟上他们那些恶魔般的把戏。角和蹄子根本无法让他们免受一顿痛打。 |凯特短暂地捂住头部，快速眨着眼睛，似乎在试图让视线恢复清晰。“哎呀！那…… [pc.name]你没事吧？” “嗯，你放心，那东西几乎没碰到你。看来那些邪教徒在长出翅膀、角和蹄子之后，又学会了新的手段。如果卡希拉对他们来说就能起到这样的作用，那么也就不足为奇了，为什么会有那么多人愿意加入托卢斯的这支小打手队伍呢。 嗯，我们也必须加倍努力才行。就像爸爸以前常说的，力量是没有捷径可走的。如果别人给了你力量，而这种力量又随时可能被夺走，那么你其实并不真正拥有它。”她摇了摇头，紧紧握住了手中的东西。 [cait.weapon] 越来越紧了。“他们来了， [pc.name]!" |就这样吧。你之前遇到那些教派时，他们其实并没有那么强大……看来卡希拉确实兑现了她关于力量的承诺，不是吗？嗯，既然他们拥有那些角、蹄子和翅膀，如果他们没有学会一些新的招数，那你反而会感到惊讶——只不过这意味着你得继续跟他们的步伐保持一致而已。 ] 多管闲事的人！”其中一个邪教徒喊道，“我们知道你在那里——卡希拉女士已经给了我们非常明确的指示，告诉我们如果你再插手我们的事情该如何处理你！” 明确的指示啊？他们会不会愿意告诉你这些指示到底是什么内容呢？ “哦，你很快就会知道的。快走开吧…… [pc.himHer]当恶魔在冰雪之上发出震耳欲聋的吼声，向你袭来时，你…… [party.hasCompanions |呼叫 [party.compNames] 站在你的一边 ]准备好吧 [pc.weapon]. 这是一场激烈的战斗！ ]

It might be possible to hide and let the group pass by, but that wouldn't sit right with you — [pc.isDK |it'd mean you'd passed up a chance to kick these creeps' asses and make them talk, rough them up a bit |just letting them go ahead and do what they're about without even trying to stop them would weigh on your conscience ]. Stealthily, you peek your head over the snowmound again, counting their number and wondering if you could take them on. ] That, alas, is answered by one of their number — a tall and lanky incubus — pulling back the hood of his cloak and concentrating briefly. You feel a pulse of... of something wash over you, and then the demon spreads his wings and points unerringly in your direction. Instantly, the group of demonic cultists drop their lazy, trudging pace and pull out various weapons, heading straight for the snow mound you're hiding behind. Both demontaurs hoof it away, double-timing it with the sled; it's clear they intend to make away while the remainder of the demon cultists stall you. [party.oneComp quin cait |"What the fuck!" Quin exclaims, reaching for his [quin.weapon] once it becomes clear stealth is no longer a recourse. "No one could pull that kind of shenanigans back when I was with them!" No one was a demon when he was with them. "Yeah, well. Guess I'll just have to learn some new tricks myself to keep up with their demon bullshit. Horns and hooves won't protect them from a good ass-kicking." |Cait clutches at her head briefly, rapidly blinking as if clearing her vision. "Eeek! That... [pc.name], are you all right?" Yeah, you're fine; that barely touched you. Looks like the cultists picked up some new tricks when they started growing wings, horns and hooves. If that's what Kasyrra can do for them, you're not surprised a bunch of people are signing up for Tollus's little goon squad. "Well, we'll just have to up our game, too. Like Dad used to say, there aren't any shortcuts to power. If you get given it and it can be taken away from you any moment, you don't really own it." She shakes her head and grips her [cait.weapon] all the tighter. "Here they come, [pc.name]!" |So much for that. The cult wasn't that powerful when you encountered them before... guess Kasyrra really did make good on her promises of power, didn't she? Well, for all the horns, hooves and wings, you'd have been surprised if they didn't learn a new trick or two — it just means you'll have to keep pace with them, that's all. ] "Meddler!" one of the cultists calls out. "We know you're there — Lady Kasyrra has left us very explicit instructions as to how to deal with you if you were to stick your nose in our business again!" Explicit instructions, eh? Would they mind sharing with you just what those instructions were? "Oh, you'll find out soon enough. Get [pc.himHer]!" With the demons thundering across the snow and ice for you, you [party.hasCompanions |call [party.compNames] to your side and ]ready your [pc.weapon]. It's a fight! ] "

rows.original:
The last of the dark-robed demons falls to the snow with a heavy crunch, gasping and panting; for all the powers Kasyrra's granted them and what they've gained themselves in the demonification process, they still weren't a match for you. [var0|Even the massive, scaled demontaur has been downed, flanks heaving as he lies on the ice. He's not getting up again anytime soon, that's for sure.]

    For now, you have a little respite, although it's certain that Tollus has more of his underlings lurking behind every rock and in every crevasse, just waiting for you to let down your guard. What, if anything, do you want to do with these demon goons of Tollus's now that you've dealt with them?
rows.translation:
最后那个身穿黑袍的恶魔重重地倒在雪地上，喘着粗气，奄奄一息；尽管卡希拉赋予了他们力量，而且他们在恶魔化的过程中也获得了自身的能力，但他们仍然不是你的对手。 [var0|就连那头庞大而强横的破坏巨兽也被击倒了，它躺在冰面上，身体不断抽搐。可以肯定的是，它在短时间内是不会再站起来了。]

    目前，你们暂时得到了喘息的机会。不过可以肯定的是，托卢斯还有许多手下潜伏在每一块岩石后面、每一条裂缝之中，只等着你们放松警惕。现在既然你们已经解决了这些托卢斯的恶魔走卒，那么对于他们，你们究竟还想做些什么呢？
rows.raw:
"
    The last of the dark-robed demons falls to the snow with a heavy crunch, gasping and panting; for all the powers Kasyrra's granted them and what they've gained themselves in the demonification process, they still weren't a match for you. [var0|Even the massive, scaled demontaur has been downed, flanks heaving as he lies on the ice. He's not getting up again anytime soon, that's for sure.]

    For now, you have a little respite, although it's certain that Tollus has more of his underlings lurking behind every rock and in every crevasse, just waiting for you to let down your guard. What, if anything, do you want to do with these demon goons of Tollus's now that you've dealt with them?
    "

rows.original: Since you went to all the trouble of beating down these cultists, you might as well question them. Stepping over to the nearest robed figure, you start demanding answers about Tollus's operations here in the rift — where he is, what his goals are, what these grunts have been assigned to do and how that ties into both Kasyrra's and Tollus's greater plans. It soon becomes clear that despite their demonic appearance, the cultists are pretty much mushrooms — kept in the dark and fed shit, just enough to keep them doing what they're doing. While the demon cultists are eager to spill the beans, fanatically self-assured in their eventual victory, that selfsame fanaticism means they don't need to know much to take to their tasks with maddened fervor. One portion of the conversation does jump out at you, though... [rand |"The Master? You'll never find him, meddler. If you're fortunate enough, he'll come looking for you." Let him try you — [pc.bg hunter barbarian |you've spent much of your life in the wilderness, and hunting people isn't that much different from hunting beasts. Call it a hunch, but you figure that someone of the likes of Tollus isn't used to roughing it in the woods, or the glaciers as it were |you daresay you're picking up this whole adventuring business really handily ]. A low, guttural laugh. "[flags.CQ_CLEAR |So let's say you do find where the Master is, meddler. Good luck getting to him — the water is cold and the depths are crushing. You wouldn't even have to worry about drowning before you froze." So then, he's underwater, either out in the ocean or the sea ice. "Couldn't tell you. Everything's fuck-all dark that deep down. The Master planned everything so that if you did come along and pressed any of us, we wouldn't be able to tell you shit." But they must have some way of knowing how to get to Tollus's hideout. A shrug. "When we're called... we just know, and we just go. That's all there is to it. Don't ask me how me or any of the others know which direction to start swimming in — we just do, when the time comes." And the cold, dark waters? A grin. "Those aren't any problem for a demon. If you want to get to the Master so badly, why don't you just give in and accept Lady Kasyrra's gifts? She's told us she's more than willing to share them with you." Yeah, thanks but no thanks. [pc.isDK |You'll be doing this your own way, thank you very much. Looking at these losers, all the gifts in the world hasn't helped them very much — power isn't something you buy, borrow, beg or steal, it's something that you are |You're not that desperate to surrender yourself to Kas anytime soon ]. Given that you kicked all of their asses, that's a lot of big talk. "Our defeat is inconsequential. Lady Kasyrra will emerge victorious at the last!" Well, that looks to be that. Assuming this freak is telling the truth, though, Tollus is deep under the sea, protected by the cold and pressure of the dark depths. It's not a bad defense, truth be told, but he has to have some way of subsisting all that way down inside... there must be some way of getting to him, and you just have to find it. |He's not even in the rift with us, so good luck with that. Did it ever cross your mind that the whole point of having people at your command is so that they can do things for you while you busy yourself elsewhere? Pff, of course not. With a head like this, meddler, I'm not even sure why the Master is so concerned about the likes of you." Big talk, given that you just kicked all of their asses. "Our defeat is inconsequential. Lady Kasyrra will emerge victorious at the last!" Well, that looks to be that. Assuming this freak is telling the truth, though, you're barking up the wrong tree at the moment. Waylaying these cultists may put small dents in Tollus's efforts, but in order to cut the head off the snake you may have to look in another part of the Marches altogether. ] |"What's in the barrels? Just a bunch of fish glue. You know, the stuff you get when you boil a whole bunch of fish skins together and they turn into sticky goop? Really good for sealing cracks — " You [pc.isDK |draw back your palm and give the cultist a resounding slap across the face. Beating this lot into submission has been more tiring than what it's worth, and you really aren't into playing the game of silly buggers right about now |tighten your hold on the cultist's shoulders and give the bastard a good hard shaking. You're not in the mood to play games now ]. For one, fish glue doesn't hiss and sputter when it hits the snow, nor does it give off acrid smoke like some kind of caustic alchemical mixture. That stuff is nasty and vile, and you want to know its origins. "The beast of the deep." Elaborate. "Some kind of fish. Or maybe it's a squid. Or something. We've never actually seen it up front — no one does except for the Master and his most trusted confidants. But it makes this stuff on its body, someone — I don't know who — packs it in the reinforced barrels, and they get sent up top. That's all. We're just here to spread the stuff and dump it all over the rift — the streams are best, but anywhere will do, really." You make a mental note of the fact that the demon cultist didn't mention Kasyrra in the list of people who knew about this beast. Is Tollus keeping things from his ostensible mistress? You wouldn't put it past a creep like him to do just that — there's little doubt that he's chafing really hard at not being the head of his posse any more. And this beast, does it have a name? "Buggered if it has one. Everyone just calls it the lureling. Dunno why, we just do." What does that mean? That doesn't add up — few, if any people have actually seen the beast, but everyone knows to call it that? Did someone pass down the order? "No... we just know. Don't ask why, we just do. That's what it wants to be called... makes it feel like it's a little fearsome instead of being penned up and having its goop scraped off its slimy skin." Inexplicable knowledge. The power, the sensation of a low thrumming drone in the back of your mind ever since you set foot in the rift — a voice speaking to you, although you can only make out a few words at a time, is that it? You don't know. Still, it lends credence to the cultist's story. Stopping the goo from being spread all around the rift is only going to be solved by getting the source — it really does feel like there's no end to Tollus's cultists. No matter how many you beat, there're always more... you'll have to find a way into the cold, dark waters and find this 'lureling' creature — that, and Tollus, if he's there. |"You want to know where Lady Kasyrra went? Why, are you so eager to meet her again? We can get the message across to her if you're that desperate, although I'm not sure when she'll be dropping around again. The Lady comes and goes as she pleases, after all." How about cutting the cheekiness and answering the question? Judging by the response, though, you guess Kasyrra's not in this part of the Marches at the moment. "Oh, she came flying up from the elf city some time ago. Spoke briefly to the Master and some others, then left flying towards the southeast. Oh, such a beautiful sight — to be able to lay eyes upon a figure as perfect as the Dark Lady's is — " All right, that's enough. Hearing someone else sing Kasyrra's praises is disquieting, to say the least. A dark, toothy grin. "Oh, are you jealous, meddler? Perhaps you, too, are starting to feel the draw of her glorious majesty? She's more than willing to accept you into her embrace, should you wish to surrender yourself to her. Why not do so? It feels really, really good, I can personally attest to that." Shut up, you need to think. Southeast... from here, that way lies the minotaur city of Khor'minos, some of the higher peaks in the region, and the rocky shores of the coastlands. You search your mind for any particular reason Kasyrra could have to be interested in that bit of geography, and [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |come up with too many to pinpoint a precise one. The coastlands used to be pretty populated back in the time of the Empire... there's no end of ruins for someone well-versed in artifice like Kasyrra to pick through. That, or Khor'minos... the city aside, there're all kinds of things buried under the mountain. Given your knowledge of the region's history, it's impossible to guess at to precisely what Kasyrra's up to without any further information, not because you don't know anything, but because there's nothing with which to narrow down the possibilities |come up with nothing. Then again, it's not like you had any particular reason to learn the histories of that region before all this happened, so you can't be blamed for knowing nothing about it ]. One way or the other, though, you're not going to be finding Kasyrra here. If you think she's a greater threat than whatever Tollus is up to here in the rift, then you'll have to harry at her heels over there. |"The Lumians? No, they haven't bothered us in the slightest. Spend all their time cooped up in their keep to the east and don't go out that much. If you're hoping to turn them against us, fat chance of that." The demon blows a raspberry at you. Now that's a bit odd. You'd have expected followers of the goddess of the dawn to be all over these guys, itching for a right proper crusade. A sneer. "They haven't done anything for real in over two hundred years. Use it or lose it — they've grown weak, soft and fat. Can't even be bothered to start looking for us like you are, meddler. If they can't even surpass you, that's a pretty harsh indictment of their abilities." Maybe they're busy with something else. "So what if they are? Doesn't matter. Fact is that we still have the run of the rift, and you're not going to be getting any help from those valkyries, meddler. You may as well give up now — you think you can beat all of us?" Well, you just thrashed this bunch to within an inch of their lives, so maybe it would be good if those words were deeply reconsidered, eh? "Doesn't matter. Our work'll be done long before you get through enough of us to make a dent. Maybe we're just out here to give you something to do while the Master works on the real deal. Ever considered that much, fuck[pc.mf |boy |girl ]?" You bristle instinctively, but there is something to what the demon cultist is saying. Tollus's little posse isn't exactly the best at stealth — if nothing else, they're starkly visible against the white and blue of the rift with their black robes and all. Surely the Lumians have some reason other than outright laziness as to why they haven't noticed the cult in their neighborhood and gone out to do some old-fashioned crusading... from what you know, the rift is in a bit of a mess right now, and it could be anything, to be honest. |So, it looks like several of the more devoted members of Tollus's little posse have taken the ticket, as it were... "Lady Kasyrra's gifts have been deeply appreciated by all of the faithful," comes the gleeful reply. "We thought we had power before — but those were mere dregs from the yearly sacrifice. With the Dark Lady through, we have not just tasted, but drunk deeply of the draught — it is such a delightful rush. You would agree too, meddler, if only you simply accepted her embrace. Why would you deny yourself such power?" Let's just say if all it takes for this power of theirs to be defeated is a good one-two, then they never really had much in the way of power to begin with. Aren't you right? "You would be so much stronger as a demon than we are. The Dark Lady would certainly take so much extra care of you than she would mere insects like us." Yeah, whatever. Say... if they're demons now, does that mean that Tollus himself has taken the ticket? "Ah... the Master has begun the process, but not yet completed it. He has magnanimously chosen to delay his own ascendance so that he might better help others along the same path." Yeah, you personally doubt that. Whatever Tollus's reasons for not going full demon quite yet, he's not doing it out of the goodness of his heart. It does raise some questions as to why he's as devoted to the whole concept of demonhood as some of his more fanatical followers are, but that's a question that these goons don't have any answers for. |So, what exactly are their orders with the barrels they've been lugging around? "Dump them." That's all? "Well, we're supposed to find nice spots like streams, open pools, and the like. Open up the barrels and spread the stuff around a bit, make sure it gets evenly covered. But y'know, the air's kind of cold and it's a lot of hard work, so it's easier to just lug them somewhere, tip them over and let them do their stuff. Less effort, same result, everyone wins." Somehow, you doubt that, but you're not about to say that out loud in front of the demon cultist. If Tollus can't be bothered to keep an eye on his minions, his plans getting fouled up by their laziness isn't something you want to get involved with. As the saying goes, never interrupt your enemy when he's in the middle of making a mistake. And they're not careful about it in the least? "The goop doesn't bother us any. The power of the Dark Lady protects us, you see — we are all walking testaments to her strength. That you continue to resist her embrace, meddler — why would you do such a thing to begin with, when the alternative is so sweet?" [flags.CQ_CLEAR |Right. So in essence they're not doing anything new from the shenanigans they were getting up to in Harvest Valley — only this time instead of dumping centaur cum into the water they're fouling it with all this gray goop. Given the way the cult goes about things, though, you can't imagine that the end result's going to be that much different from before. |Right. So in essence, they're going around dumping a bunch of corruptive stuff in the rift. That might explain the behavior of the locals... although given how hostile they're being, you'd imagine they'd be sprouting hooves and horns already. Maybe there's more to all of this than meets the eye... or maybe there isn't. You'd have to learn more about the gray goop that they've been spreading in order to make a better assessment, but getting a workable sample of the stuff is hard. Once it hits anything outside of the barrels it's carried about in, it rapidly starts to sublime into foul miasma... ] ] Well then, thanks for everything — that was a very informative chat you had back there. Dumping the cultist back into the ice with a thump, you dust off your hands and make to leave. It's a small piece of the puzzle, to be sure, but with enough of them you should be able to make some light of what's going on here in the glacial rift. [party.has quin | At length, Quin comes up to your side, falling in step with you, and you give the taleer a quick nod. Think that one was lying back there? "Don't think so," your bunny companion replies. "They don't have the imagination to lie effectively, nor the discretion for such. Not the grunts, at any rate. Yes, there's the whole saying about not underestimating your enemies just to make you feel better about your chances, but let's face it — these aren't the brightest candles in the box." Tollus or Kasyrra could've fed them false information to throw you off, in that case. A shrug. "Sure, but these are the sort to imagine there's no point in lying, since there's nothing you can do to come out ahead, anyway. Nothing's for sure, [pc.name] — you've got to weigh what you get out of these guys with what you already know." Sure, that matches up with your reading of the situation. You'll take what information you can wring out of these grunts with a grain of salt, but not dismiss it entirely, then. They may have been coached or fed false information to throw you off the trail, but then that's circling back to double-guessing yourself, isn't it? ]
rows.translation: 既然你费了那么大劲才打败这些狂信徒，不如直接去问他们吧。你走到最近的那个穿着长袍的人面前，开始要求他们解释托卢斯在裂隙这里的行动计划——他现在在哪里，他的目标是什么，这些喽啰们被派去执行什么任务，以及这些行动与卡希拉和托卢斯的整体计划之间有什么关联。 很快人们就发现，尽管这些邪教徒外表看起来像恶魔，但实际上他们就像蘑菇一样——被蒙在鼓里，只得到足够维持他们当前行为的食物。虽然这些恶魔邪教徒热衷于泄露秘密，并且对自己最终的胜利充满狂热的自信，但正是这种狂热使他们根本不需要了解太多细节，就能以极其狂热的态度去执行他们的任务。 不过，对话中有那么一部分内容确实特别引人注意…… [rand |那位大师？你永远也找不到他的，多管闲事的人。如果你运气好的话，他可能会主动来找你。” 让他来试试看吧—— [pc.bg hunter barbarian |你大半生都在荒野中度过，捕猎人类与捕猎野兽其实并没有太大区别。凭直觉来说，你认为像托卢斯这样的人，应该不太习惯在森林里或是冰川上艰难生存吧。 |你肯定觉得自己把这次冒险活动处理得相当得心应手吧。 ]一种低沉、从喉咙深处发出的笑声。[flags.CQ_CLEAR |那么，假设你是…… 做 去找找那位大师在哪儿吧，爱管闲事的人。祝你好运能找到他——水太冷了，深度也大得令人窒息。在冻死之前，你恐怕连淹死的麻烦都不会有。” 那么，他现在应该在水下，要么在海洋里，要么在海冰下面。 “我也说不准。那么深的地方根本一片漆黑。那位大师把一切都安排得如此精妙，就是为了让你…… 做了 要是他们真的找上我们中的任何一个，我们根本就不知道该告诉他们些什么。” 但他们肯定有办法知道如何找到托卢斯的藏身处。 “只能等他们召唤我们吧。”他耸了耸肩。我们就是知道，然后就行动起来。就是这么简单。别问我或者其他人是怎么知道该朝哪个方向游的——到了该行动的时候，我们就会知道该怎么做。” 那么，那些寒冷而黑暗的水域呢？ 他咧嘴一笑：“对这些恶魔来说，根本不是什么问题。如果你那么渴望见到大师，为什么不干脆接受卡希拉夫人的礼物呢？她已经告诉我们，她非常乐意与你分享这些礼物。 嗯，谢谢，但还是算了吧。 [pc.isDK |你会亲自来做这件事的。 拥有 真的，太感谢你了。看看这些失败者，世界上所有的礼物对他们来说都毫无帮助——力量不是你可以购买、借用、乞求或偷来的东西，它是一种你必须…… 是 |你应该不会那么急于在短时间内向卡斯屈服吧。 ]既然你把他们全都打得落花流水，那这些话也就没什么说服力了。” “我们的失败无关紧要。卡希拉女士最终一定会取得胜利！” 好吧，看来事情就是这样了。 不过，如果这个怪人说的是实话的话，那么托卢斯确实位于海洋深处，那里寒冷的环境和巨大的水压为它提供了保护。说实话，这种防御方式还算不错，但它在那么深的地方，总得有某种方式来维持生存吧。一定有办法能够联系到他，你只需要找到那个方法而已。 |他甚至都没有与我们产生矛盾，所以祝你好运吧。你有没有想过，让别人听你的指挥，其实就是为了让他们在你忙于其他事情的时候能够帮你做事？哼，当然没有想到吧。 长着这么一张嘴，还总爱管闲事……我真不明白为什么大师会这么关心你们这种人。” “说得倒挺响亮，不过你们不就是把他们全都打得落花流水了吗？” “我们的失败根本无关紧要。 卡希拉女士最终一定会取得胜利！” 好吧，看来事情就是这样了。不过，前提是这个怪人说的必须是实话。目前你们找错方向了。拦截这些狂热信徒虽然会对托卢斯的行动造成一些阻碍，但要想从根本上解决问题，或许应该去边境的其他地方寻找线索。 ] |桶里装的是什么？不过是一堆鱼胶而已。你知道的，就是把很多鱼皮煮在一起之后，会变成那种粘稠的物质吧？这种东西用来填补裂缝效果非常好——” 你 [pc.isDK |你收回手掌，狠狠地给了那个狂热信徒一记耳光。让这些家伙屈服实在是一件既费力又毫无意义的事情，此刻你真的没有心情陪这些愚蠢的家伙玩这些把戏。 |紧紧抓住那个邪教徒的肩膀，狠狠地摇晃他一顿。你现在可没心情跟他玩花招。 ]首先，鱼胶落在雪地上时并不会发出嘶嘶声或喷溅现象，也不会像某些腐蚀性的炼金混合物那样释放出刺鼻的烟雾。那种东西实在又恶心又讨厌，人们肯定想知道它的来源。 “深海中的怪物。 某种鱼类吧。或者也可能是鱿鱼之类的。其实我们从来都没有亲眼见过它——除了大师和他最信任的亲信们，没人见过。但是这种生物会在自己身上分泌出某种物质，然后有人——我不知道是谁——会把这些物质装进加固过的桶里，再把它们运到上面去。就这些而已。我们的任务就是把这些物质散布开来，把它们撒到裂隙里去——溪流附近是最好的地点，不过其实随便什么地方都行。 要想阻止这种黏稠物质在裂隙中四处蔓延，就必须找到它的源头——事实上，Tollus的狂信徒似乎永远也消灭不完。无论你消灭了多少人，总会有更多的出现……你必须要找到进入那些寒冷、暗影的水域的方法，找到那个“具有诱惑力的”生物——当然，如果Tollus还在那里的话，也必须把他抓出来。 |你想知道卡希拉小姐去了哪里吗？难道你这么急切地想再见到她吗？如果你真的那么坚持的话，我们可以帮你们把消息传给她，不过我也不确定她什么时候会再来。毕竟，这位小姐来去自如，完全按照她自己的意愿行事。 别这么厚脸皮了，赶紧回答问题吧。不过从你的回答来看，看来卡希拉现在应该不在边境地区的这一带。” rows.raw: " Since you went to all the trouble of beating down these cultists, you might as well question them. Stepping over to the nearest robed figure, you start demanding answers about Tollus's operations here in the rift — where he is, what his goals are, what these grunts have been assigned to do and how that ties into both Kasyrra's and Tollus's greater plans. It soon becomes clear that despite their demonic appearance, the cultists are pretty much mushrooms — kept in the dark and fed shit, just enough to keep them doing what they're doing. While the demon cultists are eager to spill the beans, fanatically self-assured in their eventual victory, that selfsame fanaticism means they don't need to know much to take to their tasks with maddened fervor. One portion of the conversation does jump out at you, though... [rand |"The Master? You'll never find him, meddler. If you're fortunate enough, he'll come looking for you." Let him try you — [pc.bg hunter barbarian |you've spent much of your life in the wilderness, and hunting people isn't that much different from hunting beasts. Call it a hunch, but you figure that someone of the likes of Tollus isn't used to roughing it in the woods, or the glaciers as it were |you daresay you're picking up this whole adventuring business really handily ]. A low, guttural laugh. "[flags.CQ_CLEAR |So let's say you do find where the Master is, meddler. Good luck getting to him — the water is cold and the depths are crushing. You wouldn't even have to worry about drowning before you froze." So then, he's underwater, either out in the ocean or the sea ice. "Couldn't tell you. Everything's fuck-all dark that deep down. The Master planned everything so that if you did come along and pressed any of us, we wouldn't be able to tell you shit." But they must have some way of knowing how to get to Tollus's hideout. A shrug. "When we're called... we just know, and we just go. That's all there is to it. Don't ask me how me or any of the others know which direction to start swimming in — we just do, when the time comes." And the cold, dark waters? A grin. "Those aren't any problem for a demon. If you want to get to the Master so badly, why don't you just give in and accept Lady Kasyrra's gifts? She's told us she's more than willing to share them with you." Yeah, thanks but no thanks. [pc.isDK |You'll be doing this your own way, thank you very much. Looking at these losers, all the gifts in the world hasn't helped them very much — power isn't something you buy, borrow, beg or steal, it's something that you are |You're not that desperate to surrender yourself to Kas anytime soon ]. Given that you kicked all of their asses, that's a lot of big talk. "Our defeat is inconsequential. Lady Kasyrra will emerge victorious at the last!" Well, that looks to be that. Assuming this freak is telling the truth, though, Tollus is deep under the sea, protected by the cold and pressure of the dark depths. It's not a bad defense, truth be told, but he has to have some way of subsisting all that way down inside... there must be some way of getting to him, and you just have to find it. |He's not even in the rift with us, so good luck with that. Did it ever cross your mind that the whole point of having people at your command is so that they can do things for you while you busy yourself elsewhere? Pff, of course not. With a head like this, meddler, I'm not even sure why the Master is so concerned about the likes of you." Big talk, given that you just kicked all of their asses. "Our defeat is inconsequential. Lady Kasyrra will emerge victorious at the last!" Well, that looks to be that. Assuming this freak is telling the truth, though, you're barking up the wrong tree at the moment. Waylaying these cultists may put small dents in Tollus's efforts, but in order to cut the head off the snake you may have to look in another part of the Marches altogether. ] |"What's in the barrels? Just a bunch of fish glue. You know, the stuff you get when you boil a whole bunch of fish skins together and they turn into sticky goop? Really good for sealing cracks — " You [pc.isDK |draw back your palm and give the cultist a resounding slap across the face. Beating this lot into submission has been more tiring than what it's worth, and you really aren't into playing the game of silly buggers right about now |tighten your hold on the cultist's shoulders and give the bastard a good hard shaking. You're not in the mood to play games now ]. For one, fish glue doesn't hiss and sputter when it hits the snow, nor does it give off acrid smoke like some kind of caustic alchemical mixture. That stuff is nasty and vile, and you want to know its origins. "The beast of the deep." Elaborate. "Some kind of fish. Or maybe it's a squid. Or something. We've never actually seen it up front — no one does except for the Master and his most trusted confidants. But it makes this stuff on its body, someone — I don't know who — packs it in the reinforced barrels, and they get sent up top. That's all. We're just here to spread the stuff and dump it all over the rift — the streams are best, but anywhere will do, really." You make a mental note of the fact that the demon cultist didn't mention Kasyrra in the list of people who knew about this beast. Is Tollus keeping things from his ostensible mistress? You wouldn't put it past a creep like him to do just that — there's little doubt that he's chafing really hard at not being the head of his posse any more. And this beast, does it have a name? "Buggered if it has one. Everyone just calls it the lureling. Dunno why, we just do." What does that mean? That doesn't add up — few, if any people have actually seen the beast, but everyone knows to call it that? Did someone pass down the order? "No... we just know. Don't ask why, we just do. That's what it wants to be called... makes it feel like it's a little fearsome instead of being penned up and having its goop scraped off its slimy skin." Inexplicable knowledge. The power, the sensation of a low thrumming drone in the back of your mind ever since you set foot in the rift — a voice speaking to you, although you can only make out a few words at a time, is that it? You don't know. Still, it lends credence to the cultist's story. Stopping the goo from being spread all around the rift is only going to be solved by getting the source — it really does feel like there's no end to Tollus's cultists. No matter how many you beat, there're always more... you'll have to find a way into the cold, dark waters and find this 'lureling' creature — that, and Tollus, if he's there. |"You want to know where Lady Kasyrra went? The Lady comes and goes as she pleases, after all." How about cutting the cheekiness and answering the question? Judging by the response, though, you guess Kasyrra's not in this part of the Marches at the moment. "Oh, she came flying up from the elf city some time ago. Spoke briefly to the Master and some others, then left flying towards the southeast. Oh, such a beautiful sight — to be able to lay eyes upon a figure as perfect as the Dark Lady's is — " All right, that's enough. Hearing someone else sing Kasyrra's praises is disquieting, to say the least. A dark, toothy grin. "Oh, are you jealous, meddler? Perhaps you, too, are starting to feel the draw of her glorious majesty? She's more than willing to accept you into her embrace, should you wish to surrender yourself to her. Why not do so? It feels really, really good, I can personally attest to that." Shut up, you need to think. Southeast... from here, that way lies the minotaur city of Khor'minos, some of the higher peaks in the region, and the rocky shores of the coastlands. That, or Khor'minos... the city aside, there're all kinds of things buried under the mountain. Given your knowledge of the region's history, it's impossible to guess at to precisely what Kasyrra's up to without any further information, not because you don't know anything, but because there's nothing with which to narrow down the possibilities |come up with nothing. If you think she's a greater threat than whatever Tollus is up to here in the rift, then you'll have to harry at her heels over there. |"The Lumians? No, they haven't bothered us in the slightest. Now that's a bit odd. You'd have expected followers of the goddess of the dawn to be all over these guys, itching for a right proper crusade. A sneer. "They haven't done anything for real in over two hundred years. Use it or lose it — they've grown weak, soft and fat. Can't even be bothered to start looking for us like you are, meddler. Well, you just thrashed this bunch to within an inch of their lives, so maybe it would be good if those words were deeply reconsidered, eh? "Doesn't matter. Tollus's little posse isn't exactly the best at stealth — if nothing else, they're starkly visible against the white and blue of the rift with their black robes and all. Even from this distance, [flags.LIULFR_MET|Liulfr|The Glacial Horseman] looms over you, [liulfr.mf|his|her] broad build adding to [liulfr.mf|his|her] already intimidating figure. [liulfr.mf|He|She] is just a little shorter than most of the Jotun you’ve met. Despite the fact that [liulfr.mf|he|she] is almost entirely covered by a heavy fur-lined cloak that’s fraying around the ends, you can still tell that [liulfr.mf|he|she]’s well-muscled, [liulfr.mf|his|her] wide shoulders and trim waist hinting at the tight physique beneath [liulfr.mf|his|her] coat. Lupine hands emerge from the shadows of [liulfr.mf|his|her] cape to clutch at the huge sword in [liulfr.mf|his|her] hands, grip so tight that you’re certain if you could see [liulfr.mf|his|her] skin at the moment, [liulfr.mf|his|her] knuckles would be white with effort. Every once in a while, you can catch the glint of a sharp tooth from within the shadows of [liulfr.mf|his|her] hood, each one as long as your whole hand and as pale as sun-bleached bone.

    Behind him stands [liulfr.mf|his|her] steed, a tall Fjord Horse a little bigger than [flags.LIULFR_MET|Liulfr|the glacial horseman] [liulfr.mf|himself|herself] — its coal-black coat stands in striking contrast to the snow that covers the land around you. Piercing blue eyes stare straight at you, glimmering with aggression and intelligence you haven’t grown to expect from a horse, its giant hooves stamping at the ground in irritation at catching your gaze. If it were possible for a horse to frown, you’re certain it would be scowling at you right now. However, despite its frightening exterior, you also spot countless carefully crafted beads woven into its intricately braided golden mane. Clearly this stallion is just as much of a pet as it is a warhorse.

在他身后，站着…… [liulfr.mf|他的|她] 那匹马是一匹高大的峡湾马，体型比普通马稍大一些。 [flags.LIULFR_MET|利乌尔弗|冰原骑士] [liulfr.mf|他自己|她自己] 它那漆黑的毛色与周围覆盖着雪的土地形成了鲜明的对比。那双锐利的蓝眼睛直直地盯着你，其中闪烁着的攻击性与智慧，让你完全无法预料这是一匹马该有的特质。它那巨大的蹄子因为被你的目光吸引而烦躁地在地上敲打着。 如果马能够皱眉的话，那么现在它肯定正在对你怒目而视。然而，尽管它的外表看起来令人畏惧，你还是能够看到，在它那编织得极为复杂的金色鬃毛中，镶嵌着无数精心制作的小珠子。 显然，这匹种马既可以被当作宠物来饲养，也可以被用作战马。
