"
    Even from this distance, [flags.LIULFR_MET|Liulfr|The Glacial Horseman] looms over you, [liulfr.mf|his|her] broad build adding to [liulfr.mf|his|her] already intimidating figure. [liulfr.mf|He|She] is just a little shorter than most of the Jotun you’ve met. Despite the fact that [liulfr.mf|he|she] is almost entirely covered by a heavy fur-lined cloak that’s fraying around the ends, you can still tell that [liulfr.mf|he|she]’s well-muscled, [liulfr.mf|his|her] wide shoulders and trim waist hinting at the tight physique beneath [liulfr.mf|his|her] coat. Lupine hands emerge from the shadows of [liulfr.mf|his|her] cape to clutch at the huge sword in [liulfr.mf|his|her] hands, grip so tight that you’re certain if you could see [liulfr.mf|his|her] skin at the moment, [liulfr.mf|his|her] knuckles would be white with effort. Every once in a while, you can catch the glint of a sharp tooth from within the shadows of [liulfr.mf|his|her] hood, each one as long as your whole hand and as pale as sun-bleached bone.

    Behind him stands [liulfr.mf|his|her] steed, a tall Fjord Horse a little bigger than [flags.LIULFR_MET|Liulfr|the glacial horseman] [liulfr.mf|himself|herself] — its coal-black coat stands in striking contrast to the snow that covers the land around you. Piercing blue eyes stare straight at you, glimmering with aggression and intelligence you haven’t grown to expect from a horse, its giant hooves stamping at the ground in irritation at catching your gaze. If it were possible for a horse to frown, you’re certain it would be scowling at you right now. However, despite its frightening exterior, you also spot countless carefully crafted beads woven into its intricately braided golden mane. Clearly this stallion is just as much of a pet as it is a warhorse."

rows.original:
With the horseman and his steed down for the count, [party.som
        |you
        |you and your companion
        |your party
    ] approach[party.som|||es] the cloaked form sprawled on the frozen bitterness of the glacial wasteland[flags.LIULFR_MET
        | ready to claim your rightful reward as the winner of this fight
        |, ready to investigate this mystery figure and claim your rightful reward
    ].
    
    Sensing your advance, [flags.LIULFR_MET
        |Liulfr
        |the Glacial Horseman
    ] attempts to get back on his feet, wobbling unsteadily for a single moment before collapsing onto his knees once again.[pc.dcb
        | You watch with amusement as he glares up at you.
        | You watch cautiously, hand drifting to your [pc.weapon] before relaxing again.
        |
    ]
    
    [var0
        |The first things that greet you when you remove his hood are a pair of fluffy wolf ears, folded back against a wild shock of long gray-blond hair. The Glacial Horseman glowers up at you, the expression marring his sharp features. Despite all his posturing, his ears betray the fear that he so obviously feels, flattened as they are against his head. 
        
        "Stop gawking, alright?" He looks away from you, the slightest hint of azure blush coloring his pale cheeks. "You’ve unmasked me! I’m Liulfr and I’m a fucking mongrel! Hoo-fecking-ray for you."
    ]
    
    [liulfr.fucked
        |You pull back Liulfr’s hood, revealing the handsome boyish features you’ve grown to become familiar with. Unlike the first time you met, the half-lupine seems happy enough to see you, even if his scrunched up face of petulant anger doesn’t quite show it. 
        
        "You here to stare or fuck?" he snarls, the thump of his tail against the ground betraying his excitement at the latter option. It seems he realizes that as well, if the blue blush that suddenly colors his face is any indication. With an angry glance at his own behind, the frantic tail wagging stops. However, Liulfr’s face is still a blushing mess of azure that lights up his face. 
        
        "Shut up," he mutters as he sees the amusement written across your face.
    ]
    
    [var1
        |"Alright, alright, I know the drill." In one quick motion, Liulfr’s cloak falls down around him, revealing the wolf-boy’s kneeling form clad in his breastplate and canvas pants, looking up at you expectantly. 
        
        "Y’know, we should just stop fighting altogether. 'm smart enough to know when I’ve been beat." He shrugs.
        
        Liulfr leans back to sit down on the snow now, apparently having accepted his defeat. With a light sigh, he draws his knees to his chest and looks up at you, waiting for whatever it is that you plan to do to him.
    ]
rows.translation:
当骑手与他的坐骑准备进行决斗时， [party.som
        |你
        |你和你的同伴
        |你的团队
    ] 接近[party.som|||es] 那个披着隐秘面纱的身影，横卧在冰川荒原那冰冷的、充满苦涩的土地上。[flags.LIULFR_MET
        | 准备好领取作为这场战斗的胜者应得的奖励吧。
        |准备好去探究这个神秘人物的来历吧，然后去领取你应得的奖励吧。
    ]察觉到你的逼近， [flags.LIULFR_MET
        |利乌尔弗
        |冰原骑士
    ] 他试图重新站稳，但身体摇晃了一下，随后又一次跪倒了下去。[pc.dcb
        | 你饶有兴致地看着他抬头瞪着你。
        | 你小心翼翼地观察着，手不知不觉地伸向了…… [pc.weapon] 在再次放松之前。
        |
    ]
    
    [var0
        |当你掀开他的兜帽时，首先映入眼帘的是一对蓬松的狼耳，它们紧贴着他那一头浓密的长灰金色头发。这位冰原骑士怒视着你，那阴沉的表情破坏了他原本棱角分明的五官。 尽管他故作镇定，但他的耳朵却暴露了他内心所隐藏的恐惧——耳朵紧紧贴在脑袋上，这明显说明他非常害怕。

“别再发呆了，好吗？”他移开了视线，他那苍白的脸颊上浮现出一丝淡淡的粉红。 你们揭露了我的身份！我叫利乌尔弗，其实是个该死的混血儿！去你们的吧！
    ]
    
    [liulfr.fucked
        |你拉开了柳弗的兜帽，露出了那个你早已熟悉了的、俊朗而带有少年气息的面容。与第一次见面时不同，这个有着半狼血统的男孩看起来似乎很高兴见到你，尽管他那副撅着嘴、满脸不高兴的表情并没有完全表现出这一点。 
        
        你是来盯着看的，还是想来干点别的？”它咆哮道，尾巴重重地敲打在地面的声音暴露了它对后一种选择的渴望。从它脸上突然出现的那种红晕来看，它似乎也意识到了这一点。 他愤怒地瞥了一眼自己的尾巴，那只疯狂摇动的尾巴立刻停止了动作。然而，利乌尔弗的脸上依然泛着红晕，那片湛蓝色的皮肤仿佛被点亮了一般。

“闭嘴，”他低声说道，同时看到了你脸上那充满笑意的表情。
    ]
    
    [var1
        |好吧好吧，我知道该怎么做。”柳尔弗迅速地脱下了斗篷，露出了那个狼人男孩跪着的姿势——他穿着胸甲和帆布裤，正满怀期待地抬头看着你。

“你知道的，我们真的应该停止所有的争斗了。 我足够聪明，能够知道自己什么时候被打败了。”他耸了耸肩。

此时，柳尔弗向后靠在雪地上坐下，显然已经接受了自己的失败。他轻轻叹了口气，把膝盖抱在胸前，抬头看着你，等待着你接下来要对他采取的行动。
    ]

rows.original:
You decide to leave, turning around and continuing on your adventure. 
        
        "What? C’mon, really?" Liulfr’s voice calls out from behind you. "D’you know how boring and lonely it gets out here? ... Goddamn it, Sleip, [pc.heShe]’s going."
        
        You hear a string of muttered swears as you set out away from the wolf-boy.
rows.translation:
你决定离开，转身继续你的冒险。

“什么？真的要走吗？”柳尔弗的声音从你身后传来。“你知道外面有多无聊、多孤单吗？……该死的，斯莱普…… [pc.heShe]我们得走了。”

当你离开那个狼人男孩时，耳边传来一连串的低声咒骂声。

[flags.LIULFR_MET |Liulfr |The Glacial Horseman ] lets out an almost childish whoop of joy, jubilantly hopping off of his horse before seemingly remembering his intimidating persona, stalking over to you with heavy steps. With a quick toss of his head, he unveils himself, [flags.LIULFR_MET |revealing the grinning face that you’ve grown to become familiar with, sharp smile and strong jawline looking the same as you remember |revealing a pair of fluffy wolf ears sprouting up from a wild mane of long silver hair, which frames his handsome but boyish face. If it weren’t for the pale blue pallor to his skin and his giant stature, you would question what right he has to call you an outsider. However, it’s clear that this half-lupine also has some Jotun heritage ]. The wolf-boy whistles, a sharp sound that catches the attention of his mount. "Sleip! Why don’t you find your way home, 'kay bud? I think I’m gonna deal with [party.som |this one |these two |these ones ] myself." The steady beat of hoofbeats crunching on icy snow slowly fades into the distance, leaving just [party.som |you and [flags.LIULFR_MET |Liulfr |the Glacial Horseman ] |you, your companion, and the half-lupine |your party and the giant-spawn ] as the sole living creatures for as far as you can see. [party.som |C |Stepping over the prone form of your companion and c |Stepping over your prone party and c ]oming to crouch by your head, the wolf-boy grabs your jaw, lifting your head to appraise you like a jeweler with a priceless diamond. A hungry look comes across his face, sharpening his features into the expression of a predator. [flags.LIULFR_MET | |"My name is Liulfr, and this is my territory." His claws dig into your jawline now, pressing sharp pinpoints of pain into your skin. "So, you tried to invade and got caught. Better figure out some way to pay up." ] [var0 |"The tables have turned, haven’t they?" Liulfr hums, his smile looking far too smug for his own good. With that, he barks out a quick laugh at his own joke, tail wagging in excitement. ]

[flags.LIULFR_TALK
        |"Okay, you know the drill." Is that a smile on Liulfr’s face? He looks away before you can look closer, grabbing his cloak and tossing it around your shoulders. Its heavy weight settles over you, the stitched in furs still holding Liulfr’s warmth and scent, a comforting blend of woodsmoke and leather filling your nose.
        
        "Don’t look at me like that," he grumbles, climbing onto a battered-looking Sleipnir. "Remember the whole 'I don’t wanna be seen with you' thing? This hides you so no one knows you ain’t one of us. And, I heard you southerners get cold up here. I don’t need you passing out on my horse." 
        
        He holds out his hand for you to take, very pointedly looking in another direction. Despite that, you can still see the blue blush blazing across his face. 
        
        Soon enough, [party.som
            |you
            |you and your companion
            |you and your companions
        ] are back in Liulfr’s cave. After hopping off the horse though, the wolf-boy looks up at you, holding up his arms. 
        
        "Look, Sleip said when you got off of him yourself you kicked him. So I’m gonna help you, alright?" 
        
        It doesn’t really look like you can argue with him on this, and the adorable pout on Liulfr’s face is cute enough to be worth it anyways. After catching you, the wolf-boy adjusts his grip [pc.thicknessRange 70
            |
            |with a strained grunt
        ], carrying you over to the pile of furs before slumping down on top of them, still carrying you in his arms. 
        
        "What was it that you wanted to talk about?"
        |"I-really?" Liulfr seems surprised by your request. Eyes darting the surrounding frozen wasteland, he slowly nods, struggling to his feet. 
        
        "Alright, but we’re gonna go to my hideout, okay? Don’t want anyone to see me carousing with [pc.raMulti elf lupine
            |a fuckin’ elf
            |another damn mutt
            |an outsider
        ][party.som
            |
            | and [pc.hisHer] weirdo friend
            | and [pc.hisHer] weirdo friends
        ]."
        
        With some effort[party.has brint
            | and a little help from Brint
            |
        ], Liulfr drags his horse back up, with the beast actually seeming quite rested after its little lay-down in the snow. In a practiced move, the dog-boy hops back onto his steed. Glancing back at you, he sighs and holds out his furred hand. 
        
        "You can ride too. Sleipnir and I appreciate someone who can fight damn well. [party.som
            |
            |Your friend is gonna have to walk though.
            |Your friends are gonna have to walk though.
        ]" He shrugs, pulling you onto the horse with a surprising strength. "Don’t worry, Sleip’ll go slow. We’re all tired here." 
        
        After a few moments of an exceptionally smooth ride, you arrive at a well-hidden opening. Liulfr hops off, leading Sleipnir through the entrance with the reins, the quiet domesticity of the scene almost making you feel like you’re intruding. 
        
        The entrance opens up into a well-made stone den, large enough to be comfortable for even a giant-spawn and his horse. Small lanterns and torches are scattered around the edges, lending the whole cave a warm orange glow. In the center is a pile of furs that Liulfr immediately bee-lines for, settling down on them with an almost childish satisfaction. 
        
        As though he finally remembered that you’re there, he pats the space beside him on the large pelt he’s sitting on.
        
        "C’mon! We don’t have all day."
        
        Sleipnir shoots you a dirty look. Apparently you’ve overstayed your welcome as his cargo.
        
        You carefully make your way down from the horse, wary of the way it’s clearly glaring at you. There was a pretty good chance that if you didn’t get off now, it would decide to buck you off itself. Liulfr sticks his tongue out at you as you walk towards the jumble of furs he’s laying in, as if that would make you walk any faster. Still, he seems to be entertaining himself, no matter how stupid he looks right now. 
        
        Settling down into the pelt pile, you look at the wolf-boy looking at you with bright eyes and a bushy tail, chuckling a little as you remember the melodrama [flags.LIULFR_MET 2|of your first meeting|you just endured]. It seems like this little puppy is nowhere as intimidating as he thinks he is.
    ]

        |好了，你知道该怎么做。”柳尔弗的脸上是不是带着微笑？在你仔细看之前，他已经转开了视线，然后抓起自己的斗篷披在你的肩上。斗篷沉重的重量压在你身上，上面缝制的毛皮依然散发着柳尔弗的温度与气味，那种混合着森林气息与皮革香味的味道令你感到十分舒适。
        
        别用那种眼神看我，”他嘟囔着，爬上了那匹看起来破旧不堪的斯莱普尼尔。“还记得我之前说过‘我不想被人看到和你在一起’吗？这匹马可以把你藏起来，这样就没人会知道你其实不是我们中的一员。而且，我听说你们南方人在这里会很容易感冒的。 我可不需要你在我的马背上昏过去。”

他伸出手让你抓住，同时故意将视线转向别处。尽管如此，你仍然能看到他脸上那抹明显的红晕。 
        
        没过多久， [party.som
            |你
            |你和你的同伴
            |你和你的同伴们
        ] 他们又回到了柳尔弗的洞穴里。不过，在从马背上下来之后，那个狼族男孩抬头看着你，同时举起了双臂。

“看，斯莱普说过，当你自己从它背上下来的时候，你踢了它一足部。所以现在我会帮你，好吗？”

在这种情况下，你似乎确实没有理由跟他争论，而且柳尔弗那副可爱的嘟嘴表情，也实在让人觉得值得这么做。在抓住你之后，那个狼族男孩调整了自己的抓握方式。 [pc.thicknessRange 70
            |
            |伴随着一声吃力的哼声
        ]他将你抱到那堆毛皮上，然后自己也瘫坐在那里，依然把你抱在怀里。

“你本来想谈些什么呢？
        |真的吗？”柳尔弗似乎对你的请求感到惊讶。他的目光在周围冰封的荒原上扫视了一圈，然后缓缓点了点头，努力站了起来。

“好吧，但我们得去我的藏身处，好吗？我可不想让别人看到我和……一起玩乐。 [pc.raMulti elf lupine
            |该死的精灵
            |又是一只该死的杂种狗
            |一个外人
        ][party.som
            |
            | 以及 [pc.hisHer] 那个行为古怪的朋友……
            | 以及 [pc.hisHer] 那些行为古怪的朋友们
        ]只要稍加努力[party.has brint
            | 还有布林特的一点帮助……
            |
        ]柳尔弗把他的马牵了回来，那匹马在雪地里小憩了一会后，看起来确实已经恢复了不少体力。那个狗男孩熟练地跳上了马背，回头看了你一眼，叹了口气，然后伸出了他那覆满毛发的手。

“你也可以上来骑。斯莱普尼尔和我都很需要一个战斗能力很强的人。 [party.som
            |
            |你的朋友得自己走过去才行。
            |你的朋友们就只能走过去了。
        ]他耸了耸肩，以出人意料的力气将你拉上了马。“别担心，斯莱普会走得很慢的。我们大家都很累了。”

经过几分钟极其平稳的骑行，你们终于来到了一个隐蔽得很好的入口处。柳尔弗跳下马，牵着斯莱普尼尔走了进去，眼前的这一幕宁静而温馨，让你几乎觉得自己像是一个不速之客。 
        
        入口处通向一个建造精良的石洞，其空间之大足以让一只巨型生物和它的马匹都能舒适地居住其中。洞穴边缘散布着一些小灯笼和火把，使得整个洞穴呈现出温暖的橙色光芒。在洞穴的正中央，有一堆毛皮，柳尔弗立刻飞奔过去，以一种近乎孩子般的满足感躺在了那些毛皮上。 
        
        仿佛他终于想起你的存在，他在自己坐着的那张巨大的毛皮上拍了拍你旁边的位置。

“快点吧！我们没有一整天的时间。”

斯莱普尼尔恶狠狠地瞪了你一眼。显然，作为他的“货物”，你在这里待得太久了。
        
        你小心翼翼地从马背上下来，留意着那匹马那明显充满敌意的目光。如果你现在不下来，它很可能会突然用后腿踢你下来。当你走向里尔弗堆放在那里的那些毛皮时，它还吐了吐舌头，好像这样就能让你走得更快一些似的。不过，不管现在它看起来有多傻，它似乎还是玩得很开心。 
        
        你躺在毛皮堆里，看着那个狼孩用明亮的眼睛和蓬松的尾巴注视着你，不禁轻笑出声，因为你想起了那一幕戏剧性的场景。 [flags.LIULFR_MET 2|在你们第一次见面时|你刚刚经历了这一切。]看来，这只小狗其实并没有他想象中那么吓人。

rows.original:
"Hm? Oh yeah." Liulfr turns his gaze to you, head tilted to the side. "I wanted to ask you a favor and figured it was weird to do that after trying to beat the shit outta you and losing. Also, like I mentioned, I know when to fold."
    
    He yawns, wrapping a furred arm around your shoulders and pulling you closer to him. His monstrous teeth glint in the light, a sharp contrast to his happily closed eyes and softly wagging tail. 
    
    "I have better things to do with my time than fight with the one person who’d give me the time of day. Surviving out here isn’t exactly all sunshine and rainbows y’know, especially not when you’re trying to avoid those Alliance bastards." Opening his one blue eye to look at you, Liulfr chuckles, shaking out his impressive mane of hair. "I suppose that you’d know about that too. Either way, we could still spar if you’d like, but you can just find me in this cave if you wanna talk or hang out or whatever..."
    
    Judging by the blush that now blazes across his face and the way he trails off, it’s clear that Liulfr’s definition for 'whatever' isn't going to be chaste.

“我的时间可没时间用来和那个唯一会愿意花时间陪我的人吵架。 在这地方生存下去，可没那么容易，尤其是当你还得躲着那些联盟的混蛋们时。”柳尔弗睁开他那只蓝色的眼睛看着你，笑了笑，然后甩了甩自己那令人印象深刻的鬃毛。 我想你也应该知道这件事吧。不管怎样，如果你愿意的话，我们仍然可以切磋一下；不过如果你想聊天、一起待着，或者做些什么别的，只需要来这个洞穴找我就行了……”

从他脸上此刻浮现的红晕，以及他说话时逐渐减弱的语气来看，很明显，对于“些什么别的”，柳弗的理解并不会那么纯洁。

rows.original:
Head tilting as he hears the question, the half-lupine nods, suddenly looking far more serious. 
    
    "I’ve been... banished, or left behind, for lack of a better word." Liulfr pauses to look at you, ears flattened with something that looks like shame. "Sleip and I aren’t doing well out here. Our supplies are already running low, and we don’t want to compete with our people. They’re already struggling enough."
    
    "Before we left, Ma said that I could try to find refuge down south. But," he swallows, eyes flicking away to stare at the floor, "You know what afflicts me, how I look when undressed, how incomplete I am. My body is imperfectly made. Back when I was still with my tribe, I was... strange, even the half-sexed weren’t like me. All I want is to be a new person with a new life. Or, at least, a person who feels whole."
    
    "You don’t even need to worry about me beyond that. I have some stuff I could trade for currency down there, so long as I get some directions to... wherever you’re from, I think I can make it." A small hopeful smile spreads across his lips as he looks up, waiting to hear what you have to say of his request. It seems like he’s asking your help in helping him find a new home and [silly
        |transing his gender
        |changing his body
    ].
